13Mmɔ na Mose ku nwuna ubunkune Yosua báyu ulu na Mose ɔ́kɔ úsie Katɔti kɔbi lili mmɔ. 14Asa na Mose watɔlɔ ni, ɔ́su benengu bammɔ ɔnini, “Bɛsɔ bilie mɛni útédu ka búnwini búbo. Na si ɔdi ku ɔdi bakɛ litemi lɛdi ni, Aaron ku Hur bakya-mii kudɔ mɛni. Bebo kuƒi ka batɛ-ni bete-mii.”
15Uwi ɔni na Mose ɔ́kɔ úsie Sinai kɔbi kɔmmɔ lili ni, liƒlukutu lɛ́ƒɔ kɔbi kɔmmɔ lɛlɔ ƒui. 16Na Unwoti bukeye bonwu búbaƒɔ Sinai kɔbi kɔmmɔ lɛlɔ. Na emeyi aku sɔɔn na liƒlukutu lɛmmɔ lɛ́kya kɔbi kɔmmɔ lɛlɔ mmɔ. Na limeyi maatɛdi ni, Unwoti ɔ́kpali Mose ɔ́siku liƒlukutu lɛmmɔ kemmo. 17Na Israelƒuɔ bani nnye kalɔ baanu teemene ni, Unwoti bukeye bɔmmɔ buse-ma aani ogya bonwu ɔni mɔɔkyula ala na kɔbi kɔmmɔ eli. 18Na Mose úduo liƒlukutu lɛmmɔ kemmo ka ɔ́kɔ úsela kɔbi kɔmmɔ lili. Na ɔ́kya kɔbi kɔmmɔ lɛlɔ emeyi aavlene usien ku ɔƒɛ.

Title: ISRAELƑUƆ BƆLƐ 25
Content:
Katɔti Kevo Akpala
1Amu na Unwoti ɔ́su Mose ɔnini, 2“Kɔ lɛsa te Israelƒuɔ na asu-ma na beti akpala beboku-mi. Na aƒɔ akpala ammɔ ɔdi biala kudɔ eboku-mi kalɛ na ɔ́si-nwu kayi kemmo kalɛ. 3Na akpala ani na adubo bɔƒɔ mmɔ ndi sika ugyiedi ku ɔƒualadi ku abuala egyiedi, 4ku koƒonu linwini adi ani náƒɔ kuye geen na ese aani evete awɔdi, ku buluu ku egyiedi ku ana lidu bamba, ku adi kpɛtɛ kpɛtɛ ku ese linwini, 5ku baƒonu lɛku lɛni na békpeyi na bákya-ni kuvo na lígyie kaduɛ, ku bebuo lɛku bamba ku akasia ligyii kpakplaa, 6ku asogya nnɔmii, ku ugyulo ƒɛƒɛɛ ɔni na baakya likpose nnɔmii kemmo ku oloƒui ƒɛƒɛɛ, 7ku sika atabi udu ɔdi na baalɔ onis ku ana lidu bamba ani na baamana ɔkpane lɛwuku ku lɛdiku lɛni muubi-nwu kayi lɛlɔ.
8“Na aya na batu kevo kedee bete-mi na lilie-ma akɔ. 9Sia anumi na anu ka bátu kevo kedee kamɛni ku kana lɛlɔ ala aani kalɛ na ndubo-ɔ bɔtina pɛpɛɛpɛ.
Bunyimi Adaka Ɔmmɔ
10“Ya na banwi akasia ugyii adaka na beti akasia ugyii ɔni bune mabla aani lɛgba ine na bɔbɛbɛ bɔdi lɛgba inyɔ ku kakɛ na ɔkuku ɔgba unwi ku kakɛ banwi-nwu. 11Na beti sika ugyiedi kede kede banwamana bewi-nwu kama ku kemmo ƒui. Na beti sika ugyiedi babla aani lɛduni bamana libila lɛmmɔ atu. 12Beti sika ugyiedi babla kɔkwɛnimi bakya adaka ɔmmɔ lɛgba ine bɔmmɔ lɛlɔ na ɔƒɛnyi ɔni ku ɔni lɛlɔ. 13Na babwi akasia ligyii gyɔlɔɔ gyɔlɔɔ na bákwa-ni ku sika ugyiedi. 14Na béti ligyii lɛmmɔ bákya kɔkwɛnimi kɔmmɔ eƒi ammɔ kemmo na adaka ɔmmɔ ɔvi ɔni ku ɔni, kalɛ na ɔdia na bataagyu-nwu taasia amangba. 15Na ligyii lɛmmɔ litaakya adaka ɔmmɔ lɛlɔ lɛni kani batada betedie. 16Ɔmmɔ kama ndubuti atabi anyɔ ani lɛlɔ na ɔda bubo etemila asia lite-ɔ na eti-nya akya adaka ɔmmɔ kemmo.
17“Na eti sika ugyiedi abla likpidi bɔkyiɛ liboku libila ete adaka ɔmmɔ. Na nwuna bune bɔdi lɛgba ine, bɔbɛbɛ bɔbla lɛgba inyɔ ku kakɛ na bɔkuku bɔbla ɔgba unwi ku kakɛ. 18Na etu sika ugyiedi abla bebweyi inyɔ bani ndi Kerub alɛ liboku lɛmmɔ atu anyɔ ammɔ lɛlɔ. 19Na unwi ɔlɛ ɔƒɛnyi unwi na ɔkladi lɛnɔ ɔlɛ ɔƒɛnyi ɔkladi lɛlɔ. Nwi libila lɛmmɔ ku Kerub bebweyi bammɔ danku lɛlɔ na ɔsala unwi na benye lɛƒɛnyi inyɔ bɔmmɔ. 20Na aya na bebweyi bammɔ bebimi bana avwi ammɔ bakɔliku katɔ na bana ɔyuli ubi libila lɛmmɔ lɛlɔ. Na aya na bebweyi bammɔ benwini anumi batina lɛlɔ na bana anumi ataanu libila lɛmmɔ. 21Ti ɔda bubo etemila ani na líte-ɔ na asia atabi ammɔ lɛlɔ kya adaka ɔmmɔ kemmo na eti libila lɛmmɔ ebi-nwu kenye. 22Na libila lɛmmɔ katɔ mmɔ kesii kani na bebweyi inyɔ bammɔ balɛ ntɛ ni, mmɔ na ndubo-ɔ butaasiaku na litemi lite-ɔ na asu Israelƒuɔ ɔda ɔni mebo-ma.
23“Ti akasia ugyii bla ala kasiakɔ na une aani lɛgba ɛtɛ, na ɔbɛbɛ aani ɔgba unwi ku kakɛ na ɔkuku aani lɛgba inyɔ ku kakɛ. 24Na eti sika ugyiedi kede kede akwa-nwu lɛlɔ ƒui na eti ɔdi abla aani lɛduni amana-nwu atu. 25Kana ugyii aani lɛkɔkɔ bɔbɛbɛ mana-nwu atu ka mana aani lɛka na eti sika ugyiedi amana-nwu lɛlɔ amana lɛni kani. 26Na abla kɔkwɛnimi ine ada ala kasiakɔ ekpo ene kesii kani na lɛgba lɛmmɔ linye mmɔ. 27Na kɔkwɛnimi kɔmmɔ kɔni kude ala kasiakɔ atu lɛka lɛmmɔ na ɔdia na kɔkwɛnimi kɔmmɔ kɔda ligyii lɛni na badubo buti butaagyu ala kasiakɔ kammɔ taavinku. 28Ti akasia ligyii nwi ligyii lɛmmɔ na eti sika ugyiedi amana-ni lɛlɔ ƒui na beti bataagyu ala kasiakɔ kammɔ. 29Na abla akyami lidu lɛni ndubo-nwu lɛlɔ butaasia ku sika ugyiedi kavɔ. Lɛni kani na akyami ku lɛsii lɛvɔdi lɛni ndubo bɔdia na beteewilimi akpala ku ntɛ akpala ammɔ ƒui ɔlɛka ɔbla sika ugyiedi ala. 30Na eti bodobodo kedee ɔni muusé Unwoti anumi asia ala kasiakɔ kamɛni lɛlɔ na mina anumi uwi ƒui.
Asogya Kasiakɔ Ugyii
31“Bla asogya kasiakɔ ugyii na aya na ɔkywɛne utu-nwu ku sika ugyiedi. Na ɔbla nwuna ɔka ku ugyii ɔni menye ɔka ɔmmɔ lɛlɔ ku amangba kɔgba wɛlɛ wɛlɛ kɔni ndanku lɛɛƒɛɛ lɛni kemmo na badubo egyii anwula butaakya. Na abla-nwu aani kalɛ na kugyii kuusé kalɔ ku bɔta. Na kesii kadi kebimi aani kalɛ ka anwula eebimi na ɔmɛni ƒui ɔdanku ugyii unwi lɛlɔ. 32Bla ugyii ɔmmɔ na akya-nwu amangba kɔgba ɛku, ɛtɛ na kakɛ kenwi na ɛtɛ bamba lɛnɔ na ɔvi ɔkladi. 33Bla lɛɛƒɛɛ udu ɔni nse aani kugyii kɔni baalɔ banii almon anwula na úbimi na ɔɔta na nwuna amadɔ lɛnɔ na eti alɛ ugyii ɔmmɔ amangba lɛlɔ ɛtɛ ɔvi unwi, ɛtɛ ɔvi ɔkladi. 34Na asogya kasiakɔ ugyii ɔmmɔ eli ni, bla almon anwula lɛɛƒɛɛ udu ɔmmɔ ine sia amangba ammɔ akɔ na anwula ammɔ ébimi na nwuna kalɔ kataata ɔwɔdi. 35Na kesii kani mɔɔta mmɔ ni, unwi ɔkya amangba ligyii inyɔ ntɛ unyɔdi lɛnɔ ligyii inyɔ bamba ntɛ na ɔtɛdi lɛnɔ ligyii inyɔ bɔkladi ntɛ. 36Na kesii kani mɔɔta mmɔ ku amangba kɔgba kɔmmɔ ɔlɛka ɔdanku lɛlɔ ɔbla ugyii unwi ku asogya ugyii ɔmmɔ, na ɔdi sika ugyiedi kede kede ƒui.
37“Lɛ asogya maatɛ ɔmmɔ ligyii lɛmmɔ lɛlɔ kalɛ na liteekeye taatina kuƒi kɔni nwi úsie anumi kakɛ. 38Asogya kɔbuli ku nnɔmii kewikɔ ku kabuli kammɔ linyenela ƒui ɔdi ka ɔbla sika ugyiedi kede kede. 39Na sika ugyiedi edula ebi akyami maane ku kakɛ unu na badubo buti bɔbla asogya kasiakɔ ugyii ɔmɛni ku nwuna lɛlɔ ala ƒui. 40Sia anumi na anu ka bábla-nwu na udu ɔni na ánu na kɔbi lili mɛni kani lɛlɔ pɛpɛɛpɛ.

Title: ISRAELƑUƆ BƆLƐ 26
Content:
Katɔti Adi Kevo
1“Biti aduni abuni kpɛtɛ kpɛtɛ ani náƒɔ kuye geen na bámii-nya ku kɔbuli buluu ku kugyiedi kɔni náƒɔ kuye na ukyuli ɔni ngyi budi geen údi Kerub bebweyi ɔ́kya-nya kemmo na biti bɛbla Adi Kevo kammɔ. 2Adi ammɔ ƒui bune ku bɔbɛbɛ bɔbla bɔkɔku bunwi bɔni mabla aani bune lɛgba aavlene-inyɔ ku bɔbɛbɛ lɛgba ɛku. 3Ya na baka aduni alɔ basala kakɛ kenwi na baka alɔ basala kakɛ kanyɔdi. 4Na beti aduni buluu buni gyɛlɛɛ baka-nwu kunu kunu na eƒi atɛ-nwu kemmo na baka bada aduni enengudi ammɔ atu ɔvi unwi. Na babla lɛni kani ku lɛduni linengudi linyɔdi lɛnɔ atu na ɔvi unyɔdi. 5Na aduni wɛlɛ wɛlɛ ani báka kunu kunu mmɔ ku eƒi abla liti na aduni enengudi ammɔ atu ɔvi ɔni ku ɔni. Na kesii kani na eƒi ammɔ ada mmɔ eti lɛlɔ atina lɛlɔ. 6Na eti sika ugyiedi abla abalala liti ani muuƒie adi taasala. Na eti eƒie aduni enengudi ammɔ atu ammɔ asala na ɔbla Adi Kevo kenwi.
7“Ti bese linwini bla aduni leevu-unwi na eti ebi kevo kammɔ eli. 8Na aduni ammɔ ƒui bune bɔbla unwi ɔni ndi lɛgba aavlene-ɛlɔ na bɔbɛbɛ bɔdi lɛgba ɛku. 9Ka aduni alɔ sala ɔvi unwi na aka aku asala ɔvi unyɔdi, na aƒɛ lɛduni lɛkundi asia ɔkpanadi lɛlɔ na kevo kammɔ kayakun kenye. 10Ti lɛduni bamba na aka eƒi kunu kunu liti ada kayakun aduni ammɔ kɔtu ɔvi unwi na abla lɛni kani ku ɔvi unyɔdi. 11Na eti abuala egyiedi abla kayakun kɔbalakɔ liti akya eƒi ammɔ kemmo na bataabala Adi Kevo kammɔ ƒui taasala. 12Na eti kɔdi kakɛ kakladi kani nebu mmɔ aƒala Adi Kevo kammɔ kama. 13Kevo aduni ammɔ adubo bune ɔgba bɔkɔku kakɛ butulo kevo kammɔ, na ɔmmɔ ɔdubo bɔyɔlɔ na kana lɛƒɛnyi lɛmmɔ kalɛ na utile kevo kammɔ. 14Na awia baƒonu lɛku lɛni na békpeyi na bákya-ni kuvo na lígyie kaduɛ abla kevo kammɔ katɔ libila, asa na eti ketu bebuo benengudi lɛku ebi ɔmmɔ katɔ.
15“Ti akasia kugyiikɛ sa eku eku gyi kevo kaduli ɔban. 16Na liku biala bɔkuku bɔdi lɛgba leevu-ɛlɔ, na nwuna bɔbɛbɛ bɔdi lɛgba inyɔ ku kakɛ. 17Na lɛgba inyɔ bɔkya liku biala kalɔ. Lɛni sɔɔn na adubo eku ammɔ ƒui bɔbla. 18Na kevo kaduli kammɔ kada kakɛ ni, sa eku ammɔ aavlanyɔ. 19Na eti sika ɔƒualadi abla lɛgba lɛmmɔ agbanvuo aavlene. Na ɔgba biala ɔƒɔ unwi, na liku biala lɛda inyɔ. 20Na kevo kaduli kammɔ katɔ kakɛ lɛnɔ ni, sa eku ammɔ aavlanyɔ. 21Na abla sika ɔƒualadi agbanvuo aavlene akya-ni kalɔ, na liku biala lɛda inyɔ. 22Na asa eku aku akya ɔƒɛ kanukɔ na kevo kaduli kammɔ kawɔlɔkɔ. 23Na asa eku anyɔ akya lɛkɔkɔ inyɔ lɛni nkya kaduli kawɔlɔkɔ ƒui. 24Na lɛkɔkɔ inyɔ lɛmɛni ni, sala ligyii lɛmmɔ inyɔ ɔ́si kalɔ útédu katɔ, na lɛgba inyɔ bɔmmɔ buduo ɔgbanvuo unwi kemmo. Na lɛkɔkɔ lɛkladi lɛnɔ lɛni kani. 25Anwuɔsu eku ammɔ adubo bɔbla maane ku nina kalɔ sika ɔƒualadi agbanvuo leevu-ɛku ɔni na liku biala lɛda inyɔ.
26“Na ɔmmɔ kama ni, na eti akasia ligyii ábla lɛtagyii ɛlɔ asia kevo kammɔ ɔƒɛnyi unwi. 27Na asia lɛtagyii ɛlɔ bamba na ɔƒɛnyi unyɔdi lɛnɔ na asia ɛlɔ na ɔƒɛ kanukɔ na kevo kammɔ kawɔlɔkɔ ƒui. 28Na ɔtagyii ɔni na ntɛntɛ ɔlɛka une ɔsi ligyii lɛni nnye ntɛ mmɔ ɔvi unwi úsie ɔkladi. 29Na eti sika ugyiedi akwa ligyii lɛni nnye mmɔ lɛlɔ ƒui na eti sika ugyiedi kɔkwɛnimi ada lɛtagyii lɛmmɔ na akwa ani lɛnɔ ku sika ugyiedi.
30“Lɛ kevo kammɔ kalɛ kani na bédie bátina-a na kɔbi lɛlɔ pɛpɛɛpɛ.
31“Na eti unwo buluu ku ugyiedi ɔni náƒɔ kuye edi kɔdi kɔbunidi. Na aya na ala udine ɔbuni udi Kerub ɔkya-nwu kemmo. 32Na eti sika ugyiedi kɔkwɛnimi akya-nwu aƒala akasia ligyii ine lɛni na bákwa ku sika ugyiedi na linye sika ɔƒualadi lɛka lɛlɔ mmɔ lɛlɔ. 33Kɔdi kɔmmɔ kutaaƒa sika ugyiedi kɔkwɛnimi kɔmmɔ lɛlɔ lɛni na eti Bunyimi Adaka ɔni kemmo na atabi anyɔ akya mmɔ ese kɔdi kɔmmɔ kama. Na kɔdi kɔmmɔ ndubule kakpakɔ kammɔ kedeedikɔ bɔsiku kesii kani nse kedee ketulo ƒui kudɔ. 34Na eti likpidi bɔkyiɛ liboku libila lɛmmɔ asia Bunyimi Adaka ɔmmɔ lɛlɔ na kesii kani nse kedee ketulo ƒui mmɔ. 35Na edie ala kasiakɔ kammɔ alɛ aduni ammɔ kama na kevo kammɔ kada kakɛ na eti asogya kasiakɔ kammɔ alɛ-nwu anumi na kada kakɛ mmɔ.
36“Na kevo kammɔ kayakun ni, ti unwo buluu ku ugyiedi ɔni náƒɔ kuye na udine údi bla kayakun kɔdi. 37Na awia kɔkwɛnimi kɔbaladi kɔni ndubo kayakun kɔdi kammɔ butaada, ku akasia ligyii ɛlɔ lɛni bákwa ku sika ugyiedi na eti abuala egyiedi abla agbanvuo ete-ni.

Title: ISRAELƑUƆ BƆLƐ 27
Content:
Bɔkyula Lɛkpabi
1“Ti akasia kugyiikɛ bla bɔkyula lɛkpabi, na ɔkuku lɛgba ine ku kakɛ na bɔbɛbɛ ku bune ƒui bɔdi lɛgba maatɛ ku kakɛ ɔvi ɔni ku ɔni. 2Na anwi bebuo ese adanku lɛbi lɛmmɔ lɛkɔkɔ ine bɔmmɔ ƒui sala bla unwi na eti abuala egyiedi ammɔ anwamana akwa lɛbi lɛmmɔ ku ese ammɔ lɛlɔ ƒui. 3Na eti abuala egyiedi avɔ oloƒui bɔkyula lɛlɔ ala aani ntɔ kewikɔ ebui ku ogya budie kalɛkɛ ku soƒi ku oloƒui uyɔ bubo lɛkyami ku kɔbwɛlɛmii kɔni mɔɔda agyabi ku ɔni baatu lɛna ƒui. 4Ti abuala egyiedi bla lɛla lɛni kemmo na ntɔ bɔdubo butaalɛ na abuala egyiedi kɔkwɛnimi kɔda-nwu atu ene ɔmmɔ. 5Biti ntɔ bɔƒɔ lɛbuala lɛmmɔ bɛkya lɛbi lɛmmɔ kalɔ na ɔkuku ubedu-ni ntɛ bule. 6Ti akasia bla ligyii gyɔlɔɔ na eti abuala egyiedi akwa ligyii lɛmmɔ lɛlɔ. 7Na eti ligyii lɛmmɔ akya kɔkwɛnimi kɔmmɔ kemmo na lɛkya lɛƒɛnyi lɛmmɔ si bágyu béti. 8Bo kugyiikɛ kɔmmɔ danku lɛlɔ mana bla adaka ɔmmɔ na katɔ ku kalɔ keteewi. Na abla-nwu asiaku kalɛ na lídie lɛ́tina-a na kɔbi lɛlɔ mɛni kani.
Adi Kevo Kaduli
9“Kya kaduli mana kevo kammɔ na kene lɛgba eti atɛ na baƒala aduni kpɛtɛ kpɛtɛ abuni geen bamana-ka. 10Na aduni ammɔ adubo bɔƒa ligyii aavlanyɔ lɛlɔ na abuala egyiedi ɔka ɔkya-ni kalɔ na kɔkwɛnimi kɔni ndubo aduni ammɔ bɔbala kɔbla sika ɔƒualadi na sika ɔƒualadi aduni wɛlɛ wɛlɛ adubo bɔka bɔmana ligyii lɛmmɔ lɛlɔ. 11Katɔ kakɛ lɛnɔ lɛgba eti atɛ. Na aduni ammɔ adubo bɔƒa ligyii aavlanyɔ lɛlɔ na abuala egyiedi ɔka ɔkya-ni kalɔ na kɔkwɛnimi kɔni ndubo aduni ammɔ bɔbala kɔbla sika ɔƒualadi na sika ɔƒualadi aduni wɛlɛ wɛlɛ adubo bɔka bɔmana ligyii lɛmmɔ lɛlɔ.
12“Na kevo kammɔ ɔƒɛ kanukɔ kawɔlɔkɔ kakɛ ni, mmɔ kadubo bɔbla lɛgba liti ku aavlanyɔ-ɛlɔ, na ligyii leevu ku nina kalɔ ɔka leevu ndubo mmɔ bɔkya. 13Na kɔwɔlɔkɔ kani nésie ɔƒɛ katukɔ kakɛ ni, kaduli kammɔ bubomo bɔbla lɛgba liti ku aavlanyɔ-ɛlɔ. 14Na mmɔ ni, aduni ani bune ndi lɛgba aavlanyɔ-inyɔ ku kakɛ ndubo bɔƒa ligyii ɛtɛ lɛni ndubo bunye nina kalɔ ɔka ɛtɛ lɛlɔ na kayakun ɔvi unwi. 15Na aduni bamba lɛgba aavlanyɔ-inyɔ ku kakɛ bune bɔdubo bɔƒa ɔvi unyɔdi na ligyii ɛtɛ lɛni ndubo bunye nina ɔka ɛtɛ lɛlɔ.
16“Na kaduli kammɔ kayakun ni, ya na udine uti aduni buluu ku egyiedi ani náƒɔ kuye na udi-nya kaduɛ bune lɛgba avlaatɛ na eti aƒala ligyii ine bɔni na adubo buti bunyene ɔka ine lɛlɔ na mmɔ. 17Na ligyii lɛni ƒui ndubo bunye bɔmana kaduli kammɔ ni, ɔdi ka beti sika ɔƒualadi aduni wɛlɛ wɛlɛ baka bamana-ni ku sika ɔƒualadi kɔkwɛnimi kɔni mɔɔbala ala na ligyii ine lɛmmɔ ɔdi biala unye ɔka lɛlɔ. 18Kaduli kammɔ ƒui bune bɔdi lɛgba eti atɛ ku bɔbɛbɛ lɛgba liti ku aavlanyɔ-ɛlɔ. Na eti adi kpɛtɛ kpɛtɛ abuni ani na bámii básala kaduɛ na ana bune bɔdi lɛgba maatɛ ku kakɛ baƒala ligyii lɛni nnye nina abuala egyiedi ɔka lɛlɔ mmɔ. 19Na kevo kammɔ lɛlɔ ala bamba biala ku ewele ani nda kevo kammɔ ku kaduli kammɔ lɛlɔ ala ƒui abla abuala egyiedi sɔɔn.
Asogya Ugyii Lɛlɔ Nnɔ
20“Su Israelƒuɔ na beboku nnɔ bɔni na bédie básiku nnɔ egyii kemmo na buse kede kede ute asogya ɔmmɔ kalɛ na utaada uwi ndi uwi. 21Na beti asogya ɔmmɔ balɛ Adi Kevo kemmo kesii kani na mɔɔsiáku-mii mmɔ ku aduni ani nƒa mmɔ anumi asa na adubuduo adaka ɔmmɔ kudɔ. Na Aaron ku nwuna bebi banu ka lɛsogya lɛmmɔ ƒui lɛɛda na Unwoti anumi mmɔ ɔ́si useyi uwi útálɛ kadi bugye. Ɔmɛni ɔdi bunyimi bɔni na Israelƒuɔ ɔdi ka bese likpo na bataadi-mu lɛlɔ uwi ndi uwi.”

Title: ISRAELƑUƆ BƆLƐ 28
Content:
Bakpane Lɛwu Lɛkyadi
1Amu na Unwoti ɔ́su Mose ɔnini, “Ƒ'ɔnwani Aaron ku nwuna bebi bani ndi Nadab ku Abihu ku Eleasar ku Itamar ni, lɔ-ma lɛku Israelƒuɔ bammɔ akɔ na bebo-ɔ kudɔ. Ɔsika ama ndi bekyuli bani na lɛ́ƒuna lɛ́lɛku Israelƒuɔ akɔ ka babla mina bakpane. 2Na aka awu gyɔlɔɔ ɔni mɔɔdia bɔnu na ɔ́manku ɔkpane ete ƒ'ɔnwani Aaron. 3Su lɛwu bakane babuni bani na líte-ma lɛnunda ka bakana awu ɔmmɔ udu bɔka kani na baka awu ɔmmɔ bete Aaron kalɛ na bedie-nwu bese sɛsɛɛ bete ka ɔbla ɔkpane kabla ute-mi. 4Na kalɛ na ɔ́lɛka báka lɛwu lɛmmɔ bavinku ndi ka baka kayi lɛbalala lɛdiku ku bakpane awu kpɛtɛ kpɛtɛ kedee ku awu ɔtɔdi akɔnkɔ bune ku awu gyɔlɔɔ ku lili dukuu ku kavobi lɛduni. Na si baaka lɛwu lɛmɛni bete ƒ'ɔnwani Aaron ku nwuna bebi bananabi ka babla-mi kabla aani bakpane kalɛ ni, 5na biti adi kpɛtɛ kpɛtɛ ku linwo lidu lɛni mɔɔdia bɔnu na lígyie na lise buluu na lɛ́ƒɔ kuye geen bɛka lɛwu lɛmmɔ na beti sika ugyiedi bakya-ni bɔdia.
Ɔkpane Awu Kpɛtɛ Kpɛtɛ Kedee
6“Na ɔkpane awu kedee ni, ɔlɛka ɔbla kɔdi kpɛtɛ kpɛtɛ na bedi-nwu kaduɛ ku unwo buluu ku ugyiedi ɔni náƒɔ kuye geen. Na beti sika ugyiedi bakya-nwu bɔdia. 7Na beti kadii bada-nwu amangba atu anyɔ ammɔ na ɔdia beteebo taada lɛlɔ. 8Na bedi kavobi lɛduni aani kadii kammɔ kalɛ ku linwo kpɛtɛ buluu ku ligyiedi lɛni náƒɔ kuye. Na bakya-nwu bɔdia ku sika ugyiedi bada awu ɔmmɔ lɛlɔ na ɔbla unwi.
9“Ti atabi anyɔ ani náƒɔ kuye na baalɔ-nya oniks na enweni Israel bebi anyi asia-nya lɛlɔ. 10Na anyi aku asia lɛtabi linwi lɛlɔ, na anyi aku akladi lɛnɔ asia lɛtabi linyɔdi lɛlɔ na bana bɔwɔ linengu kenye. 11Na enweni Israelƒuɔ bebi anyi leevu-anyɔ asia atabi anyɔ ammɔ lɛlɔ. Bla-nya aani kalɛ na atabi banwine baanwí atabi kemmo ku ala bunweni. Na eti sika ugyiedi kɔbuli aka-nya, 12ada awu kedee ɔmmɔ amangba lɛlɔ aani likposela ute Israelƒuɔ bebi. Na bana anyi adubo bɔma Aaron lɛlɔ uwi ndi uwi na Unwoti uteenyimo-ma. 13Na sika ugyiedi ɔni nábala atabi ammɔ ni, 14ƒala sika ugyiedi kɔbuli inyɔ bamba kɔni bámii lɛlɔ.
Kayi Lɛbalala Lɛdiku
15“Sia bedine babuni lɛlɔ na abla litemi siin bɔtɛ kayi lɛbalala lɛdiku aani bakpane awu kedee ɔmmɔ kalɛ. Na eti kɔdi kpɛtɛ kpɛtɛ ku linwo buluu ku ligyiedi lɛni náƒɔ kuye geen edi-ku na akya-ku bɔdia ku sika ugyiedi. 16Na aƒɛ kɔdi kɔmmɔ kemmo inyɔ. Na nwuna bɔbɛbɛ ku bune ƒui bɔbla bɔkɔku bunwi aani lɛnimi ntɛ bukulo yaalenwi ɔƒɛnyi biala. 17Na eti atabi ani náƒɔ kuye aka amana lɛdiku lɛmmɔ lɛlɔ na lɛgaala ine kemmo. Na ɔgaala udeedi kemmo ni, kya atabi ani baalɔ sardis ku topas ku beril. 18Na ɔgaala unyɔdi kemmo ni, kya atabi ani baalɔ banii torkis ku sapir ku smardo. 19Na ɔgaala ɔtɛdi kemmo ni, kya atabi ani baalɔ yiakint ku agate ku ametist. 20Na ɔgaala unedi kemmo ni, kya atabi ani baalɔ krisolit ku oniks ku yaspa. Na edie eƒi na sika ugyiedi asɛɛ ebi kemmo, na eti atabi ammɔ akya-nya kemmo unwi unwi, asa na aka amana lɛdiku lɛmmɔ lɛlɔ. 21Ɔlɛka atabi ammɔ abla leevu-inyɔ na enye ete Israel bebi leevu-inyɔ bammɔ anyi kenye. Na atabi ammɔ adubɔbla aani ekposela atabi, na adubɔnwi bana anyi asia unwi unwi.
22“Na adubuti sika ugyiedi na elii-nwu aani kɔbuli ete lɛdiku lɛmmɔ. 23Na eti sika ugyiedi na abla kɔkwɛnimii inyɔ na eti akya lɛdiku lɛmmɔ atu. 24Na eti sika ugyiedi kɔbuli kɔmmɔ ebo ada kɔkwɛnimii kɔmmɔ kemmo na lɛdiku lɛmmɔ lɛlɔ. 25Na kuna eli anyɔ akladi ni, ti-nya bo da awu kedee ɔmmɔ amangba kesii kani na sika ugyiedi ɔ́bala atabi ammɔ. 26Na asɔ abla sika ugyiedi kɔkwɛnimii inyɔ bamba ada lɛdiku lɛmmɔ atu na kemmo kakɛ kesii kani nda awu kedee ɔmmɔ lɛlɔ. 27Na asɔ abla sika ugyiedi kɔkwɛnimii inyɔ bamba ada awu kpɛtɛ kpɛtɛ ɔmmɔ kada kakɛ na kesii kani na kavobi lɛduni lɛmmɔ lɛdanku. 28Unwo buluu kadii na badubo lɛdiku lɛmmɔ kɔkwɛnimii bɔbala butádanku awu kedee ɔmmɔ kɔkwɛnimii lɛlɔ. Na kadii kammɔ kadubɔsia awu ɔmmɔ kavobi lɛduni lɛni bédi bákya-ni bɔdia mmɔ lɛlɔ.
29“Na uwi biala na Aaron weduo kesii kani nse kedee mmɔ ni, ɔlɛka ɔkya awu ɔni na Israel kaba anyi ama-nwu kayi mmɔ. Na ɔmɛni ndubɔya na ami Unwoti anumi asia mina bekyuli lɛlɔ uwi ndi uwi. 30Na eti Urim ku tumim amana litemi siin bɔtɛ kayi lɛdiku lɛmmɔ lɛlɔ. Na utaama Aaron kayi lɛlɔ uwi ndi uwi ɔni na uuduo mina kakpakɔ kesii kani nse kedee mmɔ uti ɔtina Israelƒuɔ litemi bɔtɛ.
Ɔkpane Unengudi Adala Abambadi
31“Na awu gyɔlɔɔ ɔni lɛlɔ na bakpane awu kpɛtɛ kpɛtɛ kedee ɔmmɔ ɔɔsia ni, ɔlɛka ɔdi kɔdi buluu. 32Na edie liƒi kesii kani na lili lɛɛví na kɔdi kɔmmɔ ntɛntɛ na edie liƒi lɛmmɔ bekpo atu kalɛ na uleyile bɔbwɛ. 33Na awu gyɔlɔɔ ɔmmɔ atu na lɛgba kada ni, beti unwo buluu ku ugyiedi ɔni náƒɔ kuye bedi egyiibi adi udu basia bamana na beti sika ugyiedi lɛdɔn wɛlɛ wɛlɛ baƒala-nwu ntɛ. 34Na egyiibi ammɔ ku sika ugyiedi lɛdɔn lɛmmɔ litaavumanaku lɛlɔ ɔmana awu gyɔlɔɔ ɔmmɔ atu. 35Na si Aaron ɔ́kya lɛwu lɛmmɔ na úduo kesii kani nse kedee mmɔ ni, lɛdɔn lɛmmɔ lɛdubo buteebo. Na ɔmɛni ɔdubɔya na nwuna ngba buleduo ɔgbankpi kemmo.
36“Na eti sika ugyiedi na abla kalɛkɛ blii kadi na anwi-nwu kemmo enweni asia anii, ‘Ɔmɛni use sɛsɛɛ ute Unwoti.’ 37Na eti kadii buluu ada-nwu lɛlɔ adanku dukuu kabwa kammɔ lɛlɔ na anumi kakɛ. 38Kalɛkɛ kammɔ kadubɔma Aaron lɛtɛntɛ kalɛ na ɔƒɔ Israelƒuɔ likpidi biala na bábla na kakpakɔ mmɔ ɔsia lɛlɔ si bébo baabla akpala bete-mi.
39“Di awu ɔtɔdi akɔnkɔ bune ku adi kpɛtɛ kpɛtɛ buni, na edi dukuu kabwa lɛni kani. Na ala ɔkane buni na ɔlɛka udi lɛduni lɛmmɔ.
Bakpane Bamba Lɛnɔ Adala
40“Na Aaron bebi lɛnɔ ni, ɔlɛka abla lɛwu lɛtɔdi akɔnkɔ bune ku kavobi aduni ku atɛntɛ aduni ani mɔɔdia bɔnu na eekeye ete-ma. 41Na adubuti lɛwu lɛmmɔ akya ƒ'ɔnwani Aaron ku nwuna bebi na ewi-ma lili nnɔmii ese-ma likpo na edie-ma ese sɛsɛɛ na babla-mi kabla aani mina bakpane.
42“Na eti unwo ɔbunidi na edi lɛwu gyɔlɔɔ kalɔ lɛwuku lɛni nási bana kavobi útédu bana ebuli ete-ma na bana ɔlɔna kesii kadi katatina. 43Na uwi biala na beeduo Adi Kevo kammɔ kemmo iye bébo bababla ɔkpane kabla na mina lɛkpabi kudɔ ni, na baláni lɛtuni beleboku lɛlɔ na ɔdi wekpi.
“Na ɔda bubo bɔmɛni bɔdubuse bute anwu ku nwuna kaba bebi úsela uwi ƒui.”

Title: ISRAELƑUƆ BƆLƐ 29
Content:
Kalɛ Ɔlɛka Bese Katɔti Bakpane
1“Asa na adubuse Aaron ku nwuna bebi badi bakpane ni, ala amɛni na ɔlɛka abla. Ƒuna ɔmantɛ akɔ ɔgyani ku baƒonu bagyani inyɔ bani na bɔsɔ bɔdi buuubo-ma lɛlɔ. 2Na eti edula ebi ɔlaaƒɔ buni ɔni na bɔnyii buuubo-nwu kemmo, na abla bodobodo unengudi ku ubliidi na asala-nwu ku nnɔ ku bodobodo bɛɛbɛɛ na esusu-nwu nnɔ. 3Na si uwi ɔni na adubo ebeti bebuo bammɔ akpa ete-mi ni, na ala bodobodo ɔmmɔ ƒui ewi kagyigyɛ kemmo na eti ada. 4Na akpanku Aaron ku nwuna bebi eboku Adi Kevo kammɔ kayakun kenye na abla-ma ntu bɔkpila ɔdi. 5Na adubuti bakpane lɛwu lɛmmɔ akya Aaron awu gyɔlɔɔ ɔmmɔ ku ɔtɔdi akɔnkɔ bune ku bakpane awu kpɛtɛ kpɛtɛ kedee ɔmmɔ ku kayi lɛbalala lɛdiku ku kavobi lɛduni buni lɛni bédi kaduɛ mmɔ. 6Na ebi-nwu dukuu kabwa kammɔ. Na eti likpose kalɛkɛ kammɔ ebo ada kabwa kammɔ lɛlɔ. 7Na ɔmmɔ kama na eti likpose nnɔmii bɔmmɔ ewi-nwu lili na ese-nwu likpo. 8Ɔmmɔ kama na akya Aaron bebi lɛwu lɛtɔdi akɔnkɔ bune lɛmmɔ. 9Na eti atɛntɛ aduni ammɔ ada-ma eli. Na eti bana aduni ada-ma kavobi. Na ese-ma aani mina bakpane kalɛ. Ɔsika ama ku bana bawɔ ndubo mina bakpane bɔbla úsela uwi ƒui.
10“Na akpanku ɔmantɛ akɔ ɔgyani ɔmmɔ esienku Adi Kevo kammɔ kayakun. Na aya na Aaron ku nwuna bebi bananabi beti bana enu basia ebuo ɔmmɔ kuli. 11Na adu ebuo ɔmmɔ na mina lɛkpabi lɛni nlɛ mina Adi Kevo kammɔ kudɔ. 12Na eti lɛnimi akya ubugya ɔmmɔ kemmo na eti esusu bebuo ese ani nlɛ lɛkpabi lɛmmɔ lɛlɔ. Na ewilimi ubugya ɔmmɔ ɔkladi ewi kalɔ na lɛkpabi lɛni kudɔ bɛ́du ebuo ɔmmɔ. 13Na eti lɛmwi lɛni ƒui nkya ebuo ɔmmɔ kaƒɔ kemmo ku akɔ ammɔ ku akabi anyɔ ammɔ ku ana lɛmwi ɔ́sia ogya lɛlɔ na lɛkpabi lɛmmɔ lɛlɔ na ɔ́kyula-ni ƒui. 14Nsu ɔmantɛ akɔ ɔgyani ɔmmɔ ɔku ɔni bédie-nwu ku lɛna lɛmmɔ ku ala ani béwilimi-nwu kaƒɔ kemmo ƒui ni, béti-nya bátákyula na keyi na bana keliekɔ kammɔ kama beti bevele likpidi buti taakyiɛ.
15“Na akpanku koƒonu kɔgyani kunwi eboku na Aaron ku bebi beti enu basia-ku kuli. 16Na adu koƒonu kɔmmɔ na akuna ubugya ɔmmɔ ewi lɛkpabi ekpo ene ammɔ ƒui. 17Na ekulo-ku na aƒɔ kuna aƒɔla ku lɛgba na eti ebuo ɔmmɔ ƒui ku nwuna lili asia lɛkpabi lɛmmɔ lɛlɔ. 18Na akyula koƒonu kɔmmɔ ƒui na lɛkpabi lɛmmɔ lɛlɔ na ɔdubɔbla akpala bɔkyula ƒui uyɔ ɔnyi ƒɛƒɛɛ ɔni mɔɔyɔ́ ami Unwoti kaƒɔ.
19“Na akpanku koƒonu kɔgyani kɔkladi eboku na Aaron ku nwuna bebi bananabi beti enu basia-ku lili. 20Na adu ebuo ɔmmɔ. Na eti ubugya ɔmmɔ ɔdi esusu Aaron kɔdianu kɔtu kawɔlɔkɔ ku nwuna kɔdianu kɔnu ku ɔgba animigya. Na abla lɛni kani ete nwuna bebi lɛnɔ. Na akuna ubugya ewi lɛkpabi lɛmmɔ ekpo ene ammɔ ƒui. 21Na eti ubugya ɔmmɔ ɔdi na eti nnɔmii bɔni na eti éwi Aaron lili mmɔ ɔdi ewi ubugya ɔmmɔ kemmo. Na akuna ewi Aaron ku lɛwu lɛni na ɔkya mmɔ lɛlɔ. Na asɔ akuna ɔdi ewi nwuna bebi ku bana lɛwu lɛlɔ. Na ɔmɛni ndubɔtina ka bése-ma bakpane bete-mi.
22“Koƒonu kɔmɛni kubunku bakpane buse kabla kammɔ kadi. Anwuɔsu ti lɛmwi lɛni nkya ebuo ɔmmɔ ɔka kakɛ ku kaƒɔ kemmo ku akɔ ammɔ kawɔlɔkɔ kakɛ ku nwuna akabi anyɔ ku kuna kɔdianu libuli lɛmmɔ se sɛsɛɛ. 23Na edie bodobodo ɔni kemmo na bɔnyii buuubo-nwu kemmo na use Unwoti anumi mmɔ. Die unengudi ku ubliidi ku ɔni nse bɛɛbɛɛ. 24Na eti bodobodo ɔmmɔ ku lɛna lɛmmɔ akya Aaron ku bebi enu kemmo na bakɔliku-nya katɔ batina-mi bebo akpala ammɔ kudu. 25Ɔmmɔ kama na aƒɔ akpala ammɔ asiku bana enu kemmo akyula na lɛkpabi lɛmmɔ lɛlɔ ete-mi, na nwuna uyɔ ɔnyi ƒɛƒɛɛ ɔdubɔyɔ-mi kaƒɔ. 26Na si bɛ́wawa lɛna linyɔdi lɛmɛni bíte Aaron ɔkpane buse kabla ni, bɛkɔliku kayi lɛna lɛmmɔ katɔ bɛtina-mi na bibo akpala ammɔ kudu. Na ɔmmɔ kama lɛna lɛmmɔ lɛdubunwini ƒula kadikɔ.
27-28“Ɔ́si uwi ɔmɛni kemmo úsela uwi ƒui ni, si beesé ɔkpane ɔdi iye baabla unwi bɔbla akpala ni, kayi lɛna ku libuli lɛmmɔ lɛdubunwini ala ani na Israelƒuɔ badubuti bete Aaron ku nwuna bebi aani bana akpala ani na béboku ami, Katɔti. 29-30Na si Aaron úkpi ni, ɔlɛka beti nwuna ɔkpane lɛwu bete nwuna bebi bani mɔɔdi nwuna ala aani ɔkpane unegudi kalɛ. Na ɔlɛka ala ɔdine ɔmmɔ ɔkya lɛwu lɛmmɔ emeyi maatɛ ani kemmo na beesé-nwu ɔkpane mmɔ.
31“Ebuo ɔni bɛ́du bíte bakpane bammɔ buse ni, biƒulo-nwu na Adi Kevo kayakun kenye mmɔ. 32Na aya na Aaron ku nwuna bebi bananabi beti bodobodo lidu ɛtɛ lɛmmɔ na badi ku lɛna lɛmmɔ na mina kevo kayakun kenye. 33Na Aaron ku bebi bananabi lɛti badi adila kedee ammɔ. Na beti babla likpidi kɔtu bɔni budie lɛkpa limeyi bɔdi. Na taya na ukyuli ɔdi ɔdi adila ammɔ adi ubunku-ma. 34Na si adila kedee ammɔ ébu úti útédu lɛdigye ni, na bakyula-nya.
35“Na eti emeyi maatɛ ese Aaron ku bebi mina bakpane aani kalɛ kani libo-ɔ ɔda pɛpɛɛpɛ. 36Na limeyi biala ɔlɛka adu ɔmantɛ akɔ ɔgyani unwi na eti abla alaekpidi kɔtu bɔni budie akpala. Na ɔmɛni ndubɔya na mina lɛkpabi lɛbla kedee. Na asɔ akuna likpose nnɔmii ewi lɛkpabi lɛmmɔ lɛlɔ na lɛbla kedee lɛwɔlɔ ƒui. 37Na abla ala amɛni asia kama emeyi maatɛ. Na ɔmɛni ɔdubɔya na lɛkpabi lɛmmɔ lɛbla kedee. Na si ukyuli ɔdi útuku lɛkpabi lɛmmɔ ni, anwu lɛnɔ ɔdubɔbla kedee.”
Lɛkpa Lɛni Ɔlɛka Abla Limeyi Ndi Limeyi
38Amu na Unwoti ɔ́sɔ ɔ́su Mose ɔnini, “Limeyi ndi limeyi ɔlɛka adu baƒonu bagyani inyɔ bani nákɛ lɛkwa linwi. 39Na adu unwi ɔtanta na adu unwi useyi uwi. 40Na kudeedi ni, wia bodobodo ɔlaaƒɔ ɔni muukeye na akya akyami anyɔ. Na akya nnɔ ɔɔƒɛɛ unwi ewi-nwu lɛlɔ. Na akya ntɛ lɛnɔ ɔɔƒɛɛ unwi ewi-nwu kemmo na eti abla akpala ammɔ. 41Na adu kunyɔdi useyi uwi na ebunku ɔlaaƒɔ ku ntɛ aani ɔtanta ɔdi kalɛ kani na ɔbla ɔnyi ƒɛƒɛɛ akpala bɔkyula ute ami Unwoti.
42“Na lɛni na awɔ ku ƒula kaba ƒui bɛdubo akpala amɛni butaabla na Adi Kevo kammɔ kayakun kesii kani na ndubo mbasiaku-mii na lɛtɛmiku-mii. 43Ndubɔsiaku amii Israelƒuɔ ƒui na mmɔ na ndubo bukeye na lɛbla mmɔ kedee.
44“Na ndubo kevo kammɔ ku lɛkpabi lɛmmɔ budie buse sɛsɛɛ bute ami Unwoti na lidie Aaron ku nwuna bebi bananabi lɛnɔ lise sɛsɛɛ na benwini bakpane bataabla-mi kabla. 45Na ami Unwoti ndubɔkya-mii akɔ aani bina Katɔti kalɛ. 46Na mmɔ na bɛdubɔnu bɔti ka ami ɔni ndi bina Katɔti nédie-mii lɛ́lɛku Egyipte kalɔ lɛlɔ.”

Title: ISRAELƑUƆ BƆLƐ 30
Content:
Oloƒui Bɔkyula Lɛkpabi
1Amu na Unwoti ɔ́su Mose ɔnini, “Ti akasia kugyii na eti abla oloƒui bɔkyula lɛbi ete-mi. 2Na aya na nwuna bune ku bɔbɛbɛ bɔbla unwi ɔgba bɔkɔku unwi ku kakɛ. Na nwuna bɔkuku lɛnɔ bɔdi lɛgba bɔkɔku ɛtɛ. Na abla ɔmantɛ akɔ ɔgyani ese udu alɛ lɛkpabi lɛmmɔ ekpo ene ammɔ. 3Na eti sika ugyiedi akwaa ligyii lɛmmɔ ƒui lɛlɔ ku nwuna katɔ. Na eti sika ugyiedi ada-nwu atu amana aani ɔmii. 4Na eti sika ugyiedi abla kɔkwɛnimii inyɔ ada-nwu atu anyɔ na kada kakɛ blii ku kakɛ kanyɔdi lɛnɔ. Na ɔdubɔdia na beti ligyii lɛdi bavinku-nwu kemmo, na lɛkpabi lɛmmɔ lɛdia butaagyu. 5Na ligyii lɛni ndubɔvi kɔkwɛnimii kɔmmɔ kemmo lɛnɔ ni, kwaa ku sika ugyiedi. 6Ti lɛkpabi lɛmmɔ lɛ kakpakɔ bule kɔdi kɔni néle kevo kammɔ kemmo mmɔ anumi kakɛ mɛni. Na Bunyimi Adaka ɔmmɔ ɔlɛ kakpakɔ bule kɔdi lɛmmɔ kama ku nwuna likpidi kɔtu bɔni budie libila kesii kani na ndubo-mii butaasiaku mmɔ.
7-8“Na ɔtanta ku useyi biala na Aaron watu asogya ɔmmɔ ni, bitaakyula oloƒui ɔni muunwenyi ƒɛƒɛɛ na lɛkpabi lɛmmɔ lɛlɔ teete-mi. 9Na bɛnu ka bɛ́kyula oloƒui ɔni muunwenyi ƒɛƒɛɛ kani. Na biteti oloƒui ɔmmɔ ɔdi bitabla edula ebi iye ebuo iye ntɛ akpala. 10Na kunwi na lɛkwa kemmo ni, Aaron ɔdu ebuo ɔbla likpidi kɔtu bɔni budie akpala ɔdi na kesii kani na ese ammɔ alɛ. Na ebuo ɔni na badubo bɔdu mmɔ ubugya na badubuti babla buvele ɔdi ɔmɛni bete kaba bekyuli bani mebo ƒui. Na ɔmmɔ ɔdi akpala ani nse kedee ƒui ute ami Unwoti.”
Kakpakɔ Egulabi Bute
11Amu na Unwoti ɔsu Mose ɔnini, 12“Ka bananabi bani náalɛ lili na Israel kalɔ lɛlɔ na aya ɔdi biala ɔƒɔ kayu kadi ute-mi. Kalɛ na ɔgbankpi ɔdi ulásiaku bana ɔdi na bekyuli bɔka bɔmmɔ kemmo. 13-15Ɔnana biala ɔni náƒɔ akwa leevu-yaalenwi úsela ɔlɛka ɔƒɔ egulabi ammɔ likeke na nwuna ekpidi lili. Ina ɔlakɛne iye ɔwabane na ɔdi ni, ɔlɛka ɔƒɔ lɛla lɛni na bálɛ ugyii béte bekyuli ƒui. 16Ƒɔ ekpidi lili buvele egulabi ammɔ na eti ataabla kakpakɔ kammɔ lɛlɔ ala. Na ɔmɛni ɔdubɔya na Israelƒuɔ beteenyimo ka ami Unwoti ndubɔƒɔ bana ekpidi lili kayu si bébo-mi kudɔ.”
Lɛkyami Lɛni Kemmo Baaƒɔ Kɔnu
17-21Amu na Unwoti ɔ́su Mose ɔnini, “Wia abuala egyiedi na abla lɛkyami lɛdi ku nwuna ɔka. Na eti lɛkyami lɛmmɔ alɛ lɛkpabi ku kevo kammɔ ntɛ. Mmɔ na bakpane bammɔ badubɔƒɔ bana enu ku lɛgba asa babla akpala na mina lɛkpabi lɛlɔ iye beduo kevo kammɔ kemmo. Na si ɔdi úni ɔmmɔ ni, ɔdubo bukpi. Na ɔmɛni ndi bunyimi ute Aaron ku nwuna bebi úsela uwi ƒui.”
Likpose Nnɔmii
22Amu na Unwoti ɔ́su Mose ɔnini, 23-25“Wia nnɔmii bɔni nse kede kede lɛkyami linwi ku ala ani muunwenyi ƒɛƒɛɛ te ukyuli ɔni ngyi bɔsala kabla kaduɛ, na uti mira ɔɔƒɛɛ unwi ku sinamon ɔɔƒɛɛ kakɛ ku kalamus ɔɔƒɛɛ kakɛ ku kasia ɔɔƒɛɛ unwi ɔsala-mu. Nnɔmii bɔmɛni bɔdubɔbla likposela nnɔmii sɛsɛɛ. 26Na adubo-mu buti esusu Adi Kevo kammɔ ku Bunyimi Adaka ɔmmɔ. 27Na nnɔmii bɔmmɔ kani na adubuti esusu ala kasiakɔ ku ala ani nlɛ-nwu lɛlɔ, ku asogya kasiakɔ ku ala ani ndaku-nwu, ku oloƒui bɔkyula lɛbi ku akyami ani ndaku-nwu, 28ku bebuo bɔkyula lɛkpabi ku nwuna lɛlɔ ala, ku ntu lɛkyami ku nwuna ɔka ɔmmɔ. 29Na si ábla ala amɛni ƒui lɛni ni, ɔdubɔya na ala ammɔ ƒui abla kedee. Na si ukyuli ɔdi úti kɔnu útuku-nya muedi ni, anwu lɛnɔ ɔdubɔbla kedee.”
30Amu na Unwoti ɔ́su-nwu ɔnini, “Uwi ɔni na eesé Aaron ku bebi mina bakpane ni, na ewi-ma nnɔmii bɔmmɔ bɔdi lili. 31Na asu Israelƒuɔ anini, ‘Nnɔmii bɔmɛni buse kedee ɔ́si ɔƒɛni úsela uwi ƒui. 32Anwuɔsu bada-mu aani lɛla lɛni nse kedee. Na ɔdi uteti-nwu utaabla limeyi ndi limeyi kabla. Iye ɔdi utaƒɛ bɔdi utasala nwuna nnɔmii bɔni na ɔɔwɛɛ kemmo kudii. 33Na si ɔdi ɔ́bla-mu lɛlɔ kabla na ɔɔɔdi ɔkpane ni, ndubo-nwu bɔda budie mina bekyuli akɔ.’ ”
Oloƒui
34-35Amu na Unwoti ɔ́su Mose ɔnini, “Wia ala ani muunwenyi ƒɛƒɛɛ na abla oloƒui. Ti mira ku klobo ku onika ku galbanum te ukyuli ɔni ngyi-nwu kabla kaduɛ, na ubunku mma uti ɔbla oloƒui sɛsɛɛ kedee ɔmmɔ. 36Na awɔ ala ammɔ adi abla ɔlaaƒɔ na akuna ɔlaaƒɔ ɔmmɔ ewi Unwoti unyimi adaka ɔmmɔ anumi, kesii kani munye taatɛmiku-mii. Oloƒui ɔmɛni ɔbla lɛla lɛni nse kedee utulo ƒui ute-mii. 37Na sɔsɔ use kedee ute ami Unwoti. Tasu anii aabla ɔdi ese ete lɛlɔ kudii. 38Na si ɔdi ɔ́bla ɔdi ɔ́kyula ute lɛlɔ ni, ndubo-nwu bɔda budie mina bekyuli akɔ.”

Title: ISRAELƑUƆ BƆLƐ 31
Content:
Unwoti Ɔ́ƒuna Besaleel Ku Oholiab
1Amu na Unwoti ɔ́su Mose ɔnini, 2“Lɛ́ƒuna Besaleel ɔni ndi Uri ubidi na ɔdi Hur uwɔ. Na ɔ́si Yuda kaba kemmo ka udi Adi Kevo ku ala ani ɔlɛka banwi bakya ɔtɔ ɔmmɔ ƒui. 3-5Na lɛ́ya na mina kɔyu kɔ́ƒɔ-nwu lɛlɔ kemmo ƒui na líte-nwu lɛnunda ku lɛlati bonwu lɛni na ɔkana uti sika ugyiedi ku ɔƒualadi ku abuala egyiedi ɔvɔ ala lidu lidu. Na uti kugyii lɛnɔ ɔnwi ala lidu lidu. 6Na lɛ́ƒuna Oholiab ɔni nási Dan kaba kemmo lɛnɔ ka uteete-nwu kebunku. Na líti lɛnunda ku lɛlati lɛ́kya bekyuli bamba bani ndubɔbla lɛla biala aani kalɛ na líbo-ɔ ɔda. 7Na badubo Adi Kevo kedee, ku Unwoti Bunyimi Adaka, ku nwuna likpidi kɔtu bɔni budie libila, ku ala ani ƒui nkya kevo kammɔ kemmo bɔbla. 8Na badubɔbla ala kasiakɔ ku ala ani beeti taasia-nwu lɛlɔ ku asogya ligyii kalɛkɔ ku oloƒui kakyulakɔ 9ku lɛkpabi ku nina lɛlɔ ala ku lɛkyami lɛni béti abuala egyiedi bávɔ-ni ku nwuna ɔka. 10Na badubɔka ɔkpane Aaron ku nwuna bebi lɛwu buni lɛni badubo bɔkya buti bɔbla bakpane kabla. 11Na badubɔbla nnɔmii ku oloƒui ƒɛƒɛɛ ɔni beeti taabla Katɔti Kakpakɔ Kedee lɛlɔ kabla. Na badubɔbla ala amɛni ƒui aani kalɛ kani na líbo-ɔ ɔda.”
Lɛnwunameyi Ɔda Bubo
12Amu na Unwoti úbo Mose ɔda ɔnini, 13“Su Israelƒuɔ anii, ‘Bɛdi lɛnwunameyi lɛni ndi mina limeyi lɛlɔ. Ɔsika limeyi lɛmmɔ lɛdi likposela lite ami Unwoti ku amii Israelƒuɔ ɔ́si ɔƒɛni úsela uwi ƒui. Na ɔmɛni ndubɔtina ka ami Unwoti náƒuna-mii lɛ́bla mina bekyuli.
14“ ‘Na bɛdi lɛnwunameyi lɛmɛni lɛlɔ kaduɛ. Ɔsika lɛdi mina limeyi kedee. Na ukyuli ɔni mayu atuɔkplu na wabla kabla kadi limeyi lɛmmɔ lɛlɔ ni, ɔlɛka badu-nwu.’ 15Su-ma anii beti emeyi aku babla kabla bete lɛlɔ, nsu limeyi maatɛdi lɛdi lɛnwunameyi lɛni lídie líse líte lɛlɔ. Na ukyuli ɔni mabla kabla kadi limeyi lɛmmɔ lɛlɔ ɔlɛka badu-nwu. 16Na Israelƒuɔ ɔlɛka basia limeyi lɛmɛni anu na bataadi-ni aani bunyimi bɔni nse nte uwi ƒui. 17Na bunyimi bɔmɛni bɔdi bunyimi bɔni ndubɔkya ami ku Israelƒuɔ ƒui ntɛ ɔ́si ɔƒɛni úsela uwi ƒui. Ɔsika ami Unwoti líti emeyi aku lídie katɔ ku kalɔ. Na limeyi maatɛdi lɛlɔ ni, lɛ́da kabla lɛ́ya na lɛ́nwuna.”
18Uwi ɔni na Katɔti ɔ́tɛmi-ku Mose ɔ́wɔlɔ na Sinai kɔbi lɛlɔ ni, úti nwuna bunyimi kɔlɛkɛ kɔni na Katɔti ɔlatidi únweni ɔda bubo ɔ́sia úte-nwu.

Title: ISRAELƑUƆ BƆLƐ 32
Content:
Aaron Úti Sika Ugyiedi Ɔ́vɔ Ɔmantɛ Akɔ Ɔkɔdi
1Uwi ɔni na Israelƒuɔ bammɔ bánu ka Mose úsie ɔkya kɔbi lili na ulébo ni, bekyuli bammɔ básala lɛlɔ lisu na bésie Aaron kudɔ na bátásu-nwu banini, “Bɔɔɔgyi lɛla lɛni nálɛku Mose ɔni nákpanku-bu ɔ́lɛku Egyipte kalɔ lɛlɔ. Anwuɔsu bla unwoti ɔdi te-bu na ɔkpanku-bu.”
2Amu na Aaron ɔ́su-ma ɔnini, “Bidie sika ugyiedi asɛɛ ani na bina bebi bananabi ku belekubi ku bina beleku bakya biboku-mi.” 3Anwuɔsu Bekyuli bammɔ ƒui bédie bana sika ugyiedi ala ani ƒui bakya mmɔ béte Aaron. 4Na Aaron lɛnɔ úti sika ugyiedi ɔmmɔ ɔ́kya ogya kemmo na ɔ́nwamana-nwu na úwilimi uwi lɛla lɛdi kemmo na ɔ́nwi-nwu ɔ́bla sika ugyiedi ɔmantɛ akɔ ubi udu. Amu na bekyuli bammɔ básu banini, “Israelƒuɔ, bɛɛnu bina katɔti ɔni natɔku-mii na bɛ́lɛ Egyipte kalɔ lɛlɔ.”
5Amu na Aaron ɔ́tu lɛkpabi na ɔmantɛ akɔ ɔni bávɔ mmɔ kudɔ. Na mmɔ na ɔ́kɔ lɛsa ɔ́su Israelƒuɔ ɔnini, “Kɔnaadi bɔdubo limeyi bɔdi buti bumwi bula Unwoti.” 6Na nwuna lɛdigye uwi ni, béti bebuo badi na béti bábla bɔkyula akpala na badi lɛnɔ bábla unwi bɔbla akpala. Mmɔ na bekyuli bamɛni bése kalɔ baadi na baaní ntɛ teekpi na baabla lɛyalɛ ala.
7Mmɔ na Unwoti ɔ́su Mose ɔnini, “Babla, na ayu kɔbi eteesie. Ɔsika ƒula bekyuli bani na ákpanku álɛku Egyipte kalɔ lɛlɔ bábla likpidi na béni-mi. 8Báyila ulu geen ɔni na líbo-ma ɔda nnii basia mmɔ lɛlɔ. Na béti sika ugyiedi bávɔ ɔmantɛ akɔ na baakpá-nwu na baabla akpala teete-nwu. Na baasu banini, ‘Ɔmɛni ndi bula Katɔti ɔni nákpanku-bu ɔ́lɛku Egyipte kalɔ lɛlɔ.’
9“Na ami Unwoti ngyi kalɛ na bekyuli bamɛni bese. 10Anwuɔsu mɔɔsu awɔ Mose nnii tedie-ma kenye, ɔsika líti kɔnyi geen lɛ́kya-ma, na lɛ́bla kasusu ka lɛyila-ma udu. Na ɔmmɔ kama ndubɔbla awɔ Mose ku ƒula kaba bekyuli kadi kani náƒɔ kuye.”
11Amu na Mose úvele kɔnyana bɔnu na Unwoti Katɔti kudɔ ɔnini, “Unwoti, bi ɔsu na éti kɔnyi ákya ƒula bekyuli lɛni? Ƒula bekyuli badi, na éti ƒula ɔyikun bonwu na áda-ma édie Egyipte kalɔ lɛlɔ. 12Na bi ɔsu na ɔdi ka Egyipteƒuɔ basu banii kasusu na ábla ka akpanku ƒula bekyuli esienku abi lɛlɔ na atádu-ma na ayila-ma udu. Anwuɔsu ya na kaƒɔ kayɔ-ɔ na avumana ƒula kasusu, na taya na ɔgbankpi ɔmɛni udu ubo ƒula bekyuli lɛlɔ. 13Na enyimo ƒula linyese lɛni na éte ƒula kabla bablane Abraham ku Isak ku Yakob ka adubɔya na bana kaba bekyuli bemomo aani katɔ ayabi. Na adubute-ma kalɔ kani na ése kenye ka badubuti-ka babla bana kadikɔ.” 14Ɔmɛni ɔsu Unwoti kasusu kávumana, na útaya na ɔgbankpi ɔni na ɔ́su ka webo nwuna bekyuli lɛlɔ ubo-nwu kemmo lɛni.
15-16Amu na Mose únwini ɔ́yu kɔbi kɔmmɔ lɛlɔ na ɔdanku bunyimi atabi anyɔ ani na Unwoti ɔ́nwi na únweni ɔda bubo ɔ́sia-nya lɛlɔ mmɔ úboku.
17Ka Yosua únu ka bekyuli bammɔ beete kudu ni, ɔ́su Mose ɔnini, “Kekpo kakya kesii kani na belie mmɔ.”
18Amu na Mose ɔ́su ɔnini, “Kudu kɔmmɔ kulátina ka bekyuli badi nékpo bádi lɛlɔ. Na kulátina lɛnɔ ka badi muuwulo ka bádi-ma lɛlɔ ɔsu. Mmomu kuse aani ɔnu na baatu.”
19Uwi ɔni na Mose ɔdaku bɔni bude kesii kani Israelƒuɔ básala belie na ɔ́nu ɔmantɛ akɔ ɔni bávɔ ku kalɛ bekyuli bammɔ bakya baatɔ́ taamana akɔ ɔni bávɔ mmɔ ni, kɔnyi kɔ́ƒɔ-nwu lɛlɔ kemmo na kɔbi kaƒɔna mmɔ na úƒwimi atabi anyɔ ani na Unwoti úti úte-nwu mmɔ ɔ́va kalɔ na ábwɛ kɔkɛ kɔkɛ. 20Mmɔ na ɔ́kyula ɔmantɛ akɔ ɔni na bávɔ mmɔ na ɔ́kɔ-nwu únwini ntɔ uti úwi ntu kemmo na úti úte Israelƒuɔ bammɔ na báni.
21Amu na Mose úye Aaron ɔnini, “Bi na bekyuli bamɛni bábla-a ɔsu na áya na bábla likpidi bonwu lɛmɛni udu?”
22Amu na Aaron údie kenye ɔnini, “Teti kɔnyi takya-mi, ɔsika agyi kalɛ na likpidi bɔbla bɔɔyu bekyuli bamɛni emini. 23Ama násu-mi banini, ‘Bɔɔɔgyi lɛla lɛni nálɛku Mose ɔni nákpanku-bu ɔ́lɛku Egyipte kalɔ lɛlɔ.’ 24Amu na lɛ́su-ma nnii beti bana sika ugyiedi asɛɛ bébo beboku. Na ama lɛnɔ béti béte-mi na líti lɛ́kya ogya kemmo, na kɔnakunwi ni, akɔ ubi ɔmɛni nálɛ!”
25Mmɔ na Mose ɔ́nu ɔ́ti ka Aaron nébile bekyuli bamɛni ɔsu na bábla adɔlɔla amɛni na bana bekisine anumi. 26Amu na Mose úténye kayakun kani bekyuli bammɔ básala belie mmɔ kenye na údie lɛdi momoomo ɔnini, “Ukyuli biala ɔni nkya Unwoti kakɛ ni, ɔlɛ na ubenye-mi kudɔ mɛni!” Ɔmɛni ɔsu Lewiƒuɔ bammɔ ƒui báka bámana-nwu.
27Mmɔ na ɔ́su-ma ɔnini, “Israel Unwoti Katɔti uubó-mii ɔda ɔnini, ‘Bina akɔ ɔdi biala uti nwuna kewii na bisie kesii kani na Israelƒuɔ básala beli na bɛdu bina banwani bananabi ku bina bakpana ku bina liku bekyuli ƒui.’ ” 28Amu na Lewiƒuɔ bammɔ bábla kalɛ bébo-ma ɔda mmɔ na bádu bekyuli aani mpim ɛtɛ limeyi lɛmmɔ. 29Amu na Mose ɔ́su Lewiƒuɔ bammɔ ɔnini, “Ɔmwi kadi ni, bɛ́bla lɛlɔ sɛɛn aani bakpane na bíte Unwoti ɔkɛnku kalɛ na bɛ́du bina bebi ku banwani ɔsu.”
30Ka kadi kégye ni, Mose ɔ́su bekyuli bammɔ ɔnini, “Bɛ́bla likpidi bonwu. Nsu nsɔ ndubusie kɔbi kɔmmɔ lili ntévele Unwoti likpidi lɛni bɛ́bla mɛni lili kayu lite-mii. Ɔƒɛni kalɛ ɔdubɔnu-mii kɔnyana na uti likpidi lɛmmɔ ɔkyiɛ-mii.”
31Amu na Mose ɔ́sɔ únwini úsie-nwu kudɔ na ɔ́su-nwu ɔnini, “Bekyuli bamɛni bábla likpidi bonwu, ɔsika béti sika ugyiedi bávɔ ɔti bamba ɔdi béte lɛlɔ na bákpa-nwu. 32Nsu buvele na nda-a nnii ti bana ekpidi kyiɛ-ma. Mmomu si éni-ma buti bɔkyiɛ bɔdi ni, na akpa ada-mi lɛnyi edie ƒula ɔku kemmo.”
33Amu na Unwoti údie kenye ɔnini, “Bekyuli bani náƒiɔ-mi anyi na ndubo bɔda budie mina ɔku ɔmmɔ kemmo. 34Nsu ɔƒaani ni, teesie na atákpanku bekyuli bammɔ esienku kesii kani lɛ́su-ɔ líse. Na enyimo ka mina ɔtu ɔdubo-ɔ bɔgyumana. Nsu uwi ɔdi ɔdubo ɔni na ndubo bekyuli bamɛni kɔtu bɔni ɔkɛnku likpidi lɛni bábla ɔsu.”
35Anwuɔsu Unwoti ɔ́ya na ɔlɛ úbada bekyuli bammɔ ka báya na Aaron úti bana sika ugyiedi na ɔ́vɔ ɔmantɛ akɔ úte-ma ɔsu.

Title: ISRAELƑUƆ BƆLƐ 33
Content:
Unwoti Ɔ́su Israelƒuɔ Ka Bata Sinai Kɔbi Lɛlɔ
1Amu na Unwoti ɔ́su Mose ɔnini, “Awɔ ku bekyuli bani na ákpanku álɛku Egyipte mmɔ bɛta kesii kani bilie mɛni. Na biteesie kalɔ kani líse kenye ka mete Abraham ku Isak ku Yakob ku bana bawɔ mmɔ lɛlɔ. 2Na ndubɔya na mina ɔtu ɔgyumana-mii. Na ndubɔbɔku Kanaanƒuɔ ku Amoriƒuɔ ku Hitiƒuɔ ku Perisiƒuɔ ku Hiwiƒuɔ ku Yebusiƒuɔ bani nlie mmɔ lidie. 3Kalɔ kani lɛlɔ bísela mmɔ egyiibi ntu bɔɔyu emini aani uwɔ na kana lɛlɔ bebuo baayu anyi ntu pii. Nsu ami Unwoti lɛɛɛdubo-mii bɔkpanku. Ɔsika bɛdi bekyuli bani atu mbo ɔkplu geen, na ɔƒɛni kalɛ ndubɔyila-mii udu na ulu lɛlɔ.”
4Uwi ɔni na bekyuli bammɔ bénu ɔmɛni ni, bana lɛlɔ lɛ́bla-ma kɔnyana na beewulo. Na básɔ bátada lɛlɔ ku sika ugyiedi ala. 5Ɔsika Unwoti ɔ́su Mose na úbasu-ma ɔnini, “Bɛdi bekyuli bani atu mbo ɔkplu geen, na ɔƒɛni kalɛ si ami ku-mii bɔsiaku lɛlɔ uwi klukwii ɔdi muedi ni, ndubɔyila-mii udu kede kede. Ɔƒɛni ɔdi biala ɔda nwuna sika ugyiedi ala udie, na ndubɔnu kalɛ maabla-mii.” 6Anwuɔsu ka bátɔlɔ Sinai kɔbi lɛlɔ mmɔ ni, básɔ bátada sika ugyiedi ala.
Katɔti Adi Kevo Kasakɔ
7Na kesi kesii Israelƒuɔ badubɔda keliekɔ kadi ni, Mose uuti Katɔti Adi Kevo taatálɛ keliekɔ kammɔ kabanye. Na ɔsia-nwu lɛnyi ɔnii Katɔti Kevo Kasakɔ. Na ukyuli biala mɔɔwia lɛla lɛdi ɔsiku Katɔti kudɔ uusié mmɔ. 8Na uwi biala na Mose úsie kevo kammɔ kudɔ ni, Israelƒuɔ ƒui baalɛ́ teenye bana nvo kɔyakun taanu Mose utédu ka úduo-ka kemmo. 9Na si Mose úsie kevo kammɔ kemmo ni, liƒlukutu bonwu lɛmmɔ liibo teebenye ɔtɔ ɔmmɔ kayakun uwi ɔni na Unwoti ɔkya ɔɔtɛmi-ku Mose. 10Na si Israelƒuɔ bánya bánu liƒlukutu lɛmmɔ na kevo kayakun na ɔdi biala uuboku lɛlɔ kalɔ. 11Na Unwoti ɔɔtɛmi-ku Mose anumi ku anumi aani kalɛ na bakpana baatɛmi. Na Mose ɔ́sɔ únwini úsie nwuna keliekɔ. Nsu okloƒu ɔni muubunku Mose na baalɔ-nwu banii Yosua na ɔdi Nun ubidi ni, anwu ɔɔƒɔ́ lɛlɔ taakya Katɔti kevo kammɔ kemmo.
Unwoti Ɔ́lɛ Ugyii Ka Ɔdubulieku Nwuna Bekyuli
12Amu na Mose ɔ́su Unwoti ɔnini, “Ɔdi sɔsɔ ka awɔ násu-mi anii nkpanku bekyuli bamɛni nsienku kalɔ kani kenye na ése-ma lɛlɔ. Nsu átasu-mi ukyuli ɔni na ndubo-mi bubunku. 13Na ɔƒɛni ɔni lɛ́ɛti-ɔ mɛni ni, ya na lɛti ƒula kasusu kani na ada, kalɛ na makana na mesie anumi na mabla ƒula lɛyɔla. Na enyimo lɛnɔ ka awɔ náƒuna bekyuli bamɛni ábla ƒula badi.”
14Amu na Unwoti ɔ́su Mose ɔnini, “Ndubɔkpanku-mii, na ndubɔya na bikpo bɛdi lɛlɔ.”
15Amu na Mose údie kenye ɔnini, “Si agyi ka aaadubo-bu bɔkpanku bɔdi ni, ya na bɔsɔ bɔkya kesii kani bulie mɛni. 16Na dɛ na ɔdubɔbla na bekyuli banu bati ka kaƒɔ kaayɔ́-ɔ na ƒula bekyuli lɛlɔ ku ami lɛnɔ si átatɔnku-bu? Si akya-bu akɔ ni, kayawi bekyuli ƒui badubɔnu kavumana kebendi na abu ku-ma ntɛ.”
17Amu na Unwoti ɔ́su Mose ɔnini, “Kalɛ na aayɔ́ ka lɛbla lite-ɔ ni, lɛni kani ndubo bɔbla. Ɔsika ngyi-ɔ kaduɛ na ƒula ala ƒui aayɔ́-mi kaƒɔ.”
18Mmɔ na Mose ɔ́su Unwoti ɔnini, “Amu buvele nda-a, ya na lɛnu ƒula bukeye.”
19Amu na Unwoti údie kenye ɔnini, “Ndubɔya na mina bukeye bɔvi ƒula anumi. Na si mɔɔví ni, ndubɔlɔ mina lɛnyi kedee nnii Unwoti. Na ukyuli ɔni litemi mɔɔyɔ́ ni, ndubɔnu-nwu kɔnyana. Na ukyuli ɔni mɔɔyɔ́ lɛnɔ ni, ndubɔbla-nwu lɛƒɔndia. 20Na aaadubo mina anumi bɔnu. Ɔsika ukyuli biala ulanu-mi anumi na welie ngba.”
21Amu na Unwoti ɔ́su Mose ɔnini, “Aanu kesii kadi na kede-mi na mmɔ akana akɔ etéduo lɛtakpɛ ɔkɔkɔ ɔdi kemmo. 22Na si mina bukeye bɔ́si bɔɔví ni, ndubɔya na anu-mi asiku ɔkɔkɔ mmɔ. Na ndubuti mina enu libiɔ-ɔ lɛlɔ uti utédu ka lɛ́vi lɛ́wɔlɔ. 23Na ɔmmɔ kama ndubɔda mina enu lidie-ɔ lɛlɔ, na adubɔnu mina kama, nsu ɔɔɔdi mina anumi.”

Title: ISRAELƑUƆ BƆLƐ 34
Content:
Mose Ɔ́nwi Atabi Anyɔ Awɔdi
1Amu na Unwoti ɔ́su Mose ɔnini, “Nwi atabi anyɔ awɔdi aani kalɛ kani na edeedi ammɔ ese. Na ndubunweni etemila ani línweni lɛ́sia edeedi ani bɛ́bwɛ lɛlɔ lɛsia awɔdi ammɔ lɛlɔ. 2Anwuɔsu klibi lɛlɔ se na lɛdigye na ata abasiaku-mi na Sinai kɔbi lili. 3Na si adubo ni, taya na ukyuli ɔdi ɔsiaku-ɔ. Ɔsika naaayɔ ka lɛnu ukyuli ɔdi na amadɔ mmɔ. Na taya na koƒonu iye ɔmantɛ akɔ ɔdi usie kɔbi kaƒɔna mmɔ utáwia adila adi.”
4Anwuɔsu Mose ɔ́nwi atabi anyɔ awɔdi na lɛdigye úti atabi ammɔ na ɔ́tɔlɔ úsie Sinai kɔbi lili aani kalɛ kani Unwoti úbo-nwu ɔda. 5Amu na Unwoti ɔ́yu úbo Mose kudɔ na kɔbi kɔmmɔ lili na liƒlukutu kemmo. Na ɔ́kpali nwuna lɛnyi kedee na ɔ́su ɔnini, “Ami Unwoti mmɔ.” 6Amu na Unwoti úsie ɔ́vi Mose anumi na ɔ́su-nwu ɔnini, “Ami Unwoti ndi Katɔti ɔni mɔɔnu kɔnyana, na mɔɔbla lɛƒɔndia uwi ƒui, na neeeti kɔnyi pla pla. Mmomu mɔɔyɔ́ mina bekyuli na mɔɔbla ala ulu lɛlɔ teete-ma. 7Mɔɔdi mina kenye kani líse líte kaba bekyuli apim apim lɛlɔ na muuti bekyuli bani nénwini kama bákya bana ulikplu ala ku bani mɔɔta teenye-mi lɛlɔ ku ekpidi ƒui taakyiɛ. Nsu mɔɔní bekyuli bani mɔɔƒiɔ́-mi ƒui kɔtu. Naaayiƒala kudii ka lɛni bana bebi ku bawɔ kɔtu utédu kaba katɛdi ku kenedi lɛlɔ ɔ́si ekpidi ani na bana bawɔne bábla ɔsu.”
8Amu na Mose úboku lɛlɔ kalɔ na úmwi Unwoti. 9Na ɔ́su-nwu ɔnii, “Unwoti, si mina lɛlɔ lɛ́da-a kubiti sɔsɔ geen ni, muuvele-ɔ nnii kpanku-bu ina ka bekyuli bamɛni bébo atu ɔkplu geen. Ti bula ekpidi kyiɛ-bu na aƒɔ-bu aani ƒula bebi.”
Katɔti Ɔ́sɔ Únyimi Bunyimi Bɔwɔdi Ku Israel
10Amu na Unwoti ɔ́su Mose ɔnini, “Ndubo bunyimi bɔwɔdi bunyimiku-ɔ na Israelƒuɔ ƒui anumi. Na bana anumi ndubo ala ebendi ani ukyuli ɔdi utabla kudii na kalɔ lɛlɔ bɔbla. Na ɔyawine biala ɔdubɔnu lɛla lɛni na ami ɔni ndi Unwoti ndubɔkana bɔbla. Ɔsika ndubo liƒu ala bɔbla bɔtina-a. 11Di ɔda ɔni muubó-ɔ ɔmwi mɛni lɛlɔ. Na ndubo Amoriƒuɔ ku Kanaanƒuɔ ku Hitiƒuɔ ku Perisiƒuɔ ku Hewiƒuɔ ku Yebusiƒuɔ bɔbɔku na ƒula anumi. 12Na awɔ ku kadi bamba bekyuli badi bitenyimi bunyimi bɔdi na kalɔ kani lɛlɔ na ésela mmɔ. 13Mmomu bo bana akpabi ƒui bwɛ na ayila bana baƒiɔ bani baalɔ banii Asera ligyii lɛni bálɛ ƒui udu. 14Na takpa ɔti ɔdi tebunku ami Unwoti lɛti pɛ. Ɔsika ami Unwoti muukpó kogyulo.
15“Na awɔ ku kadi bamba bekyuli badi bitenyimi bunyimi bɔdi. Ɔsika si baakpá bana baƒiɔ na baabla akpala teete-nwu ni, badubo-ɔ bɔlɔ na ɔmɛni ɔdubunwini ala ani ndubo-ɔ bukpoku na adubɔdi bana adila. 16Mmɔ na bina bebi badubusie betéti bana beleku na ɔmɛni ɔdubɔkpanku-ma na balɛ-mi kama na besie batákpa bana baƒiɔ.
17“Teti lɛbuala tabla baƒiɔ badi na ataakpa.
18“Di Bodobodo Ɔni Néteƒu Limeyi. Na adi bodobodo ɔni kemmo na bɔnyii buuubo emeyi maatɛ aani kalɛ na líbo-ɔ ɔda. Na abla ɔmɛni na Abib kɔbuli kɔni na líse líse kemmo, ɔsika kɔbuli kɔmmɔ kemmo na álɛ Egyipte kalɔ lɛlɔ.
19“Na ubi ɔnanabi udeedi ku ɔmantɛ ebuo ɔgyani ubi udeedi biala ɔdi ami Unwoti ɔdi. 20Nsu ebo kuƒi ka aƒɔ ƒula ɔpɔnkɔ ɔgyani ubi udeedi ɔni na éti éte-mi na aƒɔ-nwu lili kayu ku koƒonu kɔkɔdi. Na si átabla lɛni ni, ɔlɛka aƒɛ-nwu limɔ. Na aƒɔ ƒula ubi ɔnanabi udeedi lili kayu ete Unwoti.
“Na tebo-mi anumi ku enu kplu.
21“Emeyi aku na ebo kuƒi ka abla kabla biala. Nsu ɔtuma uwi na ɔdi o-o, edula ɔƒɛwi o-o ni, tabla kabla kadi na limeyi maatɛdi lɛlɔ.
22“Na taadi Edula Ebi Edeedi Bɔƒɛ Limeyi ku Kevo Kemmo Bɔkya Emeyi lɛkwa biala. 23Kɔtɛ na eteebo mina anumi taabakpa ami Unwoti ɔni ndi Israelƒuɔ Katɔti. 24Na ndubɔbɔku kadi bamba bani nlie mmɔ asa na ésie. Na ndubɔya na ƒula lɛmii lɛbɛbɛ libu. Kɔtɛ na adubɔda bɔlɛ ami Unwoti Katɔti anumi lɛkwa biala. Na ukyuli ɔdi uleti lɛnungyie na waƒɔ ƒula kalɔ kadi.
25“Teti akpala ubugya ku lɛla biala kemmo na bɔnyii bɔkya tabla akpala tete-mi. Na akpala ani na ábla na Kukpi Lili Bɔvia Limeyi ni, taya na kadi kegye akpala ammɔ lɛlɔ.
26“Na eti edula abuni ani na ákɛ ásiku ƒula kalɔ kemmo eboku ami Unwoti Katɔti kaduli.
“Na tadu koƒonu iye ese ɔni mɔɔnyimi takun.”
27Amu na Unwoti ɔ́sɔ ɔ́su Mose ɔnini, “Nweni etemila amɛni ƒui se. Ɔsika etemila amɛni na ndubo buti bɔbla mina bunyimi ku Israel.” 28Na Mose ɔ́kya Unwoti kudɔ na kɔbi kɔmmɔ lili emeyi aavlene usien ku ɔƒɛ, na útadi iye útani lɛla lɛdi. Na únweni bunyimi bɔmmɔ ku Ɔda Bubo Leevu bɔmmɔ ɔ́sia atabi anyɔ ammɔ lɛlɔ.
Mose Únwini Úsie Israelƒuɔ Kudɔ Ɔ́si Sinai Kɔbi Lɛlɔ
29Uwi ɔni na Mose ɔ́yu Sinai kɔbi úbo na ɔda Ɔda Bubo Leevu ni, nwuna anumi eekeye, ɔsika ɔ́kya Unwoti kudɔ na bátɛmi. Nsu na ɔɔɔgyi ɔnii nwuna anumi eekeye lɛni. 30Amu ka Aaron ku bekyuli bammɔ bánu kalɛ na nwuna anumi eekeye ni, ɔdi biala ɔ́yia ka ɔni ude-nwu. 31Nsu ɔ́lɔ-ma ka bebo. Na Aaron ku Israelƒuɔ batɔnkune bésie Mose kudɔ na ɔ́tɛmi úte-ma. 32Na ɔmmɔ kama Israelƒuɔ ƒui báni béde-nwu na báka bamana-nwu. Na Mose ɔ́kɔ lɛsa ɔ́su-ma ɔda bubo etemila ani na Unwoti úti úte-nwu na Sinai kɔbi lɛlɔ.
33Uwi ɔni na Mose ɔ́kɔ lɛsa lɛmmɔ ɔ́wɔlɔ ni, úti lɛla lɛdi úbi anumi. 34Na uwi biala na Mose wesie Unwoti anumi utátɛmiku-nwu ni, ɔɔda lɛdiku lɛmmɔ teebimi. Na si ɔ́tɔlɔ mmɔ úbo Israelƒuɔ kudɔ úbasu-ma ɔda bubo biala ni, 35bekyuli bammɔ baanu ka nwuna anumi eekeye, na ɔɔsɔku lɛdiku lɛmmɔ teebi anumi útédu uwi ɔni na ɔ́sɔ únwini úsie utátɛmiku Unwoti.

Title: ISRAELƑUƆ BƆLƐ 35
Content:
Mose Úbo Israelƒuɔ Ɔda Na Lɛnwuna Limeyi Lɛlɔ
1Amu na Mose ɔ́lɔ Israelƒuɔ ƒui ɔ́sala na ɔ́su-ma ɔnini, “Ɔmɛni na Unwoti ɔɔsu-mii ka bɛbla. 2Ɔnii bibo emeyi aku ka biti bɛbla bina kabla. Nsu limeyi maatɛdi lɛlɔ ni, bɛbla-ni kedee bite Unwoti na ɔdi utabla kabla kadi. Na si ukyuli ɔdi ɔ́bla kabla kadi lɛnwunameyi lɛlɔ ni, ɔlɛka badu-nwu. 3Na ɔdi utasala ogya muedi lɛnwunameyi lɛlɔ.”
Akpala Buti Busienku Unwoti
4Amu na Unwoti ɔ́su Mose ɔnini, 5“Kɔ lɛsa te Israelƒuɔ na asu-ma na beti akpala beboku-mi. Na aƒɔ akpala ammɔ ɔdi biala kudɔ eboku-mi kalɛ na ɔ́si-nwu kayi kemmo kalɛ. Na akpala ani na adubo bɔƒɔ mmɔ ndi sika ugyiedi ku ɔƒualadi ku abuala egyiedi, 6ku unwo buluu ku ugyiedi ɔni náƒɔ kuye adi kpɛtɛ kpɛtɛ ku bese linwini, 7ku baƒonu lɛku lɛni na békpeyi na bákya-ni kuvo na lígyie kaduɛ, ku ketu kemmo bebuo lɛku ku akasia ligyii kpakplaa, 8ku asogya nnɔmii, ku ugyulo ƒɛƒɛɛ ɔni na baakya likpose nnɔmii kemmo ku oloƒui ƒɛƒɛɛ, 9ku sika atabi udu ɔdi na baalɔ onis ku ana lidu bamba ani na baaka taamana ɔkpane unengudi awu kedee ku lɛdiku lɛni muubi-nwu kayi.”
Kɔlɛmii Kɔni Badubuti Batu Katɔti Kevo Kasakɔ
10Amu na Mose ɔ́su bekyuli bani ƒui nda kɔnu kemmo kabla ka bebo na babla kabla kani Katɔti úbo-ma ɔda. 11Na batu Kevo Kasakɔ ku kɔdi ku abalala na bawia kugyikɛ ku abuala ku ligyii akpa nina aka. 12Na bawia ala na batu Bunyimi Adaka ku nwuna ligyii ku likpidi kɔtu bɔni budie libila ku kakpakɔ bule kɔdi kɔni beeti taaƒla-nwu anumi. 13Na babla ala kasiakɔ ku nwuna ligyii lɛni baagyú-nwu ku ala ani na baasia-nwu lɛlɔ ku Katɔti bodobodo kedee ɔni muusé-nwu anumi. 14Na babla asogya kalɛkɔ ku nwuna lɛlɔ ala ku nnɔmii bɔni na badubo buteewi asogya ɔmmɔ kemmo teese. 15Na batu oloƒui bɔkyula lɛbi ku nwuna ligyii ku likpose nnɔmii oloƒui ku kevo kayakun lɛduni. 16Na beti kugyikɛ na babla bɔkyula lɛkpabi ku ntɔ bɔƒɔ lɛbuala ku nwuna bɔgyu ligyii ku nwuna lɛlɔ ala. Na beti abuala egyiedi babla lɛkyami lɛni kemmo badubo asogya butaaƒɔ ku nina ɔka. 17Na babla aduni bete kevo kaduli kammɔ ku kana akpa ku ana ɔka, ku aduni ani na baaƒala kayakun. 18Na bawia ewele ku kɔbuli kɔni ndubɔda kevo ku kaduli kammɔ akpa. 19Na bawia adi na bédi Aaron lɛwu sɛsɛɛ ku nwuna bebi lɛwu lɛni na badubo butaakya taabla bakpane kabla.
Israelƒuɔ Béti Bana Akpala Béte
20Amu na bekyuli bammɔ bátɔlɔ Mose kudɔ. 21Na ukyuli biala kubiti kɔ́da-nwu. Na bani nátuna ku kaƒɔ ƒaa béti etela bésienku Unwoti ka beti batu Kevo Kasakɔ kammɔ ku akpala lɛlɔ ala ku bakpane lɛwu kedee lɛmmɔ ƒui. 22Na banana ku beleku bani mɔɔyɔ́ ni, bédie bana kaƒɔ ƒaa na beti bana sika ugyiedi ala ani baakya ɔkwɛ ku atu ku animi ku ana udu besienku Mose. Na bákɔliku-nya katɔ bátina Katɔti bébo-nya kudu. 23Na bani ƒui na bébo linwo buluu ku ligyiedi lɛni náƒɔ kuye ku adi kpɛtɛ kpɛtɛ iye bese linwini iye baƒonu lɛku lɛni békpeyi na bákya-ni kuvogyie iye ɛpu bebuo lɛku ni, béti-ni béboku. 24Na bani mbo sika ɔƒualadi ku abuala egyiedi ku bani mbo akasia kugyikɛ kɔni ndubɔdia bute kabla kammɔ lɛnɔ béti béboku Unwoti. 25Na beleku bani lɛnɔ ngyi budi béti bana linwo buluu ku ligyiedi lɛni náƒɔ kuye ku adi kpɛtɛ kpɛtɛ béboku. 26Na béti bana bese linwini bédi ala lidu béboku. 27Na batɔnkune bammɔ béboku onis atabi ani náƒɔ kuye ku ana lidu bamba ani na badubɔka bamana ɔkpane unengudi awu kedee ku lɛdiku lɛni muubi-nwu kayi lɛlɔ. 28Na básɔ béboku nnɔmii kede kede, ku ugyulo ƒɛƒɛɛ ɔni na baakya likpose nnɔmii kemmo ku oloƒui ƒɛƒɛɛ. 29Na Israelƒuɔ beleku ku banana bédie kayi ƒaa na béti ala pii bésienku Unwoti ka beti babla kabla kani na Unwoti ɔkɛnku Mose lɛlɔ úbo-ma ɔda mmɔ.
Besaleel Ku Oholiab Lɛlɔ Kɔtɛ
30Amu na Mose ɔ́su Israelƒuɔ bammɔ ɔnini, “Unwoti údie Besaleel ɔni ndi Uri ubidi na ɔdi Hura uwɔ ɔni nási Yuda kaba kemmo. 31Na ɔ́ya na nwuna kɔyu kɔƒɔ-nwu lɛlɔ kemmo ku lɛnunda ku lɛlati, na úte-nwu kɔnu kemmo kabla lidu lidu. 32Na ɔdubo sika ugyiedi ku ɔƒualadi ku abuala egyiedi buti bɔbla kɔlɛmii lidu lidu. 33Na ɔdubo atabi bɔbwɛ bɔtu, na ɔnwi ligyii, na ɔbla enu kabla abunidi lidu lidu. 34Na Unwoti úte anwu ku Oholiab ɔni ndi Ahisamak ubidi na ɔ́si Dan kaba kemmo kasusu ka béti ala ani na Unwoti úte-ma mmɔ batina bekyuli bamba. 35Ɔ́ya na nwuna kɔyu kɔ́ƒɔ bekyuli bamɛni lɛlɔ kemmo kalɛ bakana na banwi ala lidu lidu na bataa ala lidu lidu na beti linwo buluu ku ligyiedi lɛni náƒɔ kuye ku adi kpɛtɛ kpɛtɛ bedi ala lidu lidu. Na bagyi bana kabla kaduɛ.”

Title: ISRAELƑUƆ BƆLƐ 36
Content:
1“Anwuɔsu Besaleel ku Oholiab ku bani ƒui na Unwoti úte-ma kɔnu kemmo kabla lɛnunda ka bakana Katɔti Kevo kammɔ bɔtu ni, ɔlɛka babla kabla kammɔ aani kalɛ kani na Unwoti úbo-ma ɔda.”
2Amu na Mose ɔ́lɔ Besaleel ku Oholiab ku ukyuli biala na Unwoti úte-nwu lɛlati lɛmmɔ ku bani na ɔ́si-ma kayi ka bebebunku kabla kammɔ ka bebo. 3Na Mose úti ala ani ƒui na Israelƒuɔ béte ka béti bátu Kevo Kasakɔ kammɔ úte-ma. Na Israelƒuɔ beesiénku etela ani beti batu ɔtɔ ɔmmɔ ɔtanta ndi ɔtanta ku kayi ƒaa. 4Mmɔ na bekyuli bani ƒui nkya mɔɔtú Kevo kammɔ báda bana abuala béwi. 5Na bésie bátásu Mose banini, “Bekyuli bammɔ béte ala bétulo kalɛ na Unwoti úbo-ma ɔda ka beti batu Kevo kammɔ.”
6Amu na Mose ɔ́tala bekyuli ɔ́kya Israelƒuɔ bammɔ ƒui ka básu-ma banii, “Ɔnana iye uleku ɔdi ɔsɔ uteti etela adi utesienku ka beti batu Kevo kammɔ.” Anwuɔsu báya na bekyuli bammɔ báda ala buti teesienku mmɔ báya. 7Ɔsika ala ani beti batu Kevo kammɔ éemomo étulo kalɛ na baawia.
Kevo Kasakɔ Bɔtu Kalɔ Kesekɔ
8Na bekyuli bani ngyi kabla kammɔ nátu Kevo kammɔ. Na béti unwo buluu ku ugyiedi ɔni náƒɔ kuye bédi adi kpɛtɛ kpɛtɛ ani baaƒala kayakun aduni leevu, na bédi Kerub bebweyi básia aduni ammɔ lɛlɔ. 9Na aduni ammɔ ƒui bɔkɔku bɔdi unwi, bune bɔdi lɛgba aavlene-inyɔ na bɔbɛbɛ bɔdi lɛgba ɛku. 10Na báka aduni alɔ básala ɔvi unwi, na báka alɔ lɛnɔ básala ɔvi ɔkladi. 11Na béti aduni buluu buni gyɛlɛɛ baka-nwu kunu kunu na eƒi atɛ-nwu kemmo, na baka bada aduni enengudi ammɔ atu ɔvi unwi. Na bábla lɛni kani ku lɛduni linengudi linyɔdi lɛnɔ atu na ɔvi unyɔdi. 12Na básɔ bédi ɔbambadi liti bamana ɔvi unwi na bédi ɔbambadi lɛni kani bámana ɔvi ɔkladi na lɛɛtina lɛlɔ. 13Na banwamana sika ugyiedi bábla ala abalala liti kalɛ na uƒie aduni akpa anyɔ ammɔ ɔsala kalɛ na kevo kammɔ kasala kabla lɛla linwi.
14Na béti bese linwini bédi aduni leevu-unwi bébi kevo kammɔ eli. 15Na aduni leevu-unwi ammɔ bɔkɔku bɔdi unwi lɛgba aavlene-ɛlɔ bune na bɔbɛbɛ bɔdi lɛgba ɛku. 16Na báka aduni alɔ básala ɔvi unwi na báka ɛku lɛnɔ básala ɔvi unyɔdi. 17Amu na báka eƒi kunu kunu liti báda kayakun aduni ammɔ kɔtu ɔvi unwi na bábla lɛni kani ku ɔvi unyɔdi. 18Na béti abuala egyiedi bánwamana bábla ala abalala liti báda libila lɛdiku lɛmmɔ básala. 19Na béti koƒonu ɔku ɔni békpeyi na bákya-nwu kuvogyie báka básala béti bébi Kevo kammɔ katɔ na béti ɛpu kemmo ebuo ɔku lɛnɔ báka básala bébi udeedi ɔmmɔ lɛlɔ.
20Na béti akasia kugyikɛ bása bágyi ɔban bálɛ eku eku. 21Na liku biala bɔkuku bɔdi lɛgba leevu-ɛlɔ. Na nwuna bɔbɛbɛ bɔdi lɛgba inyɔ ku kakɛ. 22Na liku biala kalɔ lɛgba inyɔ bɔlɛ. Lɛni na eku ammɔ kalɔ ƒui ese ɔ́mana kevo kaduli kammɔ. 23Bábla ɔban ɔmmɔ eku aavlanyɔ bálɛ kevo kaduli kada kakɛ. 24Na bánwi sika ɔƒualadi agbanvuo aavlene bákya lɛgba lɛmmɔ kalɔ. Na liku linwi lɛda agbanvuo inyɔ, na ɔgba biala úduo ɔgbanvuo unwi kemmo. 25Bása eku ammɔ aavlanyɔ bákya kaduli kammɔ katɔ kakɛ. 26Na bánwi sika ɔƒualadi agbanvuo aavlene, na béti inyɔ bákya liku biala kalɔ. 27Na bása eku aku bálɛ kaduli kammɔ ɔƒɛ kanukɔ kakɛ. 28Na bása eku anyɔ bákya kaduli kammɔ lɛkɔkɔ. 29Na lɛkɔkɔ ligyii lɛmmɔ básala-ni ɔ́si kalɔ betédu katɔ, na nina inyɔ líduo ɔgbanvuo unwi kemmo. 30Anwuɔsu eku ammɔ ebo maane ku sika ɔƒualadi agbanvuo leevu-ɛku, na inyɔ bɔkya liku biala kalɔ.
31Na lɛnɔ ni, béti akasia ligyii bábla lɛtagyii ɛlɔ básia kevo kammɔ ɔƒɛnyi unwi. 32Na básia lɛtagyii ɛlɔ bamba na ɔƒɛnyi unyɔdi lɛnɔ, na básia ɛlɔ na ɔƒɛ kanukɔ na kevo kammɔ kawɔlɔkɔ ƒui. 33Na ɔtagyii ɔni na ntɛntɛ úne ɔ́si ligyii lɛni nnye ntɛ mmɔ ɔvi unwi úsie ɔkladi. 34Na béti sika ugyiedi bákwa ligyii lɛni nnye mmɔ lɛlɔ ƒui. Na béti sika ugyiedi kɔkwɛnimi báda lɛtagyii lɛmmɔ na bákwa ani lɛnɔ ku sika ugyiedi.
35Na béti unwo buluu ku ugyiedi ɔni náƒɔ kuye ku adi kpɛtɛ kpɛtɛ na bédi kakpakɔ bule kɔdi kɔmmɔ, na bédi Kerub bebweyi básia-nwu lɛlɔ. 36Na béti akasia ligyii bábla akpa ene na bakwa-ni lɛlɔ ku sika ugyiedi. Na bábla sika ugyiedi kɔkwɛnimi kɔbaladi ku nina sika ɔƒualadi agbanvuo. 37Na kevo kammɔ kayakun ni, béti unwo buluu ku ugyiedi ɔni náƒɔ kuye ku adi kpɛtɛ kpɛtɛ na bédi lɛduni. Na bedine babuni nábla kɔlɛmii básia-nwu lɛlɔ. 38Bánwi ligyii ɛlɔ ku nina kɔkwɛnimi kɔbaladi, na bákwa-ni ku sika ugyiedi. Na béti abuala egyiedi bábla ligyii lɛmmɔ agbanvuo.

Title: ISRAELƑUƆ BƆLƐ 37
Content:
Katɔti Bunyimi Adaka
1Amu na Besaleel úti akasia kugyikɛ na ɔ́nwi Bunyimi Adaka ɔmmɔ. Na adaka ɔmmɔ bune bɔdi lɛgba ɛtɛ ku kakɛ. Na nwuna bɔkuku bɔdi lɛgba inyɔ ku kakɛ. 2Na úti sika ugyiedi ɔ́nwamina úwi-nwu kemmo ku kama, na úti anwu kani ɔ́da-nwu atu ɔ́mana. 3Na úti sika ugyiedi ɔ́bla kɔkwɛnimi ɔ́da adaka ɔmmɔ lɛgba ine bɔmmɔ lɛlɔ na ɔƒɛnyi ɔni ku ɔni. 4Amu na ɔ́nwi akasia ligyii na ɔ́kwa-ni ku sika ugyiedi. 5Na úti ɔ́kya kɔkwɛnimi kɔmmɔ kemmo.
6Na úti sika ugyiedi sɔɔn ɔ́bla likpidi kɔtu bɔni budie libila úte Adaka ɔmmɔ. Na libila lɛmmɔ bune bɔdi lɛgba ɛtɛ ku kakɛ na nwuna bɔbɛbɛ bɔdi lɛgba inyɔ ku kakɛ. 7Na úti sika ugyiedi ɔ́bla Kerub bebweyi bani muuveyi inyɔ. 8Na úti-ma ɔ́lɛ libila lɛmmɔ lɛƒɛnyi inyɔ. Na Kerub bebweyi bammɔ badanku libila lɛmmɔ lɛlɔ. 9Na bebweyi bammɔ baanu lɛlɔ na bana avwi étile adaka mmɔ.
Bávɔ Lɛla Lɛni Lɛlɔ Badubo Bodobodo Butaasia
10Amu na úti akasia kugyikɛ na ɔ́nwi ala kasiakɔ na nwuna bune bɔdi lɛgba ɛtɛ na nwuna bɔbɛbɛ bɔdi ɔgba unwi ku kakɛ na nwuna bɔkuku bɔdi lɛgba inyɔ ku kakɛ. 11Na úti sika ugyiedi ɔ́kwa-nwu lɛlɔ na úti ɔdi lɛnɔ ɔ́bala-nwu atu ɔ́mana. 12Na ɔ́bla eƒi ɔ́kya-nwu ɔ́mana na úti sika ugyiedi ɔ́kya eƒi ammɔ ɔ́mana. 13Ɔ́bla sika ugyiedi kɔkwɛnimii kɔdi ɔ́kya-nwu lɛkɔkɔ ine bɔmmɔ na kesii kani na lɛgba lɛmmɔ lɛda na atu kakɛ. 14Na kɔkwɛnimi kɔmmɔ kemmo na beeti ligyii taakya kalɛ na ɔdia na bagyu-nwu. 15Na akasia ligyii na úti ɔ́nwi ligyii lɛni na baagyú-nwu mmɔ na úti sika ugyiedi ɔ́kwa-ni lɛlɔ. 16Na úti sika ugyiedi na ɔ́kwa akyami ku ebui ku ana udu ku lɛɛƒɛɛ kalɛ beti bataabla ntɛ akpala.
Bábla Asogya Kasiakɔ Ligyii
17Amu na úti sika ugyiedi ugyii na útu-nwu ɔ́bla asogya kasiakɔ ugyii na ubo ɔka ku ugyii ɔni muunye-nwu lɛlɔ. Na úti kugyii anwula aani ɔɔƒɛɛ udu ku nwuna evete ƒui ɔ́bla unwi ɔ́danku lɛlɔ ɔ́mana-nwu lɛlɔ na ɔɔdia bɔnu. 18Na ɔ́bla kɔgba ɛku ɔ́da ugyii ɔmmɔ lɛlɔ, ɛtɛ bɔda ɔƒɛnyi unwi na ɛtɛ na ɔƒɛnyi ɔkladi lɛnɔ lɛlɔ. 19Na ɔ́bla kugyii anwula ani nébimi aani lɛɛƒɛɛ udu ɛtɛ ku ani nése kalɔ eebimi ɔ́mana kɔgba ɛku kɔmmɔ ɔdi biala lɛlɔ. 20Na ɔ́bla ine bamba lɛnɔ ɔ́mana ugyii ɔmmɔ ɔlati lɛlɔ ekpo ene. 21Na kesii biala kani na kɔgba kɔmmɔ kɔdanku ugyii ɔmmɔ lɛlɔ ni, lɛɛƒɛɛ udu anwula ammɔ alɛ. 22Na asogya kasiakɔ kammɔ ku nwuna kɔgba ku anwula ammɔ ƒui ni, bábla-nwu na ɔdi lɛlakpa linwi ɔdanku lɛlɔ ku sika ugyiedi sɔɔn.
23Na ɔ́bla lɛsogya maatɛ lɛmmɔ adikpi linyenela ku ntɔ kewikɔ ku nina lɛlɔ kabla ablala ƒui ku sika ugyiedi. 24Na sika ugyiedi edula ebi akyami maane ku kakɛ unu na béti bábla ala ammɔ.
Bábla Oloƒui Kakyulakɔ Lɛbi
25Amu na úti akasia kugyikɛ na ɔ́nwi oloƒui bɔkyula lɛbi. Na nwuna bune bɔdi ɔgba unwi ku kakɛ na nwuna bɔbɛbɛ bɔdi ɔgba unwi ku kakɛ na nwuna bɔkuku bɔdi lɛgba ɛtɛ. Na lɛbi lɛmmɔ ku ese ani nlɛ-nwu atu ene ammɔ ƒui adanku lɛlɔ ɔ́bla unwi. 26Na úti sika ugyiedi ɔ́kwa-nwu katɔ ku amadɔ ku ese ammɔ lɛlɔ ƒui ɔ́mana. 27Na úti sika ugyiedi na ɔ́bla kɔkwɛnimi inyɔ ɔ́da lɛkpabi lɛmmɔ atu kada kakɛ blii na lɛƒɛnyi inyɔ lɛlɔ kalɛ ɔkana ligyii lɛmmɔ bɔda na ɔdia buti. 28Na úti sika ugyiedi na ɔ́kwa akasia ligyii lɛni badubo kɔkwɛnimi kɔmmɔ kemmo bɔkya.
29Na ɔ́sɔ ɔbla ala kewikɔ kesii kani beewi nnɔmii kedee ku oloƒui ɔni muunwenyi ƒɛƒɛɛ na béti ala ƒɛƒɛɛ básala-nwu.

Title: ISRAELƑUƆ BƆLƐ 38
Content:
Batu Akpala Bɔkyula Lɛkpabi
1Na ɔ́bla akpala bɔkyula lɛkpabi ku akasia kugyikɛ na nwuna bune bɔdi lɛgba maatɛ ku kakɛ na nwuna bɔbɛbɛ bɔdi lɛgba maatɛ ku kakɛ na nwuna bɔkuku bɔdi lɛgba ine ku kakɛ. 2Na ɔ́nwi bebuo ese ɔ́lɛ ekpo ene ammɔ ƒui na ana ƒui adanku lɛlɔ ábla lɛla linwi. Na úti abuala egyiedi ɔ́kwa-nwu lɛlɔ. 3Na ɔ́vɔ akyami ku soƒi ku ogya akyami ku kɔbuɛlɛmii lidu lidu. Na ala amɛni ƒui abuala egyiedi na úti ɔ́vɔ-nya. 4Na úti abuala egyiedi na ɔ́bla lɛla lɛni kemmo na ntɔ bɔdubo butaalɛ ɔ́kya lɛbi lɛmmɔ kalɔ na ɔ́kuku úbedu-ni nte bule. 5Na ɔ́bla kɔkwɛnimi ine ɔ́da ntɔ lɛƒɔla lɛmmɔ atu ene ammɔ kalɛ na ɔdia na beti ligyii bavinku-nwu kemmo. 6Na ɔ́nwi akasia ligyii na úti abuala egyiedi ɔ́kwa-ni lɛlɔ. 7Na úti ɔkya kɔkwɛnimi kɔmmɔ kemmo kalɛ na ɔdia na bataagyu lɛkpabi lɛni bábla ku kugyikɛ na liƒi lɛtɛ-nwu kemmo mmɔ.
Bávɔ Lɛlɔ Bɔƒɔ Lɛkyami
8Amu na úti beleku bani mɔɔbla kabla na kasakɔ kedee kayakun kenye mmɔ abuala egyiedi kanu ɔ́vɔ lɛkyami bonwu lɛdi ku nwuna ɔka.
Katɔti Kevo Kaduli
9Ɔmmɔ kama ni, ɔ́bla kaduli ɔ́kya kevo kammɔ. Na úti aduni kpɛtɛ kpɛtɛ abuni geen ɔ́ƒala ɔ́mana úti úsie kada kakɛ. Na nwuna bune bɔdi lɛgba eti atɛ (150). 10Na akpa aavlanyɔ ammɔ ku ana aka ƒui adi abuala egyiedi ku sika ɔƒualadi abalala na úti ligyii aavlanyɔ lɛni na úti abuala egyiedi ɔ́kwa-nya lɛlɔ ɔda-nwu lɛlɔ. 11Katɔ kakɛ lɛnɔ kadi lɛgba eti atɛ (150) ku nwuna abuala egyiedi akpa aavlanyɔ ku ana ɔka ku sika ɔƒualadi abalala.
12Na ɔƒɛ kanukɔ ni, ɔdi lɛgba liti ku aavlanyɔ-ɛlɔ na aduni leevu aƒa akpa leevu ammɔ ku ana ɔka lɛlɔ ku sika ɔƒualadi abalala. 13Na kawɔlɔkɔ kani nésie ɔƒɛ katukɔ kakɛ ni, ɔdi lɛgba liti ku aavlanyɔ-ɛlɔ. 14Na aduni ani bune ndi lɛgba aavlanyɔ-inyɔ nƒa kayakun kammɔ ɔvi unwi ku akpa atɛ ani nnye ana ɔka lɛlɔ. 15Lɛni kani na kayakun ɔvi unyɔdi lɛnɔ aduni lɛgba aavlanyɔ-inyɔ ku kakɛ bune bɔƒa ku akpa atɛ ani nnye ana kalɔ ɔka lɛlɔ. 16Na aduni ani ƒui nƒa ámana kaduli kammɔ adi adi abuni kpɛtɛ kpɛtɛ ani na bédi ku unwo ɔƒualadi. 17Na ligyii lɛmmɔ ɔdi biala kalɔ ɔka ɔdi abuala egyiedi. Na akpa ammɔ abalala ani ƒui nda-nya lɛlɔ adi sika ɔƒualadi.
18Na kaduli kammɔ kayakun aduni ni, unwo buluu ku ugyiedi ɔni náƒɔ kuye geen na béti bédi-nya. Na ana bune bɔdi lɛgba avlaatɛ na bɔbɛbɛ bɔdi lɛgba maatɛ ku kakɛ aani kaduli kammɔ aduni akladi kalɛ. 19Na ligyii lɛmmɔ libo ine ku nina abuala egyiedi ɔka ine. Na akpa ammɔ eli ku abalala ani nda-nya lɛlɔ adi sika ɔƒualadi. 20Na Adi Kevo ku kaduli kammɔ ewele ani nda-nwu ámana adi abuala egyiedi.
Katɔti Kevo Atula
21Amɛni ndi Katɔti Bunyimi Kevo atula ani na Lewiƒuɔ bénweni ɔkɛnku Mose ɔda bubo kenye na ɔkpane Aaron ubidi Itamar ntɔnku-ma. 22Na Besaleel ɔni ɔti ndi Uri ɔni ɔti ndi Hur ɔni nási Yuda kaba kemmo nábla lɛla biala na Unwoti úbo ɔda. 23Na ubunkune ɔni baalɔ banii Oholiab ɔni ndi Ahisamak ubidi na ɔ́si Dan kaba kemmo na ɔdi enu kabla lidu ɔblane ni, ɔgyi bɔtaa ku adi buluu ku egyiedi kpɛtɛ kpɛtɛ ani náƒɔ kuye geen budi. 24Na akpala ani bekyuli bammɔ béte na bákɔliku katɔ bébo kudu béte Unwoti na ɔdi sika ugyiedi bumomo bɔdubɔbla aani edula ebi aƒo leevu unu.
25Na sika ɔƒualadi ɔni na kadi bammɔ bekyuli bani na báka mmɔ béyii ɔdi edula ebi aƒɔ avlaatɛ ku kakɛ unu. 26Na kuyii kɔni na báda béte ukyuli biala na báka mmɔ ɔdi edula ebi ɔɔƒɛɛ blii keyile unu. Na banana bani náaƒɔ akwa aavlanyɔ ku kama na báka-ma bumomo bɔdi nkyuli mpim eti leevu-anyɔ ku ɛtɛ ku eti leevu-unwi (603,550) 27Na sika ɔƒualadi edula ebi aƒo avlaatɛ ku kakɛ unu ɔni ndi bɔkɔku talento eti anyɔ ɔmmɔ, na béti bábla kevo kammɔ ku akpa ammɔ kalɔ ɔka eti anyɔ ammɔ. Na ɔka biala ɔda talento unwi ɔni ndi edula ebi akyami aavlanyɔ-ɛtɛ. 28Na sika ɔƒualadi ɔni nébu na wabla aani edula ebi akyami leevu-ɛlɔ unu ni, Besaleel úti ɔ́bla akpa ammɔ kɔkwɛnimi kɔbaladi ku aduni ani mɔɔbala akpa ammɔ eli ku lɛlɔ.
29Na abuala egyiedi akpala ani bákɔliku katɔ bébo kudu béte Unwoti mmɔ unu ɔdi edula ebi aƒo aavlanyɔ ku kakɛ unu. 30Na anwu na béti bábla kalɔ ɔka béte Kevo Kasakɔ kayakun ku abualagyie lɛkpabi lɛmmɔ ku nina abualagyie ntɔ kaƒɔkɔ kammɔ ku kana lɛlɔ ablala ƒui 31ku kaduli kammɔ akpa ammɔ ku kana kaduli kammɔ kayakun ku ewele ani nda kevo ku kaduli kammɔ ámana ƒui. Ligyii lɛni nda ɔtɔ ɔmmɔ kemmo ku kama.

Title: ISRAELƑUƆ BƆLƐ 39
Content:
Báka Bakpane Lɛwu
1Amu na béti linwo buluu ku ligyiedi lɛni náƒɔ kuye geen na bédi lɛwu lɛni mɔɔdia bɔnu béte bakpane bani ndubo kabla butaabla na Unwoti Adi Kevo kedee kammɔ kemmo. Na bédi ɔkpane awu sɛsɛɛ béte Aaron aani kalɛ na Unwoti úbo Mose ɔda.
2Na béti linwo buluu ku ligyiedi lɛni náƒɔ kuye geen bédi bakpane awu kpɛtɛ kpɛtɛ kedee ɔni mɔɔdia bɔnu geen na béti sika ugyiedi bákya-nwu bɔdia. 3Sika ugyiedi na bétu bábla aani kɔbuli gyɛlɛɛ na bélii-nwu básala ku linwo buluu ku ligyiedi na bedine babuni geen bédi-nwu kaduɛ ku adi kpɛtɛ kpɛtɛ. 4Na béti kadii bada-nwu atu anyɔ ammɔ na ɔdia beteebo taada lɛlɔ. 5Na bédi kavobi lɛduni na lɛ́lɛ kadii kammɔ ku linwo buluu ku ligyiedi lɛni náƒɔ kuye ku kɔdi kpɛtɛ kpɛtɛ. Na bákya-nwu bɔdia ku sika ugyiedi báda awu ɔmmɔ lɛlɔ na ɔ́bla unwi aani kalɛ Unwoti úbo Mose ɔda.
6Béti atabi anyɔ ani náƒɔ kuye na baalɔ-nya oniks na bénweni Israel bebi anyi básia-nya lɛlɔ. 7Na báka-nwu bámana awu kedee ɔmmɔ amangba lɛlɔ aani likposela úte Israelƒuɔ aani kalɛ na Unwoti úbo Mose ɔda.
Kayi Lɛbalala Lɛdiku
8Na kayi lɛbalala lɛdiku lɛmmɔ ni, bedine babuni geen nédi-ni aani awu kedee ɔmmɔ kalɛ. Na bédi-nwu ku linwo buluu ku ligyiedi lɛni náƒɔ kuye geen ku adi kpɛtɛ kpɛtɛ. 9Na kɔdi kɔmmɔ ni, báƒɛ-ku kemmo inyɔ. Na nwuna bɔbɛbɛ ku bune ƒui bɔdi bɔkɔku bunwi aani lɛnimi ntɛ bukulo yaalenwi ɔƒɛnyi biala. 10Na béti atabi ani náƒɔ kuye báka lɛgala ine bámana-nwu lɛlɔ. Na ɔgaala udeedi atabi adi sardis ku topas ku beril. 11Na ɔgaala unyɔdi atabi adi torkis ku sapir ku smardo. 12Na ɔgaala ɔtɛdi atabi adi yiakint ku agate ku ametist. 13Na ɔgaala unedi atabi adi krisolit ku oniks ku yaspa. Na lɛni bámana atabi ammɔ na sika ugyiedi asɛɛ ebi eƒi kemmo. 14Na adi atabi leevu-inyɔ ani lɛlɔ na bénweni Yakob bebi leevu-inyɔ bammɔ anyi básia unwi unwi. Na adi ekposela úte Israelƒuɔ kaba leevu-inyɔ bammɔ.
15Na kayi lɛdiku lɛmmɔ lɛlɔ ni, béti sika ugyiedi bélii-nwu aani kɔbuli. 16Na béti sika ugyiedi na bédie asɛɛ ebi eƒi anyɔ na bábla kɔkwɛnimii inyɔ na béti bákya lɛdiku lɛmmɔ atu. 17Na béti sika ugyiedi kɔbuli inyɔ bákya kɔkwɛnimii kɔmmɔ kemmo na lɛdiku lɛmmɔ lɛlɔ. 18Na sika ugyiedi kɔbuli kɔmmɔ eli anyɔ akladi ni, béti-nya bébo báda awu kedee ɔmmɔ amangba na sika asɛɛ ebi eƒi anyɔ ammɔ kemmo na anumi kakɛ. 19Na básɔ bábla sika ugyiedi kɔkwɛnimii inyɔ bamba báda lɛdiku lɛmmɔ atu na kemmo kakɛ kesii kani nda awu kedee ɔmmɔ lɛlɔ. 20Na básɔ bábla sika ugyiedi kɔkwɛnimii inyɔ bamba báda kayi lɛdiku lɛmmɔ amangba kada kakɛ na kesii kani na kavobi lɛduni lɛmmɔ lɛdanku awu kpɛtɛ kpɛtɛ ɔmmɔ na kadii kani na bákya bɔdia mmɔ kudɔ mmɔ. 21Bébo unwo buluu kadii kammɔ báda lɛdiku lɛmmɔ kɔkwɛnimii bábala bádanku awu kedee ɔmmɔ kɔkwɛnimii lɛlɔ. Na kadii kammɔ kasia awu ɔmmɔ kavobi lɛduni lɛni bédi bákya-ni bɔdia mmɔ lɛlɔ kalɛ na ɔda lɛdiku lɛmmɔ use nwuna keliekɔ.
Báka Bakpane Bakladi Lɛwu
22Na awu gyɔlɔɔ ɔni lɛlɔ na bakpane awu kpɛtɛ kpɛtɛ kedee ɔmmɔ ɔɔsia ni, báka-nwu na ɔdi kɔdi buluu. 23Na bédie liƒi kesii kani na lili lɛɛví na kɔdi kɔmmɔ ntɛntɛ na bédie liƒi lɛmmɔ békpo atu kalɛ na uleyile bɔbwɛ. 24Na awu gyɔlɔɔ ɔmmɔ atu na lɛgba kada ni, béti unwo buluu ku ugyiedi ɔni náƒɔ kuye bédi egyiibi adi udu básia bámana. 25Na béti sika ugyiedi lɛdɔn wɛlɛ wɛlɛ báƒala-nwu ntɛ aani kalɛ kani na Unwoti úbo Mose ɔda.
26Na awu gyɔlɔɔ ɔni na baakya taabla lɛkpa mmɔ atu na lɛgba kada ni, béti unwo buluu ku ugyiedi ɔni náƒɔ kuye bédi egyiibi adi udu básia bámana na béti sika ugyiedi lɛdɔn wɛlɛ wɛlɛ báƒala-nwu ntɛ.
27Na bédi awu ɔtɔdi akɔnkɔ bune ku adi kpɛtɛ kpɛtɛ buni béte Aaron ku nwuna bebi bananabi. 28Na dukuu kɔbwa ku eli aduni bamba ƒui ku awu gyɔlɔɔ kalɔ lɛwuku lɛmmɔ ni, bédi-ni ku adi kpɛtɛ kpɛtɛ buni ƒui. 29Na kavobi lɛduni lɛmmɔ ni, béti unwo buluu ku ugyiedi ɔni náƒɔ kuye bédi-nwu na bávili-nwu atu kaduɛ aani kalɛ na Unwoti úbo Mose ɔda.
30Na béti sika ugyiedi na bábla kalɛkɛ blii kadi na bánwi-nwu kemmo na bénweni básia banii, Ɔmɛni Use Sɛsɛɛ Ute Unwoti. 31Na unwo buluu na bényimi bámana kabwa kammɔ anumi aani kalɛ kani na Unwoti úbo Mose ɔda.
Mose Úsie Útánu Kalɛ Bátu Unwoti Kevo Kammɔ
32Ɔmɛni ɔsu Israelƒuɔ báwɔlɔ Unwoti Adi Kevo kani ndi Kevo Kasakɔ kammɔ bɔtu. Na bátu-nwu pɛpɛɛpɛ aani kalɛ kani na Unwoti úbo Mose ɔda. 33Amu na béti Unwoti Adi Kevo kammɔ atula ammɔ ƒui bátátina Mose na ɔ́nu kalɛ bánwi kɔyakun ku ƒansili kugyikɛ ku lɛtagyii lɛmmɔ ku akpa ku ana kalɔ ɔka ɔmmɔ. 34Na ɔ́nu kalɛ békpeyi baƒonu lɛku na bákya-ni kuvo kugyiedi béte adaka ɔmmɔ bubi ku bebuo bamba lɛku na bábla kakpakɔ bule kɔdi béte adaka ɔmmɔ. 35Na ɔ́nu Bunyimi Adaka ɔmmɔ ku nwuna ligyii ku likpidi kɔtu bɔni budie libila lɛmmɔ. 36Na ɔ́nu ala kasiakɔ kammɔ ku nwuna lɛlɔ ala ku bodobodo ɔni muusé Unwoti anumi. 37Ɔ́nu sika ugyiedi asogya kasiakɔ ligyii ku lɛsogya lɛmmɔ otogyi ƒui ku nina lɛlɔ ala ku lɛsogya nnɔmii bɔmmɔ. 38Na ɔ́nu sika ugyiedi lɛkpabi lɛmmɔ ku likpose nnɔmii ku oloƒui ƒɛƒɛɛ ɔmmɔ ku kevo kammɔ kayakun aduni ammɔ. 39Ɔ́nu abuala egyiedi lɛkpabi ku abuala egyiedi ntɔ kaƒɔkɔ kammɔ ku ana ligyii ku kabla ablala ku ɔdi lɛlɔ bɔƒɔ lɛkyami bonwu ku nina ɔka. 40Ɔ́nu Unwoti Adi Kevo kammɔ kaduli aduni ku kana ligyii ku ɔka ɔni lɛlɔ na liinye ku kaduli kayakun lɛduni ku kana lɛbuli ku ewele ku Unwoti Adi Kevo kani ndi Kevo Kasakɔ kammɔ lɛlɔ ala ƒui. 41Na ɔ́nu Aaron lɛwu sɛsɛɛ lɛni bédi ku nwuna bebi lɛwu lɛni na badubo butaakya taabla bakpane kabla.
42Na Israelƒuɔ bábla kabla kammɔ pɛpɛɛpɛ kalɛ kani na Unwoti úbo Mose ɔda. 43Na ka Mose ɔ́sia ala ammɔ ƒui anu na ɔ́nu ka bábla-nya kalɛ kani na Unwoti úbo-nwu ɔda ni, úte Israelƒuɔ kusɛ kusɛ.

Title: ISRAELƑUƆ BƆLƐ 40
Content:
Bátu Unwoti Adi Kevo Kammɔ Báwɔlɔ
1Amu na Unwoti ɔ́su Mose ɔnini, 2“Lɛ Adi Kevo kani ndi Kevo Kasakɔ kammɔ na kɔbuli kudeedi kuna limeyi lideedi lɛlɔ. 3Na eti Bunyimi Adaka ɔmmɔ alɛ-nwu kemmo na eti kakpakɔ bule kɔdi kɔni mɔɔbala adaka ɔmmɔ anumi aƒala. 4Na alɛ ala kasiakɔ kammɔ na eti ala ani na ɔlɛka beti basia-nwu lɛlɔ asia. Na eti asogya kasiakɔ ugyii ɔmmɔ alɛ na eti lɛsogya lɛmmɔ ƒui asia-nwu lɛlɔ. 5Na eti oloƒui bɔkyula sika ugyiedi lɛbi lɛmmɔ alɛ Bunyimi Adaka ɔmmɔ anumi na eti kɔdi aƒala kevo kammɔ kayakun.
6“Na eti lɛkpabi lɛni lɛlɔ badubo butaakyula akpala alɛ Unwoti Adi Kevo kani ndi Kevo Kasakɔ ɔmmɔ kayakun. 7Na eti lɛkyami lɛni kemmo badubo enu butaaƒɔ alɛ ɔtɔ ɔmmɔ ku lɛkpabi lɛmmɔ ntɛ na edu ntu eyile-nwu kemmo. 8Na alɛ kevo kaduli kammɔ ɔban eku amana na eti kayakun kɔdi aƒala kayakun kammɔ.
9“Si áwɔlɔ ala ammɔ ƒui bɔbla ni, na eti nnɔmii kedee na akuna ewi kevo kammɔ ku ala ani ƒui nkya-ka kemmo na abla-nya sɛsɛɛ na adubuse kedee. 10Na akuna nnɔmii bɔmmɔ bɔdi ewi lɛkpabi lɛni lɛlɔ badubo akpala butaabla lɛlɔ ku akyami ani ndubuse mmɔ ƒui lɛlɔ na ala ammɔ ƒui adubo bɔbla kedee ƒui. 11Na akuna nnɔmii bɔmmɔ bɔdi ewi lɛkyami lɛni kemmo badubo enu butaaƒɔ ku nwuna ɔka ɔmmɔ na abla-nwu sɛsɛɛ.
12“Na akpanku Aaron ku nwuna bebi bananabi eboku kevo kammɔ kenye na akpila-ma ntu. 13Na ɔmmɔ kama na eti ɔkpane awu kedee ɔmmɔ akya Aaron na awɛɛ-nwu nnɔmii kedee bɔmmɔ ese-nwu likpo. Kalɛ wakana na wabla ɔkpane wete-mi. 14Na akpanku Aaron bebi lɛnɔ eboku na akya-ma bana lɛwu lɛmmɔ. 15Na awɛɛ-ma nnɔmii ese-ma likpo aani kalɛ kani na áwɛɛ bana ɔti kalɛ ama lɛnɔ babla bakpane bete-mi. Na likpose nnɔmii bɔwɛɛ bɔmɛni bɔdubo bɔbla lɛla lɛni ndubo buse bute bakpane ƒui usela uwi ƒui.” 16Na Mose ɔ́bla ɔsiaku kalɛ kani na Unwoti úbo-nwu ɔda.
17Anwuɔsu bálɛ kevo kammɔ na lɛkwa linyɔdi kɔbuli kudeedi limeyi lideedi lɛlɔ ka bálɛ Egyipte kalɔ lɛlɔ. 18Na kevo kammɔ bɔlɛ kemmo ni, Mose ɔ́ya na bése aka ammɔ ƒui na bálɛ lɛban eku ammɔ ku akpa ammɔ ku lɛtagyii lɛmmɔ ƒui. 19Na ɔ́ya na báni kevo kɔdi kɔmmɔ bébi-nwu lili na ɔ́ya na béti kɔdi kɔtɔdi bébi kɔmmɔ katɔ aani kalɛ kani na Unwoti úbo-nwu ɔda.
20Na uti atabi anyɔ ani na ɔda bubo etemila ásia-nwu lɛlɔ mmɔ ɔ́kya Bunyimi Adaka ɔmmɔ kemmo. Na úti ligyii ɔ́kya eƒi ammɔ kemmo ɔ́danku adaka ɔmmɔ atu. Na úti likpidi kɔtu bɔni budie libila úbi adaka ɔmmɔ katɔ. 21Amu na ɔ́ya na béti adaka ɔmmɔ bése Adi Kevo kammɔ kemmo na béti kakpakɔ bule kɔdi báƒala. Na ɔ́bɛla Bunyimi Adaka ɔmmɔ aani kalɛ na Unwoti úbo-nwu ɔda.
22Amu na ɔ́ya na béti ala kasiakɔ kammɔ béduoku ɔtɔ kemmo bétése kasakɔ kevo kani ndi Unwoti Adi Kevo mmɔ kemmo na katɔ kakɛ na kakpakɔ bule kɔdi kɔmmɔ anumi kakɛ. 23Na ɔ́tɛ Unwoti Bodobodo ɔmmɔ ɔ́sia-nwu lɛlɔ aani kalɛ na Unwoti úbo-nwu ɔda.
24Na úti lɛsogya kasiakɔ ugyii ɔmmɔ lɛnɔ ɔ́lɛ ɔtɔ ɔmmɔ kemmo na kada kakɛ kesii kani na ala kasiakɔ kammɔ kalɛ. 25Na ɔ́tu lɛsogya lɛmmɔ ɔ́sia nina kalɛkɔ mmɔ na Unwoti anumi aani kalɛ na Unwoti úbo-nwu ɔda.
26Na úti sika ugyiedi lɛkpabi lɛmmɔ lɛnɔ ɔ́lɛ ɔtɔ ɔmmɔ kemmo na kesii kani kakpakɔ bule kɔdi kɔmmɔ kɔ́ƒa anumi kakɛ. 27Na ɔ́kyula oloƒui ƒɛƒɛɛ aani kalɛ kani na Unwoti úbo-nwu ɔda. 28Na úti kɔdi ɔ́ƒala kevo kammɔ kayakun.
29Na úti bɔkyula lɛkpabi ɔ́lɛ úde Unwoti Adi Kevo kani ndi Kevo Kasakɔ mmɔ kayakun na ɔ́kyula akpala na béti edula etela lɛnɔ béboku Unwoti na mmɔ aani kalɛ kani na Unwoti úbo-nwu ɔda.
30Na úti lɛkyami lɛni kemmo badubo enu butaaƒɔ mmɔ ɔ́lɛ Kevo Kasakɔ ku lɛkpabi lɛmmɔ ntɛ na ɔ́ya na bédu ntu béwi-ni kemmo kalɛ na bataaƒɔ enu. 31Na lɛkyami lɛmmɔ kemmo na Mose ku Aaron ku Aaron bebi baaƒɔ enu ku lɛgba. 32Na uwi biala na badubuduo Kevo Kasakɔ mmɔ ku si báni beedé lɛkpabi lɛmmɔ ni, baaƒɔ bana enu ku lɛgba aani kalɛ na Unwoti úbo Mose ɔda.
33Amu na Mose ɔ́ya na béti ɔban eku ammɔ na bálɛ bámana bákya kaduli béte kevo ku lɛkpabi lɛmmɔ na béti kayakun kɔdi báƒala kaduli kammɔ kayakun. Anwuɔsu Mose ɔ́wɔlɔ kabla kammɔ.
Unwoti Bukeye Búwi Nwuna Adi Kevo
34Amu na liƒlukutu lɛdi líbebi Kevo Kasakɔ kammɔ lɛlɔ na Unwoti bukeye bɔ́ƒɔ ɔtɔ ɔmmɔ kemmo ƒui. 35Liƒlukutu lɛni mbi ɔtɔ ɔmmɔ lɛlɔ ku kalɛ na Unwoti bukeye bɔ́ƒɔ ɔtɔ ɔmmɔ kemmo ɔsu ni, Mose útakana na uduo ɔtɔ ɔmmɔ kemmo.
36Na Israelƒuɔ ulu buse biala kemmo ni, si bánya bánu ka liƒlukutu lɛmmɔ lɛ́ta Adi Kevo kammɔ eli ni, na ɔlɛka ama lɛnɔ basiaku-nwu. 37Nsu si liƒlukutu lɛmmɔ lítata tɔ ni, ama lɛnɔ balata tɔ wetédu limeyi lɛni na liƒlukutu lɛmmɔ lɛ́ta.
38Anwuɔsu na Israelƒuɔ ulu busie kemmo ƒui ni, Unwoti liƒlukutu lɛmmɔ liibi Adi Kevo kammɔ lɛlɔ na kadi nwaa. Na usien lɛnɔ liinwíni aani lɛgyavonku lɛkpa taatɔnku-ma.

Title: LEWIƑUƆ ƆDA BUBO 1
Content:
Katɔti Úbo Ɔda Na Bebuo Bɔdu Taakyula Akpala Lɛlɔ
1Unwoti ɔ́kpali Mose ɔ́siku Unwoti Adi Kevo kemmo na ɔ́su-nwu ɔnini, 2“Tásu Israel kadi bekyuli anini, ‘Si bina akɔ ɔdi úti akpala etela ɔduboku ami bina Unwoti ni, ɔlɛka uti ebuo ɔsiku nwuna bebuo akɔ iye nwuna ɔmantɛ bakɔ akɔ.
3“ ‘Ɔƒɛni si bebuo bɔkyula akpala na ɔdi ɔdanku ebuo ɔdi ka ubabla ni, na ɔƒuna ebuo ɔni nse sɛɛn na útasɔ kesii kadi na ɔdi ebuo ɔgyani. Na ebuo ɔmmɔ ni, Unwoti Adi Kevo kammɔ kayakun kenye na ɔdubuti-nwu uboku na lɛnu si ɔdia-mi. 4Ɔdi ka ukyuli ɔmmɔ uti kɔnu ɔsia ebuo ɔmmɔ lili, na ɔtina ka ebuo ɔmmɔ na úti uunyene nwuna lɛlɔ kenye kalɛ na lɛƒɔ nwuna akpala bɔkyula ƒui bɔmmɔ na lidie kɔtu bɔni biala na nwuna lɛlɔ. 5Ɔmmɔ kama ni, ɔdubɔdu ɔmantɛ akɔ ɔgyani ɔmmɔ na Unwoti Adi Kevo kammɔ kayakun kenye. Na Aaron bebi bananabi bani ndi bakpane mmɔ ndubɔkɔliku ubugya ɔmmɔ katɔ batina-mi asa na bakuna-nwu bewi lɛkpabi lɛni nnye Unwoti Adi Kevo kammɔ kayakun kenye mmɔ lɛlɔ bamana. 6Ɔmmɔ kama ukyuli ɔmmɔ ɔdubudie akpala bɔkyula ebuo ɔmmɔ ɔku. Na ɔwawa-nwu na ule-nwu kemmo akpa akpa. 7Aaron bebi bakpane bammɔ badubo ogya bɔsala na lɛkpabi lɛmmɔ lɛlɔ. Na bala ekyweni basia-nwu lɛlɔ kaduɛ. 8Si báwɔlɔ ni, badubɔtɛ lɛna lɛmmɔ basia ogya ɔmmɔ lɛlɔ ku ebuo ɔmmɔ lili ku lɛmwi ƒui. 9Na ukyuli ɔmmɔ ɔdubuti kaƒɔ ala ammɔ ku agyobi ɔkya ntu kemmo na ɔƒɔ kaduɛ na beti basia ogya ɔmmɔ lɛlɔ na akywi. Na ɔmmɔ ɔdubɔbla ogya akpala bɔkyula ƒui ute-mi na uyɔ ɔmmɔ ɔnyi ƒɛƒɛɛ ɔyɔ-mi kaƒɔ.
10“ ‘Na si koƒonu iye ese lɛnɔ na ɔdi ɔ́ƒuna na nwuna bebuo akɔ ka uti ɔbla akpala bɔkyula ƒui ɔdi ɔmmɔ lɛnɔ ni, ɔlɛka ɔbla ebuo ɔgyani ɔni na use sɛɛn na útasɔ kesii kadi. 11Na badubɔdu ebuo ɔmmɔ na lɛkpabi lɛmmɔ katɔ kakɛ na Unwoti anumi. Na Aaron bebi, bakpane bammɔ badubuti ubugya ɔmmɔ na bakuna bewi lɛkpabi lɛmmɔ lɛlɔ bamana. 12Badubo-ni bukulo wɛlɛ wɛlɛ na ɔkpane ɔmmɔ ɔtɛ lɛna lɛmmɔ ɔsia ogya ku ekyweni ani nsia lɛkpabi lɛlɔ mmɔ lɛlɔ ku nwuna lili ku lɛmwi ƒui. 13Na agyobi ku kaƒɔ ala ammɔ ni, ɔdubuti-nya ɔkya ntu kemmo na ɔƒɔ kaduɛ. Na bakpane bammɔ beti ana ƒui basia ogya na akywi. Na ɔmmɔ ɔdubɔbla ogya akpala bɔkyula ƒui ute-mi na uyɔ ɔmmɔ ɔnyi ƒɛƒɛɛ ɔyɔ-mi kaƒɔ.
14“ ‘Na si baasɛ na ɔdi úti ubabla bɔkyula ɔdi ɔmmɔ ni, na ɔdi ka ɔƒuna-ma na babloduma iye bamangbɛ akɔ. 15Na ɔkpane ɔmmɔ ɔdubuti-nwu uboku lɛkpabi lɛmmɔ kudɔ, na ulii-nwu limɔ ukulo na uti lili lɛmmɔ ɔkya ogya ɔkyula na lɛkpabi lɛmmɔ lɛlɔ, na ɔya na lɛna lɛkladi ubugya ɔ́yu uwi lɛkpabi lɛmmɔ amadɔ. 16Na udie ala ani nkya nwuna lɛkoolobi koƒo na ɔgya-nwu uwi lɛkpabi lɛmmɔ ɔƒɛ katukɔ kakɛ kesii kani na beedie ogya ntɔ bɔmmɔ teewi. 17Na ɔda-nwu avwi na ɔni-nwu kemmo ɔbwɛ, nsu utamamiku lɛlɔ, na uti-nwu ɔsia ogya ku ekyweni ammɔ lɛlɔ na ɔkywi. Na ɔmmɔ ɔdubɔbla ogya akpala bɔkyula ƒui ute-mi na uyɔ ɔmmɔ ɔnyi ƒɛƒɛɛ ɔyɔ-mi kaƒɔ.’

Title: LEWIƑUƆ ƆDA BUBO 2
Content:
Edula Ebi Akpala Ɔdi
1“ ‘Si ukyuli ɔdi úti edula ebi úboku ɔnii ubabla akpala ni, ɔlɛ ka ɔkɔ ala ammɔ ɔbla ɔlaaƒɔ sɛɛn. Na ɔdi ka uti nnɔ uwi-nwu lili na uti oloƒui ɔsia-nwu lɛlɔ. 2Ɔmɛni kama na uti ala ammɔ uboku Aaron bebi bananabi bakpane bammɔ na badubudie ɔlaaƒɔ ɔmmɔ lɛkɔkɔ linwi ku nwuna lɛlɔ nnɔ ku oloƒui ɔmmɔ ƒui. Na badubuti bakyula lɛkpabi lɛlɔ aani enyimo adila bɔsia akpala. Na ɔmmɔ ɔdubɔbla akpala bɔkyula ƒui ute-mi na uyɔ ɔmmɔ ɔnyi ƒɛƒɛɛ ɔyɔ-mi kaƒɔ. 3Na ɔlaaƒɔ ɔkladi ɔni mebu ɔdi Aaron ku nwuna bebi bananabi ɔdi. Na ɔdi lɛla lɛni na bédie bése sɛsɛɛ na akpala ani na bábla béte-mi kemmo.
4“ ‘Si ukyuli ɔdi úti edula ebi etela ani na béƒi bodobodo lɛyu kemmo ɔduboku-mi ni, ɔlɛka ɔnu ka ɔdi ɔlaaƒɔ sɛɛn ɔni na bɔnyii bɔdi buuubo-nwu kemmo. Na uti nnɔ ɔsala-nwu kemmo. 5Na si lɛbuala kalɛkɛ lɛlɔ na ɔ́bla lɛla lɛni na úti ɔdubo ubete-mi mmɔ ni, ɔnu ka ɔdi ɔlaaƒɔ sɛɛn ɔni na bɔnyii buuubo-nwu kemmo na ɔ́sala-nwu ku nnɔ. 6Na ɔbwɛ-nwu kɔkɛ kɔkɛ na uwi nnɔ. Na ɔmmɔ ɔdi edula etela akpala. 7Na si etela ani na úti ɔduboku mmɔ adi lɛla lɛni na bánwa na lɛbuala libui lɛkya kemmo ni, ɔnu ka ɔlaaƒɔ ɔmmɔ use sɛɛn na ɔ́sala-nwu ku nnɔ. 8Ala ani na lɛ́ka mɛni si ana ɔdi biala na éti edula ebi ábla na éti aduboku-mi ni, na eti ete ɔkpane na anwu ɔdubuti usienku lɛkpabi lɛmmɔ lɛlɔ. 9Na ɔkpane ɔmmɔ ɔdubudie lɛkpabi lɛlɔ enyimo adila ani na ɔdubuti ɔkyula ute-mi na lɛkpabi lɛmmɔ lɛlɔ. Na ɔdubɔbla akpala bɔkyula ƒui ute-mi na uyɔ ɔmmɔ ɔnyi ƒɛƒɛɛ ɔyɔ-mi kaƒɔ. 10Na ɔkladi ɔni mebu ɔdi Aaron ku bebi bananabi ɔdi aani bana kadikɔ kani bédie bése sɛsɛɛ ɔ́siku akpala ani na béboku-mi kemmo.
11“ ‘Edula ebi etela biala na ɔdi éti aduboku-mi ni, nu ka bɔnyii bɔdi buuubo-nwu kemmo. Ɔsika lɛla lɛni kemmo na bɔnyii bɔkya iye uwɔ ni, utalɛka beti-nwu babla ogya akpala bɔkyula ƒui bete-mi. 12Bakana beti ala ammɔ basala ku kemo edula awɔdi ani báka bɔƒɛ beboku-mi aani etela, nsu balakyula-nya aani ogya akpala bɔkyula ƒui na uyɔ ɔmmɔ ɔnyi ƒɛƒɛɛ ɔyɔ-mi kaƒɔ. 13Ɔƒɛni edula ebi etela biala na bíti bɛdububoku-mi ni, bɛnu ka mma bɔsia-nwu lɛlɔ kalɛ na mina bunyimi bɔni ndanku mma emini bɔkya bina kakpa edula etela kemmo uwi biala. Na bɛsia ɔmmɔ anu uwi ndi uwi.
14“ ‘Ɔƒɛni lɛnɔ si bíti edula ebi udu biala ani náka bugyie bɛdububoku-mi ni, bɛƒɛ edula aboyo awɔdi ammɔ na biƒi-nwu ɔgya kemmo na bikuo-nwu na ɔbwɛ na biti bibunku bina edula awɔdi bɔƒɛ etela ammɔ. 15Na biti nnɔ bibunku na biti oloƒui bɛsia. Na ndubɔƒɔ-nwu lite-mii aani edula ebi akpala. 16Ɔmmɔ kama ni, ɔkpane ɔdubudie edula ebi aboyo ani na bíƒi na bíkuo-nya bɛ́bwɛ mmɔ enyimo adila ku nwuna lɛlɔ nnɔ ku oloƒui ɔmmɔ ƒui na uti ɔkyula aani akpala bɔkyula ƒui ute-mi.’

Title: LEWIƑUƆ ƆDA BUBO 3
Content:
Ɔda Bubo Na Unwi Bɔbla Akpala Ɔdi Lɛlɔ
1“ ‘Si ɔdi úti ɔmantɛ akɔ ɔgyani iye uledi úboku ka ubabla unwi bɔbla akpala ni, ɔlɛ ka ɔƒuna ebuo ɔni nse sɛɛn na útasɔ kesii kadi uboku ami Unwoti anumi. 2Na uti nwuna enu ɔsia ebuo ɔmmɔ lili uti ɔtina ka ɔmmɔ na úti únyene nwuna lɛlɔ kenye. Ɔmmɔ kama na badu ebuo ɔmmɔ na Unwoti Adi Kevo kammɔ kenye. Na Aaron bebi bananabi bakpane bammɔ beti ubugya ɔmmɔ bakuna bewi lɛkpabi lɛmmɔ lɛlɔ bamana. 3Na ebuo ɔni na úti ubabla unwi bɔbla akpala ammɔ kaƒɔ kemmo lɛmwi ku lɛmwi lɛni mma kaƒɔ ala ammɔ lɛlɔ ƒui ni, ɔdubuti ute na bakyula bete-mi. 4Na ɔmmɔ ubunku akabi ammɔ ku lɛmwi lɛni mma-nwu lɛlɔ ku kasɔma lɛmwi ku akɔ ammɔ kenye kakɛ. 5Na Aaron bebi bananabi bammɔ badubuti basia ekyweni ani mɔɔda mmɔ lɛlɔ na ɔkywi. Na ɔmmɔ ɔdubɔbla ogya akpala bɔkyula ƒui ute-mi na uyɔ ɔmmɔ ɔnyi ƒɛƒɛɛ ɔyɔ-mi kaƒɔ.
6“ ‘Nsu si bese ku baƒonu na ɔdanku úboku ka ubabla unwi bɔbla akpala ɔdi ɔmmɔ ute-mi ni, ɔkana uboku ebuo ɔgyani iye uledi. Nsu ɔnu ka use sɛɛn na útasɔ kesii kadi. 7Na si koƒonu ubi na ɔda ɔnii uuti uboku aani nwuna akpala ni, ɔlɛka uti uboku mina anumi. 8Na ɔdubuti enu ɔsia-ku lili na ɔmmɔ kama na ɔdu-nwu na Unwoti Adi Kevo kammɔ kenye. Na Aaron bebi bananabi bammɔ badubuti ubugya ɔmmɔ bakuna bewi lɛkpabi lɛmmɔ lɛlɔ bamana. 9Na koƒonu ubi ɔni na ɔdanku úboku úbabla unwi bɔbla akpala ammɔ ni, ɔdubudie kuna lɛmwi lɛni ndanku nwuna ɔka ku kasɔma likubi lɛmwi ku kaƒɔ ala lɛmwi lɛni mma-nwu lɛlɔ ku kaƒɔ kemmo lɛmwi lɛmmɔ ƒui. 10Na udie akabi anyɔ ammɔ ku lɛmwi lɛni mma-nwu lɛlɔ ku kasɔma lɛmwi ku akɔ ammɔ kawɔlɔkɔ mmɔ. 11Na ɔkpane ɔdubuti ala amɛni kakɛ kadi ɔkyula na lɛkpabi lɛlɔ. Na ɔmmɔ ɔdubɔbla ogya akpala bɔkyula ute-mi na uyɔ ɔmmɔ ɔnyi ƒɛƒɛɛ ɔyɔ-mi kaƒɔ aani kalɛ na lɛdila liimó ukyuli.
12“ ‘Ɔƒɛni si ese na ɔdanku úboku ubabla akpala ammɔ ni, ɔlɛka uti uboku Unwoti anumi. 13Na ɔdubuti enu ɔsia-nwu lili.
