Anwuɔsu báni béde Mose ku Aaron limeyi lɛmmɔ lɛlɔ kani 7na básu Mose banini, “Ka bula ukyuli ɔdi úkpi ɔsu ni, bɔ́nu ka buuuse sɛɛn, nsu bi ɔsu na abu bulakana bula akpala buti busienku Unwoti ku bula bakpana na limeyi lɛni na básu bése mmɔ lɛlɔ?”
8Amu na Mose údie kenye na ɔ́su-ma ɔnini, “Bɛkɛ kayi utédu ka lɛ́tɛmiku Unwoti na bina litemi lɛmɛni lɛlɔ.”
9Mmɔ na Unwoti ɔ́su Mose ɔnini, 10“Kɔ lɛsa na asu Israelƒuɔ anini, ‘Si úbo úte ka bina akɔ ɔdi ɔ́sɔ na uuuse sɛɛn ka nwuna lɛlɔ ukyuli ɔdi kukpi ɔsu iye nwuna ulu busie bɔdi ɔsu ni, bamu bebo kuƒi ka badi Kukpi Lili Bɔvia Limeyi. 11Na ɔlɛka badi limeyi lɛmmɔ na kɔbuli kunyɔdi limeyi leevu-linedi lɛlɔ useyi uwi. Na ɔlɛka bakun koƒonu ubi kɔmmɔ ku bodobodo ɔni na bɔnyii buuubo-nwu kemmo ku evete ani mbo ɔdu. 12Na betebu ala ammɔ lɛdi betese na kadi kegye-ni lɛlɔ iye babwɛ likubi lɛdi lɛnɔ si baadi. Ɔƒɛni si baadi limeyi lɛmɛni ni, badi bunyimi bɔmmɔ ƒui lɛlɔ kaduɛ. 13Nsu ukyuli ɔni na use sɛɛn na útesie ulu ɔdi lɛnɔ na úni limeyi lɛmmɔ bɔdi ni, ɔdi ka bedie-nwu nwuna badi akɔ, ɔsika úni nwuna akpala buti busienku Unwoti na uwi ɔni na bése bése lɛlɔ. Na ukyuli ɔmmɔ ɔlati ɔdubuti anwu ɔlati nwuna ekpidi etila.
14“ ‘Ɔƒɛni si ɔƒɔ ɔdi ɔkya-mii akɔ na ɔɔyɔ́ ka ɔdi Kukpi Lili Bɔvia Limeyi lɛmmɔ ni, ɔkana na ɔdi-ni ƒaa, nsu ɔlɛka ɔdi bunyimi bɔmmɔ ƒui lɛlɔ kalɛ kani na básu. Na bunyimi bɔmmɔ ɔlɛka bɔdi bunwi pɛ bute ɔmantɛ ubi ku baƒɔ ƒui.’ ”
Liƒlukutu Lɛdi Libi Katɔti Kevo Kammɔ Eli
15Na limeyi lɛni na bálɛ Unwoti Adi Kevo kammɔ ni, liƒlukutu líbebi ɔtɔ ɔmmɔ ƒui lɛlɔ. Na liƒlukutu lɛmmɔ lɛ́ƒɔ ɔtɔ ɔmmɔ ɔ́si useyi uwi útédu kadi bugye ɔtanta na use aani si ogya mɔɔda. 16Na lɛni kani úse uwi ƒui. Na liƒlukutu lɛmmɔ lɛ́ƒɔ ɔtɔ ɔmmɔ ƒui. Na si useyi údu ni, ɔɔda aani ogya kalɛ. 17Na uwi biala na liƒlukutu lɛmmɔ lɛ́ta ɔtɔ ɔmmɔ katɔ ni, na Israelƒuɔ lɛnɔ bata bayu ulu. Na kesi kesii na liƒlukutu lɛmmɔ lídi línye ni, na Israelƒuɔ lɛnɔ bada keliekɔ na mmɔ.
18Unwoti ɔda bubo kenye na baata bana keliekɔ na nwuna ɔda bubo kenye na baasɔ taada keliekɔ. Na uwi ɔni ƒui na liƒlukutu lɛmmɔ lilie ɔtɔ ɔmmɔ katɔ ni, na Israelƒuɔ lɛnɔ baasɔ taakya bana keliekɔ mmɔ. 19Si uwi ɔni na liƒlukutu lɛmmɔ lɛ́ƒɔ ɔtɔ ɔmmɔ katɔ útu uwi ni, Israelƒuɔ beenú Unwoti lɛdi na ɔdi ulayu ulu.
20Uwi ɔdi liƒlukutu lɛmmɔ lɛdubunye ɔtɔ ɔmmɔ katɔ emeyi alɛɛ adi na Unwoti ubo-ma ɔda na bada keliekɔ na anwu kani ɔsɔ ubo-ma ɔda asa na basɔ bata. 21Uwi ɔdi liƒlukutu lɛmmɔ lɛdubudi bunye ɔ́si ɔtanta útédu useyi uwi kani, na si liƒlukutu lɛmmɔ lɛ́ta ɔtanta na ama lɛnɔ bata. Ina liƒlukutu lɛmmɔ lɛta useyi iye ɔƒiiwi iye ɔlɛka ama lɛnɔ bata. 22Na si liƒlukutu lɛmmɔ lɛ́ƒɔ lɛlɔ linye ɔtɔ ɔmmɔ eli emeyi anyɔ iye kɔbuli iye lɛkwa ni, Israelƒuɔ bammɔ lɛnɔ badubɔsɔ bɔkya bana keliekɔ mmɔ lɛni kani na balata. Nsu si liƒlukutu lɛmmɔ lɛ́nya lɛ́ta na ama lɛnɔ bata. 23Unwoti muubó-ma ɔda na baadá keliekɔ na anwu kani muubó-ma ɔda basɔ bata bayu ulu. Na bádi ɔda bubo bɔmmɔ lɛlɔ aani kalɛ na Unwoti ɔkɛnku Mose lɛlɔ ɔ́su-ma kalɛ.

Title: BUMOMO BƆKA 10
Content:
Mose Uti Sika Ɔƒualadi Ɔvɔ Kakpɛɛ
1Amu na Unwoti ɔ́su Mose ɔnini, 2“Tu sika ɔƒualadi na eti avɔ kɔkpɛɛ inyɔ, na eteeti-ku taalɔ Israelƒuɔ taasala ku kati bute uwi ɔni na bata bana keliekɔ bayu ulu. 3Si bávwi kɔkpɛɛ inyɔ bɔmmɔ ni, na Israelƒuɔ ƒui ɔlɛka babasiaku-ɔ na Unwoti Adi Kevo kammɔ anumi. 4Nsu si bávwi kakpɛɛ kenwi ni, na ɔɔtina ka benengu bammɔ ku baduɔti bammɔ ƒui ɔlɛka babasa-a kudɔ na Unwoti Adi Kevo kammɔ anumi. 5Si bénu kɔkpɛɛ bɔku klukwii kunwi kani, ni, na ɔɔtina ka adua ani náda keliekɔ na ɔƒɛ katukɔ kakɛ na ɔlɛka bata bayu ulu. 6Na si básɔ bénu-ka bɔvwi lɛni kani kunyɔdi ni, na adua ani náda keliekɔ na kada kakɛ na ɔlɛka bata bana keliekɔ bayu ulu. Kɔkpɛɛ bɔvi klukwii ɔmɛni ndubɔbla kati bute uwi ɔni na bata bayu ulu. 7Na bekyuli bammɔ ƒui bɔlɔ bɔsala ni, ɔlɛka kɔkpɛɛ kɔmmɔ bɔvwi bɔvumana ku kati bute kalɛ na bata bayu ulu.
8“Na Aaron bebi bani ndi bakpane ndubo kɔkpɛɛ kɔmmɔ butaavwi. Na ɔda bubo bɔmɛni buse bute-mii uwi ƒui ku bina bawɔ bawɔ. 9Na si bɛ́ta bɛnii biikpóku bina bekisine bani na banii babaƒɔ-mii kalɔ ni, na bɛvwi kakpɛɛ kammɔ kɔnakunwi. Na bina Unwoti Katɔti ɔdubo-mii bunyimo na ukpo ɔƒɔ-mii na bina bekisine enu kemmo. 10Na bina lɛlɔyɔ emeyi ku emeyi ani na bɛ́lɛ ugyii bíse aani kɔbuli kɔwɔdi bɔlɛ ku abamba ni, bɛvwi kɔkpɛɛ kɔmmɔ na bɔkyula akpala ku unwi bɔbla akpala ammɔ lili na adubunwini bina lɛlɔ enyimo ete Unwoti na bina lili. Ami ndi bina Unwoti Katɔti.”
Israelƒuɔ Báta Sinai Ketele Kemmo Bátɔlɔ
11Na lɛkwa linyɔdi kɔbuli kunyɔdi limeyi aavlanyɔdi lɛlɔ ka Israelƒuɔ bálɛ Egyipte kalɔ lɛlɔ ni, liƒlukutu lɛmmɔ lɛ́sɔ lɛ́ta na Unwoti Adi Kevo lɛlɔ. 12Amu na Israelƒuɔ báta Sinai ketele kalɔ kakwiidi kemmo mmɔ báyu ulu na bávi ekpo ekpo. Na liƒlukutu lɛmmɔ lítáyu lílie Para ketele kalɔ kakwiidi kemmo. 13Na kudeedi kɔmɛni na báta báyu ulu na Unwoti ɔda bubo kenye ɔkɛnku Mose lɛlɔ.
14Na Yuda kaba bekyuli náka bɔta na bana esu kenye ku bana likposela na Aminadab ubidi Nahason ndi bana ɔtɔnkune. 15Na Suar ubidi Netaneel ɔtɔnku Isakar kaba bekyuli lisu. 16Na Helon ubidi Eliab ɔtɔnku Sebulon kaba bekyuli lisu.
17Ɔmmɔ kama bégyingya Unwoti Adi Kevo kammɔ na Gerson bebi ku Merari bebi bani nti-ka lɛnɔ báyu ulu.
18Ɔƒɛni Ruben kaba bekyuli násia-ma kama, na bana esu esu kenye, na Seleur ubidi Elisur ɔtɔnku-ma ku bana likposela. 19Na Surisadai ubidi Selumiel ɔtɔnku Simeon kaba bekyuli lisu. 20Na Deuel ubidi Eliasaƒ ɔtɔnku Gad kaba bekyuli lisu. 21Ɔmmɔ kama Kehat kaba bekyuli bani nti Unwoti Adi Kevo kemmo ala kedee basia. Na ɔdi ka balɛ Unwoti Adi Kevo kammɔ asa na ama betédu mmɔ.
22Ɔmmɔ kama Eƒraim kaba bekyuli nsia na bana esu esu kenye, na Amihud ubidi Elisama ɔtɔnku-ma ku bana likpose aƒlaga. 23Na Pedahsur ubidi Gamaliel ɔtɔnku Manase kaba bekyuli lisu. 24Na Gideoni ubidi Abidan ɔtɔnku Benyamin kaba bekyuli lisu.
25Amu na kawɔlɔkɔ ƒui ni, Dan kaba bekyuli bakpɛ kama na bana esu kenye aani lisu likplodi. Na Amisadai bidi Ahieser ɔtɔnku-ma ku bana likposela. 26Na Okran ubidi Pagiel ɔtɔnku Aser kaba bekyuli lisu. 27Na Enan ubidi Ahira ɔtɔnku Naƒtali kaba bekyuli lisu. 28Na lɛni na Israelƒuɔ kaba bekyuli esu esu ammɔ béti bésie bana ulu ɔmmɔ ka báyu ulu.
29Amu na Mose ɔ́su ulekudi ɔti Hobab ɔni ndi Midiani ɔni baalɔ Reuel ubidi ɔnini, “Uwi údu ka buteesie kalɔ kani na Unwoti ɔ́su úse ɔnini, ‘Ndubuti-ka lite-mii,’ mmɔ lɛlɔ. Bo na abasiaku-bu, na bɔdubɔda-a kaduɛ, ɔsika Unwoti úse ala abuni kenye úte Israelƒuɔ.”
30Amu na Hobab údie kenye ɔnini, “Oowo, lɛɛɛdubo mmɔ busie, mmomu línwini lísela mina bati ku beni kalɔ lɛlɔ.”
31Mmɔ na Mose ɔ́su-nwu ɔnini, “Buvele nda-a tatɔlɔ-bu kudɔ. Ɔsika agyi kesii kani búsela bútáda bula keliekɔ na ketele kalɔ kakwiidi kemmo, na adubɔbla ɔtɔnkune ete-bu. 32Na si asiaku-bu ni, ala abuni ani na Unwoti ɔdubute-bu mmɔ ni, abu ku-ɔ ƒui bɔdubule-nya.”
33Ɔmmɔ ɔsu Israelƒuɔ báta Sinai kɔbi kedee kaƒɔna mmɔ na bésie emeyi atɛ. Na Unwoti Bunyimi Adaka ɔtɔ-ma emeyi atɛ ammɔ ƒui kalɛ na utáwia keliekɔ kadi ute-ma na banwuna. 34Na Unwoti liƒlukutu lɛmmɔ lɛɛƒa-ma katɔ ɔƒiiwi ɔ́si ɔni na báta bakɛ ulu.
35Na uwi biala na Bunyimi Adaka ɔmmɔ ɔdubo bɔgyu ni, Mose uudie kudu kɔmɛni,
“Unwoti ta!
Na ƒula bekisine begyingya.
Na aya na bani muukisi-ɔ bekeli na ƒula anumi.”
36Na uwi biala na Adaka ɔmmɔ ɔdubo budi bunye na Mose ɔsɔ udie kudu ɔnini,
“Unwoti, yu bo,
Israelƒuɔ bekyuli mpim mpim akɔ.”

Title: BUMOMO BƆKA 11
Content:
Lɛgyavonku Lɛ́si Unwoti Kudɔ
1Na Unwoti únu ka Israelƒuɔ bamɛni bésie kalɔ beetemi enyekpi taasiku-nwu lɛlɔ na lɛbibo lɛni baasiáku ɔsu. Na ka Unwoti únu bana etemila ammɔ ni, úti kɔnyi kaduɛ. Na ɔkɛnku ɔmmɔ ɔsu ɔ́ya na ogya ɔ́si katɔ na úbakyula ala na bana keliekɔ mmɔ amadɔ. 2Na ka bákpali Mose ni, úvele Unwoti na ogya ɔmmɔ úni. 3Anwuɔsu básia kesii kani na ogya ɔmmɔ ɔ́kyula mmɔ lɛnyi banii Tabera, na nwuna kalɔ ndi bɔkywi. Ɔsika ogya ɔ́si Unwoti kudɔ úbakyula ala bana akɔ.
Unwoti Úte Israelƒuɔ Baasɛ Wɛlɛwɛlɛ Badi
4Amu na baƒɔ bani nsiaku Israelƒuɔ na ketele kalɔ kakwiidi kemmo ku Israelƒuɔ alati bésie kalɔ baawia adila ani badi. Ɔmɛni ɔsu bése kalɔ baasu banini, “Si nka bɔkɛ lɛna lɛdi nka bɔdubɔkun. 5Buunyimo lɛna lɛni bútaakun uwi ɔni bɔ́kya Egyipte, na lɛna lɛmmɔ lítaƒɔ kuye kɔdi, ku egyiibi, ku alakpi lidu, ku kutu akyala aani abuala ku nwuna udu ani ƒui na bútaadi mmɔ lɛnɔ. 6Nsu ɔƒɛni bɔsɔ bulakɛ adila bamba biala taadi amu ntu manna ɔmɛni kani, na anwu lɛnɔ úukpi-bu ɔkwɛ.”
7Na manna ɔmɛni use aani kakpa kebi ƒuala ƒuala. 8Na bekyuli bammɔ baaví taala-nwu na bakɔ-nwu na kukɔ lɛlɔ iye baawɔ-nwu na kaawɛ kemmo. Na beeƒulo-nwu teebo abɔ wɛlɛwɛlɛ na si étu-nwu unyemi na use aani kaaklo ɔni na bágyi ku nnɔmii. 9Na si amii áyu éwi kesii kani na Israelƒuɔ belie mmɔ usien ni, na manna ɔmɛni lɛnɔ ɔ́ɔyu úbewi kalɔ.
10Mose únu ka Israelƒuɔ kaduli biala bekyuli bakya beewulo adila kɔnyana kɔmɛni na bana nvo kenye. Na Unwoti úti kɔnyi kati kati ɔ́kya-ma geen, na lɛla lɛmɛni líkpoku Mose geen. 11Mmɔ na Mose ɔ́kpali Unwoti ɔnini, “Bi ɔsu na éti etila amɛni udu ásia-mi ƒula kabla ɔblane lɛlɔ lɛni? Bi na lɛ́bla-a na útayɔ-ɔ kaƒɔ ɔsu na eti bekyuli bamɛni ƒui etila asia-mi lɛlɔ? 12Ami náda bekyuli bamɛni ƒui kaƒɔ, munuu ami náwɔ-ma? Na bi ɔsu na aayɔ́ ka ntaagyu-ma taada enu kemmo aani kalɛ na ukyuli ɔni mɔɔda ubi ɔɔbla, asa na lɛkpanku-ma lisienku kalɔ kani na ése bana bati kuuku kenye ka adubute-ma kemmo? 13Wɛ na ndubo lɛna bɔkɛ bute bekyuli bamɛni? Bakya beewulo kɔnyana taakpali-mi banii ‘Te-bu lɛna lɛdi na bɔkun!’ 14Kabla kamɛni kétulo-mi na naaakana bekyuli bamɛni ƒui bɔtɔnku ami lɛti. 15Na si lɛni na adubo-mi bɔbla bɔdi ni, si áya-mi na líkpi muedi ɔdia-mi utulo si ɔ́yɔ-ɔ kaƒɔ lɛni, na taya na lisie ntásiaku mina ɔgbankpi ɔdi.”
16Amu na Unwoti ɔ́su Mose ɔnini, “Die banana liti ku aavlanyɔ bani lɛlɔ mbo ɔbu na badi batɔnkune na bekyuli bammɔ akɔ. Na akpanku-ma eboku na awɔ ku-ma bibenye Unwoti Adi Kevo anumi mɛni. 17Na si bébenye mmɔ ni, ndubɔyu bubo-mii kudɔ na lɛtɛmiku-mii. Na mmɔ ni, ndubɔya na mina kɔyu kɔni nkya-a kemmo kɔdi kɔlɛ na liti ku lɛkya bana kemmo ɔdi. Na ama ndubo-ɔ kebunku buteete. Na betiku-ɔ bekyuli bammɔ etila. Kalɛ na asɔ eleti etila ammɔ awɔ lɛti.
18“Su bekyuli bammɔ anini, ‘Bikisi lɛlɔ na bɛbla lɛlɔ sɛɛn bite kɔnaadi limeyi lɛni na bɛdubo lɛna bɔkun. Unwoti únu uwi ɔni na bɛkya biiwulo kɔnya bɛnii, “Si bɔkɛ na bɔkɛ lɛna lɛdi bɔkun nka ɔdia, ɔsika uwi ɔni na bɔ́kya Egyipte ni, ala ádianku-bu étulo ɔmɛni!” 19Na ɔɔɔdi limeyi linwi iye emeyi anyɔ iye emeyi alɔ iye emeyi leevu iye emeyi aavlanyɔ kani na bɛdubo lɛna lɛmmɔ bɔkɛ bɔkun. 20Mmomu bɛdubo lɛna lɛmmɔ bɔkun kɔbuli kumodi sɔɔn utédu ka lɛna lɛmmɔ lɛdi lɛ́lɛ-mii enwu kemmo na bɛ́kɛ ɔlɛ bɛ́siku-nwu kemmo na bikisi-ni, ɔsika bíni Unwoti ɔni nkya-mii akɔ, na bíwulo kɔnyana na nwuna anumi na bɛɛsu bɛnini, “Bi ndi lɛla lɛni ɔsu geen na bɛ́lɛ Egyipte kalɔ lɛlɔ?” ’ ”
21Nsu Mose úye Unwoti ɔnini, “Aanu-mi nkɛnku bekyuli mpim eti leevu-anyɔ ku lɛgba mɛni na aasu anini, ‘Ndubute-ma lɛna na bakun kɔbuli kumodi!’ 22Na si ina baƒonu ku ɔmantɛ bakɔ ɛlɛ ɛlɛ na bádu béte-ma muedi lɛna lɛmmɔ lɛdubudu-ma? Na si ketu kemmo kɔbɛ ƒui na béƒie béte-ma lɛnɔ nɔɔ ɔdubudu-ma bɔkun?”
23Amu na Unwoti údie Mose kenye ɔnini, “Si lídie kɔnu nnii mɔɔbla lɛla lɛdi ni, bɔsɔ na mina ɔyikun ɔ́sɔ? Adubo bɔnu si lɛla lɛni na lɛ́su lɛdubo-nwu kemmo lɛni iye lilebo.”
24Ɔmmɔ ɔsu Mose úsie na útásu bekyuli bamɛni lɛla lɛni na Unwoti ɔ́su-nwu ka ɔbla. Na údie batɔnkune liti ku aavlanyɔ bammɔ na ɔ́kpanku-ma úbenyene Unwoti Adi Kevo anumi. 25Mmɔ na Unwoti ɔ́yu úbo kalɔ na liƒlukutu kemmo na ɔtɛmi ku Mose. Na kɔyu ɔyikun ɔni nkya-nwu ni, údie ɔyikun ɔmmɔ ɔdi ɔ́kya batɔnkune liti ku aavlanyɔ bammɔ kemmo. Na si kɔyu kɔmmɔ kɔ́ƒɔ-ma lɛlɔ kemmo na beedie Unwoti ablala kenye, nsu uwi ulétu gyɔlɔɔ.
26Nsu banana inyɔ bádi bákya na baalɔ-ma Eldad ku Medad na báƒuna ama lɛnɔ bákya benengu bammɔ akɔ, nsu báƒɔ lɛlɔ bákya bana nvo kemmo mmɔ na bétesie kasakɔ mmɔ, nsu Kɔyu kɔmmɔ kɔ́ƒɔ-ma lɛlɔ kemmo na ama lɛnɔ bákya béteedie Unwoti ablala kenye na bana kakyakɔ mmɔ. 27Mmɔ na okloƒu ɔdi úkeli usi na útásu Mose ka Eldad ku Medad lɛnɔ bakya beedie Unwoti ablala kenye bana kakyakɔ mmɔ.
28Amu na Nun ubidi ɔni baalɔ banii Yosua na anwu nsiaku Mose kesi kesii na úsela ɔ́si nwuna lɛkloƒu uwi ɔ́su Mose ɔnini, “Ati, ya na bekyuli bammɔ bada Unwoti ablala kudu bubo baya.”
29Amu na Mose údie-nwu kenye ɔnini, “Anumi eegyie-ɔ mina lɛlɔ yoo? Si nka ami lɛti ni, nka Unwoti bekyuli ƒui benwini nwuna kenye bediene na Unwoti ɔya na nwuna kɔyu kɔƒɔ-ma lɛlɔ kemmo!” 30Amu na Mose ɔ́ya na anwu ku benengu bammɔ bénwini bésie bana kakyakɔ.
31Kɔnakunwi Unwoti ɔ́ya na ɔƒɛƒɛɛ ubendi ɔdi úkpo na ɔ́sala baasɛ wɛlɛ wɛlɛ badi ɔ́siku ɛpu kudɔ. Na bakya beeveyi taavi kalɔ kalɔ. Na bébo bewi bekyuli bammɔ kakyakɔ mmɔ ƒui. 32Ɔmmɔ ɔsu ɔ́si limeyi lɛmmɔ ku kadi kegye usien ku ɔƒɛ bekyuli bammɔ bakya baala baasɛ bamɛni. Na ukyuli biala ɔ́la baasɛ bamɛni aani edula ebi lɛkyami linwi unu. Na bégyingya baasɛ bamɛni béwi ɔƒɛ lɛlɔ kalɛ bakwii. 33Nsu asa na badubɔkun lɛna lɛmɛni bebweli ni, Unwoti úti kɔnyi ɔ́kya bekyuli bammɔ geen na ɔ́ya na ɔlɛ ukpidi ɔni mɔɔví úduo-ma akɔ.
34Anwuɔsu na baalɔ kesii kammɔ banii Kibrot-Hataawa. Na nwuna kalɔ ndi ɔkwɛ adala kaƒiɔtɔ. Ɔsika mmɔ na báva bekyuli bani nkya muuwulo ka lɛna lɛɛda-ma ɔkwɛ. 35Ka bekyuli bammɔ báta Kibrot-Hataawa mmɔ ni, bésie bétéli Haserot.

Title: BUMOMO BƆKA 12
Content:
Miriam Ku Aaron Báta Bénye Mose Lɛlɔ
1Amu na Miriam ku Aaron bése kalɔ beetemi teewi Mose. Ɔsika Mose úsie útéti Etiopiani uleku ɔdi. 2Na beeye banini, “Mose lɛlɔ lɛti na Unwoti ɔ́tɛmi ɔ́siaku na útatɛmi útasiaku abu lɛnɔ lɛlɔ dii?” Na Unwoti únu lɛla lɛni na básu.
3Na Mose ɔdi ukyuli ɔni use buɛɛ, na úboku lɛlɔ kalɔ útulo ukyuli biala na kalɔ kamɛni lɛlɔ.
4Kɔnakunwi Unwoti ɔ́kpali Mose ku Aaron ku Miriam ɔnini, “Bina ɛtɛ ƒui bɛlɛ bibo Unwoti Adi Kevo mɛni.” Anwuɔsu bana ɛtɛ bammɔ ƒui bálɛ bébo. 5Amu na Unwoti ɔ́yu úbo kalɔ na liƒlukutu bonwu kemmo, na úbenye Unwoti Adi Kevo kammɔ anumi na ɔ́lɔ Aaron ku Miriam. Ka bálɛ bébo ni, 6ɔ́su-ma ɔnini, “Binu etemila ani ndubo-mii bɔsu mɛni.
“Si Unwoti kenye udiene ɔdi ɔkya-mii akɔ ni,
muudie lɛlɔ taatina-nwu
na kɔyu kemmo ala budie bɔtina kemmo
iye kɔna kemmo na mɔɔtɛmiku-nwu.
7Nsu mina kabla ɔblane Mose anwu ni,
ɔɔɔdi lɛni na mɔɔbla-nwu.
Ɔdi ukyuli ɔni mɔɔbla ala ulu lɛlɔ na mina kaduli.
8Mɔɔtɛmi ku anwu anumi ku anumi,
na ɔɔɔdi agyolo kemmo, mmomu atɛ nwaa kemmo,
na ɔɔnu kalɛ na Unwoti use ku nwuna anumi.
Na bi ɔsu na bítayia ka bɛsu lɛla lɛdi
na bɛ́ta bínye mina kabla ɔblane Mose lɛlɔ?”
9Mmɔ na Unwoti kɔnyi kúbakɔ katɔ na Aaron ku Miriam lɛlɔ, na ɔ́gyu-ma kudɔ na ɔ́tɔlɔ.
10Uwi ɔni na liƒlukutu lɛmmɔ lɛ́ta na Adi Kevo ɔmmɔ eli ni, amu na ɔlɛgyie ɔ́lɛ úwi Miriam lɛlɔ, na nwuna ɔlɔna ɔ́ta ɔ́bla ƒututuu aani etubankɛ. Uwi ɔni na Aaron únwini na ɔ́nu ka ɔlɛgyie uwi Miriam lɛlɔ ni, 11ɔ́su Mose ɔnini, “Mina ati, buvele nda-a, tenye tanu na kɔdɔlɔ likpidi lɛni bɔ́bla mɛni lɛtuni lɛsiaku-bu. 12Na taya na Miriam únwini ubi ɔni báwɔ na útata ntu kemmo na nwuna ɔlɔna kakɛ kadi lɛnɔ káyii udu.”
13Amu na Mose úwulo ɔ́kpali Unwoti ɔnini, “O Unwoti Katɔti, buvele nda-a, bwi Miriam ɔlɛ ɔni nda-nwu.”
14Amu na Unwoti údie Mose kenye ɔnini, “Si nka bɔbwɛ na ɔti ɔ́bwɛ lisuo úwi Miriam anumi ni, nka kɔƒa kɔɔɔdubo-nwu bukpo emeyi maatɛ? Anwuɔsu biti-nwu bɛlɛku bina kakyakɔ mmɔ emeyi maatɛ. Na ɔmmɔ kama bɛsɔ bitiku-nwu biboku.” 15Ɔmmɔ ɔsu báda Miriam bédie bana kakyakɔ mmɔ emeyi maatɛ, na bekyuli bammɔ lɛnɔ básɔ bátata bana keliekɔ mmɔ útédu ka emeyi maatɛ ammɔ édu. Na básɔku-nwu béboku.
16Ɔmmɔ kama bekyuli bammɔ báta Haserot na bétélie Paran ketele kalɔ kakwiidi kemmo.

Title: BUMOMO BƆKA 13
Content:
Bekyuli Badi Bátávi Kanaan Kalɔ Kemmo Bánu
1Amu na Unwoti ɔ́su Mose ɔnini, 2“Die ukyuli unwi unwi na Israel kaba leevu-anyɔ ammɔ batɔnkune akɔ, na besie batánu Kanaan kalɔ kani na lɛ́su ka meti mete Israelƒuɔ mmɔ kemmo banu kalɛ kalɔ kammɔ kese.”
3Ɔmmɔ ɔsu Mose ɔ́di ɔda bubo bɔni na Unwoti úte-nwu mmɔ lɛlɔ, na ɔ́tala-ma uwi ɔni na bákya Paran ketele kalɔ kakwiidi kemmo mmɔ. Na bekyuli bani Mose ɔ́tala mmɔ ƒui badi Israelƒuɔ batɔnkune. 4Na bekyuli bani bátala mmɔ anyi ndi amɛni.
Ruben kaba kemmo ukyuli ndi Sakur ubidi Samua.
5Simeon kaba kemmo ukyuli ndi Hori ubidi Saƒa.
6Yuda kaba kemmo ukyuli ndi Yeƒune ubidi Kaleb.
7Isakar kaba kemmo ukyuli ndi Yuseƒ ubidi Igal.
8Eƒraim kaba kemmo ukyuli ndi Nun ubidi Hosea.
9Benyamin kaba kemmo ukyuli ndi Raƒu ubidi Palti.
10Sebulon kaba kemmo ukyuli ndi Sodi ubidi Gadiel.
11Yoseƒ kaba kemmo ndi Manase kaba ukyuli ndi Susi ubidi Gadi.
12Dan kaba kemmo ukyuli ndi Gemali ubidi Amiel.
13Aser kaba kemmo ukyuli ndi Mikael ubidi Setur.
14Naƒtali kaba kemmo ukyuli ndi Woƒsi ubidi Nahbi.
15Gad kaba kemmo ukyuli ndi Maki ubidi Geuel.
16Banana bamɛni na Mose ɔ́tala ɔnii batánu kalɔ kammɔ. Na Mose násia Nun ubidi Hosea lɛnyi Yosua.
17Uwi ɔni na Mose ɔ́tala bekyuli bammɔ ɔnii batávi banu Kanaan kalɔ kammɔ ni, ɔ́su-ma ɔnini, “Si bísela ni, na bɛsia Negev kalɔ kemmo na biti bɛkɔ bisie abi lɛma kalɔ kammɔ kemmo. 18Na bɛnu kalɛ kalɔ kammɔ kese ku bekyuli bammɔ si badi bekyuli bani mbo ɔlɔkplu iye beeebo ɔlɔkplu, ku si bemomo iye beeemomo. 19Na bɛnu bɛnii bi kalɔ udu lɛlɔ belie? Na bɛnu si kalɔ kammɔ kadia iye kaaadia? Na bɛnu bɛnii bi lɛma udu kemmo na bélie? Bátu awoduku bámana-ni munuu bátatu? 20Na kalɔ kammɔ lɛti nɔɔ, dɛ na lise, lɛdia munuu lɛɛɛdia? Na egyii akya kalɔ kammɔ kemmo munuu eeebo? Bɛsia ulu biala lɛlɔ na biti adingyii ebi adi bɛsiku kalɔ kammɔ kemmo biboku si bɛdubo.” Na uwi ɔmmɔ ɔdi adingyii ebi edeedi bugyie uwi.
21Ɔmɛni ɔsu bekyuli bamɛni báyu ulu na bátávi bánu kalɔ kammɔ ɔ́si Sin ketele kalɔ kakwiidi kemmo útédu Rehab, kesii kani baasia teesie Hamat. 22Na básia Negev kalɔ kemmo na bákɔ bétédu Hebron, kesii kani na Anak kaba kemmo bekyuli bani ndi Ahiman ku Sesai ku Talmai bélie. Báada Hebron ɔma akwa maatɛ kama asa na báda Soan ɔma ɔni nkya Egyipte. 23Uwi ɔni bédu Eskol ɔni kalɔ ndi kɔkpasa kɔwɛ kemmo ni, békulo egyiibi adi kagba ku kɔkpasa yuu kɔdi. Bákya-nwu ugyii na nkyuli inyɔ básia-nwu amangba ku kɔnwingyie ebi ku egyiibi abambadi lɛnɔ. 24Na kesii kammɔ baalɔ banii Eskol Kɔwɛ, ɔsika mmɔ na Israelƒuɔ békulo egyiibi kɔkpasa. 25Na emeyi aavlene kama ni, bávi kalɔ kammɔ kemmo báwɔlɔ na bénwini bébo bana kakyakɔ.
Batalane Bammɔ Bédie Kenye Lɛla Lɛni Na Bánu
26Amu na batalane bammɔ ƒui bénwini bébo na básala Mose ku Aaron ku Israelƒuɔ ƒui lisu na Paran ketele kalɔ kakwiidi kemmo na Kedes. Mmɔ na básu-ma ala ani bánu na béti egyiibi ani béde na kalɔ kammɔ lɛlɔ adi bátina-ma. 27Amu na básu Mose banini, “Kalɔ kani lɛlɔ na átala-bu mmɔ ni, sɔsɔ búsie bútéduo-ka kemmo na kana egyiibi ntu bɔɔyu emini aani uwɔ na kana lɛlɔ bebuo baayu anyi ntu pii. Na aanu kana egyiibi ammɔ adi muedi. 28Nsu bɔɔsu-ɔ ka bekyuli bani nlie mmɔ ni, bebo ɔyikun geen, na bana lɛma linengudi ƒui lɛnɔ bátu awodu bámana-ni. Na mmɔ muedi na bɔ́nu Anak kaba bekyuli. 29Amalekƒuɔ belie bésie Negev kalɔ kemmo na Hetiƒuɔ ku Yebusiƒuɔ ku Amoriƒuɔ ama belie abi eli. Na Kanaanƒuɔ belie bésie ɛpu amadɔ na Yordan kakɛ.”
30Mmɔ na Kaleb údie lɛdi na ɔ́ya na bekyuli bammɔ bába lɛsɛ na Mose anumi na ɔ́su-ma ɔnini, “Bɛya na busie butéti kalɔ kammɔ, ɔsika bɔdubɔkana bukpo na bɔdi-ma lɛlɔ.”
31Nsu bekyuli bani na ama ku Kaleb bésie mmɔ bénye momoomo básu banii, “Bulakana-ma bukpoku, ɔsika bebo ɔyikun betulo-bu.” 32Na batalane bamɛni bégyingya bana etemila ekpidi amɛni bákya Israelƒuɔ akɔ. Na básu-ma banini, “Kalɔ kammɔ muedi kalákana edula bɔnwu kaduɛ. Na bekyuli bani udu nli kalɔ kammɔ kemmo bákuku na bébomo. 33Na bɔ́nu bekyuli bani náta katɔ na bási Anak kaba kemmo muedi na mmɔ. Na abu buse na buse aani bakpɔtilikpɔ na bana anumi. Na lɛni na badubo-bu bɔnu.”

Title: BUMOMO BƆKA 14
Content:
Bekyuli Bammɔ Báta Bénye Mose Ku Aaron Lɛlɔ
1Usien umodi ɔmmɔ ƒui Israelƒuɔ bákya beewulo momoomo ku kudu. 2Na ɔkɛnku ɔmmɔ ɔsu bekyuli bammɔ bákya baadɔnku Mose ku Aaron kalɔ kalɔ. Na baasu banini, “Si bukpi na búkpi bɔ́kya Egyipte iye ketele kalɔ kakwiidi kemmo mmɔ muedi nka ɔdia utulo! 3Na bi ɔsu na Unwoti úti-bu úboku kalɔ kamɛni kemmo na bubekpi na kewii kenye? Bula bekisine badubo bula beleku ku bebi buƒie bɔtɔlɔku. Ɔɔɔdia-bu uuutulo ka bɔsɔ bunwini buteesie Egyipte mmomu?” 4Anwuɔsu básu lɛlɔ ka, “Bɛya na bɔwia ɔtɔnkune na bɔsɔ bunwini buteesie Egyipte.”
5Mmɔ na Mose ku Aaron báyu bebi kalɔ na bekyuli bammɔ ƒui anumi. 6Na Nun ubidi Yosua ku Yeƒune ubidi Kaleb bani mbunku bekyuli bani nésie bátávi bánu kalɔ kammɔ báni bana lɛwu bábwɛ. 7Na básu Israelƒuɔ bammɔ ƒui banini, “Kalɔ kani kemmo na bútávi bɔnu mmɔ kadia geen sɔsɔ. 8Na bɔɔsu-mii ka si ɔ́yɔ Unwoti kaƒɔ ni, ɔdubɔtɔnku-bu na butéduo kalɔ kani kana egyiibi ntu bɔɔyu emini aani uwɔ na kana lɛlɔ bebuo baayu anyi ntu pii na kabla bula kadi. 9Na bɔta kani na bitata bitenye Unwoti lɛlɔ. Na bitaya na liƒu lɛdi lɛda-mii na bekyuli bani nkya kalɔ kammɔ kemmo lɛlɔ ɔsu. Ɔsika basɔ beeebo bɔgyumana bɔdi, nsu Unwoti uli ku abu na bɔdubo-ma bubweli. Anwuɔsu bitayia!”
10Na uwi ɔni na bekyuli bammɔ ƒui bábla kasusu ka badubo Yosua ku Kaleb atabi bubo ni, mmɔ na Unwoti bukeye bɔ́bwɛ bɔ́lɛ Unwoti Adi Kevo anumi na Israelƒuɔ bánu. 11Amu na Unwoti úye Mose ɔnini, “Na akɔla ala lidu lidu lɛni na lɛ́bla na bekyuli bamɛni anumi kama ni, uwi ɛlɛ na badubuni-mi bétédu, na baláƒɔ-mi baladi, na bataata teenye taanu-mi anumi lɛni? 12Ɔmɛni ɔsu ndubo ɔ́lɛ buɛ ɔdi buti bɔkya bekyuli bammɔ akɔ na lɛyila-ma udu. Nsu awɔ Mose anwu ni, ndubo bɔya na kadi bekyuli pii bani na bemomo betulo bamɛni balɛ basi-ɔ kemmo na bayu ɔkplu lɛnɔ betulo-ma.”
13Amu na Mose ɔ́su Unwoti ɔnini, “Awɔ nákpanku bekyuli álɛku Egyipte kalɔ lɛlɔ na ƒula ɔyikun kenye. Na Egyipteƒuɔ bammɔ badubo lɛla lɛmɛni bunu kalɛ na ábla awɔ ɔlati bekyuli. 14Na badubo bekyuli bani nlie kalɔ kamɛni lɛlɔ lɛla lɛmɛni bɔsu. Kalɔ kamɛni bekyuli béenu kukuuku kalɛ na awɔ Unwoti akya Israelƒuɔ akɔ, na bánu-ɔ anumi ku anumi ku kalɛ na ƒula liƒlukutu lɛ́yu líbelie-ma eli ku kalɛ na aatɔ-ma anumi aani liƒlukutu lɛkpa bonwu kalɛ na ɔƒiiwi, na usien lɛnɔ aani lɛgyavonku bonwu kalɛ. 15Na si ádu bekyuli bamɛni ƒui kɔnakunwi ni, kadi bamba badubo ƒula litemi lɛmɛni bunu na badubo bɔsu banii, 16‘Unwoti útakana nwuna linyese lɛlɔ bɔdi na ɔkpanku bekyuli bamɛni usienku kalɔ kani kenye na ɔ́su-ma use mmɔ lɛlɔ. Ɔmmɔ ɔsu na ɔ́du-ma ɔ́kya ketele kalɔ kakwiidi kemmo mmɔ.’
17“Ɔmɛni ɔsu muuvele-ɔ, O Unwoti, die ƒula ɔyikun unengudi keyi aani kalɛ na ásu ése anii, 18‘Ami Unwoti ndi Katɔti ɔni mɔɔnu kɔnyana, na mɔɔbla lɛƒɔndia uwi ƒui, na neeeti kɔnyi pla pla. Mmomu mɔɔyɔ́ mina bekyuli na muuti bani nénwini kama bákya bana ulikplu ala ku bani mɔɔta teenye-mi lɛlɔ ku ekpidi ƒui taakyiɛ. Nsu mɔɔní bekyuli bani mɔɔƒiɔ́-mi ƒui kɔtu. Naaayiƒala kudii ka lɛni bana bebi ku bawɔ kɔtu utédu kaba katɛdi ku kenedi lɛlɔ ɔ́si ekpidi ani na bana bawɔne bábla ɔsu.’ 19Na ɔkɛnku ƒula lɛƒɔndia bonwu ɔsu ni, ti bana ekpidi kyiɛ-ma aani kalɛ kani na eeti takyiɛ-ma ɔ́si uwi ɔni na bɔ́lɛ Egyipte kalɔ lɛlɔ úbedu ɔƒaani.”
20Amu na Unwoti údie kenye ɔnini, “Líti lɛkyiɛ-ma na kalɛ na évele-mi kenye. 21Nsu mɔɔsu geen ka ni, ami Unwoti ɔni nli ngba na mina bukeye bɔ́ƒɔ kayawi ƒui mɛni ni, 22bekyuli bani nánu mina bukeye na bánu mina akɔla búdie taatina lidu lidu lɛni lɛ́bla na Egyipte kalɔ lɛlɔ ku ketele kalɔ kakwiidi kemmo, nsu báta benye mina litemi lɛlɔ na bákɔku-mi bánu leevu sɔɔn ni, 23bana kemmo ɔdi biala ulanu kalɔ kani líse kenye ka meti mete bana bati kuuku mmɔ. Na ukyuli biala nétenu-mi litemi na ɔbu-mi uleduo mmɔ. 24Nsu ka mina kabla ɔblane Kaleb anwu úbo kɔyu kɔni návumana na úti nwuna kayi ƒui ɔsiaku-mi kama ɔsu ni, ndubuti anwu ku nwuna kaba bekyuli na betéduo kalɔ kammɔ kemmo na badubo kalɔ kammɔ ala bɔdi. 25Na ka Amalekƒuɔ ku Kanaanƒuɔ belie bésie kɔwɛ kemmo ɔsu ni, kɔnaadi binwini bitásia ketele kalɔ kakwiidi ulu ɔni na úti anumi ɔɔtina Ɛpugyie mmɔ lɛlɔ.”
26Amu na Unwoti ɔ́su Mose ku Aaron ɔnini, 27“Uwi ɛlɛ geen na bekyuli bekpidi bamɛni badubunye bataadɔ bana lɛlɔ kemmo kalɔ kalɔ na mina lɛlɔ betédu? Línu ala ani na benye baaká taadɔnku-mi. 28Anwuɔsu kɔ lɛsa na asu-ma anini, ‘Ami Unwoti nnii na ami ɔni nli ngba mɛni anumi ni, lɛla lɛni na línu lɛ́siku-mii kenye kemmo mɛni na ndubɔya na lɛlɛku-mii. 29-30Ketele kalɔ kakwiidi kamɛni kemmo na bɛdubo bukpi, amii bani ƒui nákɛ akwa aavlanyɔ ku kama, amu ntu Yeƒune ubidi Kaleb ku Nun ubidi Yosua kani ndubo mmɔ buduo.
31“ ‘Na bina bebi bani mmomu na bɛ́kya bɛɛsu bɛnii badubo-ma buƒie batɔlɔku mmɔ ni, ama na ndubo bɔkpanku na betélie kalɔ kani na amii bíni mmɔ lɛlɔ na badi-ka ebi bakɛ ebiti. 32Nsu amii amu mɛni na bɛdubo bukpi bɔtɛ na kalɔ kakwiidi kamɛni kemmo. 33Na bina bebi badubo abi bubo na bataaka taamana kalɔ kakwiidi kamɛni kemmo akwa aavlene sɔɔn útédu ka bina ƒui bíkpi bɛ́sa.
34“ ‘Na ndubɔya biti akwa aavlene sɔɔn bibo abi na emeyi aavlene ani na bíti bítávi kalɔ kammɔ kemmo kenye na bina ekpidi ɔsu, na bɛnu bɛti kalɛ na use si ami Unwoti lɛ́kɛ ku bekyuli kɔnyi.’ 35Ami Unwoti násu, na ndubɔnu ka ala ani lɛ́su ka mabla bekyuli bekpidi bani nása lili na báta bénye-mi lɛlɔ mɛni ébo lɛni. Na ndubɔnu ka ɔdi biala úkpi na ketele kalɔ kakwiidi kamɛni kemmo.”
36Ɔmɛni ɔsu bekyuli bani na Mose ɔ́tala ka besie na bátávi kalɔ kammɔ kemmo bánu mmɔ, na bénwini bébedie kenye kekpidi básu bekyuli bammɔ ɔsu na baadɔ bana lɛlɔ kemmo kalɔ kalɔ na Unwoti lɛlɔ ni, 37kalɔ kamɛni lɛlɔ litemi likpidi basune ƒui ama ni, Unwoti ɔ́ya na ɔlɛ ukpidi ɔdi ubebo-ma na békpi na Unwoti anumi mmɔ kani. 38Na bekyuli bani ƒui nésie batávi bánu kalɔ kammɔ akɔ ni, Nun ubidi Yosua ku Yeƒune ubidi Kaleb kani nákɛ ngba.
39Amu ka Mose únwini úsie Israelƒuɔ kudɔ na útásu-ma lɛla lɛni na Unwoti ɔ́su-nwu mɛni ni, béwulo bana lɛlɔ geen. 40Amu ka kadi kégye ɔtanta tutuutu ni, béyile bésie abi eli na bétévele básu banini, “Unwoti, bɔ́bla likpidi, anwuɔsu buuvele ka bɔdu busie kalɔ kani na awɔ Unwoti ásu ése ka adubute-bu mmɔ kemmo.”
41Nsu Mose úye-ma ɔnini, “Na bi ɔsu na biládi Unwoti bunyimi lɛlɔ? Lɛla lɛni bɛɛbla mɛni lɛɛɛdubo bɔtɛ bute-mii! 42Anwuɔsu bitesie. Si bísie ni, bina bekisine badubo-mii lɛlɔ bɔdi. Ɔsika Unwoti ɔɔɔsiaku-mii. 43Na si bísie bɛnii bitékpoku Amalekƒuɔ ku Kanaanƒuɔ ni, badubo-mii lɛlɔ bɔdi na badu-mii ku kuwii. Ɔsika Unwoti ɔɔɔdubo-mii kama bɔsiaku ka bíni nwuna litemi na bítadi-ni lɛlɔ ɔsu.”
44Ina ka Unwoti Bunyimi Adaka iye Mose útasiaku-ma ni, báyu kayi ɔkplu na báta bésie abi lɛma ka betékpo. 45Mmɔ na Amalekƒuɔ ku Kanaanƒuɔ báta na bétékpoku-ma na bádi-ma lɛlɔ na bábi básiaku-ma laa bétédu Horma.

Title: BUMOMO BƆKA 15
Content:
Unwoti Úbo Israelƒuɔ Ɔda Kalɛ Bataabla Akpala
1Amu na Unwoti ɔ́su Mose ɔnini, “Kɔ lɛsa na asu Israelƒuɔ anini, 2‘Si bísie na bítéduo kalɔ kani kemmo na lɛ́su ka meti mete-mii na biti-ka bɛbla bina keliekɔ 3na ɔdi ɔɔyɔ́ ka uti ebuo ɔdi ɔsiku nwuna bebuo lidu akɔ ɔbla bɔkyula akpala ƒɛƒɛɛ ani mɔɔyɔ́ ami Unwoti kaƒɔ, iye kenye kadi na úse na ɔnii ɔɔbla akpala iye kayi ƒaa akpala iye akpala ani ndanku emeyi bɔdi ni, 4na ukyuli ɔmmɔ uti ɔlaaƒɔ buni lɛkyami linwi ɔni na básala ku nnɔ ɔsii unwi uboku aani edula ebi akpala. 5Koƒonu kɔkɔdi biala na ɔdi úti ɔɔbla bɔkyula akpala ni, na uti ntɛ ɔsii bonwu unwi ɔbla ntɛ akpala.
6“ ‘Na koƒonu kɔgyani kunengudi biala na ɔdi úti ɔɔbla akpala ammɔ ni, na uti ɔlaaƒɔ buni akyami anyɔ ɔni na básala ku nnɔ ɔsii bonwu unwi ku kakɛ uboku aani edula ebi akpala, 7ku ntɛ ɔsii bonwu unwi ku kakɛ aani ntɛ akpala. Na uti-nya ɔbla akpala ɔnyi ƒɛƒɛɛ ɔni mɔɔyɔ́ Unwoti kaƒɔ.
8“ ‘Na si ɔmantɛ akɔ na ɔdi úti ɔɔbla bɔkyula ute Unwoti, iye kenye buse kayu bɔƒɔ akpala iye unwi bɔbla akpala adi ni, 9ɔlɛka ɔwia ɔlaaƒɔ buni akyami atɛ ku kakɛ ɔni na básala ku nnɔ lɛsii bonwu inyɔ ku kakɛ uboku aani edula ebi akpala, 10ku ntɛ lɛsii inyɔ na uti ɔbla bɔkyula akpala ammɔ na ɔnyi ƒɛƒɛɛ ɔmmɔ ɔyɔ Unwoti kaƒɔ. 11Na akɔ iye koƒonu kɔgyani iye koƒonu kɔkɔdi iye ese ɔkɔdi ɔdi biala ni, ulu ɔmɛni lɛlɔ na badubɔbla-nwu basiaku ute akpala ammɔ bɔbla. 12Ina dɛ na bebuo bammɔ bemomo ni, lɛni kani na ɔlɛka babla ɔdi biala.
13“ ‘Na ukyuli biala na ɔdi Israelni ubi geen na úti nwuna akpala úboku ka ubakyula na nwuna ɔnyi ƒɛƒɛɛ ɔyɔ Unwoti kaƒɔ ni, ɔlɛka ɔbla akpala amɛni ɔsiaku ulu ɔmɛni lɛlɔ. 14Na si uwi biala na baƒɔ bani na belie-mii kudɔ ɔdi ɔɔyɔ́ ka uboku akpala adi ubakyula na ɔnyi ƒɛƒɛɛ ɔmmɔ ɔyɔ Unwoti kaƒɔ ni, lɛni kani na ɔdubɔbla-nya ɔsiaku pɛpɛɛpɛ úsela uwi ƒui na ulavumana. Ɔlɛka anwu lɛnɔ ɔbla ɔsiaku kalɛ kani líbo-mii ɔda. 15Na ɔda bubo bɔni na buse bute-mii ni, amu kani lɛlɔ na ɔlɛka baƒɔ bammɔ lɛnɔ badi, na bunyimi bɔmɛni buse búsela uwi ƒui ku bina bawɔ bani mebo akɔ. 16Ɔda bubo bɔmɛni buunyimi amii ku baƒɔ bani na bakya-mii akɔ ƒui.’ ”
17Amu na Unwoti ɔ́su Mose ɔnini, 18“Kɔ lɛsa na asu Israelƒuɔ anini, ‘Si bítéduo kalɔ kani lɛlɔ na líti-mii líselaku kemmo 19na bɛɛdi-ka edula ni, na bidie adi bise na biti bɛkpa bite Unwoti. 20Na ɔlaaƒɔ udeedi ɔni na bɛdubo bɔkɔ bɔsiku bina mmo edula ebi edeedi ani na bɛdubo buwiile buse kakpa ni, biti-nwu bɛbla bodobodo bɛbla akpala bite-mi. 21Na ɔ́si ɔƒɛni úsela uwi ƒui ku bina bebi ku bawɔ akɔ ni, ɔlɛka biti akpala amɛni biboku Unwoti ɔsiku bina edula ebi edeedi ɔlaaƒɔ udeedi ɔni na bɛdubɔkɔ kemmo.
22“ ‘Nsu si tati tati kemmo na ɔdi anu ávi ɔda bubo bɔni na líte Mose mɛni ɔdi lɛlɔ 23iye ɔda bubo bamba biala na ɔkɛnku-mi lɛlɔ na Mose úte amii kadi bekyuli bammɔ ɔ́si limeyi lɛni lɛlɔ na Unwoti únyimi-mu úti úsela uwi ɔni mebo ƒui kemmo 24na kadi kammɔ ƒui bátadi-mu lɛlɔ na tati tati ɔsu ni, ɔlɛka bawia akɔ na beti babla bɔkyula akpala na ɔnyi ƒɛƒɛɛ ɔmmɔ ɔyɔ Unwoti kaƒɔ ku nwuna lɛlɔ edula ebi ku ntɛ akpala, aani kalɛ na bényimi bése, ku ketukpa na beti babla likpidi lili buvele akpala. 25Ɔmmɔ kama ɔkpane ɔdubɔbla akpala ute bana likpidi kɔtu bɔni budie na kadi bekyuli bammɔ ƒui lili na badubuti bakyiɛ-ma, ɔsika bátati asa na bábla-ni, na ɔmmɔ ɔsu béboku etela ka bakyula bete Unwoti ku likpidi lili buvele akpala. 26Na ɔmɛni bɔbla kama Unwoti ɔdubuti Israelƒuɔ ku baƒɔ bani nkya-ma akɔ ƒui likpidi ɔkyiɛ-ma, ɔsika likpidi lɛmmɔ lɛda bana ƒui ina bátati asa na bábla-ni.
27“ ‘Nsu si ukyuli unwi ɔ́bla likpidi lɛni na útati asa na ɔ́bla-ni ni, ɔlɛka ɔwia ese uledi ɔni nákɛ lɛkwa linwi na uti ubabla likpidi lili buvele akpala. 28Na ɔkpane ɔlɛka ɔbla akpala ute Unwoti úte ukyuli ɔni na tati tati ɔsu na ɔ́bla likpidi lɛmmɔ na Unwoti ɔdubuti ɔkyiɛ-nwu. 29Na ɔda bubo bɔmɛni buse bute ukyuli biala maƒiɔ ɔni na útati útese asa na ɔ́bla likpidi lɛdi, amii ɔmantɛ bebi ku baƒɔ bani nkya-mii akɔ ƒui.
30“ ‘Nsu si ukyuli ɔdi ɔgyi nwaa asa na ɔ́bla likpidi lɛdi na ɔdi ɔmantɛ ubi iye ɔdi ɔƒɔ ni, ukyuli ɔmmɔ udu ɔlɛka bada-nwu bedie bina akɔ. 31Ɔsika útabu Unwoti litemi na ɔ́ta únye nwuna ɔda bubo lɛlɔ, ɔsu ɔlɛka bekulo ukyuli ɔmmɔ udu bedie nwuna bekyuli akɔ kede kede na anwu ɔlati ɔdubuti nwuna likpidi etila.’ ”
Kɔtu Bɔni Na Kabla Bɔbla Na Lɛnwunameyi Lɛlɔ
32Uwi ɔni na Israelƒuɔ bákya ketele kalɔ kakwiidi kemmo ni, bekyuli badi bánu ka ɔnana ɔdi ɔkya ɔɔyɔ́ ekyweni na lɛnwunameyi lɛlɔ. 33Na bekyuli bani nánu-nwu mmɔ béƒie-nwu bésienku Mose ku Aaron ku Israelƒuɔ ƒui anumi, 34na béti-nwu bátákya ɔtɔ, ɔsika balati lɛla lɛni na babla-nwu. 35Mmɔ na Unwoti ɔ́su Mose ɔnini, “Ukyuli ɔni nábla lɛla lɛmmɔ udu ɔ́manku kukpi. Anwuɔsu ɔdi ka kadi bekyuli bammɔ ƒui bakpanku-nwu balɛku bana kakyakɔ na bétébo-nwu atabi bádu.” 36Ɔmmɔ ɔsu bákpanku-nwu bálɛku na bétebo-nwu atabi aani kalɛ na Unwoti úbo-ma ɔda.
Unwo Lɛbuli Lɛlɔ Bunyimi
37Amu na Unwoti ɔ́su Mose ɔnini, 38“Kɔ lɛsa na ásu Israelƒuɔ anini, ‘Úti ɔ́si ama ku bana kaba lɛlɔ úsela ni, biti linwo lɛni nse buluu na bibo-ni ekpo wɛlɛ wɛlɛ bɛsala bɛda bina adi atu. 39Na adi linwo lɛmmɔ lɛdubɔbla enyimola ute-mii na uwi biala bɛ́nu adi ammɔ ni, bɛdubo buteenyimo mina ɔda bubo na bitaadi-nwu lɛlɔ kalɛ na bilálɛ-mi kama na bitásiaku amii alati ɔbladu kama. 40Na adi linwo lɛmmɔ lɛdubɔya na biteenyimo kalɛ na bɛdi mina ɔda bubo lɛlɔ na bɛbla lɛlɔ sɛsɛɛ bise bite bina Katɔti. 41Ami ndi Unwoti bina Katɔti ɔni nákpanku-mii lɛ́siku Egyipte kalɛ na lɛdi bina Katɔti. Ami ndi Unwoti bina Katɔti.’ ”

Title: BUMOMO BƆKA 16
Content:
Kora Ku Datan Ku Abiram Atuɔkplu
1Kora ɔni ɔti ndi Isa ɔni ɔti ndi Kohat ɔni ɔti ndi Lewi ku Ruben kɔdua bebi bani ndi Datan ku Abiram bani ɔti ndi Eliab ku On ɔni ɔti ndi Pelet bábla atuɔkplu ala adi, 2na báta bénye Mose lɛlɔ. Na Israelƒuɔ banana babune geen bani na badi kelisa benengu nkyuli eti alɔ (250) bébunku-ma. 3Bekyuli bamɛni báta na lisu kemmo bésie Mose ku Aaron kudɔ na bátásu-ma banini, “Bɛɛyɔ́ bisie ɔgyu bɛgya! Israel kadi bekyuli ƒui bese kedee bete Unwoti bana ɔdi biala, na Unwoti ulieku bula ƒui. Na bi ɔsu na bɛɛnu lɛlɔ katɔ katɔ teetuloku Unwoti bekyuli lɛni?”
4Ka Mose únu etemila amɛni ni, ɔ́yu úbi kalɔ na ɔ́kpali Katɔti. 5Mmɔ na ɔ́su Kora ku nwuna bekyuli bani nsiaku-nwu kama ɔnini, “Kɔnaadi ɔtanta ni, Unwoti ɔdubɔtina ukyuli ɔni ndi nwuna ɔdi na use kedee, na ɔdubɔya na ukyuli ɔmmɔ ɔni ude-nwu. Na ukyuli ɔni na ɔ́ƒuna mmɔ ni, Unwoti ɔlati ɔdubɔya na ɔni ude-nwu. 6Na awɔ Kora ku ƒula kama basiakune ni, bɛwia oloƒui bɔkyula ebui, 7na kɔnaadi bidie ogya ku oloƒui biwi-ni kemmo na Unwoti anumi. Na ukyuli ɔni na Unwoti ɔ́ƒuna ni, anwu nse kedee. Amii Lewiƒuɔ mmomu nésie ɔgyu bɛgya!”
8Mose ɔ́su Kora lɛnɔ ɔnini, “Binu, amii Lewiƒuɔ! 9Israelƒuɔ Katɔti nédie-mii sɛsɛɛ ɔ́lɛku Israelƒuɔ akɔ na ɔ́ya na bɛ́ni bíde-nwu ka bitaabla kabla na Unwoti Adi Kevo kemmo, na binye bekyuli bammɔ kenye bitaabla-nwu kabla teete-ma. Ɔmɛni lɛti útabɔ-mii? 10Anwu nédie amii ku Lewiƒuɔ bakladi ɔ́bla nwuna ɔdi. Nsu bɛnu, ɔƒɛni bɛɛwia ka bɛƒɔ ɔkpane kabla lɛnɔ bɛbla bina ɔdi. 11Unwoti ɔmmɔ geen lɛlɔ na awɔ Kora ku ƒula basiakune bamɛni bɛ́ta binye. Ɔma na Aaron anwu ɔdi ɔsu na bɛɛdɔ lɛlɔ kemmo kalɔ kalɔ na nwuna lɛlɔ?”
12Amu na Mose ɔ́tala ɔnii bátálɔ Datan ku Abiram bani ndi Eliab bebi na bebo. Nsu básɔku kenye bémene Mose banini, “Bɔɔɔdubo mmɔ! 13Ɔni lɛti na ákpanku-bu ásiku Egyipte kalɔ kani kana egyiibi ntu bɔɔyu emini aani uwɔ na kana lɛlɔ bebuo baayu anyi ntu pii éboku ketele kalɔ kakwiidi kamɛni kemmo ka bubekpi bɔyii udu útabɔ? Na ɔƒɛni aawia ka asɔ ataadi-bu lɛlɔ lɛlati na mɛni? 14Na ɔni ntulo ndi ka éteti-bu éteboku kalɔ kani egyiibi ntu mɔɔyu emini aani uwɔ na kana lɛlɔ bebuo baayu anyi ntu pii, iye bɔkɛ adingyii mmo, iye kɔlɔ kɔbuni kɔni na busie mmo. Bunye na adubunye eteese bekyuli bamɛni lisusu lɛni na ɔ́sa? Oowo bɔɔɔdubo!”
15Mmɔ na Mose úbakɛ kɔnyi geen na ɔ́su Unwoti ɔnini, “Taƒɔ bekyuli bamɛni akpala adi. Ńtaƒɔ bana ɔdi lɛla lɛdi ina ebuo ala utine, na ńtaƒiɔ ɔdi lɛnɔ.”
16Amu na Mose ɔsu Kora ɔnini, “Kɔnaadi ni, awɔ ku ƒula basiakune ku Aaron ƒui bisie Unwoti Adi Kevo kammɔ anumi. 17Na ɔdi biala uti nwuna oloƒui bɔkyula libui na udie ogya ku oloƒui uwi-ni kemmo na biti-nya biboku Unwoti anumi, na ebui ammɔ ƒui adubɔbla eti alɔ (250). Na awɔ ku Aaron lɛnɔ biti bina ɔdi bɛda.” 18Anwuɔsu ɔdi biala úti nwuna oloƒui bɔkyula libui na úwi ogya ku oloƒui, na bana ƒui besie beténye Unwoti Adi Kevo kayakun ku Mose ku Aaron lɛnɔ. 19Amu ka Kora ɔ́sala nwuna bekyuli bani nsiaku-nwu kama ɔ́wɔlɔ na bébenye baanu Mose ku Aaron anumi na Unwoti Adi Kevo kayakun kenye mmɔ ni, kɔnakunwi ni, Unwoti bukeye bonwu bɔ́bwɛ búbewi bekyuli bammɔ ƒui lɛlɔ. 20Unwoti ɔ́su Mose ku Aaron ɔnini, 21“Bɛmami lɛlɔ bɛsiku bekyuli bammɔ ƒui kudɔ na ɔdia-mi na lɛyila-ma udu ƒui kɔnakunwi.”
22Nsu Mose ku Aaron báyula bana lili kalɔ na báva momoomo bákpali Katɔti basu-nwu banini, “O Katɔti, awɔ Katɔti ndi bayawine ƒui ayu ɔti, buti na adubuti kɔnyi akya kasala kammɔ ƒui na ukyuli unwi ɔdi likpidi ɔsu?”
23Amu na Unwoti ɔ́su Mose ɔnini, 24“Su Israelƒuɔ bani ƒui nlie nde Kora ku Datan ku Abiram nvo kudɔ na bata balɛ-ma kudɔ mmɔ besie kama.”
25Amu na Mose útiku Israelƒuɔ benengu na báta bésie Datan ku Abiram kudɔ. 26Mmɔ na útébo Israelƒuɔ ɔda ɔnini, “Bɛta bina kuliekɔ mɛni na bɛkpɛ bɛlɛ bekyuli bekpidi bamɛni nvo kudɔ. Na ɔdi biala uteti nwuna kɔnu utetuku bekyuli bammɔ lɛla lɛdi kalɛ na ɔgbankpi ɔmmɔ ɔdi uletuku ɔdi ɔ́si bana likpidi ɔsu.” 27Ɔmmɔ ɔsu bákpɛ bálɛ Kora ku Datan ku Abiram nvo kudɔ. Uwi ɔmmɔ ni, Datan ku Abiram ku bana beleku ku bana bebi ku bawɔ bálɛ bénye bana nvo kɔyakun kenye.
28Mmɔ na Mose ɔ́su bekyuli bammɔ ƒui ɔnini, “Ɔmɛni na bɛdubuti bɛnu bɛti ka Unwoti nátala-mi ɔnii mbabla ala amɛni. Na ɔɔɔdi ami ɔlati kasusu kadi. 29Si bekyuli bamɛni békpi kukpi kɔni kani na bekyuli ƒui beekpi ni, na ɔɔɔdi Unwoti nátala-mi. 30Nsu si Unwoti údie lɛla lɛwɔdi keyi na ɔ́ya na kalɔ kébimi kenye na kébweli-ma ku ngba ku ngba ama ku bana akɛla ani ƒui na bebo ni, bɛdubɔnu bɔti ka bátanu Unwoti bátabu munu munu.”
31Amu ka Mose ɔ́wɔlɔ nwuna butemi pɛ kalɔ kani lɛlɔ na Datan ku Abiram bene benye mmɔ kábwɛ kemmo inyɔ. 32Na kalɔ kammɔ kébimi kenye na kébweli-ma ku bana akɛla ƒui kede kede, na kébweli Kora bekyuli lɛnɔ ku bana akɛla ƒui. 33Bekyuli bammɔ béduo kekpine ku ngba ku ngba, ku bana ala ani ƒui na bebo na kalɔ kammɔ kásɔ kébile kenye, na báyii udu na bekyuli bammɔ ƒui akɔ. 34Uwi ɔni na Israelƒuɔ bénu kɔvanu momoomo kɔni bekyuli bani kalɔ kebweli mmɔ bedie uwi ɔni baanyi mmɔ ni, ama lɛnɔ béti usi bétuku na baava taasu banini, “Abu lɛnɔ kalɔ kadubo-bu bubweli!”
35Kɔnakunwi ni, ogya ɔ́si katɔ úbakyula nkyuli eti alɔ bani mɔɔkyula oloƒui mmɔ.
36Amu na Unwoti ɔ́su Mose ɔnini, 37“Su ɔkpane Aaron ubidi Eleasar na ɔla oloƒui bɔkyula ebui ammɔ udie ogya ntɔ bɔmmɔ kemmo na ugyingya ogya ɔmmɔ usienku kama ƒui, ɔsika ebui ammɔ ese kedee, 38na adi ebui ani na bekyuli bani nábla likpidi béti bana ngba báƒɔ bana likpidi lili kayu adi. Bitu ebui ammɔ bɛbla abuala kɔlɛkɛ bɛbɛɛbɛ bibi lɛkpabi lɛmmɔ lɛlɔ, ɔsika béti-nya béte Unwoti na ese kedee, na unwini likposela ute Israelƒuɔ.” 39Ɔmɛni ɔsu ɔkpane Eleasar ɔ́la oloƒui ebui ani na bekyuli bani na ogya ɔ́kyula mmɔ béboku na ɔ́ya na bétu-nya bábla kɔlɛkɛ bɛbɛɛbɛ bébi Unwoti Lɛkpabi lɛmmɔ lɛlɔ 40aani kalɛ na Unwoti úbo Mose ɔda. Na ɔmɛni ɔ́bla bɔlɛ úte Israelƒuɔ kaduɛ ka ukyuli ɔni nátasi Aaron kaba kemmo utalɛka usie Unwoti lɛkpabi kudɔ ɔnii utákyula oloƒui ute Unwoti. Na si ɔdi ɔ́bla lɛni ni, Unwoti ɔdubɔyila-nwu udu aani kalɛ na ɔ́bla Kora ku nwuna bekyuli. Na Eleasar ɔ́bla lɛla biala ɔ́siaku pɛpɛɛpɛ aani kalɛ na Unwoti úbo Mose ɔda.
Aaron Ɔ́ƒɔ Israelƒuɔ Ngba
41Ka kalɔ kébweli Kora badi kadi kégye kani na Israelƒuɔ ƒui báta na bákya baakya ku Mose ku Aaron unyeƒi na baasu-ma banii, “Amii nádu Unwoti bekyuli badi.” 42Nsu uwi ɔni na Israelƒuɔ básala lɛlɔ na baakya ku Mose ku Aaron unyeƒi mmɔ ni, béti anumi bátina Unwoti Adi Kevo na kɔnakunwi liƒlukutu lɛ́si líbewi ɔtɔ ɔmmɔ lɛlɔ, na Unwoti bukeye bonwu bɔ́bwɛ bɔ́lɛ mmɔ. 43Amu na Mose ku Aaron bésie béténye Unwoti Adi Kevo kammɔ anumi. 44Na Unwoti ɔ́su Mose ɔnini, 45“Bɛkpɛ bɛlɛ Israelƒuɔ bammɔ kudɔ kalɛ na ɔdia-mi na lɛyila-ma udu kɔnakunwi.” Nsu Mose ku Aaron báyu bébi kalɔ.
46Mmɔ na Mose ɔ́su Aaron ɔnini, “Babla na eti ƒula oloƒui libui na edie ogya asiku Unwoti lɛkpabi lɛmmɔ lɛlɔ na ewi oloƒui, na ekeli esie Israelƒuɔ bammɔ akɔ na atábla akpala ete Unwoti úte bana likpidi kɔtu bɔni budie. Ɔsika Unwoti úti kɔnyi ɔ́kya bekyuli bammɔ na ɔgbankpi úse kalɔ ɔɔlɛ́ku-ma.” 47Anwuɔsu Aaron lɛnɔ ɔ́bla kalɛ na Mose ɔ́su-nwu na úkeli úsie Israelƒuɔ bammɔ kudɔ. Nsu na uwi ɔmmɔ kemmo ni, Unwoti úuse kalɔ ɔɔdú bekyuli bammɔ. Na Aaron ɔ́bla oloƒui bɔkyula akpala úti údie likpidi kɔtu bɔni bana lɛlɔ. 48Únye bekyuli bani nlie ngba ku bani nekpi mmɔ ntɛ ɔ́bla akpala ammɔ na kukpi kɔmmɔ kenye kékulo. 49Nsu nkyuli mpim leevu-ine ku eti leevu-ene (14,700) békpi na ɔgbankpi ɔmmɔ kemmo bébunku bani nékpi ɔ́si Kora atuɔkplu ɔsu. 50Ɔmmɔ kama na Aaron ɔ́sɔ únwini úsie Mose kudɔ na Unwoti Adi Kevo mmɔ, ɔsika ɔgbankpi ɔmmɔ kenye kékulo.

Title: BUMOMO BƆKA 17
Content:
Aaron Ugyii Ɔdadi Ɔ́ta
1Amu na Unwoti ɔ́sɔ ɔ́su Mose ɔnini, 2“Kɔ lɛsa na asu Israelƒuɔ kaba leevu-inyɔ bammɔ ɔtɔnkune biala na ɔnwi ugyii ɔdadi unwi. Na enweni ɔdi biala lɛnyi asia nwuna ugyii lɛlɔ. 3Na enweni Aaron lɛnyi asia Lewiƒuɔ ugyii lɛlɔ, ɔsika kɔdua biala ɔtɔnkune ɔdi ka ugyii unwi use-nwu. 4Na eti ligyii lɛmmɔ etése Unwoti Adi Kevo kemmo na Bunyimi Adaka ɔmmɔ anumi kesii kani na mɔɔsiáku-mii. 5Na ukyuli ɔni na lɛ́ƒuna ni, nwuna ugyii ɔdubo bɔta budie evete. Na ulu ɔmɛni lɛlɔ na ndubɔsia na Israelƒuɔ badaku-ɔ unyeƒi bɔkya baya na lɛda kalaka kamɛni udu bunu lɛya.”
6Ɔmmɔ ɔsu Mose ɔ́kɔ litemi lɛmmɔ lɛsa úte Israelƒuɔ na bana kaba batɔnkune bammɔ ɔdi biala úti nwuna ugyii ɔdadi úboku Mose. Na ligyii lɛmmɔ ƒui lɛdi leevu-inyɔ. Na Aaron ugyii ɔdadi lɛnɔ ubunku. 7Na Mose úti ligyii lɛmmɔ úsienku Unwoti Adi Kevo kammɔ kemmo na úti-ni útése Bunyimi Adaka ɔmmɔ anumi.
8Ka kadi kégye ni, Mose úsie Unwoti Kevo kemmo na ka ɔ́nu ni, na Aaron ugyii ɔni nnye nte Lewiƒuɔ mmɔ ɔ́ta na údie evete ku anwula na ɔ́nwu ebi. 9Mmɔ na Mose ɔ́la ligyii lɛmmɔ ƒui ɔ́siku Unwoti anumi na úti-ni úsienku Israelƒuɔ kudɔ. Na ɔtɔnkune biala ɔ́nu nwuna ugyii údie.
10Na Unwoti ɔ́su Mose ɔnini, “Sɔku Aaron ugyii tése Bunyimi Adaka ɔmmɔ anumi. Na ugyii ɔmmɔ ɔdubɔbla likposela ute Israelƒuɔ batuɔkplune. Na ɔdubɔya na bada bɔdɔ na bana lɛlɔ kemmo na mina lɛlɔ baya kalɛ na balása bukpi ƒui.” 11Na Mose ɔ́bla ɔ́sia kalɛ kani Unwoti úbo-nwu ɔda.
12Mmɔ na Israelƒuɔ bammɔ básu Mose banini, “Bɔdubo bukpi! Bɔ́yii ɔƒɛni amu! Bula ƒui bɔyii! 13Na ukyuli biala mani mede Unwoti Adi Kevo kammɔ muedi ɔdubukpi. Ɔmmɔ ɔsu bula ƒui bɔdubo bukpi?”

Title: BUMOMO BƆKA 18
Content:
Kabla Kani Na Bakpane Ku Lewiƒuɔ Ɔlɛka Babla
1Amu na Unwoti ɔ́su Aaron ɔnini, “Awɔ, ku ƒula bebi ku ƒ'ɔti ɔtɔ bebi ƒui kani ndubo bɔƒiɔ biala mebo Unwoti Adi Kevo kammɔ lɛlɔ buti, na awɔ ku ƒula bebi kani ndubo bɔƒiɔ biala mebo ɔkpane bɔdi kabla kammɔ lɛlɔ buti. 2Kpanku Lewiƒuɔ ku ƒula kaba bekyuli na bebebunku-ɔ si uwi ɔni awɔ ku ƒula bebi bɛkya bɛɛbla bakpane kabla na Unwoti Adi Kevo kemmo mmɔ. 3Na Lewiƒuɔ bammɔ badubɔkya-a kalɔ na ama ndubɔbla kabla biala na Kevo mmɔ, na bana akɔ ɔdi biala na útamanku utani utede ala kedee ani na Kevo kemmo mmɔ ku lɛkpabi lɛmmɔ, si ɔɔɔdi lɛni amii ku-ma ƒui bɛdubo bukpi. 4Badubo na bebunku-ɔ na bitaabla kabla biala na Kevo kammɔ kemmo ku kana lɛlɔ bɔnu, na ukyuli bamba ɔdi utani utede-mii na mmɔ.
5“Amii na ɔlɛka bitaanu Adi Kevo kammɔ lɛlɔ ku lɛkpabi lɛmmɔ lɛlɔ, kalɛ na mina kɔnyi kɔsɔ kuláda kulálɛ Israelƒuɔ lɛlɔ. 6Ami ɔlati náƒuna Lewiƒuɔ bammɔ lɛ́lɛku Israelƒuɔ akɔ líte-ɔ lɛ́bla na bese sɛsɛɛ bete Unwoti ka babla kabla na Unwoti Adi Kevo kemmo. 7Nsu awɔ ku ƒula bebi bananabi kani na ɔlɛka bitaabla bakpane kabla biala na lɛkpabi lɛmmɔ lɛlɔ ku kakpakɔ bule kɔdi kɔmmɔ kama mmɔ. Na líti ɔkpane kabla kamɛni muute-mii aani etela kalɛ. Na ɔmmɔ kama ukyuli biala mani mede kakpakɔ kammɔ kudɔ ɔlɛka badu-nwu.”
Bakpane Ku Lewiƒuɔ Kadikɔ
8Ɔmmɔ kama Unwoti ɔ́su Aaron ɔnini, “Ami ɔlati néti-ɔ líse etela biala na béti béboku-mi kenye. Na etela kedee biala na Israelƒuɔ badubuti buboku-mi ni, lɛ́sɔku-nya muute awɔ ku ƒula bebi bananabi aani bina kadikɔ ku lɛla lɛni na ɔdi ka bitaakɛ. 9Na akpala kedee ani na balákyula na lɛkpabi lɛlɔ aani edula ebi akpala ku likpidi lili buvele akpala biala adi bina ɔdi. Na akpala biala na béti béboku-mi na ese kedee ƒui adi awɔ ku ƒula bebi bananabi ɔdi. 10Na si bɛɛdi ala ammɔ na bɛdi-nya na kesii kani nse kedee. Na awɔ ku ƒula bebi bananabi kani ɔlɛka bɛdi adila ammɔ. Bɛbu adila ammɔ ka ese kedee.
11“Ɔmmɔ kama akpala sɛsɛɛ biala Israelƒuɔ badubuti beboku-mi adi awɔ ku ƒula bebi ɔdi. Na líti-nya muute awɔ ku ƒula bebi bananabi ku belekubi ɔƒɛni ku uwi ɔni mebo ƒui. Na ukyuli biala nási ƒula kaduli kemmo na ukyuli ɔmmɔ use sɛɛn ɔkana ɔdi ala ammɔ adi.
12“Na edula edeedi abuni ani na Israelƒuɔ badubɔkɛ aani nnɔ ku ntɛ bɔwɔdi ku edula ebi ani na badubuti beboku Unwoti ni, lɛ́sɔku-nya muute-mii. 13Na kalɔ kammɔ ƒui edula edeedi ani béti béboku Unwoti adubɔbla bina ɔdi. Na ukyuli biala nlie-ɔ kaduli na use sɛɛn ɔkana ɔdi adila ammɔ adi.
14“Na lɛla biala nkya Israel kalɔ lɛlɔ na bédie-ni sɛsɛɛ bése béte Unwoti ɔdi bina ɔdi. 15Na kaƒɔ biala ubi udeedi ku ebuo udeedi biala na báwɔ, na Israelƒuɔ béti-nwu béboku Unwoti ɔdi bina ɔdi. Nsu ɔnanabi udeedi ku ebuo ala utine biala anwu ni, ɔlɛka basɔku-nwu beye basiku-mi kudɔ. 16Na kayu kani na ɔlɛka baƒɔ na ɔnanabi ubi udeedi biala na báwɔ-nwu na ɔ́kɛ kɔbuli ɔdi sika ɔƒualadi ebi alɔ na kakpakɔ ala bɔkɔku kenye.
17“Nsu ɔmantɛ akɔ, ku koƒonu ku ese udeedi biala na báwɔ ɔdi Unwoti ɔdi na utalɛka beti ebuo ɔmmɔ ɔdi beye. Ama bese kedee na ɔlɛka badu-ma na beti bana ubugya bakuna bewi lɛkpabi lɛlɔ na bakya bana lɛmwi lɛmmɔ ogya bakyula na ɔnyi ƒɛƒɛɛ ɔmmɔ ɔyɔ-mi kaƒɔ. 18Bana lɛna lɛdi bina ɔdi aani kalɛ kani na bebuo bani kayi ɔvu ku ebuli lɛna bákɔliku katɔ bátina-mi bébo-ni kudu lɛdi bina ɔdi. 19Ala ani ƒui na bédie bése sɛsɛɛ béte-mi ɔ́siku Israelƒuɔ etela ani na béboku-mi kemmo ni, líti muute awɔ Aaron ku ƒula bebi bananabi ku belekubi. Na bunyimi bɔmɛni na Unwoti únyimi úse úte awɔ ku ƒula bebi ku bawɔ úsela uwi ƒui na ulavumana.”
20Amu na Unwoti ɔ́su Aaron ɔnini, “Aaadubo kadikɔ kadi bɔkɛ na Israel, na belele lɛla lɛdi lɛnɔ belete-ɔ, ɔsika ami Unwoti kani ndi ƒula kadikɔ ku lɛla lɛni nédu-ɔ na Israelƒuɔ akɔ.
21“Na ala ani ƒui na Israelƒuɔ bákɛ básiku bana kabla kani baabla kemmo lɛkpa leevudi ni, líti muute Lewiƒuɔ ka beti babla bana kadikɔ na Unwoti Adi Kevo kemmo kabla kani na baabla kenye. 22Na ɔ́si ɔƒɛni úsela ni, Israelni biala utani utede Unwoti Adi Kevo kammɔ kudɔ. Na si ɔdi ɔ́bla lɛni ni, ɔdubɔkɛ nwuna likpidi kɔtu bɔni ɔni ndi kukpi. 23Lewiƒuɔ kani na ɔlɛka bataabla kabla na Unwoti Adi Kevo kammɔ kemmo. Na si lɛla lɛdi lɛ́lɛ mmɔ ama kani ndubɔnuku-ni. Ɔda bubo bɔmɛni buse úsela uwi ƒui útédu bina bawɔ bawɔ akɔ lɛnɔ. Na ama beeebo kadikɔ kadi na Israelƒuɔ akɔ. 24Mmomu Israelƒuɔ ala lɛkpa leevudi lɛni beeti teeboku Unwoti aani akpala ndubɔbla bana kadikɔ. Ɔmɛni ɔsu na lɛ́su nnii, ‘Beeebo kadikɔ kadi na Israelƒuɔ akɔ.’ ”
25Amu na Unwoti ɔ́su Mose ɔnini, 26“Temi te Lewiƒuɔ na asu-ma anini, ‘Ala lɛkpa leevudi lɛni lɛ́su Israelƒuɔ ka beti beboku-mii aani bina kadikɔ mmɔ si béti béboku ni, amii lɛnɔ bidie lɛkpa leevudi na biti bɛbla akpala bite Unwoti. 27Na badubuti etela ammɔ aani edula ebi ani nási bina mmo edula ebi kewiilekɔ iye egyiibi ntu bɔni nási bina ntɛ kebulokɔ. 28Na ala lɛkpa leevudi lɛni na bɛɛƒɔ́ taasiku Israelƒuɔ kudɔ ni, ulu ɔmɛni lɛlɔ na bɛdubɔsia na amii lɛnɔ biti akpala biboku Unwoti. Na akpala amɛni kemmo ni, biti Unwoti kadikɔ bite ɔkpane Aaron. 29Na ɔdi ka bɛsia anu na ala ammɔ kabunikɔ ƒui kani nse kedee na biti bite Unwoti.’
30“Na asu Lewiƒuɔ bammɔ anini, ‘Si bíti ala ammɔ kabunikɔ kammɔ ƒui bíboku Unwoti ni, badubɔnu-nya aani edula ebi ani na bíwiile bíwi kakpa iye egyiibi ntu bɔni nási bina ntɛ kebulokɔ. 31Na amii ku bina kaduli bekyuli bɛkana na bɛdi ɔkladi na kesi kesii ƒaa, ɔsika ɔmmɔ ndi bina lɛyuƒɔla na kabla kani na bɛɛbla na Unwoti Adi Kevo kemmo kenye. 32Na si bídie ala ammɔ kabunikɔ ƒui bíte Unwoti ni, biiibo kɔtɔ budu bɔdi na ɔmɛni kemmo, na ɔɔɔdubo bɔya na Israelƒuɔ akpala ammɔ ese lɛlɔ, na amii lɛnɔ bilekpi.’ ”

Title: BUMOMO BƆKA 19
Content:
Unwoti Úbo Mose Ɔda Na Ɔmantɛ Akɔ Ugyiedi Ntɔ Lɛlɔ
1Unwoti úbo Mose ku Aaron ɔda ɔnini, 2“Ala ani nkɛnku ɔda bubo bɔni na Unwoti úte-mii ndi ɔmɛni, bɛsu Israelƒuɔ na beboku ɔmantɛ akɔ ugyiedi uledi ɔkɔdi ɔni na bɔsɔ bɔdi buuubo-nwu lɛlɔ na bátabala-nwu kɔgba kɔdi na ɔbla kabla kadi kudii. 3Na beti-nwu beboku ɔkpane Eleasar, na beti akɔ ammɔ balɛku bana keliekɔ mmɔ bésienku kama na badu-nwu mmɔ na ɔkpane ɔmmɔ anumi. 4Na si bádu-nwu báwɔlɔ ni, na Eleasar uti ubugya ɔmmɔ na uti nwuna lɛnimi ɔkya ubugya ɔmmɔ kemmo. Na uti nwuna anumi ɔtina kesii kani na Unwoti Adi Kevo kammɔ kenye na ɔkuna ubugya ɔmmɔ umene Kevo kammɔ anumi maatɛ. 5Na ɔmmɔ kama na unye ɔnu na bakyula ebuo umodi ɔmmɔ ku nwuna ɔku ku ubugya ku nwuna kaƒɔ ala ƒui. 6Na ɔmmɔ kama Eleasar ɔwia kegyiikɛ kadi ku hisope ku kabuli kegyiedi kadi na ubo-nya ɔkya ogya ɔmmɔ kemmo. 7Na si ɔ́bla ala ammɔ ƒui ɔ́wɔlɔ ni, ɔlɛka utáƒɔ nwuna adala na ɔkpi ntu. Na ammɔ kama ɔkana na unwini utéduo bana kakyakɔ mmɔ. Nsu nwuna lɛlɔ lɛɛɛdubo buse sɛɛn wetédu useyi uwi. 8Na ukyuli ɔni nákyula akɔ ammɔ lɛnɔ ɔlɛka ɔƒɔ nwuna adala na ɔkpi ntu, nsu anwu lɛnɔ ɔɔɔdubo buse sɛɛn utédu useyi uwi.
9“Na ukyuli ɔni nse sɛɛn ndubɔbuma akɔ ntɔ bɔmmɔ utéwi kesii kani nse sɛɛn na bana keliekɔ kammɔ kama. Na ntɔ bɔmmɔ bɔdubuwi mmɔ bute Israelƒuɔ kadi kammɔ na beteewi ntu kemmo taabla lɛlɔ bɔbla sɛɛn ɔdi. 10Na ɔnana ɔni mabuma ntɔ bɔmmɔ lɛnɔ ɔlɛka ɔƒɔ nwuna adala, na ɔɔɔdubo buse sɛɛn wetédu useyi uwi. Ɔda ubo bɔmɛni buse bute Israelƒuɔ ku baƒɔ bani nkya-ma akɔ úte uwi ƒui.
11“Ukyuli biala meti kɔnu metuku ukpine ɔdi ɔ́sɔ na ulése sɛɛn emeyi maatɛ. 12Na limeyi lɛtɛdi ku limeyi maatɛdi lɛlɔ ni, ɔlɛka uti ntu bɔmmɔ ɔbla lɛlɔ sɛɛn, na nwuna lɛlɔ lɛdubɔbla sɛɛn. Nsu si úteti ntu bɔmmɔ útabla lɛlɔ sɛɛn na limeyi lɛtɛdi ku maatɛdi lɛmmɔ lɛlɔ ni, ɔɔɔdubo buse sɛɛn. 13Na ukyuli biala meti kɔnu metuku ukpine na uni na utabla sɛɛn bɔbla ɔdi ɔmmɔ ni, ɔ́ya na Unwoti kakpakɔ keesé lɛlɔ, na ɔlɛka bada ukyuli ɔmmɔ bedie Israelƒuɔ akɔ. Ɔsika batakuna ntu bɔni mɔbla sɛɛn bétewi-nwu lɛlɔ ɔsu uusé lɛlɔ. Na nwuna sɛɛn tabla ɔmmɔ ɔkya-nwu lɛlɔ.
14“Na si ubebo ute ka ukyuli ɔdi ukpi na nwuna kɔdi ɔtɔ kemmo ni, bekyuli bani nkya mmɔ asa na ukpi iye ukyuli biala meduo ɔtɔ ɔmmɔ kemmo ɔdubuse lɛlɔ emeyi maatɛ. 15Na akyami ku ebui ani neeebo libila na alɛ ɔtɔ ɔmmɔ kemmo lɛlɔ lɛdubuse lɛlɔ. 16Na ukyuli biala metuku ukyuli ɔni bébo-nwu bádu iye anwu alati kukpi na úkpi iye útuku ukpine likubi iye kaƒiɔtɔ ni, ukyuli ɔmmɔ ɔdubuse lɛlɔ emeyi maatɛ.
17“Asa na ukyuli ɔni muusé lɛlɔ mmɔ ɔdubɔbla sɛɛn ni, ɔlɛka bama akɔ ugyiedi ntɔ bɔni bákyula na amu muudie likpidi na ukyuli lɛlɔ mmɔ bɔdi. Na beti ntɔ bɔmmɔ bewi libui kemmo na bedu ntu bɔbuni bewi-nwu kemmo. 18Na ukyuli ɔni nse sɛɛn na ulese lɛlɔ ɔlɛka ɔwia hisope lɛla lɛni lɛdia ntu bɔkuna buwi lɛla lɛdi lɛlɔ. Na uti ɔkya ntu libui lɛmmɔ kemmo na ɔkuna uwi Adi Kevo ɔtɔ ɔni na ukyuli úkpi-nwu kemmo mmɔ ku bekyuli bani nákya mmɔ ƒui. Kunyɔdi ukyuli ɔni nse sɛɛn ɔlɛka ɔkuna ntu bɔmmɔ uwi ukyuli ɔni nétuku ukpine likubi iye utuku ukpine ɔni na bádu iye anwu ɔlati nékpi iye kaƒiɔtɔ. 19Na limeyi lɛtɛdi ku maatɛdi lɛlɔ ni, ukyuli ɔni nse sɛɛn ɔkuna ntu bɔmmɔ uwi ukyuli ɔni neeese sɛɛn mmɔ lɛlɔ. Na limeyi maatɛdi lɛlɔ ukyuli mmɔ ɔlɛka ɔƒɔ nwuna adala na ɔkpi ntu. Na ɔmmɔ kama ukyuli ɔni nákuna ntu bɔmmɔ úwi lɛlɔ mmɔ ɔbla-nwu sɛɛn. Na si ɔƒɔ na ukyuli mmɔ ɔbla sɛɛn.
20“Nsu si ukyuli ɔdi ɔkya-mii akɔ na úni na útabla lɛlɔ sɛɛn ɔlɛka bada-nwu bedie bina akɔ. Ɔsika uti eƒi utuku Unwoti kakpakɔ ka béteti ntu bɔni mɔɔbla ukyuli ɔni eƒi akya-nwu lɛlɔ betewi-nwu lɛlɔ ɔsu. Ɔmmɔ ɔsu na uuse lɛlɔ. 21Na ɔda bubo bɔmɛni buse busela uwi ƒui. Na ukyuli ɔni maakuna ntu bɔni mɔɔyá ukyuli ɔɔbla sɛɛn mmɔ mewi ukyuli ɔdi ɔlɛka anwu lɛnɔ ɔƒɔ nwuna adala. Na ukyuli biala meetuku ntu bɔdi ɔdubuse lɛlɔ wetédu useyi uwi. 22Ukyuli biala na ukyuli ɔni lɛlɔ muusé lɛlɔ weti kɔnu wetuku-nwu ɔdubuse lɛlɔ. Na ukyuli biala lɛnɔ metuku-nwu ɔdubuse lɛlɔ wetédu useyi uwi.”

Title: BUMOMO BƆKA 20
Content:
Ntu Bɔ́bwɛ Bɔ́lɛ Lɛtakpɛ Kemmo
1Kɔbuli kudeedi kemmo na Israelƒuɔ ƒui bétéduo Sin Ketele kalɔ kakwiidi kemmo na báda bana keliekɔ na Kades. Mmɔ na Miriam úkpi na báva-nwu.
2Uwi ɔmmɔ ni, ntu biala bútakya mmɔ na bakɛ bani, anwuɔsu Israel kadi bekyuli bammɔ básala lɛlɔ báta bénye Mose ku Aaron lɛlɔ. 3Na bádɔnku Mose banini, “Si bukpi na abu lɛnɔ búkpi-ku bekyuli bani nékpi na Unwoti anumi mmɔ nka ɔdia-bu utulo! 4Bi ɔsu na éti bula ƒui ku bula bebuo ébewi ketele kalɔ kakwiidi kamɛni kemmo na bukpi bɔkya mɛni? 5Na bi ɔsu na ákpanku-bu ásiku Egyipte kalɔ lɛlɔ ábakya ketele kalɔ kakwiidi kamɛni kemmo, kesii kani na edula ebi adi iye kɔnwingyie iye egyiibi lidu adi eeebo, na ntu biala muedi buuubo na bɔni?”
6Mmɔ na Mose ku Aaron bátɔlɔ bekyuli bani násala mmɔ kudɔ na bátáyu bátɛ kalɔ na béti bana anumi bébi kalɔ na Unwoti Adi Kevo anumi. Mmɔ na Unwoti bukeye bɔ́bwɛ búbewi-ma lɛlɔ. 7Amu na Unwoti ɔ́su Mose ɔnini, 8“Ti ugyii ɔdadi ɔmmɔ na awɔ ku Aaron bɛsala bekyuli bammɔ ƒui. Na etemi ete lɛtakpɛ lɛmmɔ na bekyuli bammɔ ƒui anumi. Na ntu bɔdubo bɔlɛ lɛtakpɛ lɛmmɔ kemmo na bekyuli bammɔ ku bana bebuo bani.” 9Ɔmmɔ ɔsu Mose úti ugyii ɔdadi ɔmmɔ ɔ́siku Unwoti anumi aani kalɛ kani na úbo-nwu ɔda. 10Na anwu ku Aaron básala bekyuli bammɔ na lɛtakpɛ lɛmmɔ kudɔ. Na Mose ɔ́su-ma ɔnini, “Amii batuɔkplune, binu! Bɛwia ntu bɛni bɛsiku lɛtakpɛ lɛmɛni kemmo?” 11Mmɔ na Mose ɔ́talaku ugyii ɔmmɔ katɔ na ɔ́ƒiɛmi lɛtakpɛ lɛmmɔ kunyɔ na ntu bɔ́bwɛ bɔ́lɛ-ni kemmo. Na bekyuli bammɔ ku bana bebuo báni kaduɛ.
12Nsu Unwoti ɔ́su Mose ku Aaron ɔnini, “Ka bitaƒɔ-mi bítadi geen na bite-mi ɔbu ka nse kedee na Israelƒuɔ bammɔ anumi ɔsu ni, bɛsɔ bɛɛɛdubo bekyuli bammɔ bɔkpanku busienku kalɔ kani lɛ́su ka ndubo-ma bute kemmo.”
13Ala amɛni álɛ na Meriba. Ɔsika mmɔ na Israelƒuɔ bákyaku Unwoti unyeƒi na údie ɔtina-ma ka Unwoti ɔni use kedee na ɔdi na bana akɔ.
Edomƒuɔ Ɔga Úni Ka Israelƒuɔ Bavi Nwuna Kalɔ Lɛlɔ
14Uwi ɔmmɔ kemmo Mose ɔ́tala bekyuli badi ɔ́kya Edomƒuɔ ɔga na bátásu-nwu banini, “Ƒ'ɔnwani Israel ɔnini, ‘Agyi lɛbibo lɛni néebo-bu lɛlɔ. 15Bula bati kuuku bétélie Egyipte kalɔ akwa pii. Na Egyipteƒuɔ bamɛni bábla abu ku bula bati kuuku kalala geen. 16Nsu ka búwulo bɔ́kpali Unwoti ni, únu bula buwulo. Na ɔ́tala nwuna ɔtu ɔdi ɔkya-bu, na úbada-bu údie Egyipteƒuɔ enu kemmo.
“ ‘Na ɔƒɛni búusie lɛgba laa búbedu Kedes ɔma ɔni nkya ƒula ɔmii lɛlɔ. 17Na buuvele-ɔ ka te-bu kuƒi na bɔsia bɔvia ƒula kalɔ ku lɛma kemmo. Na bulávi bina mmo iye adingyii mmo bɔdi kemmo. Na buláni bina abiɔ ntu bɔdi lɛnɔ. Bɔsia kani na bɔdubo ƒula lilu linengudi lɛmmɔ lɛlɔ bɔsia bɔvi na bulenwini bulanu kɔmii iye kɔdianu útédu ka bɔ́vi ƒula kalɔ kemmo bɔ́wɔlɔ.’ ”
18Nsu Edomƒuɔ ɔga údie batalane bammɔ kenye ɔnini, “Kuƒi kuuubo ka bɛvi mmɔ. Na si bɛ́yu atuɔkplu bɔdubɔta na buti bula kuwii na bubekpoku-mii.”
19Amu na Israelƒuɔ básɔ bédie kenye banini, “Ulu unengudi ɔmmɔ lɛlɔ kani bɔdubo bɔsia. Na si bula ɔdi iye bula ebuo ɔdi ɔ́ni bina ntu bɔdi bɔdubɔƒɔ kayu. Mmomu kalɛ kani na bɔsia mmɔ bɔvi ku lɛgba kani na bɔɔwia.”
20Edomƒuɔ básɔ bédie-ma kenye banini, “Kuƒi kuuubo ka bɛsia-bu kalɔ kemmo.”
Amu na Edomƒuɔ bamɛni báta na béti bana bekpone bani mbo ɔyikun kaduɛ ka betékpoku-ma. 21Na ka Edomƒuɔ bétete kuƒi ka basia bana kalɔ kemmo bavi ɔsu ni, Israelƒuɔ bédeyi na bátásia ulu bamba.
Aaron Úkpi
22Amu na Israelƒuɔ báta Kades na bébedu Hor Kɔbi kaƒɔna. 23Na Hor Kɔbi lɛlɔ na kesii kani nde Edom ɔmii lɛlɔ mmɔ ni, Unwoti ɔ́su Mose ku Aaron ɔnini, 24“Aaron ɔdubusie utánwuna ku nwuna bati. Na ɔɔɔdubo buduo kalɔ kani líti muute Israelƒuɔ mmɔ kemmo, ɔsika awɔ Mose ku Aaron bɛ́ta binye mina ɔda bubo lɛlɔ na Meriba Ketudɔ. 25Kpanku Aaron ku ubidi Eleasar sienku Hor Kɔbi kɔmmɔ lili. 26Die Aaron lɛwu gyɔlɔɔ lɛmmɔ na eti-ni akya ubidi Eleasar, ɔsika Aaron ɔdubo busie nwuna bati kudɔ mmɔ.”
27Mose lɛnɔ ɔ́bla kalɛ kani na Unwoti úbo-nwu ɔda. Na ɔ́kpanku-ma úsienku Hor Kɔbi kɔmmɔ lili na Israelƒuɔ bammɔ ƒui anumi. 28Mmɔ na Mose údie Aaron lɛwu gyɔlɔɔ lɛmmɔ na úti-ni ɔ́kya ubidi Eleasar. Na Aaron úkpi na kɔbi kɔmmɔ lili. Na Mose ku Eleasar báyu kɔbi kɔmmɔ lili bébo kalɔ. 29Uwi ɔni na Israelƒuɔ báti ka Aaron úkpi ni, Israelƒuɔ béwulo-nwu emeyi avlaatɛ.

Title: BUMOMO BƆKA 21
Content:
Israelƒuɔ Békpo Bádi Kanaanƒuɔ Lɛlɔ
1Uwi ɔni na Kanaanƒuɔ ɔga ɔni mɔɔdi Arad lɛlɔ na uli Negev kalɔ kemmo únu ka Israelƒuɔ bákɛ ulu ɔni na úti úsela Atarim ni, ɔga ɔmɛni úsie na útékpoku Israelƒuɔ na úƒie badi ɔ́tɔlɔku. 2Mmɔ na Israelƒuɔ bése kenye béte Unwoti básu-nwu banini, “Unwoti, si adubuti Kanaanƒuɔ bamɛni akya-bu enu kemmo ni, bɔdubɔyila bana lɛma linengudi ƒui udu kede kede.” 3Ɔmmɔ ɔsu Unwoti únu Israelƒuɔ kenye kani bése mmɔ. Na Unwoti úti Kanaanƒuɔ bamɛni ɔ́kya Israelƒuɔ enu kemmo. Na békpo bádi-ma lɛlɔ na báyila bana lɛma ƒui udu, anwuɔsu básia ntɛ mmɔ lɛnyi banii Horma, na nwuna kalɔ ndi Kebiekɔ.
Mose Úti Lɛbualagyie Ɔ́bla Kɔlakpi
4Uwi ɔni na Israelƒuɔ bésie bási Hor Kɔbi lɛlɔ na Ɛpugyie ulu lɛlɔ bétédu Edom na bésela ni, Israelƒuɔ bamɛni basɔ balakɛ kayi lɛnɔ. 5Ɔmmɔ ɔsu bétemi béwi Mose ku Unwoti na básu banini, “Bi ɔsu na bɛ́da-bu bídie Egyipte kalɔ lɛlɔ na bubekpi bɔkya ketele kalɔ kakwiidi kamɛni kemmo? Kesii kani na bodobodo ku ntu buuubo? Na adila ani bɔɔdi mɛni éedu-bu ɔkwɛ!”
6Na ɔmmɔ ɔsu Unwoti údie balakpi bani mbo ugyulo ukpidi ɔkya-ma na bádu Israelƒuɔ badu kaduɛ. 7Mmɔ na bekyuli bammɔ bákpɛ bede Mose na básu-nwu banini, “Bɔ́bla likpidi na awɔ ku Unwoti anumi, ɔsika bútemi buwi-mii. Anwuɔsu buuvele na akpali Unwoti na ɔda balakpi bamɛni udie-bu akɔ.” Ɔmmɔ ɔsu Mose ɔ́kpali Unwoti na úvele ute bekyuli bammɔ.
8Amu na Unwoti ɔ́su Mose ɔnini, “Vɔ kɔlakpi udu ɔdi na akɔliku-nwu aƒala ugyii ɔdi eli. Na ukyuli biala na kɔlakpi kɔ́du-nwu na unwini ɔnu kɔlakpi kɔni nƒa ugyii lɛlɔ mmɔ na nwuna ɔlɛ ɔba-nwu.” 9Anwuɔsu Mose úti lɛbualagyie na ɔ́vɔ kɔlakpi na úti-nwu ɔ́ƒala ugyii lɛlɔ. Mmɔ na si kɔlakpi kɔ́du ukyuli ɔdi na ɔ́talaku nwuna lili ɔ́nu kɔlakpi kɔmmɔ pɛ na nwuna ɔlɛ ɔ́ɔba-nwu.
Israelƒuɔ Básɔ Báta Báyu Ulu
10Amu na Israelƒuɔ bésie na betédu Obot. 11Na básɔ báta na betédu Iye-Abarim ketele kalɔ kakwiidi kani nkya Moab anumi na ɔƒɛ katukɔ kakɛ lɛlɔ. 12Na ka básɔ báta mmɔ ni, basɔ bétédu Sared Kɔwɛ kemmo. 13Na ka básɔ bási mmɔ ni, bakɛ lɛgya lɛgya na betédu Aron ketele kalɔ kakwiidi kani nkɛ utédu Amoriƒuɔ ɔmii lɛlɔ. Na Arnon ndi Moabƒuɔ ɔmii ɔni nkya Moabƒuɔ ku Amoriƒuɔ ntɛ. 14Ɔmɛni ɔsu na bénweni bákya Kekpo Ɔku kemmo banini,
“Waheb ɔma ɔni nkya Suƒa
ku Arnon Kɔwɛ
15ku kɔwɛ kɔni náyu kútédu Ar,
na ɔkɛ étédu Moab.”
16Ka bási mmɔ ni, bésie bétédu kesii kani baalɔ banini, Beer. Mmɔ na Unwoti ɔ́su Mose ɔnini, “Sala bekyuli bammɔ ƒui lisu na ndubo-ma ntu bute na bani.”
17Uwi ɔmmɔ na Israelƒuɔ bátu kɔgya kɔmɛni.
“Abiɔ, bitaayu ntu pii,
na bɔdubo kɔgya buti bɔkya-mii kenye.
18Libiɔ lɛni na bagadine béku,
na bekyuli bammɔ batɔnkune bátu kɔgya.
Béti bagadine ɔyikun ugyii lɛbuala
ku batɔnkune ligyii lɛdadi béku.”
Na báta bási ketele kalɔ kakwiidi kemmo bésie Matana. 19Na bási Matana bésie Nahaliel na bási Nahaliel bésie Bamot. 20Na bási Bamot bésie kɔwɛ kɔni nkya Moab kesii kani Pisga uwi katɔ kakɛ na akana enye anu ketele kalɔ kakwiidi kammɔ.
Israelƒuɔ Békpo Bádi Sihon Ku Og Lɛlɔ
21Amu na Israelƒuɔ bátala batu bákya Amoriƒuɔ Ɔga Sihon ka, 22ute kuƒi na basia nwuna kalɔ lɛlɔ bavi. Na beledeyi belésie kemo iye adingyii kemo kadi. Na baláni nwuna abiɔ ntu bɔdi lɛnɔ. Na Ɔga Ulu Unengudi ɔmmɔ lɛlɔ kani badubo busie bɔvi útédu ka bɔ́via nwuna ɔmii.
23Nsu Sihon útete kuƒi na bavi nwuna kalɔ lɛlɔ. Ɔmmɔ ɔsu ɔ́sala nwuna bekpone ƒui na bésie ketele kalɔ kakwiidi kemmo ka betékpo-ku Israelƒuɔ. Na ka bédu Yahas ni, békpoku Israelƒuɔ. 24Na Israelƒuɔ bádu-ma kaduɛ. Ɔmmɔ ɔsu béti bana kalɔ ɔ́si Arnon útédu Yabok. Na ɔmmɔ ɔdi Amonƒuɔ kakɛ. Ɔsika Amonƒuɔ bágyumana bana ɔmii kaduɛ. 25Na Israelƒuɔ békpo báƒɔ Amoriƒuɔ lɛma linengudi ƒui na béti-ni ku Hesbon ku lɛma lɛni nde-ni ƒui. 26Na Hesbon ndi Amoriƒuɔ Ɔga Sihon ɔma unengudi. Anwu nékpo ku Moabƒuɔ ɔga ɔkukudi na úti nwuna kɔlɔ ƒui útédu Arnon. 27Ɔmmɔ ɔsu na baatu asugba kɔgya banini,
“Bibo na bɔsɔ bɔda Hesbon ɔma.
Na bɛya bɔsɔku Ɔga Sihon ɔma unengudi
use aani kalɛ use kuuku.
28Dii ni, Hesbon ɔma unengudi ɔmɛni
Sihon bekpone báta aani kalɛ lɛgyavonku lɛsala.
Na útáyila Moabƒuɔ ɔma Ar
na bése bétebile ala na abi ani nkya Arnon katɔ kakɛ.
29Amii Moabƒuɔ bɔbuɛ ɔdi bina ɔdi.
Amii kadi bekyuli bani mɔɔkpá Kemos baƒiɔ bɛyii ku udu.
Bɛya na bina bananabi bekeli betenwini kadi bamba bekyuli.
Na bina belekubi ni, Amoriƒuɔ Ɔga Sihon
ɔdubo-ma buƒie bɔtɔlɔku.
30Nsu búgyingya-ma ƒui na Hesbon ɔ́yii udu útédu Dibon.
Na bɔ́yila-ma butédu Noƒa laa útédu Medeba.”
31Ɔmmɔ ɔsu Israelƒuɔ báda keliekɔ na Amoriƒuɔ kalɔ lɛlɔ. 32Ɔmmɔ kama Mose ɔ́tala bekyuli badi ka batánu Yaser ɔma. Na Israelƒuɔ békpo na báƒɔ kɔlɔ kɔni nkya amadɔ mmɔ. Na bábɔku Amoriƒuɔ bani nlie mmɔ bene. 33Ɔmmɔ kama bénwini na bátásia ulu ɔni úti úsela Basan. Amu na Og ɔni ndi Basanƒuɔ ɔga úti nwuna bekpone ka betékpoku Israelƒuɔ na Edrei.
34Amu na Unwoti ɔ́su Mose ɔnini, “Tayia bekyuli bammɔ, ɔsika líti ɔga ɔmmɔ ku nwuna bekpone ku kalɔ kammɔ ƒui lɛ́kya-a enu kemmo na kalɛ na ábla Sihon ɔni ndi Amoriƒuɔ ɔga ɔni nádi lɛga na Hesbon lɛni kani na ɔlɛka abla Ɔga Og.”
35Ɔmmɔ ɔsu bádu ɔga ɔmmɔ ku nwuna bebi bananabi ku bekpone bammɔ ƒui ɔni na ukyuli unwi muedi utebu. Na béti bana kalɔ kammɔ.

Title: BUMOMO BƆKA 22
Content:
Balak Ɔ́lɔ Bileam Ɔnii Ubasiku-nwu
1Anu na Israelƒuɔ báta bátáda keliekɔ na Moab kalɔ ƒiaa lɛlɔ na Yordan Ketudɔ kesii kani nde Yeriko ɔma. 2Amu ka Sipor ubidi Balak ɔ́nu kalɛ Israelƒuɔ bábla Amoriƒuɔ ni, 3liƒu lɛ́da Moabƒuɔ geen, ɔsika bemomo geen. Na sɔsɔ ni, liƒu lɛ́du Moab ɔ́si Israelƒuɔ ɔsu.
4Amu na Moabƒuɔ básu Midianƒuɔ batɔnkune banii, “Bekyuli lisu lɛmɛni badubo lɛla biala lɛkya bula amadɔ mɛni udu bɔyila aani kalɛ ɔmantɛ akɔ ɔɔkun livo lɛni lɛdia.”
Ɔmɛni ɔsu Sipor ubidi Balak ɔni ndi Moabƒuɔ ɔga na uwi ɔmmɔ kemmo 5ɔ́tala bekyuli badi ka besie Beor ubidi Bileam ɔni nli Petor ɔni nde ketu kani nkya nwuna ɔma mmɔ kudɔ ɔnii batásu-nwu banini, “Bekyuli badi báta bási Egyipte na bébeyi mina kalɔ lɛlɔ na belie bede-mi. 6Anwuɔsu bo na ebewida bekyuli bamɛni. Ɔsika bekyuli bammɔ bebo ɔyikun geen betulo-mi. Na si ewida-ma ni, ndubɔkana bukpo bɔdi-ma lɛlɔ na lɛbɔku-ma lidie kalɔ kammɔ lɛlɔ. Ɔsika ngyi ka bekyuli bani na ásu ka kusɛ kusɛ ɔsiaku-ma ni, ɔdubɔsiaku-ma lɛni kani. Na bani lɛnɔ na éwida ni, ewida adubɔsiaku-ma lɛni kani.”
7Amu na Moabƒuɔ ku Midianƒuɔ batɔnkune báyu ulu na béti egulabi ani baaƒɔ asa na beebó like bada. Na ka beteduo Bileam kudɔ ni, básu-nwu lɛla lɛni Balak ɔ́su-ma.
8Amu na Bileam ɔ́su-ma ɔnini, “Bɛtɛ-mi kudɔ usien ɔmɛni na lɛla lɛni Unwoti ubo ka ɔsu-mii ni, ndubɔsu-mii.” Ɔmɛni ɔsu Moabƒuɔ batɔnkune bamɛni bátɛ mmɔ usien ɔmmɔ.
9Ɔmmɔ kama Katɔti úbo Bileam kudɔ na úye-nwu ɔnini, “Bekyuli bamani nkya-a kudɔ mɛni?”
10Amu na Bileam údie Katɔti kenye ɔnini, “Sipor ubidi Balak ɔni ndi Moabƒuɔ ɔga néti kenye kamɛni úmene-mi ɔnini, 11‘Bekyuli lisu lɛni nási Egyipte bébo bákya mɛni béti kalɔ ƒui. Anwuɔsu bo na ebewida bekyuli bammɔ. Ɔƒɛni kalɛ ɔmmɔ ɔdubɔya na lɛkana-ma bukpoku na lɛbɔku-ma lidie kalɔ kammɔ kemmo.’ ”
12Nsu Katɔti ɔ́su Bileam ɔnini, “Awɔ ku bekyuli bammɔ bitesie kesii kadi. Lɛnɔ ni, tewida Israelƒuɔ bammɔ. Ɔsika badi bekyuli bani na béte kusɛ kusɛ.”
13Ka kadi kégye ni, Bileam ɔ́ta na ɔ́lɔ Moabƒuɔ batɔnkune bammɔ na ɔ́su-ma ɔnini, “Binwini biteesie bina ɔma. Ɔsika Unwoti útete-mi kuƒi ka lɛsiaku-mii.”
14Anwuɔsu Moabƒuɔ bammɔ bénwini bésie Balak kudɔ na básu-nwu banini, “Bileam úni ka ɔsiaku-bu.”
15Ɔmmɔ kama Balak ɔ́sɔ ɔ́tala bekyuli bamba bani na basɔ bemomo na bebo ɔbu betulo bekyuli bedeedi. 16Na bésie Bileam kudɔ na bátásu-nwu banini, “Lɛni na Sipor ubidi Balak ɔɔsu-bu ka bɔ́su-ɔ. Ɔnii taya na lɛla lɛdi litele-ɔ ulu na mina kudɔ bubo. 17Ɔsika ndubo-ɔ lɛyuƒɔla bonwu geen bute, na lɛla biala na ásu-mi ka mbla ni, ndubo-ni bɔbla. Ɔmmɔ ɔsu ta na ebo ebewida bekyuli bamɛni ete-mi.”
18Nsu Bileam údie bekyuli bammɔ kenye ɔnini, “Ina Balak úti sika ugyiedi ku ɔƒualadi úyile nwuna kaduli kani kemmo na ulie ɔɔdi lɛga ute-mi muedi naaakana na lini mina Unwoti Katɔti ɔda ɔni na úbo-mi na ulu biala lɛlɔ.” 19Mmɔ na ɔ́su-ma ɔnini, “Ami lɛnɔ bɛtɛ mɛni aani kalɛ bedeedi bammɔ bátɛ kalɛ. Na lɛwia lɛsiku Unwoti kudɔ lɛla lɛni na wasu-mi na litemi lɛmmɔ lɛlɔ.”
20Na usien ɔmmɔ Katɔti úbo Bileam kudɔ na ɔ́su-nwu ɔnini, “Bekyuli bamɛni bubo bɔni bébo-ɔ kudɔ mɛni bɔɔtina ka bebetiku-ɔ batalɔku. Anwuɔsu ni, nu kalɔ na bisie, nsu si ésie ni, lɛla lɛni kani na lɛ́su-ɔ ka su ni, na asu-ni lɛni kani.”
Bileam Ku Nwuna Ebuo Ala Utine Lɛlɔ Kɔtɛ
21Ka kadi kégye ni, Bileam úti nwuna ebuo ala utine na ɔ́kɔ úlie-nwu kama. Na anwu ku Moab bekyuli bani na ɔ́tala mmɔ bátɔlɔ. 22Nsu ka úsela ni, Unwoti úti kɔnyi ɔ́kya Bileam. Ɔmmɔ ɔsu Unwoti ɔtu ɔdi útáda-nwu únyene ulu lɛlɔ na uléte ebuo ɔmmɔ kuƒi ka ɔvi. Uwi ɔmmɔ kemmo Bileam útiku nwuna kabla bablane inyɔ ɔda na béli ebuo ɔmmɔ kama. 23Ka ebuo ɔmmɔ ɔ́nu Unwoti ɔtu ɔmɛni ka únye ulu ntɛ na ɔ́kpa lɛtula ɔda ni, ebuo ɔmmɔ údeyi ulu ɔmmɔ lɛlɔ na úti anumi ɔ́tina kemo kadi kemmo. Na Bileam uubó ebuo ɔmɛni ka ɔsɔ unwini ubasia ulu lɛlɔ.
24Amu na Unwoti ɔtu ɔmɛni ɔ́sɔ únye ulu blii suɛ ɔdi lɛlɔ na adingyii mmo inyɔ bɔdi ntɛ. Na bátu awodu bákya-mu lɛƒɛnyi inyɔ bɔmmɔ. 25Na ka ebuo ɔmmɔ ɔ́nu Unwoti ɔtu ɔmmɔ ni, úti lɛlɔ útámana lɛwoduku lɛmmɔ na lɛɛmana Bileam ɔgba momoomo. Ɔmmɔ ɔsu Bileam ɔ́sɔ úbi ebuo ɔmmɔ kugyiimi ubu.
26Amu na Unwoti ɔtu ɔmmɔ úsie anumi na úténye kesii kani nse klo klo na kuƒi kɔdi kuuubo na akana lɛlɔ bunwini buse kɔdianu iye kɔmii kakɛ. 27Uwi ɔmɛni kemmo ka ebuo ɔmɛni ɔ́sɔ ɔ́nu Unwoti ɔtu ɔmmɔ ni, ɔ́yu úbi kalɔ, na kalɛ na ebuo ɔmɛni ɔ́bla ɔsu Bileam ɔ́kɛ kɔnyi geen na úti ugyii ɔni na ɔda na úse kalɔ uubi ebuo ɔmɛni kaduɛ. 28Amu na Unwoti úbimi ebuo ɔmɛni kenye na úse kalɔ uutemi taasu Bileam ɔnini, “Bi na lɛ́bla-a ɔsu na eebó-mi kɔtɛ sɔɔn?”
29Amu na Bileam údie ebuo ɔmmɔ kenye ɔnini, “Ɔsika ábu-mi kɔdɔlɔ! Na si kewii na nka nda ni, nka ndubo-ɔ bɔdu ɔƒɛni kani.”
30Amu na ebuo ɔmɛni úye Bileam ɔnii, “Ɔɔɔdi ami ndi ebuo ɔni lɛlɔ na élie ƒula ngba emeyi ƒui? Na lɛ́ɛbla-a lɛmɛni udu dii?” Na Bileam údie kenye ɔnini, “Átabla lɛni kudii.”
31Mmɔ na Unwoti úbimi Bileam anumi na ɔ́ya na ɔ́nu ɔtu ɔmmɔ ka únye mmɔ na kewii kákya-nwu kɔnu. Ka ɔ́nya ɔ́nu lɛni kani na ɔ́yu ɔ́tɛ kalɔ na úti anumi úbi kalɔ.
32Amu na Unwoti ɔtu ɔmmɔ úye Bileam ɔnini, “Bi na ebuo ɔmmɔ ɔ́bla-a ɔsu na ébo-nwu kɔtɛ sɔɔn? Bubo na líbo ḿbenye lítile-nwu ulu. Ɔsika ulu ɔni akɛ ésela mmɔ uuuse-nwu siin. 33Na ka ebuo mmɔ ɔ́nu-mi kɔtɛ sɔɔn ɔsu na údeyi. Na mɔɔsu-ɔ ka si ɔɔɔdi ɔni na ebuo ɔmmɔ ɔkya udeyi ɔsu ni, nka lɛ́ɛdu-ɔ na lɛnyonu ebuo ɔmmɔ.”
34Amu na Bileam údie ɔtu ɔmmɔ kenye ɔnini, “Lɛ́bla likpidi. Ńtati ka awɔ nnye ulu lɛlɔ étile-mi. Nsu muuvele-ɔ ka si ɔɔɔdia ka lɛsɔ nteesie ulu ɔmmɔ ni, na asu-mi na linwini nteesie kaduli.”
35Nsu Unwoti Ɔtu ɔmmɔ ɔ́su-nwu ɔnini, “Awɔ ku bekyuli bammɔ biteesie. Nsu lɛla lɛni kani na lɛ́su-ɔ ni, ani kani na ɔlɛka asu.” Ɔmmɔ ɔsu Bileam ku bekyuli bammɔ bágyu na bátɔlɔ.
36Ɔni na Balak únu ka Bileam ɔkɛ ulu lɛlɔ ɔdubo ni, ɔ́ta na útásiaku-nwu na Moab ɔma ɔni nkya Arnon ɔmii lɛlɔ na nwuna ɔmii lɛlɔ pɛɛ. 37Mmɔ na Balak úye Bileam ɔnini, “Ɔɔɔdi bɔ́tala na lɛ́tala kudeedi nnii, ‘Ta pla na ebo’? Bi ɔsu na átakpete? Munuu bɔkali na aakali anii, naaakana-a lɛyuƒɔla bonwu bute?”
38Amu na Bileam údie kenye ɔnini, “Lɛ́ɛda ḿbalɛ, nsu lɛɛɛdubo-ɔ bɔsu lɛla lɛni ami ɔlati mɔɔyɔ́, mmomu lɛla lɛni na Katɔti weti wakya-mi kenye kani na ndubo-ɔ bɔsu.”
39Amu na Bileam ɔ́siaku Balak na bátɔlɔ bésie Kiriat-Husot. 40Mmɔ na Balak ɔ́du ɔmantɛ bakɔ ku baƒonu na úti ɔ́bla akpala. Na údie kadikɔ úte Bileam ku batalane bammɔ. 41Na kadi kégye ɔtanta ni, Balak útiku Bileam na bákɔ bésie Bamot-Baal Kɔbi lili. Na mmɔ na ɔ́nu Israelƒuɔ badi úmene.

Title: BUMOMO BƆKA 23
Content:
Bileam Kenye Budie Budeedi
1Amu na Bileam ɔ́su Balak ɔnini, “Tu akpabi maatɛ lɛ mɛni na awia ɔmantɛ bakɔ maatɛ ku baƒonu bagyani maatɛ ete-mi.” 2Amu na Balak ɔ́wia ala ammɔ úboku na Balak ku Bileam bádu akɔ ku koƒonu kunwi basia lɛkpabi biala lɛlɔ. 3Amu na Bileam ɔ́su Balak ɔnini, “Sɔ nye ƒula akpala amɛni kudɔ na ami nteesie kesii bamba. Ngyi ka uwi ɔni lisela ni, Unwoti ɔdubɔsiaku-mi ulu lɛlɔ. Na lɛla biala wedie watina-mi ni, ndubɔsu-ɔ.” Mmɔ na Bileam ɔ́tɔlɔ úsie kɔbi kɔdi lɛlɔ.
4Mmɔ na Katɔti útásiaku Bileam na Bileam ɔ́su Katɔti ɔnini, “Lɛ́klibi akpabi maatɛ líse. Na lɛkpabi biala lɛlɔ lɛ́du ɔmantɛ akɔ ku koƒonu lɛ́sia-ni lɛlɔ liti lɛ́bla akpala.”
5Amu na Unwoti úti litemi lɛdi ɔ́kya Bileam kenye kemmo ka unwini usie Balak kudɔ na utásu-nwu ɔnini, 6Ɔmɛni ɔsu únwini úsie Balak kudɔ na ɔmu únye nwuna akpabi kudɔ ku nwuna benengu. 7Mmɔ na Bileam úse kalɔ ɔɔsu nwuna litemi lɛni Unwoti úti ɔkya-nwu kenye. Na úse kalɔ ɔnini,
“Aram na Balak úti-mi ɔ́siku,
Na Moab ɔga úti-mi ɔsiku ɔƒɛ katukɔ abi lɛlɔ.
Na ɔ́su ɔnini, ‘Wida Yakob te-mi
Na aya na Israel kaba kayii.’
8Na dɛ na mewida bekyuli bani na Katɔti útewida?
Na dɛ na mayila bekyuli bani Unwoti utayila udu?
9Na nnye atakpɛ ani nákuku lɛlɔ mɔɔnu-ma,
na mɔɔnu-ma taasiku abi lɛlɔ.
Na badi kadi bekyuli bani na ama lɛti nli.
Na balánu lɛlɔ aani kalɛ kadi bamba bekyuli bese.
10Na ɔma ndubɔkana Yakobƒuɔ bɔka?
Ɔsika bemomo aani kɔnwinimi.
Bemomo kaduɛ ɔni na ukyuli ɔdi.
Ɔɔɔdubo-ma bɔkana bɔka.
Ya na likpi bekyuli bani nse siin kukpi.
Na ɔwɔlɔku-mi aani kalɛ na ɔɔwɔlɔ ku bekyuli bammɔ udu.”
11Amu na Balak úye Bileam ɔnini, “Bi ɔsu na ábla-mi lɛni? Buti na líti-ɔ líboku mɛni ka ebewida mina bekisine ete-mi, nsu átabla lɛni! Mmomu kusɛ kusɛ na ébo ébete-ma.”
12Amu na Bileam údie Balak kenye ɔnini, “Lɛla lɛni na Unwoti úti ɔ́kya-mi kenye kemmo ni, ani kani na ɔlɛka lɛsu?”
Bileam Kenye Kanyɔdi Kani Ɔsɔ Údie
13Amu na Balak ɔ́sɔ ɔ́su Bileam ɔnini, “Siaku-mi na bɔsɔ busie kesii bamba na mmɔ amu ni, alanu Israelƒuɔ ƒui mmomu badi kani. Na ewida-ma asiku mmɔ.”
14Anwuɔsu Balak útiku Bileam úsienku Soƒin ketele kalɔ kakwiidi kemmo na Pisga Kɔbi lili. Na mmɔ na Balak ɔ́tu akpabi maatɛ na ɔ́du akɔ unwi ku koƒonu kunwi ɔ́sia lɛkpabi biala lɛlɔ. 15Amu na Bileam ɔ́su Balak ɔnini, “Sɔ kya ƒula akpabi amɛni kudɔ na ami nteesie ntásiaku Unwoti na mmɔ.”
16Amu na Unwoti úbasiaku Bileam na úti litemi ɔ́kya-nwu kenye kemmo ka ni, “Nwini teesie Balak kudɔ na atasu-nwu kenye kammɔ.”
17Anwuɔsu Bileam únwini úsie na útánu ka Balak unye nwuna lɛkpabi kudɔ ku nwuna Moab benengu. Na Balak úye Bileam ɔnini, “Bi na Unwoti ɔ́su-ɔ ka asu?”
18Mmɔ na Bileam use kalɔ ɔ́ɔsu nwuna kenye ɔnini,
“Balak, ta na enu,
na awɔ Sipor ubi se atu na enu!
19Katɔti ɔɔɔdi ɔyawine na ɔnyi ɔkɔ, iye ɔyawine ubi
ɔni na si ɔ́su lɛla lɛdi ulabla ulasia-ni lɛlɔ.
Munuu si use kenye kadi uláya na webo-nwu kemmo?
20Ɔda ɔni na úbo-mi ndi ka lite-ma kusɛ kusɛ.
Na kusɛ kusɛ na líte-ma,
na naaakana kusɛ kusɛ ɔmmɔ kama bɔlɛ.
21“Ɔsika ńtanu ɔgbankpi ɔdi na Yakob kaba lɛlɔ,
na ńtanu lɛƒɛda lɛdi na Israelƒuɔ lɛlɔ.
Bana Unwoti Katɔti ɔ́kya-ma akɔ.
Na beedie kudu taasu banii
anwu ndi bana ɔga.
22Katɔti náda-ma údie Egyipte
na bebo ɔyikun ɔni nse aani ɔmantɛ akɔ unengudi geen.
23Na like ubone udu biala ɔdi uuubo
na beti-nwu na ɔsu ukpidi na Israelƒuɔ lɛlɔ.
Ɔƒɛni lɛni na bekyuli badubɔsu na Israelƒuɔ lɛlɔ,
‘Bɛnu lɛla lɛni Katɔti ɔ́bla!’
24Na Israel kaba kese aani gyata
ɔni mbo ɔyikun geen,
na ulánwuna wetédu ka ɔdu lɛla lɛdi,
na ɔduli lɛla biala,
utédu ka ɔni bana ubugya.”
25Amu na Balak ɔ́su Bileam ɔnini, “Si use lɛni ni, na tewida-ma iye tete-ma kusɛ kusɛ kulaa!”
26Amu na Bileam údie kenye ɔnini, “Ńtasu-ɔ ka lɛla biala na Unwoti ɔ́su-mi ni, ndubɔdi-ni lɛlɔ?”
Bileam Kenye Katɛdi Kani Ɔ́sɔ Údie
27Amu na Balak ɔ́su Bileam ɔnini, “Bo na bɔsɔ busie kesii bamba. Ɔƒɛni kakɛ ɔdubɔda Katɔti kubiti na ɔya na ewida Israelƒuɔ bamɛni ete-mi na kesii kani búsela mmɔ.” 28Amu na Balak útiku Bileam na bésie Peor Kɔbi lili. Na si enye mmɔ na aanu ketele kalɔ kakwiidi kani kewi mmɔ ƒui.
29Amu na Bileam ɔ́su Balak ɔnini, “Tu akpabi maatɛ na mɛni na awia ɔmantɛ bakɔ maatɛ ku baƒonu bagyani maatɛ ese ete-mi.” 30Na Balak ɔ́bla kalɛ na Bileam ɔ́su. Na ɔ́du akɔ unwi ku koƒonu kɔgyani kunwi ɔ́sia lɛkpabi biala lɛlɔ.

Title: BUMOMO BƆKA 24
Content:
1Ɔƒɛni ka Bileam ɔ́nu ɔ́ti ka ɔ́da Unwoti kubiti ka úte Israelƒuɔ kusɛ kusɛ ni, ɔsɔ útebo like lɛdi aani kalɛ na ɔɔyɔ́ bɔbla, anwuɔsu únwini anumi ɔ́tina kalɔ kakwiidi kammɔ. 2Ka Bileam únwini na ɔ́nu ka Israelƒuɔ básala lɛlɔ bélie kaba kaba kenye ni, Unwoti kɔyu kúbaƒɔ-nwu lɛlɔ kemmo, 3na údie Unwoti kenye kamɛni.
“Kenye kamɛni na Beor ubidi Bileam ubo na udie.
Etemila ani na ukyuli ɔni mɔɔnu kaduɛ,
4ubo na udie aani ukyuli ɔni muunú lɛla
lɛni na Katɔti ɔɔsu ubo na udie,
ukyuli ɔni mɔɔnú budie bɔtina taasiku Ɔyikune Ƒui kudɔ,
ukyuli ɔni náyu ɔtɛ na nwuna anumi ebi kalɔ,
nsu ɔɔnu nwaa.
5“Yakob kadi bekyuli! Bɛnu kalɛ na bina nvo bɔɔdia bɔnu.
Na bɛnu kalɛ na amii Israelƒuɔ kakyakɔ lɛnɔ kese.
6“Kese aani kalɛ na bégyingya kɔwɛ béwi.
Na use aani kemo kani bátuma na ketudɔ.
Na use aani Unwoti nálɛ egyii ebendi adi.
Na use aani sida egyii nlɛ ketudɔ.
7Bana kutubui kɔdubo buyi buteewiakun.
Na bana egyiibi adubɔkɛ ntu kaduɛ.
“Na bana ɔga ɔdubɔƒɔ kuye utulo Agag.
Na bana lɛgadi lɛdubɔkɔ katɔ.
8Unwoti náda-ma údie Egyipte kalɔ lɛlɔ.
Na bebo ɔyikun aani ɔmantɛ akɔ unengudi geen
na baduli bana bekisine.
Na báƒɛ bana ekubi kɔkɛ kɔkɛ.
Na beti bana kɔtaminta baƒuaala-ma.
9Na kadi bekyuli bammɔ bese aani gyata ɔyikune ɔdi.
Na si ɔtɛ ɔlɛɛ ni, lɛla biala lɛɛyia-nwu bɔgyila.
“Ukyuli biala mete Israel kusɛ kusɛ ni,
kusɛ kusɛ ɔdubɔsiaku-nwu.
Na ukyuli biala mewida Israel ni,
ewida adubɔsiaku-nwu.”
10Mmɔ na Balak úti kɔnyi kati kati ɔ́kya Bileam. Na ɔ́gya anukpɛ na ɔ́su-nwu ɔnini, “Bɔlɔ na lɛ́lɔ-ɔ ka bo na ebewida mina bekisine. Mmomu kusɛ kusɛ na éte-ma kɔtɛ kɔmɛni sɛɛn. 11Ɔƒɛni gyu lɛgba na atɔlɔ eteesie ƒula ɔma! Líse kenye ka nka mete-ɔ lɛyuƒɔla nsu Unwoti únye útile-ɔ ka akɛ lɛyuƒɔla lɛmmɔ!”
12Amu na Bileam údie-nwu kenye ɔnini, “Lɛ́su bekyuli bani na átala akya-mi mmɔ ka, 13‘Ina Balak úti sika ugyiedi ku ɔƒualadi úyile nwuna kaduli kani kemmo na ulie ɔɔdi lɛga ute-mi muedi, naaakana na lini mina Unwoti Katɔti ɔda ɔni na úbo-mi na ulu biala lɛlɔ, na lɛbla lɛla lɛni ami ɔlati mɔɔyɔ́. Na mɔɔsu-ɔ ka lɛla lɛni kani na Unwoti ɔ́su-mi ka lɛsu-ɔ ni, ani kani ndubɔsu-ɔ.’ ”
Bileam Kenye Kenedi Kani Ɔsɔ Údie
14Amu na Bileam ɔ́su Balak ɔnini, “Ɔƒɛni lisela mina bekyuli kudɔ. Nsu asa na matɔlɔ ni, muubó-ɔ ɔda ɔmɛni na lɛsu-ɔ lɛla lɛni Israelƒuɔ badubo ƒula bekyuli bɔbla limeyi lɛdi.” 15Mmɔ na Bileam úse kalɔ uudie Unwoti kenye kamɛni ɔnini,
“Kenye kani na Boer ubidi Bileam udie.
Etemila ani na ukyuli ɔni mɔɔnu kaduɛ ubo na udie.
16Etemila ani na ukyuli ɔni muunú lɛla
lɛni na Katɔti ɔɔsu ubo na udie,
ukyuli ɔni úbo lɛlati ɔsiku Katɔti kudɔ,
ukyuli ɔni mɔɔnu budie bɔtina
taasiku Ɔyikune Ƒui kudɔ,
ukyuli ɔni náyu ɔ́tɛ na nwuna anumi
ebi kalɔ nsu ɔɔnu nwaa.
17“Mɔɔnu-nwu nsu ɔɔɔdi ɔƒɛni
mɔɔnu taati nsu uuude.
Kayabi kadi kadubo bɔbwɛ bɔlɛ Yakob kaba kemmo.
Ɔgagyii ɔdi ɔdubɔlɛ Israelƒuɔ akɔ,
na ubo Moabƒuɔ batɔnkune ƒui uwi kalɔ,
na ɔƒɛ Set bekyuli ƒui uwi kalɔ.
18Na ɔdubɔdi nwuna bekisine bani nkya Edom lɛlɔ.
Na ɔdubɔdi Seirƒuɔ bani muukpóku-nwu lɛlɔ.
Nsu Israelƒuɔ ama ni, bana ɔyikun katɔ kani ɔdubɔkɔ.
19Lɛlɔ ɔdine ɔdubɔlɛ bɔsiku Yakob kaba kemmo,
na ɔyila bekyuli bani nébu ɔma unengudi udu.”
Bileam Kenye Kekplodi Kani Údie
20Amu Na Bileam ɔ́nu Amelekƒuɔ na údie kenye kamɛni ɔnini,
“Amalekƒuɔ ndi bekyuli bedeedi na kadi akɔ.
Nsu badubo bɔyii udu na kawɔlɔkɔ.”
21Amu na ɔ́nu Keniƒuɔ na údie kenye kamɛni ɔnini,
“Bɛgyumana bina keliekɔ kaduɛ
na bɛtu bina ayu bɛkya atakpɛ kemmo.
22Nsu badubo-mii udu bɔyila
si uwi ɔni Asiriaƒuɔ bébeƒie-mii ɔni na bɛɛɛgyi biiise.”
23Amu na údie kenye kamɛni ɔnini,
“Aa! Ɔma ndubɔkana bunye bɔnu
uwi ɔni Katɔti ɔɔbla ɔmɛni?
24Lɛkɔlɔ libendi lɛdubɔsia Kittim Ɛpu kɔtu
na badi Asiriaƒuɔ ku Eberƒuɔ lɛlɔ.
Nsu ama lɛnɔ badubɔyila-ma udu.”
25Ka Bileam ɔ́wɔlɔ ni, ɔ́ta na ɔ́tɔlɔ úsie nwuna ɔma, na Balak lɛnɔ ɔ́wia nwuna ulu ɔ́sia.

Title: BUMOMO BƆKA 25
Content:
Israelƒuɔ Lɛsɔnɔdi Ku Bana Lɛƒiɔkpa
1Uwi ɔni na Israelƒuɔ bákya Sitim ni, na ama ku Moab belekubi bése kalɔ baatɛ. 2Na ɔkɛnku ɔmmɔ ɔsu beleku bamɛni baakpanku banana bammɔ teesienku bana lɛƒiɔkpa emeyi bɔdi kalɔ. Na Israelƒuɔ baadi adila ani béti bákpa béte baƒiɔ na baalɛ-ma akɔnkɔ kalɔ. 3Anwuɔsu Israelƒuɔ béti lɛlɔ bébunku Moabƒuɔ na baakpá baƒiɔ bani baalɔ banii Baal-Peor. Ɔmmɔ ɔ́ya na Unwoti úti kɔnyi kati kati ɔ́kya-ma.
4Amu na Unwoti ɔ́su Mose ɔnini, “Kpanku Israelƒuɔ batɔnkune bammɔ ƒui lɛku na adu-ma ɔƒiiwi ketee na bekyuli bammɔ anumi na ukyuli biala ɔnu kalɛ na Unwoti kɔnyi kati kati kɔni na úti mmɔ kenye kayɔ na Israelƒuɔ lɛlɔ.”
5Anwuɔsu Mose ɔ́su Israelƒuɔ litemi batɛne ɔnini, “Bina akɔ ukyuli biala ɔdu nwuna lɛlɔ bekyuli bani ndi banana bani néti lɛlɔ bákya Baal-Peor lɛƒiɔkpa kemmo.”
6Amu na Israelni ɔnana ɔdi ɔ́kpanku Midiani ulekubi ɔdi úboku nwuna kaduli na Mose ku Israelƒuɔ ƒui anumi uwi ɔni na básala lisu na Unwoti Adi Kevo anumi beewulo. 7Na ka Pinehas ɔni ɔti ndi Eleasar ɔni ɔti ndi Aaron ɔ́nu lɛla lɛni na ɔnana ɔmmɔ ɔ́bla ni, ɔ́ta mmɔ na útéti lɛtula 8na utéduo Israelni ɔmmɔ kevo kemmo na ɔ́tu Israelni ɔmmɔ na ɔ́ƒuala-nwu útalɛku uleku ɔmmɔ lɛnɔ. Na mmɔ kani na Israelƒuɔ ɔlɛ ɔmmɔ kenye kékulo. 9Nsu bani békpi na ɔlɛ ɔmmɔ kemmo bábla aani nkyuli mpim aavlanyɔ-ine (24,000).
10Amu na Unwoti ɔ́su Mose ɔnini, 11“Ɔsi lɛla lɛni na Pinehas ɔ́bla mɛni ɔsu mina kɔnyi kenye káyɔ na Israelƒuɔ bamɛni lɛlɔ. Ɔsika údie ɔ́tina ka utalɛka ukyuli ɔdi ɔkpa bamba utulo ami Unwoti. Na ɔmɛni ɔsu lɛ́sɔ ńteti kɔnyi na lɛyila-ma udu. 12Anwuɔsu su Pinehas ka ni, keyi buɛɛ bunyimi bɔdubɔkya ami ku-nwu ntɛ. 13Na nwuna bekyuli ndubo bakpane kabla bɔbla usela uwi ƒui. Ɔsika úkpo kɔgyulo úte-mi na ɔkɛnku ɔmmɔ ɔsu ɔ́ya na líti likpidi lɛni bekyuli bammɔ babla lɛkyiɛ-ma.”
14Na Israelni ɔni bádu ku Midiani uleku ɔmmɔ lɛnyi ndi Simri ɔni ndi Salu ubidi na ɔdi Simeon kaba ɔtɔnkune. 15Na Midiani ulekubi ɔni bádu mmɔ lɛnyi ndi Kosbi, Sur ɔni ndi Midianƒuɔ kaba kadi unengu ubidi.
16Amu na Unwoti ɔ́su Mose ɔnini, 17“Ti Midianƒuɔ bammɔ bla ƒula bekisine na adu-ma, 18ɔsika bábla-mii likyulikpi ala aani bekisine na bátɔlɔ-mii na bítákpa baƒiɔ na Peor ku Midiani ɔtɔnkune ubidi ulekubi ɔni baalɔ Kosbi na bádu-mmɔ kalɛ na ɔ́blaku-mii unwi ɔsu.”

Title: BUMOMO BƆKA 26
Content:
Báka Israelƒuɔ Kunyɔdi
1Na ɔlɛ ɔmmɔ kama ni, Unwoti ɔ́su Mose ku ɔkpane Aaron ubidi Eleasar ɔnini, 2“Bɛka Israelƒuɔ bammɔ bani nákɛ akwa aavlanyɔ ku kama na bédu kekpo busie. Na bɛka-ma na kɔduli kenye.” 3Anwuɔsu uwi ɔni na bakya Moab kalɔ ƒiaa lɛlɔ na Yordan Ketu kɔtu ni, Mose ku ɔkpane Eleasar bétemi béte bekyuli bammɔ banini, 4“Bɛka banana bani nákɛ akwa aavlanyɔ ku kama bɛnu aani kalɛ Unwoti úbo Mose ɔda.”
Bekyuli bani nálɛ bási Egyipte kalɔ lɛlɔ ndi bamɛni.
5Ruben ɔni ndi Israel ubi udeedi kaba bekyuli ndi bamɛni.
Hanok ɔdanku Hanokƒuɔ.
Palu ɔdanku Paluƒuɔ.
6Hesron ɔdanku Hesronƒuɔ.
Karmi ɔdanku Karmiƒuɔ.
7Na bammɔ ndi Ruben kaba bekyuli. Na bana bumomo bɔdi mpim aavlene-ɛtɛ eti leevu-ene (43,730).
8Na Palu ubidi ndi Eliab. 9Na Eliab bebi ndi Nemuel ku Datan ku Abiram. Na Datan ku Abiram bamɛni ndi bekyuli bani nátaadɔnku Mose ku Aaron. Na bebunku Kora lɛkpa bekyuli bani náta benye Unwoti lɛlɔ. 10Na ama ndi bekyuli bani kalɔ kébimi kenye na kébweli-ma mmɔ ku Kora kama basiakune nkyuli eti alɔ (250) bani na ogya ɔ́kyula-ma mmɔ. Na bénwini likposela béte Israelƒuɔ ka bati lɛlɔ kalɛ. 11Nsu Kora bebi ama bátasa bukpi ƒui.
12Na Simeon kaba bekyuli na bana adua ammɔ kenye ndi bamɛni.
Nemuel ɔdanku Nemuelƒuɔ.
Yamin ɔdanku Yaminƒuɔ.
Yakin ɔdanku Yakinƒuɔ.
13Sera ɔdanku Seraƒuɔ.
Saul ɔdanku Saulƒuɔ.
14Na bammɔ ndi Simeon kaba bekyuli. Na bana banana bumomo bɔdi mpim aavlanyɔ-inyɔ ku eti ene (22,200).
15Na Gad kaba bekyuli na bana adua ammɔ kenye ndi bamɛni.
Seƒon ɔdanku Seƒonƒuɔ.
Hagi ɔdanku Hagiƒuɔ.
Suni ɔdanku Suniƒuɔ.
16Osni ɔdanku Osniƒuɔ.
Eri ɔdanku Eriƒuɔ.
17Arod ɔdanku Arodƒuɔ.
Areli ɔdanku Areliƒuɔ.
18Na bammɔ ndi Gad kaba bekyuli. Na bana bumomo bɔdi mpim aavlene ku eti leevu (40,500).
19Er ku Onan, badi Yuda bebi nsu ama békpi na Kanaan kalɔ lɛlɔ.
20Na Yuda kaba bekyuli na bana adua ammɔ kenye ndi bamɛni.
Sela ɔdanku Selaƒuɔ.
Peres ɔdanku Peresƒuɔ.
Sera ɔdanku Seraƒuɔ.
21Na Peres kɔdua bekyuli badanku bamɛni.
Hesron ɔdanku Hesronƒuɔ.
Hamul ɔdanku Hamulƒuɔ.
22Bammɔ ndi Yuda kaba bekyuli. Na bana bumomo bɔdi mpim liti ku aavlanyɔ-ɛku ku eti leevu (76,500).
23Na Isakar kaba bekyuli na bana adua ammɔ kenye ndi bamɛni.
Tola ɔdanku Tolaƒuɔ.
Puwa ɔdanku Puwaƒuɔ.
24Yasub ɔdanku Yasubƒuɔ.
Simron ɔdanku Simronƒuɔ.
25Na bammɔ ndi Isakar kaba. Na bana bumomo bɔdi mpim liti ku leevu-ine ku eti aku (64,300).
26Na Sebulon kaba bekyuli na bana adua ammɔ kenye ndi bamɛni.
Sered ɔdanku Seredƒuɔ.
Elon ɔdanku Elonƒuɔ.
Yakleel ɔdanku Yakleelƒuɔ.
27Na bammɔ ndi Sebulon kaba bekyuli. Na bana banana bumomo bɔdi mpim liti ku leevu ku eti leevu (60,500).
28Na Yoseƒ kaba kani nkɛnku Manase ku Eƒraim lɛlɔ.
29Manase kaba bekyuli ndi bɔmɛni.
Makir ɔdanku Makirƒuɔ, na Makir ɔ́wɔ Gilead.
Gilead ɔdanku Gileadƒuɔ.
30Gilead kaba bekyuli na bana adua ammɔ kenye ndi bamɛni.
Yeser ɔdanku Yeserƒuɔ.
Helek ɔdanku Helekƒuɔ.
31Asriel ɔdanku Asrielƒuɔ.
Sekem ɔdanku Sekemƒuɔ.
32Heƒer ɔdanku Heƒerƒuɔ.
33Heƒer ubidi Seloƒehad uuubo bebi bananabi. Bebi belekubi kani na ɔ́wɔ na bana anyi ndi Mahla ku Noa ku Hogla ku Milka ku Tirsa.
34Na bammɔ ndi Manase kaba bekyuli. Na bana banana bumomo bɔdi mpim liti ku inyɔ eti leevu-ene (52,700).
35Na Eƒraim kaba bekyuli na bana adua ammɔ kenye ndi bamɛni.
Sutela ɔdanku Sutelaƒuɔ.
Beker ɔdanku Bekerƒuɔ.
Tahan ɔdanku Tahanƒuɔ.
36Sutela bebi ndi bɔmɛni.
Eran ɔdanku Eranƒuɔ.
37Na bammɔ ndi Eƒraim bebi kaba. Na bana banana bumomo bɔdi mpim avlaatɛ-inyɔ ku eti leevu (32,500).
