Na bekyuli badubɔsɔ balɔ Yerusalem banii
Ɔma unengudi ɔni kemmo baatɛ litemi geen
ku Ɔma unengudi ɔni bekyuli mɔɔdi etemila lɛlɔ.’ ”
27Ka Unwoti Katɔti ɔɔtɛ litemi
ulu lɛlɔ na use siin ɔsu ni,
alaekpidi bablane
bani nkya Sion na bana ekpidi
éduo-ma na bénwini kayi,
badubɔkɛ bɔƒɔ.
28Na bani na ekpidi kani na beli baabla ni,
ɔdubo-ma udu bɔyila ƒui,
ɔsika béni na banii
belebo Unwoti kudɔ.
29“Kɔƒa ndubo-mii bukpo geen si bɛ́kali bɛ́nu
uwi ɔni na bítaakpa ala
teete baƒiɔ
na egyii enengudi ani bɛ́da bínyene sɛsɛɛ
na bina akunkpo ammɔ kemmo.
Na bilákɛ anumi kesekɔ
si bínyimo
alaekpidi lidu lɛni na bɛ́bla
na bina nvoma mmo
bɔni na bɛ́da bíse bíte
lɛƒiɔkpa mmɔ kemmo.
30Na bɛdubo bɔyuɛ
na biwiile evete
aani kemo kani egyii
nátakɛ ntu.
31Na bina bayikune ƒui badubɔyii aani kalɛ na
keti kaakywí na ɔdi ulakana bunine.”

Title: YESAIA 2
Content:
Unwoti Kɔbi Lɛlɔ Kɔtɛ
1Ala ani ndubo mɛni na Amos ubidi Yesaia ɔ́nu ɔkɛnku Yuda ku Yerusalem lɛlɔ.
2Na uwi ukplodi kemmo ni,
kɔbi kɔni lɛlɔ na Katɔti kakpakɔ kenye
ndubɔbla kɔbi kɔni náƒɔ kuye kutulo abi ƒui akɔ.
Kɔdubɔkuku kɔvia abi ƒui eli, na kadi bekyuli ƒui
badubukeli besie mmɔ.
3Bekyuli badubɔsi kɔlɔ pii lɛlɔ bebo na babasu banini,
“Bɛya na bɔkɔ busie Unwoti Katɔti kɔbi lili
na Yakob Katɔti kakpakɔ, na ɔtina-bu
nwuna lilu na bɔsia-ni lɛlɔ.”
Ɔsika Sion mmɔ na badubɔtina-bu ala,
na bunu Unwoti litemi bɔsiku Yerusalem.
4Na Unwoti ɔdubɔtɛ litemi na ɔklibi kadi ku kadi
unyeƒi ɔni nkya-ma ntɛ.
Na bana kuwii ƒui ni, ama alati badubuti-ku bakywɛ
anwami bonwu ani
muunwíni kalɔ.
Na beti bana atula bakywɛ asaaka.
Na kadi ku kadi basɔ balata kekpo,
na basɔ balatumini bekyuli belete kekpo lɛnɔ.
5Israel kadi bekyuli, bibo
na bɔsia Unwoti bukeye kemmo.
Katɔti Ɔ́su Bekyuli Úse Ka Ɔdubɔtɛku-ma Litemi
6Unwoti úni Israel kadi bekyuli,
ɔsika bábla unwi ku ɔƒɛ katukɔ kadi bamba bekyuli
bani na evo ala bɔbla bɔ́ƒɔ-ma lɛlɔ kemmo,
na beebó like aani
Ƒilistiƒuɔ kalɛ.
Na baakya kadi bamba bekyuli lɛnɔ kɔgbu.
7Na Israelƒuɔ bebo akɛla lidu lidu aani sika ɔƒualadi
ku ugyiedi ku bapɔnkɔ ku bana kɛɛkɛ pii.
8Baƒiɔ béyi kalɔ kammɔ lɛlɔ.
Na bekyuli bammɔ baakya eli kalɔ taakpa ala
ani na béti bana enu bábla béte lɛlɔ.
9Ɔmmɔ ɔsu Unwoti ɔdububoku bekyuli ƒui kalɔ.
Na ukyuli biala ɔyila nwuna kenyekɔ.
Teti takyiɛ-ma!
10Bikeli bitéduo atakpɛ libu.
Na bɛbɛla bina lɛlɔ bɛsiku Unwoti ɔni mɔɔda liƒu,
na nwuna lɛgadi liikeye kudɔ.
11Limeyi lɛmmɔ ni, bekyuli bekpidi
bani mɔɔnu bekyuli ɔnusɛ bɔdubɔkya lili kalɔ,
na lɛlɔ katɔ bɔkɔliku biala bɔdububo kalɔ.
12Unwoti ubo nwuna limeyi na lɛsia ulu lɛdubo lite
bani mɔɔkun lɛmɛnɛ na baanu lɛlɔ katɔ katɔ.
Na ɔdububoku lɛlɔ katɔ bɔkɔli biala kalɔ limeyi lɛmmɔ.
13Na Lebanon egyii kpakplaa enengudi ammɔ ƒui
ɔdubukulo-nya uwi kalɔ ku Basan adi kpakplaa ammɔ.
14Na ɔdubɔbwɛ abi ku abinkpo ƒui uwi kalɔ.
15Na bagyumane kɔgyumanakɔ kpakplaa biala ni,
ɔdubɔƒɛ-ku ku awodu ƒui
uwi kalɔ.
16Na ɔbwɛ beyedine lɛkɔlɔ libendi ƒui ku lɛkɔlɔ libliidi
lɛni nnye lɛkɔlɔ kalɛlɛkɔ.
17Na bekyuli atuɔkplu ku lɛlɔ katɔ bɔkɔliku ƒui
ɔdububoku-mu kalɔ.
Na Unwoti lɛnyi kani ndubɔkɔ katɔ limeyi lɛmmɔ.
18Na Unwoti ɔdubɔyila baƒiɔ
biala udu.
19Na uwi ɔni na Katɔti ɔdubɔta unye ɔnii ɔɔkunku
kalɔ kammɔ ni, nwuna bekisine badubɔkpɛ
na bekeli beduo ubu.
Na babɛ na libu kemmo na atakpɛ akɔ,
na Unwoti bɔyia ku kalɛ na uukeye ɔsu.
20Na limeyi lɛmmɔ ni, sika ɔƒualadi ku ugyiedi baƒiɔ
bani na bávɔ bése lɛlɔ
baakpá ni,
badububo-nwu bewi baƒiamu ku bagyina.
21Badubo bukeli butéduo atabi libu bonwu kemmo,
na batábɛ atabi yayaaya ammɔ kɔka,
na bekeli Unwoti kɔnyi limeyi lɛmmɔ ku nwuna lɛgadi
lɛni muukeye na limeyi lɛni na ɔdubɔta unye
ɔnii ɔɔkunku kayawi.
22Bɛsɔ bitasia ukyuli ɔyawine anu ka ɔƒɛƒɛɛ
kani na nkya-nwu enwu.
Bi kɔsia na ɔdubɔlɛ ute-mii?

Title: YESAIA 3
Content:
Unwoti Ɔdubɔtɛku Yuda Ku Yerusalem Litemi
1Unwoti ɔni ndi Unwoti
Ɔyikune Ƒui
ɔdubutile kebunku biala kuƒi,
na ɔdubɔya na adila ku ntu
bɔsɔ bulédu Yerusalem ku Yuda bekyuli,
2kadi bayikune ku bekpone, litemi batɛne
ku kenye bediene, ku bani muubó like
ku benengu ƒui,
3ku bekpone esu batɔnkune ku bekyuli babune
ku kasusu bakyane ku enu kabla lidu bablane
ku bani mɔɔkanti taakya ala.
4Na bakloƒu na ɔdubɔya na bataanu-ma lɛlɔ,
na ɔya na banamu keeke bataadi-ma lɛlɔ.
5Na bekyuli badubo lɛlɔ butaanya taakya,
na banwani ku bakpana beteekpoku lɛlɔ.
Bakɔdi badubɔta benye benengu lɛlɔ,
na bani na nka balábu-ma kadi akɔ
badubɔta benye bekyuli babune lɛlɔ.
6Na uwi ɔmmɔ ni, ɔnwa ɔdubɔta na ɔsu ɔnwani
na ɔti kaduli ɔnini,
“Ka awɔ ebo ala adadi ɔsu ni,
awɔ nwini bula ɔtɔnkune
na anu kalɛ na aklibi ala ani nébie mɛni!”
7Nsu ɔdubudie kenye ɔnini,
“Oowo! Lɛɛɛdubo bɔkana kebunku kadi bute,
ɔsika liiibo adila iye adala adi na mina kaduli,
anwuɔsu tabla-mi ɔtɔnkune tete bekyuli bammɔ.”
8Yerusalem ku Yuda lɛma ƒui lɛdubo bubie
na ala ƒui eƒu akya, ɔsika bana etemila áta énye Unwoti lɛlɔ,
na béni ka babu anwu ɔni muukeye na bana akɔ.
9Na bana anumi lɛlɔ muedi adubɔnu bana bɔƒiɔ ati.
Na anumi ku anumi na baabla ekpidi ammɔ,
aani Sodom kadi bekyuli kalɛ na balábɛla-nya muedi.
Bɔbuɛ ute-ma!
Ama alati néti bana ɔgbankpi kɔtu bɔni béboku lɛlɔ.
10Su bekyuli bani nse siin anii, ɔdubɔtɛ ute-ma
ɔsika badubɔdi bana kabla ebi.
11Bɔbuɛ ute likyulikpi ala bablane!
Ɔgbankpi ɔ́ɔda ɔ́lɛ-ma lɛlɔ!
Bana enu kabla lɛyuƒɔla badubo bɔƒɔ.
12Bekyuli bani ablala nse aani banamu
mɔɔnya mina bekyuli taakya,
na beleku baadi-ma lɛlɔ.
O mina kadi bekyuli, bina batɔnkune
bákpanku-mii bésela batáyila.
Bákpanku-mii bálɛku ulu geen ɔmmɔ lɛlɔ.
13Katɔti úusie ulie kalɔ na litemi katɛkɔ,
na ɔdubo bekyuli ƒui litemi bɔtɛku.
14Ɔdubɔtɛku nwuna kadi benengu
ku batɔnkune litemi ɔnini,
“Amii nébile Yerusalem ɔni nse
aani mina adingyii ebi kemo.
Na bíyile bina kɔduli ku ala ani na
bíƒie bɛ́ƒɔ bawabane kudɔ.”
15Unwoti Ɔyikune Ƒui ɔnini,
“Ulu ɔmani udu na bɛ́kɛ,
na bɛɛkɔ́ mina bekyuli bawabane kpɛtɛ kpɛtɛ
lɛni binwini ɔtumu?”
Katɔti Ɔ́lɛ Yerusalem Beleku Kpakplaa
16Unwoti ɔnini,
“Yerusalem beleku balábu.
Bákpa bana amɔ bakɛ beesé anumi teete banana,
na bana enwu eti kayaa, na ala ani nda-ma akɔnkɔ
ku anikpo aabla kɔku na beebó lɛlɔ kudu.
Katɔti ɔdubɔni-ma kɔtu.
17Unwoti ɔdubɔya na bana eli alɛ alɛlɛbi
na bana eli apa na linwini lɛsɔ lilákwɛ.”
18Limeyi lɛmmɔ ni, Unwoti ɔdubɔda bana ala abuni ani na beeti taaklibi lɛlɔ udie-ma lɛlɔ. Ala ammɔ adi ndi asɛɛ ani na baakya amɔ ku ani mɔɔƒa bana lɛduuku lɛlɔ ku duuku ɔmmɔ alati 19ku asɛɛ ani baakya atu ku usɔ ku aduni ani baabala amɔ. 20Na ɔdubudie bana dukuu ku asɛɛ ebi ani nda-ma anikpo, ku kedi kani baabala agblinti, ku ligyulo ku ala ani na beeti teeƒie bakyuli kayi. 21Na ɔdubudie bana asikpɛɛ ku sika ugyiedi ala, 22ku limeyi kadikɔ adala ku lɛwu gyɔlɔɔ ku bana sika ugyiedi ala ani náƒɔ kuye ku egulabi kɔvumi wɛlɛ wɛlɛ kɔmmɔ ƒui 23ku bana kɔnu kɔni baanu lɛlɔ ku lɛwu kpɛtɛ kpɛtɛ gyɔlɔɔ ku ala ani beeti taakya bana eli bɔdia ku aduni ani beebi eli ku amangba mmɔ ƒui ɔdubo-nya budie.
24Na bana ugyulo ɔnyi ƒɛƒɛɛ ɔmmɔ ɔdububie.
Na bana agblinti aduni buni enwini lɛbuli lɛbuli.
Na bana eli linwini lɛni báklibi ƒui lɛdubɔyii udu.
Na benyimi adikpi na lɛwu buni gyɔlɔɔ lɛmmɔ kenye.
Na bayila bana bɔdia ƒui, na beti kɔƒa kani bataavi.
25Bana banana badubukpi kekpokɔ na kuwii kenye,
na bekpone batɛ kekpo.
26Na Yerusalem lɛban kenye ƒui lɛdubuse aani bekyuli
bani néduo kɔnyana, na beewulo bani nékpi.
Na ɔma umodi ɔmmɔ ɔdubɔbla aani uleku
ɔni náyu uwi kalɔkplu na ɔsɔ uuubo lɛla lɛla.

Title: YESAIA 4
Content:
1Na emeyi ammɔ kemmo ni,
beleku maatɛ ndubo ɔnana unwi bɔnwanɛ,
na basu-nwu banini, “Ya na bulieku-ɔ,
abu alati bɔdubɔwia bula lɛdila ku adala,
na bekyuli badubɔnu-bu bamana-a
aani ƒula beleku na baláma-bu aani bakinsi.
Die kɔƒa kɔmmɔ lɛti lɛti
na bula lɛlɔ.”
Unwoti Kugyii Kagba
2Nsu na uwi ɔni mebo kemmo ni, bekyuli bani na Unwoti ɔdubɔya na balɛ sɛɛn babla aani kugyii kagba kawɔdi kani mɔɔdia bɔnu na keekeye na kana ebi ndubɔya na Israelƒuɔ bani nébu mmɔ baƒɔ lɛnyi na beteekeye. 3Na bani ƒui nébu na Sion na bése-ma likpo na Yerusalem mmɔ ka belie ngba ni, badubɔlɔ-ma bekyuli kedee. 4Na Unwoti ɔdubɔkpila Yerusalem beleku bammɔ ƒui sɛɛn na bana ekpidi ɔsu. Na udie ubugya ɔni na ɔ́dɔli Yerusalem ƒui na nwuna lɛlɔ, ku kɔyu kɔni mɔɔtɛ litemi siin na kuse aani ogya ɔni mɔɔkyula ala. 5Na ɔmmɔ kama ni, Unwoti ɔdubɔya na liƒlukutu bonwu lɛdi lɛƒɔ Yerusalem ku bani ƒui na básala lɛlɔ na mmɔ na limeyi kemmo. Na usien ni, na ogya bonwu ɔdi utaada teekeye teewi kalɔ kammɔ ƒui lɛlɔ. Na Unwoti bukeye bubi-ma eli aani lɛkpɔtɔ. 6Na ɔdubɔbla kabɛkɔ ute-ma na limeyi liwulu ɔsu ku ɔƒɛƒɛɛ ku ɔnantu lɛnɔ kudɔ.

Title: YESAIA 5
Content:
Bátu Ɔnu Ɔdi Na Unwoti Adingyii Kemo Lɛlɔ
1Ndubudie ɔnu lite mina ɔyɔne
ɔsiku nwuna adingyii kemo lɛlɔ.
Mina ɔyɔne ubo adingyii kemo kadi
na kɔbi kaƒɔna kalɔ buni lɛlɔ.
2Ɔ́tu kalɔ kammɔ únwini
na údie atabi ammɔ ƒui.
Na ɔ́va adingyii ebi abuni ani ndia geen.
Na ɔ́tu bagyumanane kenyekɔ únyene-ka ntɛ.
Na údie egyiibi ammɔ ntu kewikɔ ubu.
Na unye ɔgya egyiibi ammɔ bugyie na bede.
Nsu ebi ani na adingyii ammɔ ánwu ni,
ana ntu ese nyanyaanya na aaadia.
3“Na ɔƒɛni ni, amii Yerusalem ku Yudaƒuɔ,
bɛtɛ ami ku mina kemo ntɛ litemi lɛmɛni na bɔnu.
4Bi na nka ɔlɛka lɛsɔ lɛbla
na mina kemo kamɛni lɛlɔ
litulo kalɛ na lɛ́bla mɛni?
Ka nka ebi buni na mɔɔsia anu ka lide ni,
bi ɔsu na ebi ani nse nyanyaanya sɔɔn na kánwu?
5“Bɛya na lɛsu-mii
lɛla lɛni na ndubo mina adingyii kemo bɔbla.
Ndububile ɔban ɔni na lɛ́gyi lɛ́kya-ka na kayii udu.
Na ndubɔƒɛ awodu ammɔ ƒui liwi kalɔ
na bataanya-ka teesusu.
6Ndubo-ka atu budie na uyi ɔbla lɛku.
Na nsɔ neeedie adingyii ammɔ kɔgba akɔ
iye lidie livo kana kemmo.
Liyu ku alakpi bamba ndubɔƒɔ-ka kemmo.
Ndubutile liƒlukutu kuƒi
na ɔnantu ɔsɔ ulana ulewi-ka.”
7Unwoti Ɔyikune Ƒui adingyii kemo
ndi nwuna bekyuli Israelƒuɔ,
na Yudaƒuɔ badi nwuna kevomadɔ kemo
kani mɔɔyɔ́-nwu kaƒɔ.
Ɔsia anu ka batɛ bekyuli etemila ulu lɛlɔ siin
Nsu ubugya kani na beewi kalɔ.
Na ɔɔwia ka bekyuli babla ala siin.
Nsu bekyuli keku kani na uunú
ka ala étulo-ma na baanya-ma taakya ɔsu.
Yuda Kadi Bekyuli Báƒiɔ Na Unwoti Ɔ́ni-ma Kɔtu
8Bɔbuɛ ute amii bani muuyé lɛtɔ taasia kama
na bɛ́bɛbɛ bina kɔlɔ kuyedi bísela anumi ƒui.
Bekyuli bamba basɔ beeebo keliekɔ kana kemmo
mmomu kénwini amii lɛti keliekɔ.
9Unwoti Ɔyikune Ƒui ɔ́su
na ami ɔlati línu ku mina atu ɔnini,
“Lɛtɔ pii ku katu taasia lɛtɔ buni lɛmmɔ
lɛdubo buse ukpludi ɔni na basɔ balákɛ bekyuli
bani nelie-ni kemmo.
10Adingyii kemo kɔbuli eti atɛ
ku leevu muedi uledie
ntɛ abo aku.
Na edula ani báƒɛ bálɛku kemo
kani na bákya edula akyami leevu
aaadubo ebi bɔlɛ na edu lɛkyami linwi.”
11Na amii bani mɔɔta ɔtanta tutuutu
teelie ntɛ bɔni lɛlɔ teetédu usien lɛdiba ni,
Unwoti uwi úudu ka ɔkyula-mii.
12Biiti lɛnu lɛni mɔɔdia bunu ku ntɛ bɔbuni
teesienku bina emeyi kadikɔ ku lɛbentaa
ku ese ku atoloyii ku kɔkpɛɛ lidu lidu.
Nsu bina kasusu kadi biala kelesie
Unwoti ku nwuna ablala lɛlɔ.
13Ɔmɛni ɔsu ndubɔya na mina bekyuli
benwini bekeline na lɛma bamba ala kalɔ tenu ɔsu.
Benengu bani nnye kunyekɔ kunengudi
ku babune ƒui kɔka kɔdubo-ma bɔdu.
Na utukwɛ ɔdu bekyuli lisu bakladi.
14Kaƒiɔtɔ kadaku akpu bɔta
na adila abuni ani na ɔdubɔkɛ
bɔsiku Yerusalem lɛlɔ ɔsu.
Babune ku bekyuli keeke ƒui
badubo-ma bubweli ku bana ntɛ bekpine ƒui.
15Limeyi lɛmmɔ lɛlɔ na bani mɔɔtalaku lɛlɔ katɔ ƒui
badubo bubuli bɔkpi ɔtumu.
Na bani mɔɔnu lɛlɔ katɔ katɔ ƒui beboku-ma kalɔ.
16Na Katɔti lɛnyi likeye
na lɛkɔ katɔ
ka ɔɔtɛ litemi siin ɔsu.
Na banu kalɛ na Unwoti use kedee,
na kalɛ na ɔɔbla ala siin ɔsu.
17Na kesii kani na Unwoti úbile ala mmɔ ni,
mmɔ na baƒonu badubo bɔdi.
Na baƒonubi ku besebi ƒui badubɔkɛ kadikɔ.
18Bɔbuɛ ute amii bani nda ɔkɔ etemila
na bɛ́ni ekpidi bɛdanku bɛkɛ aani kɔbuli,
na bina ulikplu ala bɔbla ese
aani kɔbuli kɔni mɔɔní kɛɛkɛ taavinku.
19Amii bani mɔɔpii Israel Unwoti Kedee bɛnini,
“Babla na abla lɛla lɛdi bɔnu!
Bo lɛlɔ na atina-bu lɛla lɛni na adubɔkana bɔbla.”
20Bɔbuɛ beete bekyuli bani mɔɔnu likpidi banii lɛbuni
na lɛbuni banii likpidi lɛdi,
ku bani mɔɔnu lɛla suu banii bukeye,
na si bánu bukeye banii
lise suu,
ku bani mɔɔnu ɔdu banii emini
na si bánu emini banii
ɔdu na ɔdi.
21Bɔbuɛ beete bekyuli bani mɔɔnu lɛlɔ banundane
na baakali ka bagyi lɛla lɛdi.
22Bɔbuɛ beete bani na ntɛ kanikɔ na badi bayikune
na ama ntulo ƒui ka baasála-mu lidu lidu taani ɔsu.
23Bekyuli bani mɔɔbɛ́ taaƒɔ ala,
na beete balalane ubo ka bekeli bana kɔtu bɔni,
na baaní bekyuli babuni mmomu kɔtu ni, bɔbuɛ beete-ma.
24Anwuɔsu bana ƒui badubo bɔkywi bɔyii udu
aani kalɛ na ogya ɔɔkyula livo ku keti.
Bana ligyiitu lɛdubo bubun na bana anwula awiɛ.
Ɔsika bekyuli bamɛni béni Unwoti Ɔyikune Ƒui ɔda bubo.
Na béni banii belenu Israel Unwoti Kedee litemi.
25Ɔmmɔ ɔsu na Unwoti uuti kɔnyi kpakplaa
taakya nwuna bekyuli.
Na ɔ́talaku kɔnu katɔ ka ɔƒiɛmi-ma ɔva kalɔ.
Abi ƒui ákunku, na bani nékpi ƒui ɔlɔna
uwi lilu lɛlɔ aani alakpi.
Nsu ɔmmɔ ƒui útayɔ tɔ Unwoti kaƒɔ.
Ɔsika ɔ́mu ɔ́tala kɔnu unye.
26Ɔ́kɔliku aƒlaga úte kadi bani na ɔgyu kakaaka.
Na ɔ́vwi uƒiomu ɔ́kpali bani na kayawi kawɔlɔkɔ ƒui.
Aanu-ma ka bakɛ ku usi badubo.
27Na lɛlɔ liletu ɔdi iye ɔgbanta lɛnɔ.
Lɛlɛɛ liléti ɔdi iye ɔtɛ ɔlɛɛ lɛnɔ.
Bana akɔ ɔdi kadii iye lɛgbanvuo kabuli kaláƒɛnimi.
28Bana atula inye bubo ɔbi yayaaya,
na báni bana kɔtaminta benye bete kekpo.
Na bana bapɔnkɔ lɛgbanvuo libo ɔkplu litulo abuala
na bana kɛɛkɛ kagba kuunwíni
teetulo ɔƒɛƒɛɛ ɔni mɔɔkya ligede.
29Na baakwanyi aani bagyata,
na beebó adi si béƒie lɛla lɛdi,
na beti-ni batɔlɔku ɔni na ukyuli ɔdi uuubo
na ɔkana-ni bɔƒɔ na bana kudɔ.
30Na limeyi lɛmmɔ ni, badubɔnwini bakya-ma,
aani kalɛ na ɛpu ɔɔnwini.
Na liƒlukutu suu lɛdi ku kɔnyana
kɔdubɔƒɔ Israel ƒui, na ɔkɛnku ɔmmɔ ɔsu
basɔ balanu bukeye bɔdi.

Title: YESAIA 6
Content:
Katɔti Ɔ́lɔ Yesaia Na Ɔ́bla-nwu Sɛɛn
1Lɛkwa lɛni kemmo na Ɔga Usia úkpi na lɛ́nu Unwoti. Na uli lɛgaboku kangyaa lɛdi lɛlɔ. Na nwuna awu gyɔlɔɔ bonwu ɔni na ɔkya atu áƒɔ Katɔti kakpakɔ mmɔ ƒui. 2Na Katɔti batu benengudi badi muukeye na bebo avwi aku aku na baalɔ-ma Seraƒim benye bámana-nwu. Ɔdi biala avwi anyɔ ebi-nwu anumi na anyɔ ebi-nwu lɛgba asa na ɔda anyɔ akladi uuveyi. 3Na bana ƒui baatu kɔgya ku lɛdi linwi momoomo banini,
“Unwoti Katɔti, ese kedee,
kedee, kedee!
Katɔ ku kalɔ kéyi ku
ƒula lɛlɔyɔ tɛɛ!”
4Na ebiti lɛnu lɛni na beedie lɛ́kunku Katɔti kakpakɔ kammɔ útéduoku kalɔ kemmo ƒui na uyɔ ɔ́ƒɔ Katɔti kakpakɔ kammɔ ƒui.
5Amu na lɛ́su nnini, “Mina bɔkywi uwi údu, ɔsika alaekpidi ɔblane na ndi na alaekpidi bablane kaba kemmo na lɛ́si, nsu mina anumi ánu Ɔga ɔni ndi Unwoti Katɔti Ɔyikune Ƒui!”
6Batu bamɛni akɔ unwi úveyi ɔ́vi lɛkpabi lɛmmɔ eli na údie lɛgyabi gaganga lɛdi ku lɛbuala lɛdi ɔ́siku ogya kemmo. 7Na úti útuku-mi enyekuli na ɔ́su-mi ɔnini, “Nu, líti ogya lɛƒɛ lɛmɛni lítuku-ɔ enyekuli lɛlɔ. Na ɔƒɛni ni, Katɔti údie ekpidi ƒui na ƒula lɛlɔ.”
8Amu na línu ka Unwoti uuye ɔnini, “Ɔma na ndubɔtala aani mina ɔtu kalɛ lɛkya mina bekyuli na ɔma ndubusie ute-bu?”
Mmɔ na lɛ́su nnini, “Ami ndubo busie! Tala-mi!”
9Na ɔ́su ɔnini, “Ɛɛn, awɔ sie! Tásu mina bekyuli anini,
“ ‘Bɛdubunu mina etemila, nsu bɛɛɛdubo-nya kalɔ bunu.
Na bɛdubɔnu ala ani mɔɔbla
nsu bɛɛɛdubo-nya bɔnu bɔti na binu kalɔ.’
10Geen ni, bana kɔyi kútili na bana atu áyu ɔkplu
na bana anumi lɛnɔ ábwɛ. Si ɔɔɔdi lɛni ni,
nka bana anumi adubɔnu nwaa
na bana atu lɛnɔ adubunu na benu kalɔ
na benwini bebo-mi kudɔ na lɛbwi-ma.”
11Mmɔ na líye Unwoti Katɔti nnini, “Uwi ɛlɛ kemmo na ndubuti lɛbla lɛla lɛmɛni?”
Amu na údie kenye ɔnini,
“Úti útédu uwi ɔni na ndubɔya
na lɛma linengudi ƒui lɛbwɛ lɛyii udu,
na bekyuli basɔ balakya-ni kemmo,
na lɛtɔ lɛsɔ linye ukpludi,
na kalɔ kemodi kammɔ ƒui kebie.
12Na ndubo bekyuli ƒui
bɔbɔku budie kalɔ kammɔ kemmo
na libile kalɔ kammɔ.
13Na ina bekyuli bammɔ
lɛkpa leevudi kani nébu ni,
ama lɛnɔ ndubɔyila-ma udu.
Nsu kalɛ na egyukwii eebú teenye
si báda egyii báwɔlɔ ni,
lɛni na mina badi bani na
lɛ́ƒuna badi badubo bubu bulie kama.”

Title: YESAIA 7
Content:
Likposela Úte Katɔti Ubidi Bɔwɔ
1Uwi ɔni na Ahas ɔni ɔti ndi Yotam, na ɔdi Usia uwɔ, ɔɔdi lɛga na Yuda ni, Aramƒuɔ Ɔga Resin ku Ramalia ubidi ɔni baalɔ Peka na ɔɔdi lɛga na Israel kalɔ lɛlɔ báta banii bebékpo Yerusalem, nsu bátakana na badi Yerusalem lɛlɔ.
2Kenye kébedu Ahas kudɔ banini, “Ɔga Resin ku Ɔga Peka bása lili na ama ku bana bekyuli báta ka bebékpo-bu.” Ɔmmɔ ɔsu ɔtɔtɔ ɔ́gyu Ɔga Ahas ku nwuna bekyuli na baatɔ́ kpakpaakpa aani kalɛ na ɔƒɛƒɛɛ uukpó taavi egyii akɔ.
3Amu na Unwoti ɔ́su Yesaia ɔnini, “Awɔ ku ƒ'ubidi Sea-Yasub, ɔni kalɔ ndi Badi Badubo Bubu, bisie na bitásiaku Ɔga Ahas na ketu kammɔ kawɔlɔkɔ kesii kani muuduo ligyu kemmo mmɔ. Mmɔ kedenku ulu ɔni néti úsela kesii kani na baakya adi kuvo mmɔ. 4Na asu-nwu anii, ‘Da kayi bukpoku ya, na utalɛka ayia Ɔga Resin ku Ɔga Peka, ku bana bekpone kɔnyi momoomo kɔni na béti. Ɔsika bese aani ogya egyukwii ani mɔɔkywí na adubo bɔsa. 5Sɔsɔ na ɔdi ka Aram ku Israel kalɔ baga bamɛni báta ka bebékpo-ɔ na baasu banini, 6“Bɛya na bukpoku Yuda na bɔgyingya ɔma ɔmmɔ na bule-nwu bɔkya lɛlɔ. Na bɔdubɔbwɛ buduo Yerusalem na buti Tabeel ubidi buse lɛga aani Yudaƒuɔ ɔga.” 7Nsu ami Unwoti Ɔyikune Ƒui mɔɔsu nnii,
“ ‘Ulebo ulete lɛni,
na balakana-mii lɛlɔ bɔdi kudii,
8ɔsika Damasko ndi ɔma unengudi ƒui na Aram kalɔ lɛlɔ
na Damasko ɔmmɔ lɛlɔ ɔdine kani ndi Resin.
Ɔƒɛni Israel kalɔ aka ni,
na akwa liti ku leevu-ɛlɔ kemmo ni,
badubo ɔma ɔmmɔ bɔbwɛ na bayila-nwu udu ƒui.
9Israel ɔma unengudi ƒui ndi Samaria.
Na ɔma ɔmmɔ lɛlɔ ɔdine kani ndi Ramalia ubidi Peka.
Na si eeenye mina bɔƒɔtaadi kemmo kpakplaa ni,
agyi anii eeebo kenyekɔ kadi.’ ”
10Unwoti ɔ́sɔ ɔsu Ahas ɔnini, 11“Vele ami Unwoti ƒula Katɔti na lɛtina-a likposela lɛdi ɔ́si kalɔ kemmo ƒui útédu katɔ kakaaka.”
12Nsu Ahas úbulo na ɔ́su ɔnini, “Oowo, lɛɛɛdubo mina Unwoti bɔkɔku bɔnu.”
13Amu na Yesaia ɔ́su ɔnini, “Binu kaduɛ, amii Dawid kaba bebi! Kalɛ na biléte bekyuli lɛlɔ buwi útabɔ? Ɔlɛka biti ɔmɛni bɛlɛku Katɔti lɛnɔ? 14Ɔmmɔ ɔsu ni, Unwoti ɔlati ɔdubute-mii likposela lɛdi. Bɛnu! Adagyaa ɔdi ɔdubɔda kaƒɔ na ɔwɔ ubi ɔnanabi. Na badubɔlɔ-nwu banii Imanuel. 15Na uwi ɔni kemmo na ubi ɔmɛni ɔdubɔti bebuo lɛnyi ntu ku uwɔ bɔdi ni, ɔdubɔti lɛla kanaalɛ na ɔƒuna lɛla lɛni ndia na uni lɛla likpidi. 16Nsu asa na ɔdubɔti likpidi ku lɛbuni kavumana ni, baga inyɔ bani na aayia geen na badi Israel ku Aram baga mmɔ béekpi bábavi. 17Unwoti ɔdubɔya na uwi kpakplaa ɔni nétebo tɔ dii ɔ́si uwi ɔni na béle Salomo lɛga kadikɔ na kénwini Yuda ku Israel ubasiaku-mii, awɔ ku ƒula kadi bekyuli ku ƒula ɔtɔ kemmo bekyuli ƒui lɛlɔ, na ɔya na Asiria ɔga ubo ubekpoku-mii.”
18Na limeyi lɛmmɔ lɛlɔ ni, Unwoti ɔdubɔvwi lise ɔkpali bekpone ɔkya-mii, na bana bumomo bɔdubɔbla aani baalɔlɔ ku banwɛnwɛ ɔsiku Egyipte ntukpa ɔvi na katɔ kakɛ ƒui ku Asiria kalɔ lɛlɔ. 19Badububo na babaƒɔ bina awɛ ƒui kemmo ku atakpɛ libu ku ana kɔka ƒui kemmo ku liyu akunkpo ku abiɔ ƒui kemmo. 20Na Unwoti ɔdubɔya na Asiria ɔga ku anwu badi bekpeyi-mii eli ku bina lɛlɔ linwini ku bina likwi lɛnɔ na bakya-mii kɔƒa. 21Na bebuo bani na badubuƒie bebu akɔ ni, ɔmantɛ akɔ ɔkɔdi ku koƒonu kɔkɔdi ku ese ɔkɔdi unwi unwi ɔdubo bubu kaduli biala. 22Na lɛnyi ntu pii lɛni na bebuo bammɔ badubo butaayu ɔsu ni, nkyuli ɛlɛɛ bani ndubo bubu mmɔ badubɔkɛ lɛnyi ntu pii na udu-ma bɔni. 23Na bina adingyii mmo bɔni na bíse na bɔdubɔƒɔ kuye sika ɔƒualadi mpim ɛlɛ ɛlɛ ni, bɔdububie bunwini liyu likpidi yayaaya aku sɔɔn. 24Na bina atula ku kɔtaminta na bɛdubuteeti teesie taatábui na mmɔ ka mmɔ kasɔ kaaadia bɔtuma ɔsu. 25Kalɔ kani na nka bɛ́kya-ka anwami bɛ́tuma dii ni, kadubunwini liyu yayaaya aku ani nsɔ naaadubo bɔdia bɔmɛnɛ buduo na bɛtuma. Mmomu ɔdubunwini kesii kani na bina bebuo badubuteesie taatávi taawia bana alakpi ani na bakun.

Title: YESAIA 8
Content:
Unwoti Úti Asiriaƒuɔ Ɔ́bla Kabla
1Na uwi ɔdi kama ni, Unwoti ɔ́sɔ ɔ́su-mi ɔnini, “Ti ebuo ɔku kakunkɛ na eti unwenigyii na enweni lɛnyi lɛni kalɔ ndi Békpo-ma Béƒie-ma Ala Báƒɔ asia-nwu lɛlɔ. 2Na ndubɔlɔ ɔkpane Uria ku Yeberekia ubidi ɔnanabi ɔni baalɔ Sakaria bani muudie-mi litemi kenye ulu lɛlɔ geen na bebo.”
3Amu na lísie mina uleku kudɔ na ɔ́da kaƒɔ na úbawɔ ɔnanabi. Na Unwoti ɔ́su-mi ɔnini, “Sia-nwu lɛnyi anii Békpo-ma Béƒie-ma Ala Báƒɔ. 4Na asa na ubi ɔmmɔ ɔdubɔti bɔsu ɔnii, ‘Mina Ati’ iye ‘Nna’ ni, Asiriaƒuɔ ɔga úuti Damasko lɛlakɛ ku ala ani na ɔdubuƒie ɔƒɔ na Samaria ɔ́tɔlɔku uwi ɔmmɔ.”
5Na Unwoti ɔ́sɔ ɔ́su-mi na uwi bamba ɔdi ɔnini,
6“Ka kadi kamɛni béni kalɛ na nda-ma
aani Siloa Ketu kani mɔɔgbá buɛɛ,
na Resin lɛlɔ mɔɔyɔ́-ma kaƒɔ
mmomu ku Remalia ubidi
ɔnanabi ɔsu ni,
7Ami bana Unwoti Katɔti ndubɔya
na Asiria ɔga ku nwuna bekpone balɛ
na bana limomo ku ɔyikun kemmo bebo
aani Euƒrate Ketu kani néyi ku atu,
na kagbala-ma kavia utubli ɔmmɔ lɛlɔ ƒui.
8Na kadubɔgbala ala laa ketédu Yuda,
na kabuala kavi na keyi kadanku-ma amɔ.
Na kana avwi ani na úgyingya
adubo bɔbɛbɛ bubi ƒula kalɔ kammɔ ƒui,
O Imanuel!”
9Bibo kekpo kudu amii kadi bekyuli,
na bibile ala kalɛ na bɛkana
na bɛdubo bɔyii udu!
Binu amii ɔlɔgyu kadi ƒui bekyuli.
Bɛklibi lɛlɔ bite kekpo, nsu bɛdubo bukpi!
10Bisie kelisa na bɛkya bina kekpo kɔkwɛ ƒui,
na bɛtaa kasiakɔ biala bite lɛlɔ,
nsu ɔmmɔ ƒui ɔdubɔbla keeke,
ɔsika Unwoti Katɔti ulieku-bu.
Bɛyia Katɔti
11Katɔti ɔyikun ɔ́ƒɔ-mi lɛlɔ kemmo na ɔ́su-mi kpakplaa ka ntasiaku bekyuli bɔmmɔ ɔbladu kama ɔnini,
12“Lɛla lɛni na badubɔlɔ kelisa kekpidi ni,
tasiaku-ma anii kelisa kekpidi kadi.
Na uwi ɔni badubɔlɔ unwi bɔbla kasala ni,
tenuku-ma kalɔ na asiaku-ma lɛni.
Tayia lɛla lɛni na baayia, na liƒu lɛnɔ litada-a.
13Unwoti Katɔti ndi ukyuli
ɔni kani na ɔdi ka anu ka use kedee,
na anwu kani na ɔdi ka ayia,
na nwuna lɛlɔ liƒu lɛkya-a kemmo,
14na ɔdubɔbla katamikukɔ
nsu na Israel lɛgakɔdikɔ inyɔ bɔmmɔ ƒui akɔ ni,
ɔdubunwini lɛtabi lɛni na bekyuli badubutulo,
na ani kani na ndubɔya
na begyiile bebuli.
Na Yerusalem kadi bekyuli
ama ni,
ɔdubunwini kakpagyuɛ ku kamia ute-ma.
15Bana akɔ pii badubo butulo na bebuli baƒɔ lɛlɛ,
na kamia kadubo bɔta na kedie-ma.”
16Kono bunyimi ku ɔda bubo bɔmmɔ
na abala-mu kenye ku kɔma ese mina basiakune.
17Ndubunye ntaanu mina Unwoti anumi,
ɔni nábɛla nwuna anumi ɔ́siku Yakob kaduli bebi kudɔ.
Ndubuti mina anu ƒui lɛsia Katɔti lɛlɔ.
18Aanu ami ku bebi bani na Unwoti úti úte-mi. Abu ndi bɔnu bɔti ku likposela na Israel bani nási Unwoti Ɔyikune ɔni nli Sion Kɔbi lɛlɔ kudɔ.
19Si bekyuli baasu-mii banii bitébo like na biye bekpine ku ayu ani mɔɔtɛmi kabɛnsɛ na baatɛmi linwubwɛ ala binu ni, ɔɔɔdi Katɔti mmomu na biye ala kalɔ binu? Bi ɔsu na bekpine na biiye ala binu bɛsiku bayawine lɛlɔ? 20Bɛnu bɛti ka si bana ala aaakɛnku mina litemi lɛni ndanku ɔda bubo ku bunyimi bɔmɛni ni, na bukeye bɔdi buuubo-ma kemmo. 21Ala adubo-ma bukpoku na kɔka lɛnɔ kutaada-ma na bakɛ bataavi kalɔ kammɔ ƒui lɛlɔ. Na si kɔka kɔmmɔ kútulo-ma ni, badubo kɔnyi buti geen na bataanu katɔ teewida bana ɔga ku bana Katɔti. 22Na si báyula anumi kalɔ lɛnɔ ni, lɛƒɛda lɛmmɔ kani na badubo bɔnu na ɔbla-ma suu na liƒu geen lɛƒɔ-ma lɛlɔ kemmo ƒui na basɔ bakya lɛdisa suu lɛmmɔ kemmo.

Title: YESAIA 9
Content:
Báwɔ Ubi Béte-bu
1Nsu kalɛ na báyila lɛnunsia na beli lɛdisa kemmo mmɔ ni, ulése lɛni uwi ƒui. Uwi ɔni návi ni, bátabu Sebulon ku Naƒtali bátakya lɛla lɛdi kemmo. Nsu uwi ɔdi ɔdubo ɔni na Katɔti ɔdubuti bukeye ute kadi bamba bekyuli bani nlie Galilea na Yordan Ketu ulu lɛlɔ úti útédu ɛpu kɔtu.
2Bekyuli bani na nka beli
baabla ala na lɛdisa kemmo
badubɔnu bukeye.
Na bani na belie kukpi ɔgbankpi kemmo ni,
Katɔti bukeye bɔdubuwi-ma lɛlɔ.
3Na Israel kadi badubɔsɔ balɛ lili
na baƒɔ lɛnyi na lɛlɔ lɛyɔ-ma
aani kalɛ na lɛlɔ lɛɛyɔ́ bekyuli si báƒɛ edula awɔdi.
Na badubo kudu bubo geen ku lɛlɔyɔ
aani bekpone muule ala
ani na béƒie báƒɔ bana bekisine kudɔ.
4Ɔsika lɛbibo ku ukyuli kalala bɔbla
bɔni nénwini lɛbibo kɔgba na kɔda ƒula bekyuli ni,
adubo-ku bɔƒɛ ƒui,
aani kalɛ na áyila Midianƒuɔ bekpone udu ƒui.
5Na bekpone adala ku agbanvuo
ani nákpi ubugya na kekpo ni,
ala ammɔ bene ƒui adubunwini ala ani
na badubo ogya bɔkya.
6Ɔsika báwɔ ubi ɔnanabi béte-bu.
Na bekyuli ƒui lɛlɔ bɔdi lɛdubɔsia-nwu lɛlɔ.
Na badubɔlɔ-nwu banii
Kasusu Buni Ɔkyane
ku Katɔti Ɔyikune
ku Ati Ɔni Nli Uwi Ƒui
ku Keyi Buɛɛ Ɔga Ubi.
7Na nwuna lɛga kadikɔ
kadubo katɔ butaakɔ
ku keyi buɛɛ,
na kaaadubo ulu bɔwɔ kudii.
Na ɔdubulie Dawid lɛgaboku lɛlɔ utaadi lɛga lɛmmɔ,
na nwuna lɛgadi lɛdubunye uwi ƒui.
Na ɔdubɔtɛ litemi ulu lɛlɔ,
na nwuna ablala ƒui
adubuse siin.
Na Katɔti ɔdubɔya na ɔmɛni
ubo-nwu kemmo
ɔkɛnku nwuna ɔyikun lɛlɔ!
8Unwoti ɔdanku linyesia kpakplaa ute Yakob kaduli bekyuli,
na lɛla lɛmmɔ lɛdubo Israel lɛlɔ.
9Na bekyuli ƒui badubo-ni bɔnu bɔti,
Eƒraim ku Samaria kalɔ lɛlɔ bekyuli ƒui.
Ama mɔɔkun lɛmɛnɛ
na baakɔliku lɛkɔ katɔ taasu banii,
10“Unwoti ɔkɛnku bula bekisine
lɛlɔ na ɔ́ya na báƒɛ bula
awodu atimbɔ lɛtɔ ƒui
béwi kalɔ,
nsu bɔdubo lɛni ndia ntulo
lɛmmɔ bɔtu
ku atabi abwɛdi ani na bánwi kaduɛ.
Na báƒɛ ɔtɔ ɔmmɔ ligyii ka liiibo ɔkplu ɔsu,
nsu bɔdubɔvumana-ni ku ligyii kpakplaa geen.”
11Nsu bana lɛlɔ katɔ bɔkɔliku bɔmɛni ɔsu ni,
Unwoti ɔdubɔya na bana bekisine
bani ndi Resin ku Asiria bekpone
basala bata babasiaku-ma.
12Na Siriaƒuɔ badubɔsi ɔƒɛ katukɔ,
na Ƒilistiƒuɔ basi ɔƒɛ kanukɔ
na bebebweli-ma aani
eƒiebuo kalɛ.
Nsu ina ɔmmɔ ƒui ni,
Unwoti kɔnyi kútayɔ tɔ,
mmomu ɔ́mu únene kɔnu
unye ka ɔƒiɛmi-ma.
13Nsu bekyuli bamɛni belenu kalɔ
ka benwini bebo ukyuli ɔni mɔɔní-ma kɔtu kudɔ,
bana Unwoti Ɔyikune Ƒui kudɔ.
14Anwuɔsu limeyi linwi kani
na Unwoti ɔdubɔyila Israel kadi bekyuli udu
ɔ́si lili útédu lɛgba,
aani kalɛ baamɛnɛ kubo kɔɔƒɛkɛ
ku livo alakpi ƒui teewi kalɔ limeyi linwi.
15Ɔma benengu ku batɔnkune
ndi lili.
Na ɔkɔ kenye bediene ndi lɛgba lɛmmɔ.
16Batɔnkune bamɛni baatɔnku-ma taatáyila,
na bani batɔnku mmɔ lɛnɔ baayii ulu.
17Anwuɔsu na lɛlɔ lilayɔ
Unwoti Katɔti
na bana bakɔdi lɛlɔ
munu munu,
na bekpinebi ku bekpinele basɔ baládu-nwu kaƒɔ,
ɔsika bana ƒui basɔ balábla Unwoti lɛyɔla,
na baabla kalala na baanyi ɔkɔ.
Nsu ina ɔmmɔ ƒui Unwoti kɔnyi kútayɔ tɔ,
mmomu ɔ́mu únene kɔnu unye ka ɔƒiɛmi-ma.
18Geen ni, kalala bɔbla buse aani lɛku kemmo ogya.
Ɔɔkyula liyu ku alakpi bamba,
na lɛku limodi lɛmmɔ lɛɛkywí,
na uudie uyɔ litigbli
taakɔliku kayaa.
19Unwoti Ɔyikune Ƒui kɔnyi kpakplaa ɔsu ni,
kalɔ kammɔ kadubɔkula lɛlɔ geen,
na bekyuli bénwini ekyweni bete ogya ɔmmɔ,
na ɔkpanadi kɔnyana bɔnu buuubo.
20Benye kesi kesii beemú taadi,
nsu belemo na kɔka kɔsa.
Ama alati bebi na badubo bɔkun ɔƒɛni amu.
21Manase ɔdubo Eƒraim badi bɔkun,
na Eƒraim ɔ́kun Manase badi aani beƒiebuo kalɛ.
Na bana inyɔ benwini benye Yuda lɛlɔ.
Nsu ina ɔmmɔ ƒui Unwoti kɔnyi kútayɔ tɔ,
mmomu ɔ́mu únene kɔnu unye ka ɔƒiɛmi-ma.

Title: YESAIA 10
Content:
1Bɔbuɛ beete bekyuli,
ama bani muunyimi ɔda bubo bukpidi
kalɛ na bataanya bekyuli taakya.
2Na balátɛ litemi ulu lɛlɔ
teete bawabane ku bekpinele ku bekpinebi
kalɛ kɔnu kutuku-ma
bana ala lɛlɔ.
3Bi na bɛdubo bɔbla
ɔgbankpi uwi,
uwi ɔni na ndubɔya na ɔsi kalɔ kakaaka
ubo ubalɛ-mii lɛlɔ?
Ɔma na bɛdubo bukeli bɔtamiku?
Na ɔma na bɛdubo bina akɛla bɔda buse?
4Badubɔni-mii batɔlɔku na abuli kemmo
ku bekyuli beƒiedi bakladi na biiibo lɛla lɛdi bɔbla,
iye badu-mii bebunku bani na báadu béwi.
Nsu ɔmmɔ ƒui Katɔti kɔnyi kɔɔɔdubo-nwu bɔyɔ tɔ.
Katɔti Ɔ́tɛku Asiriaƒuɔ Litemi
5“Bɔbuɛ beete Asiria, mina ugyii ɔni nda ku kɔnyi.
Bana enu kemmo na mina kɔnyi ligyiiku lɛkya!
6Na mɔɔtala-ma ka betékpoku mina bekyuli
bani naaadi mina etemila lɛlɔ.
Lídie-ma ulu nnii betékpo mina kadi bekyuli,
bekyuli bani mɔɔkya-mi kɔnyi,
na beƒie-ma ala baƒɔ na besusu-ma kpɛtɛ kpɛtɛ.
7Nsu Asiriaƒuɔ baaagyi banii
ami nda-ma mɔɔbla lɛla
lɛni mɔɔyɔ́.
Ama bana kasusu ndi ka
ama alati nda bana ɔyikun
ka bekpo
na badi kɔlɔ pii lɛlɔ
na bayila-ma udu.
8Anwuɔsu na Asiria ɔga ɔɔkun lɛmɛnɛ ɔnini,
‘Mina kekpo batɔnkune ƒui badi baga.
9Na bádi Kalno ɔma lɛlɔ
aani kalɛ na bádi Karkemis ku Hamat
ku Arpad ku Samaria ku Damasko lɛnɔ lɛlɔ.
10Geen ni, líkpo lɛ́di kɔlɔ kɔni baƒiɔ nákuku lɛlɔ,
na kúbomo kútulo Yerusalem ku Samaria badi.
11Na lɛni kani na ndubo bukpo
na lɛdi Yerusalem ku nwuna baƒiɔ ƒui lɛlɔ.’ ”
12Ɔƒɛni si lebo lɛni na Unwoti Katɔti ɔ́sia Asiriaƒuɔ lɛlɔ ɔ́wɔlɔ lɛla lɛni na ɔɔwia ka ɔbla na Yerusalem ku Sion ni, ɔdubunwini na ɔsu ɔnini, “Ndubɔni Asiriaƒuɔ ɔga ku nwuna kadi bekyuli kɔtu, ɔsika uutú kɔnu kayi na ɔɔkun lɛmɛnɛ na ɔɔnu bekyuli bani lɛlɔ na ɔ́di ɔnusɛ. 13Ɔɔtina lɛlɔ ku enyekpi taasu ɔnini,
“ ‘Ami ɔlati mina ɔyikun ku lɛlati
ku lɛnunda kemmo na líkpo bekyuli bamɛni
na lɛ́di-ma lɛlɔ na líƒie kɔlɔ pii
ku bana akɛla lɛ́ƒɔ
na lɛ́di baga bammɔ lɛlɔ na lɛ́yila-ma udu ƒui.
14Kalɛ na ukyuli ɔɔkya kɔnu
nwuna bebuo lɛyu teeƒie ebuo ɔni na ɔɔyɔ́ ni,
lɛni na lɛ́kya kɔnu kadi bamba kalɔ kemmo
na lɛ́kpala-ma akɛla ƒui lɛ́tɔlɔku.
Kalɛ na ukyuli ɔɔla avala na lɛyu kemmo ni,
lɛni na lɛ́sala kalɔ lɛlɔ baga ku bana bekyuli
ɔni na ɔdi útebimi kenye iye unene kɔvwi muedi.’ ”
15Bɔkana na kadadi kadubɔkana
lɛlɔ katɔ bɔkɔli butulo ukyuli ɔni nda-ka?
Munuu lɛbuala lɛni bada baabwɛ kugyii
ndubɔkana kayi butu bɔkya ukyuli ɔni nda-nwu?
Aani si lɛbuala mɔɔgyú ukyuli teeƒwimi
iye ligyiiku mɔɔda ukyuli taaƒiɛmi lɛla lɛdi.
16Anwuɔsu Unwoti Ɔyikune Ƒui, ɔdubɔya
na ɔlɛ kpakplaa ubo Asiria ɔga
ku nwuna bekpone bani mɔɔtina lɛlɔ lɛlɔ,
na bana ɔlɔna kemmo
keteenu ɔlɛ
aani ogya mɔɔkyula-ma.
17Unwoti ɔni ndi Israel bukeye
ɔdubunwini ogya na udie ogya unyemi
na ɔkyula-ma limeyi linwi pɛ
na bakywi
aani liyu ku alakpigya kalɛ.
18Na bana akumiɔ ani nábi
ku kɔlɔ kɔni nélie lɛmwi
mmɔ ƒui
ndubo-ku bɔkyula na kɔyii udu
aani kalɛ na ɔlɛne uuƒi
taayii udu.
19Na egyii alɛɛ geen
ndubo bubu
na ɔnamu blii muedi
adubɔka-nya!
Israelƒuɔ Ɛlɛɛ Badi Badubo Bubu
20Na uwi ɔmmɔ ni, Israelƒuɔ ɛlɛɛ bani mebu
na badi Yakob kaba kemmo bebi ni,
basɔ beleti bana anu balasia
bekyuli bani nékpo-ma na bádi-ma lɛlɔ
banii ama ndubo-ma bubunku.
Mmomu Unwoti Israel
Katɔti Kedee
na badubuti bana kayi ƒui basia.
21Yakob kaba kemmo
nkyuli ɛlɛɛ
badubunwini bebo Katɔti Ɔyikune Ƒui kudɔ.
22O Israel, ina ka bina kadi bekyuli bemomo
aani ɛpu kɔnwinimi muedi ni,
bina ɛlɛɛ kani ndubunwini bibo kama.
Katɔti ɔ́lɛ ugyii na nwuna ulu siin lɛlɔ úse ka
ɔkyula-mii na ɔyila-mii udu.
23Na Unwoti ɔni ndi Ɔyikune Ƒui
ɔdubo kalɔ kammɔ ƒui kɔtu kɔmɛni bɔni sɔsɔ.
24Anwuɔsu binu lɛla lɛni na Unwoti Ɔyikune Ƒui ɔmmɔ ɔ́su,
“Mina kadi bekyuli bani nkya Yerusalem,
bise kayi na bitayia Asiriaƒuɔ si beekpóku-mii
na baanya-mii taakya
aani kalɛ kani na Egyipte kadi bekyuli
bábla kuuku dii bábavi.
25Bana bukpoku bɔmmɔ
buletu uwi.
Na uwi klukwii kemmo ni,
kɔnyi kɔni na líti lɛ́kya-mii kɔdubo-mi bɔyɔ
na bana lɛlɔ mmomu na kɔnyi kɔdubo-mi bɔkɔ
kalɛ na lɛkyula-ma.”
26Unwoti Katɔti Ɔyikune Ƒui
ɔdubo-ma bubo bɔƒiɛmi kalɔ
na ebola eduo-ma lɛlɔ
aani kalɛ na ɔkɛnku
Gideon lɛlɔ,
na ɔ́di Midian kadi bekyuli lɛlɔ
na kesii kani baalɔ banii Oreb lɛtakpɛ.
Iye uwi ɔni na Mose ɔ́talaku Unwoti ugyii katɔ
na ɛpu úle ntɛ
na ɔ́nyina Egyipteƒuɔ bekpone bammɔ ƒui
na ntu kemmo.
27Limeyi lɛmmɔ lɛlɔ na Unwoti ɔdubɔya
na kalɛ na nwuna kadi bekyuli
bakya bekyuli bamba kalɔ
baabla-ma kabla ɔdubɔwɔ.
Na ɔƒɛ bana lɛlɔ bɔdi kɔgba
kɔni nda-mii amɔ ku amangba udie-mii lɛlɔ.
28Bɛnu! Báasi bébedu Aiat ɔma,
na básia bálɛ Migron ɔma kemmo.
Na baaklibi bana ala buse na Mikmas.
29Bávia ketu na utukwalɛ
bonwu ɔdi,
na bátáƒɔ lɛlɔ bátɛ Geba ɔma kemmo.
Na liƒu lɛ́ya na lɛlɔ lɛɛtɔ́ Rama ɔma bekyuli.
Na Saul ɔma Gibea kadi bekyuli
beekeli ka baƒɔ bana lili ngba.
30Amii Galim ɔma bekyuli,
bibo kɔnu kenye!
Na amii Laisa ɔma bekyuli,
binu kudu kɔni nda
O Anatos ɔma bekyuli, bíduo kɔnyana.
31Madmena ɔma bekyuli
bakɛ usi baawia kabɛkɔ.
Na Gebim kadi bekyuli
bábɛ beeduo ala kalɔ.
32Ɔmwi ni, bekisine bammɔ
badubɔƒɔ lɛlɔ bakya Nob ɔma
na bataadu anyi teekene lɛvu
taayila Sion teemene kɔbi kɔmmɔ na Yerusalem.
33Nsu bɛnu! Unwoti Ɔyikune Ƒui
ɔdubo kugyii bonwu
ku kuna kɔgba bonwu bɔmɛnɛ buwi kalɔ
ku nwuna ɔyikun bonwu.
Egyii enengudi ani nákuku mmɔ
na ɔdubo bɔƒɛ
na uboku-nya kalɔ.
34Ɔdubɔda lɛkumiɔ egyii ammɔ ku kadadi.
Na Lebanon egyii mmɔ
ewi kalɔ
na nwuna anumi na ayii udu.

Title: YESAIA 11
Content:
Yese Kugyii Kagba Lɛlɔ Kɔtɛ
1Yese kaba kemmo ligyukui lɛdi lɛdubɔta,
na nwuna ugyitu ɔdubudie kagba na kanwu ebi.
2Na Katɔti Kɔyu kɔdubɔƒɔ-nwu lɛlɔ kemmo ƒui,
kɔyu kɔni ndanku lɛnunda ku ala kalɔ bunu
kakwɛ ku ɔyikun ku lɛlati ku Katɔti bɔyia.
3Nwuna lɛƒɔyɔ ndi ka bekyuli ƒui
beti ɔbu ku bɔyia bete Unwoti.
Na ɔɔɔdubo anumi bɔnu
bɔtɛ litemi,
iye unu bekyuli litemi ɔtɛ
lɛla lɛdi.
4Mmomu ɔdubɔtɛ litemi siin bute bawabane
na ukulo litemi kemmo ulu geen ɔmmɔ lɛlɔ
ute kalɔ kamɛni lɛlɔ bawabane.
Nwuna kenye litemi na ɔdubuti
ɔni bekyuli kɔtu aani lɛbuala na ɔyila-ma udu.
5Na ala bɔbla siin ndi kadii
kani ndubɔda-nwu kavobi,
na litemi geen lɛlɔ bɔdi ndubɔdi
lɛduni lɛni nda-nwu lɛmana.
6Na limeyi lɛmmɔ lɛlɔ ni,
kegidi ku koƒonu badubɔtɛ liku linwi,
na ebuoƒuala ku ese besie bavi kpɛtɛ kpɛtɛ.
Na ɔmantɛ bakɔ bebi ku
bebuo bamba
bani bebi nétedu tɔ
lɛkwa linwi
badubusie bavi bagyata ntɛ.
Na ɔnamu blii kani ndubɔtɔnku bana ƒui.
7Na ɔmantɛ bakɔ bebi
badubɔdi na begidi akɔ,
na bebuo inyɔ bammɔ
batɛ liku linwi basala,
na gyata ɔkun livo aani ɔmantɛ akɔ kalɛ.
8Ubiwɔ ɔni na anyi ntu
amu akya-nwu akpu ɔdubɔƒia
na balakpi bani mbo ugyulo ukpidi libu kenye,
na ɔkya-ma kɔnu libu, nsu lɛla lɛdi lilabla-nwu.
9Ɔdi ɔsɔ ulabla ɔkpanadi kalala,
na basɔ baládu lɛlɔ lɛnɔ
na mina kɔbi kedee lɛlɔ
na Sion mmɔ,
ɔsika kayawi bekyuli badubɔƒɔ-mi
na bati ami bana Unwoti geen
aani kalɛ na ntu bɔɔƒɔ́ ɛpu kemmo tɛtɛɛtɛ.
10Na limeyi lɛmmɔ lɛlɔ ni, Yese kugyii ugyiitu ɔdubɔlɛ unye aani ngba bɔƒɔ aƒlaga ute kayawi bekyuli ƒui. Na kadi ƒui bekyuli badubukeli bebo-nwu kudɔ na kesii kani na uli, ɔsika mmɔ kadubɔbla kesii kani muukeye na bekyuli baakɛ́ bɔnwuna. 11Ɔƒɛni na limeyi lɛni na Unwoti ɔlati úse úse lɛlɔ ni, ɔdubɔsɔ ɔkɔliku aƒlaga katɔ ute-ma na ɔsɔku nwuna kadi nkyuli ɛlɛɛ bani mebu ubasala ɔsiku Asiria ku Egyipte ku Patros ku Elam lɛnɔ.
12Ɔdubo bunyene aƒlaga ɔdi ute kadi ƒui bekyuli,
na ɔkpanku Israel kadi bekyuli
bani na béƒie bésienku kɔlɔ bamba
ku Yudaƒuɔ bani na bégyingya bakya ƒui
ɔsiku kayawi lɛƒɛnyi ine bɔmmɔ ƒui ubasala.
13Eƒraim ɔsɔ ulékpo kogyulo,
na bekisine Yudaƒuɔ bukpoku
kenye kadubo buklo.
Na Yuda kadi bekyuli lɛnɔ
basɔ belékpoku Eƒraim.
14Mmomu badubɔsala lɛlɔ
na babwɛ bayu Ƒilistiƒuɔ besie ɔƒɛ kanukɔ.
Na basi mmɔ betékpoku
kadi kani bekyuli nkya bésie ɔƒɛ katukɔ.
15Na Unwoti ɔdubɔya na Ɛpugyie kaviakɔ
kani nédie utukwalɛ aani lɛba mmɔ kakwii.
Na ɔtalaku nwuna kɔnu ɔsia Euƒrate Ketu
na utiku ɔƒɛƒɛɛ ɔni
mɔɔkula ala
na ukpo ɔvi-ka anumi
na ule-ka ɔbla ntukpa wɛlɛ wɛlɛ maatɛ
na ɔdia bɔvia ku lɛgba.
16Na Unwoti ɔdubɔya
na ulu bɛbɛɛbɛ ɔdi
ɔsia mmɔ ɔvi
ute nwuna kadi bekyuli
bani na bébu bakya Asiria,
aani kalɛ na ɔ́bla úte-ma
uwi ɔni na bávi baalɛ́ Egyipte kalɔ lɛlɔ.

Title: YESAIA 12
Content:
Batu Bumwi Ɔnu
1Na Unwoti limeyi lɛmmɔ lɛlɔ ni, bɛdubo ɔnu budie bɛnini,
“Bemwi-ɔ, O Unwoti!
Ina ka éti kɔnyi ákya-bu ni,
kɔnyi kɔmmɔ kɔ́yɔ-ɔ
na ásɔ énwini aayala-bu kaƒɔ mmomu.
2Sɔsɔ geen na ɔdi ka Unwoti úbo
ɔnii ubaƒɔ-mi ngba.
Ndubuti mina anu ƒui
bɔsia-nwu lɛlɔ
na lɛɛɛdubo bɔyia.
Unwoti Katɔti ndi ukyuli ɔni mɔɔkya-mi ɔyikun,
na anwu ndi ɔnu ɔni ndubɔkya-mi kenye uwi ƒui
ka anwu ndi-mi ngba bɔƒɔ.”
3Ebiti kemmo na bɛdubo ntu budu bɔni
bɔsiku ngba bɔƒɔ libiɔ lɛmɛni kemmo.
4Na Unwoti limeyi lɛmmɔ lɛlɔ ni, bɛdubɔsu bɛnii,
“Bimwi Unwoti lɛnyi
na bɛkpali-nwu lɛnyi bivele ala.
Na bibo nwuna ala ebendi
ani na ɔ́bla kudu bite kadi ƒui,
na bati ka Unwoti lɛnyi lɛ́kɔ katɔ katɔ ƒui.
5Bidie ɔnu bimwi Unwoti,
ɔsika ɔ́bla ala ebendi ani muukeye.
Bɛya na kayawi bekyuli ƒui bati kalɛ na biimwi-nwu.
6Amii bani nkya Sion ƒui
bidie ɔnu ku kudu momoomo,
ɔsika Israel Unwoti Kedee úbomo na bina akɔ.”

Title: YESAIA 13
Content:
Básu Kenye Kadi Bése Na Babel Lɛlɔ
1Amos ubidi Yesaia ɔ́nu budie taatina bɔdi na Babel kalɔ bɔkyula lɛlɔ.
2Unwoti ɔnini, “Tálɛ aƒlaga ɔdi na kɔbi goolo kɔdi ɔtantɛ
kesii kani badubɔnu-nwaa,
na akpali-ma emene momoomo
na ebo-ma kɔnu anii
bavi ɔma ɔban ɔmmɔ kenye
na beduo bayikune bammɔ lɛlɔ na mmɔ.
3Ami nébo ɔda líte bani na lɛ́ƒuna líse sɛsɛɛ,
bekpone bani lɛ́tala ka babla mina kɔnyi kabla,
ama ndi bekyuli bani mɔɔyɔ́ ka bakɔliku-mi katɔ.
4“Binu kɔku kɔni nda na abi lɛlɔ
aani bekyuli lisu bonwu lɛdi!
Na binu kalɛ na kadi ƒui bekyuli lɛga kɔdikɔ
bála lɛlɔ bébo baasála na beedie adi.
Kadi bekyuli ƒui Unwoti mɔɔsála-ma
ka bebo babasala babla bekpone lisu linwi.
5Bási ɔgyu bun bun
nsu badi Unwoti ekpola,
na badanku nwuna kɔnyi
kɔni na ɔdubuti ɔkyula kalɔ kana ƒui.
6“Biwulo momoomo ku kɔnyana,
ɔsika Unwoti Ɔyikune Ƒui limeyi
lɛni na ɔdubo bekyuli bɔkyula
lɛsia ulu líibo líbedu
suɛlɛ suɛlɛ.
7Ɔmmɔ ɔsu enu adubɔƒɛ
ukyuli biala
na ɔtɔtɔ buɛ ɔ́gyu bana ƒui
8na liƒu bonwu lɛdubuƒie-ma.
Ɔsika badubuduo kɔnyana ku ɔlɛ bunu kemmo
aani uleku ɔni ntɛ kɔwɔ uukpóku lɛlɔ.
Na ɔdubɔbwɛ ogya uwi-ma anumi,
na bana ƒui benye bataanu lɛlɔ kalɛ kadi.
9“Bɛnu! Unwoti limeyi lɛmmɔ lɛsia ulu,
nwuna kɔnyi limeyi likpidi lɛmmɔ
ku ɔdu kati kati ka ubakyula kayawi
ku kana alaekpidi bablane bammɔ
ɔni na kalɔ kammɔ kasɔ kalabla keliekɔ kabuni.
10Na kayaa ayabi lidu ƒui asɔ elekeye.
Na ɔƒɛ ɔni nátu ɔdubo lɛnɔ adubɔbla suu.
Lɛni kani na kɔbuli lɛnɔ kɔsɔ kɔɔɔdubo bukeye.
11Ndubɔni bayawine kɔtu
na bana likyulikpi ɔsu,
na lɛni balalane kɔtu na bana ekpidi ɔsu.
Na bani mɔɔnu lɛlɔ katɔ katɔ ni,
ndubɔya na bana lɛla tabu kenye kekulo,
na liboku bani mɔɔtalaku lɛlɔ katɔ kalɔ.
12Ndubɔya na bekyuli basa na kebu ɛlɛɛ geen
utulo kalɛ na Oƒir sika ugyiedi ɔbuni ƒui use ɛlɛɛ.
13Anwuɔsu ndubɔya na katɔ ku kalɔ ƒui
kakunku geen na kana kenyekɔ,
na ami Unwoti Ɔyikune Ƒui kɔnyi ɔsu.
14“Kalɛ na akwa uukeli ɔgbini si ɔsiaku-nwu
iye baƒonu bani neeebo ɔdane baagyingya ni,
ukyuli biala ɔdubo bunwini
na ukeli usie nwuna ɔma na nwuna badi kudɔ.
15Na bani ƒui béƒie badubɔtu-ma baƒuaala,
na batɛ kuwii kenye.
16Bana anumi lɛlɔ na badubɔƒiɛmi bana bebi
atakpɛ lɛlɔ babwɛ kpɛtɛ kpɛtɛ.
Na badubɔla-ma ɔtɔ kemmo ala ƒui batɔlɔku.
Na beƒie bana beleku batɛnku-ma ɔkplu kemmo.
17“Ndubo Medes kadi bekyuli budie bɔkya-mii
Na bilátɔlɔ-ma ku sika ugyiedi iye ɔƒualadi
ɔni na baaadaku lɛda.
18Na bekpone bani ndubo-mii bukpo
badubo bina bakloƒu atula bubo bɔdu.
Na balanu bebi bani naaagyi lɛla lɛdi muedi kɔnyana.”
19Babel lɛgakadikɔ,
lɛkɛ lɛni muukeye ƒui kesekɔ,
kesii kani lɛlɔ lɛmɛnɛ baakun,
Unwoti ɔdubo-nwu bunwini bubi
na ɔyila-nwu udu aani Sodom ku Gomora.
20Ɔsɔ ɔɔɔdubo bekyuli keliekɔ bunwini
úsela kaba kaba kemmo ƒui.
Belusiene ɔdi kevo kasɔ kelenye mmɔ,
na baƒonu ɔdane ɔdi
ɔsɔ ulawia nwuna bebuo katɛnkɔ na mmɔ.
21Bakumbuo kani ndubɔƒɔ mmɔ belie
ku bekuku ku baasɛ bonwu lidu.
22Na bebuoƒuala ndubo adi buteebo
na bana ala abuni kesekɔ,
na beƒukutu bataatɛ bana kuliekɔ kɔbuni
kɔni baaƒɔ́ baƒɔ.
Na uwi ɔmmɔ úude geen,
na ɔsɔ ulésie kama lɛnɔ.

Title: YESAIA 14
Content:
1Unwoti ɔdubo Israelƒuɔ kɔnyana bɔnu,
na ɔsɔ ɔƒuna-ma,
na ɔsɔku-ma utésie bana keliekɔ
na bana kalɔ lɛlɔ.
Baƒɔ badubɔsalaku-ma
na bablaku Israelƒuɔ unwi.
2Na kadi bamba bekyuli
ndubo-ma butiku na beti-ma besienku bana kalɔ lɛlɔ.
Na Israelƒuɔ beti-ma benwini bana banana
ku beleku kabla bablane na Unwoti kalɔ kammɔ lɛlɔ.
Na kadi bani néƒie-ma bátɔlɔku
na bénye-ma lɛlɔ na baabla bana kabla ni,
Israelƒuɔ mmomu badubo bunwini bunye-ma lɛlɔ
na bataabla-ma kabla.
3Na limeyi lɛni na Unwoti ɔdubɔya na bɛlɛ bina lɛbibo ku lɛlɔ bukpoku ku kalɛ na benye-mii lɛlɔ na bɛɛbla bekyuli bamba kabla kemmo ni, 4bɛdubo ɔnu bɔnwi bɔsia Babel ɔga na bɛsu bɛnini,
“Báyila ɔyikune ɔmmɔ udu!
Na nwuna kɔnyi kpakplaa ku lɛlɔ bɔtina bɔmmɔ kenye kékulo!
5Unwoti ɔ́ƒɛ balalane ɔgagyii,
lɛlɔ badine bammɔ likposela,
6lɛni na bada baadú bekyuli ku kɔnyi,
na baláda baláya uwi ɔdi.
Na ɔmmɔ udu na béti baadi kɔlɔ ƒui lɛlɔ,
na balásɔ bana likyulikpi kama.
7Kayawi ƒui kábla buɛɛ
na ukyuli biala atu áyɔ
na békeyi lɛnu na benye beedie.
8Egyii enengudi gyɛnglɛɛ ammɔ muedi,
lɛlɔ lɛɛyɔ́-nya na Lebanon kalɔ banini,
‘Ɔni na bébo-ɔ kalɔ ɔƒɛni amu ni,
ala ɔnwine ɔdi ɔsɔ ulebo ulabada-bu uláva kalɔ.’ ”
9Kekpine muedi owogyo úwi,
na lɛlɔ badine bani lɛnɔ néesie kekpine mmɔ
báta babasiaku-ɔ ka bánu-ɔ ka ási adubo.
10Na baasu ku lɛdi linwi banini,
“Abu ku-ɔ búlie,
ɔsika kablakɔ kása awɔ lɛnɔ aani abu.”
11Ƒula kenyekɔ ku ɔyikun ɔ́sa,
ɔsika báva awɔ ku ƒula lɛbentaa ku lɛnu ƒui,
na atɛ beklubi lɛlɔ, na bani bewi-ɔ lɛlɔ.
12O ukyuli ɔni muukeye aani ɔtanta lɛyabi
na ese aani ɔtanta kadi bugye!
Nu kalɛ báya-a na ánu ási katɔ katɔ
kesii kani na élie ábayu kalɔ lɛlɔ mɛni,
Awɔ ɔni na nka ákɔ kayawi ƒui bekyuli ásɔ!
13Awɔ mɔɔsu na ƒula kayi kemmo anii,
“Ndubɔkɔ lisie katɔ katɔ
ntése mina liboku na mmɔ
na keliekɔ kammɔ kebo kavi Katɔti ayabi,
na ndubulie kɔbi kedee kɔmmɔ lɛlɔ katɔ ƒui,
ntaadi katɔ bayikune bani ƒui mɔɔsála mmɔ lɛlɔ.
14Na ndubɔkɔ lisie katɔ katɔ ƒui,
na ami ku Unwoti Ɔyikune Ƒui bɔdubɔbla likeke.”
15Nsu aanu-ɔ mɛni
na báayula kalɔ na ébeduo kekpine
na ubu kemmo mɛni.
16Na bekyuli ƒui bágyu anumi bálɛ-ɔ
baanu-ɔ kaduɛ, na béye banini,
“Awɔ ndi nkyuli ɔni nágyu kayawi éti
átaatanyi-ka dii mmɔ?
17Na awɔ nésusu kayawi kammɔ
na kénwini kalɔ kakwiidi,
na ábwɛ lɛma linengudi
na étete kuƒi ka bekyuli bani na éƒie
basɔ benwini besie bana lɛma?”
18Baga bani na békpi mmɔ ƒui
batɛ bana kɔƒiɔtɔ kemmo ku bana agala.
19Nsu aanu-ɔ na béƒwimi bábava mɛni
aani kalɛ na baavá kaƒɔ kebiledi,
na bekyuli bani na áya na bátu kuwii bádu
ubugya ɔ́ƒɔ-ɔ lɛlɔ ƒui.
20Na baaadubo-ɔ bɔva bubunku bakladi
kalɛ na báva ama,
ɔsika ébile ƒula kalɔ na ádu ƒula bekyuli.
Ukyuli ukpidi bebi ni,
basɔ baaadubo-ma anyi bɔkpali kudii.
21Bɛklibi kesii kadi
na bɛdu alaekpidi ɔblane ɔmɛni bebi,
na bana bati ekpidi ɔsu.
Na ɔdi ɔsɔ utakɔ utetédu ka ɔɔkɛ́ ɔyikun
na ɔsɔ utaadi kayawi lɛlɔ,
na ɔtu lɛma linengudi uyile kalɔ lɛlɔ.
22Unwoti Ɔyikune Ƒui ɔnini,
“Ndubunye litile Babelƒuɔ kuƒi,
na bana lɛnyi lɛmmɔ lɛyii udu.
Na bana ɛlɛɛ bani mebu ku bana bawɔ ƒui
ndubo-ma bɔkyula.
23Ndubɔya na mmɔ kenwini bekuku keliekɔ
ku ntu ku lɛba sɔɔn.
Ndubɔyila-ma ƒui
na lɛkpala-ma aani uƒiɔ kalɛ lɛkyula.”
Básu Kenye Kadi Na Asiria Lɛlɔ
24Unwoti Ɔyikune Ƒui úse kenye ɔnini,
“Kasusu biala na lɛ́bla líse ni,
ndubɔya na kebo-nwu kemmo lɛni kani
na mina bɔyɔ kenye.
25Ndubo Asiriaƒuɔ udu bɔyila na mina kalɔ,
na lɛkɔ-ma lɛbwɛ kpɛtɛ kpɛtɛ na mina kɔbi lɛlɔ,
ama bani nákɔ belie mina bekyuli lɛlɔ,
na lidie bana lɛbibo kɔgba kɔni nda Israelƒuɔ,
na bana etila atimi mina bekyuli lɛlɔ.”
26Unwoti ɔ́bla kasusu kadi úse
úte kayawi kemodi kammɔ ƒui,
ɔsika nwuna ɔyikun unengudi ɔmmɔ
ɔ́ƒɔ kayawi kammɔ kesii biala,
27na úudie kɔnu úse na kɔnyi kemmo
ka ɔni kayawi kɔtu na ɔdi uletile-nwu kuƒi.
Básu Kenye Kadi Na Ƒilistiƒuɔ Lɛlɔ
28Lɛkwa lɛni na Ɔga Ahas úkpi ni,
anwu na Unwoti úti kenye kamɛni úte-mi.
29Ɔƒɛni amii Ƒilistiƒuɔ ni, lɛlɔ litayɔ-mii tɔ bɛnii
bina ugyii ɔdadi ɔni ndi ɔga ɔmmɔ ɔ́ƒɛ.
Ɔsika kɔlakpi kukpidi ubi ni,
use aani kugyii ugyiitu ukpidi bɔta.
Kuna ebi adi avan ɔni mɔɔtu ku ugyulo ukpidi.
30Ndubute bawabane geen ƒui na badi
aani baƒonu ɔdane buni kalɛ
na bani mɔɔyaki ƒui batɛ ku banwuna.
Nsu amii ni, ndubɔya na kɔka kɔdu-mii ƒui
na bɛyii udu ku ligyiitu.
31O amii Ƒilistiƒuɔ! Biteewulo na biteedumo,
na bina lɛma linengudi lɛmmɔ kemmo
ku bina lɛma ɔban kenye,
na bɛyu biwi kalɔ ku bɔyia,
na bɛnu bina bekisine uyɔ
ka ɔ́si katɔ kakɛ ɔ́yu ɔdubo,
na bɛnu bekpone bammɔ
kalɛ na básala lɛlɔ badubo gbini gbini.
32Bi kenye na bɔdubudie bute bekisine bammɔ
si banii bana batu badi bébeye lɛla lɛdi?
Bɔdubɔsu-ma bɔnini,
“Unwoti úse katamikukɔ úse Sion,
na nwuna bekyuli bani ƒui na baanya taakya
badubɔkɛ katamikukɔ.”

Title: YESAIA 15
Content:
Yesaia Ɔ́su Kenye Kadi Ɔ́siku Moab Kalɔ Lɛlɔ
1Kenye kamɛni kaatina lɛla lɛdi na Ar ku Kir Moab lɛma linengudi lɛlɔ.
Usien unwi kani na bábwɛ lɛma
lɛmmɔ na lɛ́yii udu ƒui!
2Dibon ɔma bekyuli
bákɔ bésie kɔbi lɛlɔ, na bana baƒiɔ kɔdu,
na Moab kalɔ bekyuli ƒui béwulo
na Medeba ɔma lili.
Békpeyi bana eli ku kuduo ƒui.
3Na bakɛ bana ɔma kemmo lilu lɛlɔ ƒui,
na benyimi adikpi,
ani mɔɔtina ka beewulo kɔnyana.
Na benye kadi kasakɔ ku lɛsa eli
na keku kada ƒioƒiooƒio na báyu bewi kalɔ.
4Na kɔvanu ku keku kani nda momoomo
na Hesbon ku Eleale lɛma linengudi kemmo,
na kɔku kɔmmɔ kuusié ɔgyu teetédu Yahas ɔma kemmo.
Ɔkɛnku ɔmmɔ ɔsu liƒu líƒie
Moab kalɔ bekpone bammɔ
na ama lɛnɔ bése kalɔ baava na ɔƒɛƒɛɛ ɔ́sa-ma.
5Mina kayi keenú ɔlɛ teete Moab kadi bekyuli,
ka bana bekyuli beekeli kekpo
béti bésela Soa ku Eglat-Selesia lɛma kakaaka ƒui.
Béti Luhit ɔma ulu na bákɔ bésela na beewulo.
Na bakɛ baaká bana ɔgbankpi ala ku kɔnyana
na Horonaim ɔma ulu lɛlɔ.
6Nimrim ntukpa bɔ́kwii!
Na ɔƒɛ ɔ́du utubili livo
lɛmmɔ ƒui,
na livo lɛdi lɛsɔ liiide mmɔ.
7Anwuɔsu akɛla ani na bábla
na báklibi bese lɛlɔ ni,
béti-nya na bávia utukwalɛ
ketudɔ egyii gyɛnglɛɛ ammɔ kemmo bátɔlɔku.
8Na kɔku kɔni na Moab kalɔ lɛlɔ bekyuli baabla ni,
kɔvanu kɔmmɔ ku kɔnyana etemila
aaku teetéwi Eglaim
na ɔkɛ mmɔ útédu Ber-Elim
na kalɔ kammɔ ɔmii lɛlɔ muedi.
9Dibon ketu ntu bɔ́ƒɔ ubugya,
nsu ubugya ɔni nsɔ ndubo kama uuuse buɛɛ.
Na Moabƒuɔ bani na banii bukeli na bada ni,
gyata na ndubo budie bɔkya-ma
ku bana ɛlɛɛ bani nébu ƒui.

Title: YESAIA 16
Content:
1Moabƒuɔ, biti baƒonu bɛsiku Sela ɔma
aani lɛlɔ bɔdi kayu bitéte kalɔ kammɔ lɛlɔ ɔdine
na bɛsia kalɔ kakwiidi kammɔ bisie Sion Kɔbi lɛlɔ.
2Moabƒuɔ beleku bese aani baasɛ
bani na bábɔku bálɛku ayu kemmo
na batɛ Arnon Ketu kaviakɔ mmɔ.
3“Bɛbla kasusu kabuni kadi bɛsiku-bu lɛlɔ,
na bɛlɛ ugyii ka bɛdubɔgyumana-bu
bula bekisine ɔsu aani kugyii ɔyuli
ɔni nse aani usien si kadi kábi yayaaya,
na bɛbɛla abu bani na baabɔku.
4Bɛya na abu Moabƒuɔ bekeline
bɔkɛ kakyakɔ na bina kudɔ,
na binwini katamikukɔ bite-bu
na bula bekisine ɔsu.”
Bekyuli bekpidi uwi ɔdubo bɔsa,
na bekyuli udu bɔyila bɔwɔ ulu.
Na bekyuli bani nkɛ mɔɔbɔku bekyuli bamba
na baayila-ma udu uwi ku ɔyikun ɔsa,
na bayii udu na kalɔ kammɔ ƒui lɛlɔ.
5Ɔmmɔ kama ni, badubuse lɛga kadikɔ kadi bese,
na kadanku bɔyɔ ute
bekyuli ƒui.
Na ukyuli ɔni mɔɔdi litemi lɛlɔ ulu lɛlɔ
ndubo lɛga lɛmmɔ bɔdi.
Na ɔ́si Dawid ɔtɔ kemmo.
Na anwu mɔɔtɛ litemi na ulu geen ɔmmɔ lɛlɔ.
Na ɔɔbabla taasia anu taabla lɛla biala siin.
6Mmɔ na ama básu banini,
“Búnu Moab kadi bekyuli lɛlɔtina.
Na bɔ́ti kalɛ na beekú lɛlɔ na balábu,
ku kalɛ na baakɔliku lɛlɔ katɔ ukpludi.”
7Anwuɔsu bɛya na Moab kadi bekyuli
bakɛ beteewulo kɔnyana taavi,
na bana lɛlɔ lɛni mɔɔkywí-ma ɔsu.
Na badubo buwulo na emini ani bádi ɔsu,
na bana ɔma unengudi na Kirhaset.
8Edula mmo bɔni na Hesbon bɔ́yɛyɛ,
na adingyii mmo bɔni na Sibma lɛnɔ bɔ́yɛyɛ.
Na egyiibi ani lɛbuli nébimi lísie Yaser muedi
kalɔ kammɔ lɛlɔ badine bésusu-ku bébile.
9Ɔmmɔ ɔsu na muuwulo ku Yaser,
na egyiibi ani náyii udu na Sibma ɔsu.
O Hesbon, muuwulo teete awɔ ku Eleale ƒui.
Ɔsika bɛsɔ bɛɛɛdubo egyiibi bɔkɛ bude ana udewi
na ebiti ada-mii ku lɛlɔyɔ.
10Egyiibi mmo bɔmmɔ bɔsɔ buláda kubiti,
na elénu ka ɔdi ɔɔtu ɔnu ɔdi iye lɛlɔyɔ kɔvanu kɔdi,
na ɔdi uuubo ntɛ kebulokɔ uláka egyiibi adi ntu,
ɔsika lɛlɔyɔ ƒui kenye kékulo.
11Mina kayi keewulo ku Moabƒuɔ kɔnyana
aani si ɔbentaa na nda muudie kɔnyana lɛnu,
na Kirhaset litemi liikpóku-mii geen.
12Moabƒuɔ béetu lɛlɔ bésie bana baƒiɔ kɔdu
na bátákpali na abi lɛlɔ, nsu kekeeke.
13Geen ni, ala amɛni udu na Unwoti ɔ́su úse na Moab kadi bekyuli lɛlɔ úbavi kukuuku. 14Nsu ɔƒɛni ni, Unwoti ɔnini, “Na akwa atɛ kemmo pɛpɛɛpɛ aani kalɛ na kabla ɔblane ɔɔká nwuna emeyi ani nébu na nwuna ɔtɔlati kudɔ na ɔbla-nwu kabla ni, Moab kalɔ kemodi ku nwuna akɛla ku nwuna bumomo ku lɛnyi lɛni na ɔ́ƒɔ na uukeye mmɔ lɛdubo bɔyii ku udu. Na bana ɛlɛɛ kani mebu na basɔ balákɛ ɔyikun ɔdi lɛnɔ.”

Title: YESAIA 17
Content:
Unwoti Údie Lɛla Kpakplaa Ɔ́tina Na Damasko Lɛlɔ
1Damasko lɛlɔ kɔtɛ.
“Bɛnu! Damasko ɔma unengudi ɔdubɔyii udu
na ɔƒaamu ɔdubunwini alakpi kebu bonwu kadi.
2Na lɛma linengudi lɛni na nwuna amadɔ ƒui
lɛdubunwini baƒonu katɛnkɔ,
na ukyuli ɔdi ulabɔku-ma.
3Eƒraim ɔma unengudi,
ɔni na awodu bonwu aagyumana
ɔdubɔyii udu na ɔsɔ ulakya,
na Damasko lɛga kadikɔ
kabwɛ ƒui,
na Aram kadi nkyuli ɛlɛɛ bani mebu
badubɔyila bana bukeye aani Israelƒuɔ.”
Lɛni na Unwoti Ɔyikune Ƒui ɔ́su.
4“Na limeyi lɛmmɔ lɛlɔ ni,
ala ani ƒui na Israel ubo ɔsu na uukeye adubɔyii udu,
ɔsika ayaki adubo kalɔ kammɔ bɔda geen.
5Na kalɔ kammɔ kadubɔbla
aani kemo kani na
umonsene údie atu,
uwi ɔni na báaƒɛ edula
abunidi ƒui,
ani nnye ku ebi sɛɛn bédie-ka kemmo.
Lɛni geen na ɔdubuse aani Raƒaƒuɔ Kɔwɛ kemo
kani kemmo na bávi bála lɛmuyɔ ƒui.
6Nsu bana ɛlɛɛ badi badubo bubu
aani kalɛ na beeti ugyii
ku asɔsɔ
teede kɔdingyii ebi ƒui
na kebu ɛlɛɛ na kayɔlɔ
kɔgba akɔ.
Lɛni na Unwoti Israel Katɔti ɔ́su.”
7Uwi ɔmmɔ ni,
bekyuli badubunwini banu bana Udiene
Israel Katɔti ɔni nse kedee.
8Na basɔ belésie bana akpabi
ani na béti bana enu bávɔ béte lɛlɔ kudɔ,
na basɔ beleti anu balasia Asera ɔƒiɔgyii
ku nwuna lɛlɔ ala ku oloƒui bɔkyula akpabi
ani na ama alati bátu mmɔ.
9Na uwi ɔmmɔ kemmo ni, bana lɛma lɛni na baagyumana kpakplaa na Israelƒuɔ bábɔku-ma bédie mmɔ lɛdubo bɔbwɛ na línwini aku.
10Bɛ́yiƒala bina Katɔti ɔni mɔɔƒɔ́-mii ngba,
na bítenyimo bina kagyumanakɔ kpakplaa
kani ndi lɛtakpɛ lɛni lɛlɔ na bíkpo kama.
Ɔkɛnku ɔmmɔ ɔsu ni, ina ka bɛ́lɛ egyii abuni,
na bíye adingyii abuni bɛ́siku kaƒɔ bíbalɛ,
11na bɛ́nu-nya lɛlɔ ɔ́si ɔnta na áta álɛ lili kaduɛ ni,
bilákɛ-nya biléde ɔsika bɛdubuduo
lɛbibo ku bɔnɔ geen kemmo na nwuna kenye kelékulo.
12Binu bekyuli lisu kɔnyi kɔku kɔni ndubo,
kɔku kɔni nse aani ɛpu ɔni mɔɔnwanɛ lɛlɔ,
na uubó teebewi utubili!
Binu kalɛ na badubo ku kudu ku kɔnyi.
13Nsu ina ka bábla kudu ku kɔnyi badubo lɛni ni,
Unwoti ɔdubo-ma bɔbɔku busienku kama,
aani kalɛ na ɔƒɛƒɛɛ uuƒwi aƒata taayulaku abi,
iye kalɛ na ɔƒɛƒɛɛ uuduo kɔnwinimi kemmo taakya ligede.
14Bekisine bákya-bu liƒu ku bɔyia geen useyi uwi,
nsu kadi bugye ni, bana ƒui báyii bákya.
Bekyuli bani muukpóku-bu lɛyuƒɔla lɛdi mmɔ.

Title: YESAIA 18
Content:
Básu Kenye Kadi Básiku Kus Lɛlɔ
1Bɔbuɛ beete kɔlɔ kɔni lɛlɔ
na baalɔlɔ bani avwi
mɔɔbla kɔku mɛni bakya,
na Kus kalɔ kemmo
ntukpa adɔ,
2ama bani nátala batu na bakɛ ɛpu lɛlɔ badubo,
na beli lɛkɔlɔ lɛni bánwi ku ketu kemmo ligyii kemmo.
Biti usi momoomo na bisie kalɔ kani bekyuli nákuku
na bana ɔlɔgyii use suɛlɛ suɛlɛ na ɔɔdia bɔnu kudɔ.
Bekyuli bebo-ma lɛlɔ liƒu úsie ɔgyu ɔ́mana
na bana kɔnyi ku kalala kani na baabla bekyuli ɔsu,
bekyuli bani na ntukpa búle-ma kalɔ kemmo ƒui bɔ́vi.
3Amii bayawine ƒui,
ku amii bani na bilie kalɔ lɛlɔ mɛni,
bɛdubo bɔnu aƒlaga ɔdi
si bákɔliku-nwu katɔ
na abi lɛlɔ,
na binu kakpɛɛ kadi kɔku si bávwi-ka.
4Lɛni na Katɔti ɔ́su-mi ɔnini,
“Ndubulie mina keliekɔ ntaanu kpoo,
aani kalɛ na ɔƒɛ ɔɔyá na kadi kaabi,
iye edula ɔƒɛwi liwulu lɛɛyá na amii aayu.”
5Ɔsika asa na badubɔƒɛ edula ammɔ,
kugyii kɔni anwula
nénwini ebi
na égyie na édu bɔƒɛ mmɔ ni,
Katɔti ɔdubuti kewii na udie kɔgba wɛlɛ wɛlɛ kɔmmɔ,
na ɔmɛnɛ kɔgba kunengudi kɔmmɔ uwi kalɔ.
6Lɛni na bekpone bammɔ ɔlɔna ɔdubuwi ɔmana
ute baasɛ bani muuƒie na abi lɛlɔ ku bakumbuo,
na baasɛ bammɔ babaduli-ma kaƒɛndi
na bakumbuo bammɔ bɔduli-ma kɔyɔ uwi ƒui.
7Na uwi ɔmmɔ kemmo ni,
bekyuli bani nákuku ku ɔlɔna suɛlɛ suɛlɛ mɛni,
na bana lɛlɔ libo liƒu úsie ɔgyu ɔ́mana mmɔ,
na bana kɔnyi ku kalala kani na baabla bekyuli ɔsu,
na ntukpa búle-ma kalɔ kemmo bɔ́vi ƒui,
badubuti etela beboku Unwoti Ɔyikune Ƒui.
Na etela ammɔ adubuse Sion Kɔbi lɛlɔ kesii kani na baakpá Unwoti Ɔyikune Ƒui.

Title: YESAIA 19
Content:
Katɔti Ɔ́su Kenye Kadi Ɔ́siku Egyipte Lɛlɔ
1Linyesia lɛmɛni lɛdanku Egyipte kalɔ lɛlɔ.
Bɛnu! Unwoti uli liƒlukutu bonwu lɛdi lɛlɔ,
na ɔkɛ ku usi momoomo úsela Egyipte kalɔ lɛlɔ,
na lɛlɔ lɛɛtɔ́ Egyipteƒuɔ baƒiɔ ku liƒu bonwu.
Na Egyipteƒuɔ bammɔ alati báyɛyɛ,
na enu áƒɛ-ma na bɔyia ɔsu.
2Ɔsika Unwoti ɔnini,
“Ndubɔtu-ma lɛkya ama alati lɛlɔ lɛlɔ,
na ama Egyipteƒuɔ lɛti lɛti bekpoku lɛlɔ.
Ɔnwa ɔnanabi ɔdubukpoku ɔnwani ɔnanabi,
na ɔkpana ukpoku ɔkpana,
na ɔma ɔta na ukpoku ɔma
na kalɛkɛ kata kekpoku kalɛkɛ.
3Na enu adubɔƒɛ Egyipteƒuɔ.
Na libile bana kɔkwɛ ƒui,
na beye kasiakɔ basiku bana baƒiɔ ku bekpine,
ku bekebone ku bevone kudɔ banɔ.
4Na ndubuti Egyipteƒuɔ lɛkya
ɔga lɛlɔ ɔdine ulikplune kalɔ,
na ɔlalane ɔdi-ma lɛlɔ.”
5Nil Ketu kadubo bɔkwii kede kede,
na ntu bɔdi bɔsɔ bulakya-ka kemmo,
na kana kavikɔ kenwini kalɔkplu.
6Ntukpa bɔni nákya kenye Nil kemmo ƒui
bɔdubo bɔda na buteenwenyi buɛ buɛ.
Na Egyipte ntukpa bɔmmɔ butaakpɛ na bɔkwii ƒui,
na ketu kemmo egyii mmɔ ƒui
ekpi ayii udu na akwii enye,
7Na mmo bɔni na bése mmɔ ƒui bɔyii udu
ku ketu kenye ku amadɔ egyii ammɔ ƒui.
8Kɔbɛ bediene badubo kɔnyana buteewulo,
na bani mɔɔtu lɛdaa ku lɛsawu bewine ƒui
badubo enu butaaƒɛ ku kɔnyana.
9Lɛbuli lidu adi bedine badubɔyila lɛnunsia,
na bani mɔɔbla adi kpɛtɛ kpɛtɛ basɔ baláti kalɛ babla.
10Kayi kadubo bedine butaakpulu
na kayu kenye kabla bablane beƒu.
11Kɔdɔlɔ kútulo amii Soan ɔma kasusu betine,
na amii bani ndi Ƒarao kelisa benengu kasusu
kasɔ kalalɛ bekyuli kɔsia kɔdi.
Dɛ na ɔdi ɔdubɔkana na ɔsu Ƒarao ɔnii,
“Ami ndi banundane bammɔ akɔ unwi
na kuuku baga bammɔ kudɔ na lɛ́tɛya ala?”
12Wɛ na bina banundane bammɔ bávi ɔƒɛni amu?
Bɛya na basu-mii na binu
kasusu kani na Unwoti ubo na Egyipte lɛlɔ.
13Soan ɔma kasusu betine bénwini badɔlɔdi.
Na Memƒis ɔma benengu béƒu ku ɔkɔ etemila,
na bekyuli bani lɛlɔ na Egyipte úkpo kama
bákpanku-ma bésela batáyila.
14Unwoti ɔ́ya na lɛlɛɛ kɔyu
kɔni mɔɔbla ukyuli gyuma gyuma
mɔɔdi Egyipteƒuɔ lɛlɔ.
Anwuɔsu na baagbánta
na bana lɛla biala na baabla kemmo,
aani kalɛ na ntɛkpine ɔɔdada
na nwuna kɔdala akɔ.
15Egyipteƒuɔ basɔ beeebo lɛla lɛdi bɔbla,
bati o-o, beni o-o, bebi o-o,
ɔdi ɔsɔ uuubo lɛla lɛdi bɔbla lɛnɔ.
16Na limeyi lɛmmɔ lɛlɔ ni, Egyipteƒuɔ badubɔta babla aani beleku, na lɛlɔ litaatɔ-ma geen ku bɔyia na Unwoti Katɔti kɔnu kɔni na ɔ́talaku katɔ ɔnii ɔɔƒiɛmi-ma ɔsu. 17Na si bénu ka ukyuli ɔdi ɔ́lɔ Israel lɛnyi muedi ni, liƒu lɛdubuƒie-ma na kayi kemmo na lɛla lɛni na Unwoti ɔ́ɔklibi lɛlɔ úse ka ɔbla Egyipteƒuɔ ɔsu.
18Ɔmmɔ kama ni, Egyipteƒuɔ lɛma linengudi ɛlɔ badubɔtɛmi Kanaan lɛdi na badubuse kenye ka béti lɛlɔ béte Unwoti Katɔti kadi ƒui Unwoti. Na lɛma lɛmmɔ akɔ unwi baalɔ banii Ɔƒɛ ɔma unengudi.
19Na batu lɛkpabi na Egyipte kalɔ kemmo ntɛntɛ, na balɛ likpose lɛkpa lɛdi na lɛkpabi lɛmmɔ kɔmadɔ na ɔmii lɛlɔ. 20Likposela lɛmɛni muudie kenye ka Unwoti Katɔti ɔdubo butaanu na Egyipte kalɔ kammɔ lɛlɔ na si báva bákpali-nwu na bekisine bukpoku ɔsu ni, na Katɔti uti ɔƒɔne ɔdi umene-ma na ubebunku-ma na bakɛ bɔƒɔ. 21Na mmɔ na Egyipteƒuɔ badubɔnu bɔti ukyuli ɔni na Unwoti ɔdi na bataakpa-nwu na bataakyula akpala ku etela bamba lɛnɔ teete-nwu. Badubuse kenye bete-nwu na badi linyese lɛmmɔ lɛlɔ lɛnɔ. 22Unwoti ɔdubo Egyipteƒuɔ bubo bɔkya ɔlɛ, nsu anwu kani ndubo-ma lɛlɛ lɛmmɔ bunyimi na ɔbwi-ma. Ɔsika ɔdububo-ma kalɛ na benwini bebo-nwu kudɔ, na si békpi-nwu kɔtɔ ni, na unu-ma buvele na ɔbla lɛla lɛni na bévele-nwu ute-ma na ɔbwi-ma.
23Uwi ɔmmɔ ni, ulu unengudi ɔdi ɔdubo bɔtɛ bɔsi Egyipte usie Asiria na Asiria ku Egyipte kadi bekyuli besie basɔ betenku lɛlɔ. Na kalɔ akpa anyɔ amɛni bekyuli bakpa Unwoti basala. 24Na uwi ɔmmɔ kemmo ni, Israel ku Egyipte ku Asiria kalɔ bekyuli badubɔbla kadi akpa atɛ bani ndubo bɔsala na benwini kusɛ kusɛ bete bayawine ƒui. 25Unwoti Katɔti ɔdubute-ma kusɛ kusɛ na ɔ́su ɔnini, “Kusɛ kusɛ ɔdubɔsiaku Egyipte mina kadi bekyuli ku Asiriaƒuɔ bani ndi mina enu kabla ku badi mina bekyuli na Asiria kadi bekyuli ku Israel kadi bani bekyuli na lɛ́ƒuna líte lɛlɔ.”

Title: YESAIA 20
Content:
Básu Kenye Kadi Bése Na Egyipte Ku Kus Lɛlɔ
1Na uwi ɔni kemmo na Asiria Ɔga Sagon ɔ́tala nwuna bekpone ɔtɔnkune ƒui kekpo ka usie útékpo na ɔ́ƒɔ Ƒilistiƒuɔ ɔma unengudi ɔni baalɔ Asdod ni, 2uwi ɔmmɔ kemmo na Unwoti Katɔti ɔ́su Amos ubidi Yesaia kenye kadi ɔnini, “Da ƒula lɛgbanvuo ku lɛla lɛni na asabla die.” Na Yesaia lɛnɔ ɔ́bla lɛni ɔni na ɔsɔ ɔɔɔkya lɛgbanvuo iye adala adi.
3Amu na Unwoti ɔ́sɔ ɔ́su ɔnini, “Kalɛ na mina kabla ɔblane Yesaia úsie ɔ́vi akwa atɛ na ɔɔɔda lɛla lɛdi na ɔɔɔkya lɛgbanvuo lɛnɔ úti ɔ́tina lɛla lɛni ndubo bɔlɛku Egyipte ku Kus lɛlɔ ni, 4lɛni na Asiriaƒuɔ ɔga ɔdubo Egyipteƒuɔ ku Kusƒuɔ benengu ku banamu ƒui buƒie bɔtɔlɔku ku kasɔngya na balada adala iye bakya lɛgbanvuo lɛdi, na ɔdubɔbla Egyipteƒuɔ kɔƒa geen. 5Kadi bani mɔɔsia Kusƒuɔ anu na baakun lɛmɛnɛ na Egyipte lɛlɔ ni, badubɔnu ɔmɛni na bayia geen na kɔƒa lɛnɔ kukpo-ma. 6Na uwi ɔmmɔ kemmo ni, kadi bani nli Ƒilistia ɛpu kɔtɔ badubɔsu banii, ‘Bɛnu lɛla lɛni nálɛku kadi bani bekyuli na bɔɔkali ka bukeli butátamiku na bebunku-bu na bɔlɛ Asiriaƒuɔ enu kemmo. Bi na badubo bɔbla ɔƒɛni? Na wɛ na bɔdubɔsɔ bukeli busie?’ ”

Title: YESAIA 21
Content:
Katɔti Ɔ́su Kenye Kadi Úse Na Babel Lɛlɔ
1Unwoti údie lɛla lɛdi ɔ́tina na ɔdanku Babel.
Kalɔ kakwiidi kani nwi ɛpu kɔmadɔ mmɔ lɛlɔ
aani ɔƒɛƒɛɛ kpakplaa ɔni mɔɔkya ligede
na uukpó na kalɔ kakwiidi kani na kada kakɛ mmɔ lɛlɔ,
ala ubilene ɔdi ɔ́si kalɔ kakwiidi ɔni
kani mɔɔda liƒu mmɔ lɛlɔ ɔdubo,
lɛni na lɛla lɛni ndubo libebile ala na Babel
lɛ́ɛsi kalɔ kakwiidi kani bekyuli lɛlɔ mbo liƒu mmɔ lɛlɔ lɛdububo.
2Katɔti údie liƒu lɛla bonwu lɛdi ɔ́tina-mi.
Na lɛ́nu ulikplu ku kalala ala bɔbla ani na aládia bɔnu,
bekyuli beedie bana bakpana teete,
na babambadi beeƒie bekyuli ala taaƒɔ.
Na kɔvanu kɔda, Elamƒuɔ bikpo-ma!
Na amii Mediaƒuɔ, bɛka lɛma linengudi lɛmmɔ bɛkya!
Na keku ku kɔnyana buwulo bɔni na ɔ́kya bekyuli
ndubukulo-nwu kenye.
3Lɛla lɛmɛni lɛ́ya na mina kaƒɔna kádu-mi momoomo
aani uleku ɔni ntɛ kɔwɔ,
na ɔ́bla-mi aani bɔyila na nda
ka línu lɛla lɛni na Katɔti ɔɔwia ka ɔbla.
Lɛni na anumi ábla-mi suu
na ɔ́bla-mi dɛye dɛye.
4Mina kasusu kéƒu,
na mina kayi kaagyú taawɔ na bɔyia ɔsu.
Na useyi uwi ɔni mɔɔwia ku udu na lɛnwuna ni,
liƒu ala ani na mɔɔnu ɔsu
naaakana lɛnumi bubile.
5Báklibi kadikɔ ku kuliekɔ kabuni bése,
na badubo bɔdi na bani!
Amii batɔnkune bammɔ, bɛta kɔnakunwi
biti bina agyumanala na bísusu-ku nnɔmii!
6Lɛla bamba lɛni na Katɔti ɔ́su-mi ndi ɔnini,
“Wia ɔgyumanane ɔdi nyene kesii kadi,
na utaanu ala ani mɔɔlɛ́ taasu-ɔ.
7Na si ɔ́nu bekyuli bani nlie bapɔnkɔ lɛlɔ,
ku bani nlie bebuo ala betine geen
ku benengudi bani mbo keƒu lɛlɔ ni,
ɔsia-ma anu kaduɛ na ɔsu-ɔ lɛla biala.”
8Na ɔgyumanane ɔmɛni ɔdubɔkpali ɔsu ɔnini,
“O Unwoti, nnye mina bagyumanane ɔsangya na katɔ mɛni,
kesii kani na ése-mi usien ku ɔƒɛ umodi ƒui, limeyi ndi limeyi.
9Bɛnu! Aanu kɛɛkɛ ku ukyuli ɔdi na bapɔnkɔ báni badububoku
na bekpone lisu lɛdi belie bapɔnkɔ lɛlɔ na báda baalɛ́!
Mmɔ ni, ukyuli ɔmmɔ údie lɛdi na ɔɔsu ɔnini,
‘Úbuli o-o, Babel úbuli na nwuna baƒiɔ bani na ɔ́nwi
ku bani na ɔ́vɔ ƒui ni, bábwɛ-ma béwi kalɔ!’ ”
10O amii, mina bekyuli, bésusu-mii
aani kalɛ na beewiile edula ebi teewi kakpa,
na mɔɔsu-mii lɛla lɛni na Unwoti Ɔyikune Ƒui,
Israel Katɔti, ɔ́su-mi ɔnii mbasu-mii.
Yesaia Ɔ́tɛmi Ɔ́siku Edom Ku Duma Lɛlɔ
11Unwoti údie lɛla lɛdi ɔ́tina na Duma kalɔ lɛlɔ.
Na línu ka ukyuli ɔdi ɔ́kpali-mi ɔ́siku Seir abi lɛlɔ ɔnini,
“Ɔgyumanane, usien uwi ɔmani kemmo na bɔkya mɛni?
Na uwi ɛlɛ asa na kadi kadubugye?”
12Mmɔ na ɔgyumanane ɔmmɔ údie kenye ɔnini,
“Kadi aka kéegye káwɔlɔ, nsu ɔƒɛ ɔsɔ ɔdubo bɔsa.
Na si aayɔ́ enu lɛla lɛmɛni kalɔ ebu ni,
na asɔ enwini ebo ebeye-mi kaduɛ.”
13Unwoti údie lɛla lɛdi ɔ́tina Arabia kalɔ lɛlɔ.
O amii bekyuli lisu bonwu
bani nékeli bɛ́si Dedan
kalɔ lɛlɔ
na bíbo bíbawia kabɛkɔ na Arabia kalɔ alakpi akɔ,
14amii Tema ɔma bekyuli,
biti adila ku ntu biboku baƒɔ bani na utukwɛ ɔɔda,
baƒɔ bani nékeli bana ɔma mɛni.
15Kuwii ku kɔtaminta atula
yayaaya kenye na békeli bási,
na kekpo kani nányi anyi mmɔ kemmo.
16Unwoti ɔ́sɔ ɔ́su ala bamba lɛnɔ ɔnini, “Na lɛkwa linwi kemmo pɛpɛɛpɛ kalɛ kani na ukyuli ɔni na bése ɔkpa ɔɔká nwuna emeyi ani na ɔdubɔbla kabla ute nwuna ɔtɔlati ni, Kedar kadi bekyuli badubɔyila bana ala ani ƒui na bebo ɔsu na bebo ɔyikun na báƒɔ lɛnyi. 17Na bayikune pii bani náƒɔ lɛnyi na Kedar bekpone akɔ bani mɔɔní kɔtaminta teebo atula teetulo ni, bana ɛlɛɛ kani mebu. Ami, Unwoti Israel Katɔti, násu!”

Title: YESAIA 22
Content:
Básu Kenye Kadi Básiku Yerusalem Lɛlɔ
1Unwoti údie lɛla lɛdi ɔ́tina na Ala Bɔnu Kɔwɛ kemmo lɛlɔ.
Bi mɔɔlɛ́ku-mii ɔsu na bina ƒui bíkeli
bɛ́kɔ lɛtɔ eli na owogyo ɔda lɛni?
2Lɛlɔyɔ kudu kani nda ɔma umodi ɔmmɔ ƒui ku lɛsɛ.
Na bani na békpi ni, ɔɔɔdi kuwii kenye na békpi,
na ɔɔɔdi kekpokɔ lɛnɔ na bésie.
3Bina batɔnkune ƒui básala na békeli,
nsu béƒie-ma enu ku enu na ɔɔɔdi kuwii kenye,
ina ka béesie ɔgyu kakaaka.
Na bani ƒui na béƒie bénwini batɔntɛne.
4Ɔmmɔ ɔsu na lɛ́su nnini,
“Bɛkpɛ bɛlɛ-mi lɛlɔ na liwulo,
na ɔdi utasia-mi kɔnu
na mina bekyuli bani náyii udu ɔsu.”
5Unwoti Ɔyikune Ƒui limeyi lɛni na liƒu bonwu lɛdubuƒie bekyuli
na bakɛ beteetu lɛgba kalɔ taakɔ taayu ku bɔyia geen
na baaagyi lɛla lɛni na baabla ni,
ani na bɔɔnu na Ala Bɔnu Kɔwɔ kɔmɛni kemmo.
Na badubɔƒɛ awodu bewi kalɔ
na bekyuli bataava taakpali abi ka bebebunku-ma.
6Elam kadi bekyuli bálɛku bana atula aƒo keyi,
na bani nlie bapɔnkɔ kɛɛkɛ kemmo
ku bani nlie bapɔnkɔ lɛlɔ lɛnɔ báda bálɛ.
Na Kir kadi bekyuli bédie kayi bɔgyumana abuala keyi.
7Bekpone bani nlie bapɔnkɔ kɛɛkɛ kemmo
ku bani nlie bapɔnkɔ lɛlɔ báƒɔ ɔkwalɛ ɔmmɔ ƒui.
Na bapɔnkɔ beliene bammɔ benye kagyumana
na bina ɔma lɛban kenye.
8Báƒɛ ɔban ɔni na bágyi
bákya Yuda kalɔ ƒui mmɔ béwi kalɔ.
Na bina anu ásia ekpola ani nse kesii
kani na baalɔ Baga Kesii Lɛku mmɔ lɛlɔ.
9Bɛ́nu Yerusalem, Dawid ɔma unengudi ɔmmɔ awodu
kalɛ na áƒuaala ábla eƒi eƒi.
Ɔmmɔ ɔsu na bɛ́ƒɔ ntu bíwi libiɔ
lɛni na kada kakɛ mmɔ kemmo.
10Na bɛ́sia lɛtɔ lɛdi anu na bɛ́bwɛ-ni bíwi kalɔ
kalɛ na biti atabi ammɔ bɛsɔku bɛtu awodu
ani náaƒɛ áwɔlɔ ƒui mmɔ na asɔ enye kpakplaa.
11Bɛ́bla ntu kaƒɔkɔ aani akpambui bɛ́kya kalɔ kemmo
na ɔban awodu ammɔ ntɛ kalɛ
na bitaaƒɔ libiɔ lɛkukudi lɛmmɔ ntu teewi,
nsu bɛ́yiƒala Katɔti ɔni nábla lɛla lɛmɛni
iye anwu ɔni nákya kasusu kammɔ
úse ɔ́si kukuuku ƒui.
12Uwi ɔmmɔ ni, Unwoti Katɔti Ɔyikune Ƒui ɔ́lɔ-mii
ɔnii biwulo keku ku kɔnyana geen,
na bikpeyi bina eli na biti adikpi binyimi,
13Nsu bɛɛnu ka lɛlɔ mmomu mɔɔyɔ́-mii,
na bɛɛtɔ́ taaƒia taadi limeyi,
na bɛɛdú bebuo taakun na bɛɛdi na bɛɛní ntɛ!
Na bɛɛsu bɛnini,
“Bɛya bɔdi na bɔni,
ɔsika kɔnaadi bɔdubo bukpi.”
14Nsu Unwoti Ɔyikune Ƒui ɔ́su-mi ku mina atu nwaa ɔnini,
“Bɛdubo likpidi lɛmɛni kayu butaaƒɔ laa
útédu bina likpimeyi,
na lɛɛɛdubo kɔtu bɔni bɔmmɔ budie bina lɛlɔ.”
15Unwoti Ɔyikune Ƒui ɔ́tala-mi ɔ́kya Sebna ɔga kesii lɛlɔ ɔnune ɔnii ntéye-nwu ɔnini,
16“Sebna, bi na aabla mɛni?
Na ɔma néte-ɔ kuƒi ɔsu na aanwí kaƒiɔtɔ ete lɛlɔ,
na aakya-ka bɔdia lɛni
na katɔ mmɔ
na lɛtakpɛ lɛmmɔ kemmo?
17“Nu kaduɛ, ɔsika Unwoti ɔdubo ubada-a kpakplaa
na uƒuimi-ɔ utáva kalɔ momoomo
ina ɔni na aanu lɛlɔ ka ebo ɔyikun mɛni!
18Na ɔdubo-ɔ bɔmana bɔkono kunu kunu
na ubo-ɔ utáva kalɔ bɛbɛɛbɛ kadi lɛlɔ
na eminime esié etékpi na mmɔ.
Na bapɔnkɔ kɛɛkɛ buni ɔni kemmo na éteelie
ɔsu na áƒɔ lɛnyi ni, nwuna kawɔlɔkɔ kadi mmɔ.
Na ɔga ɔni kesii lɛlɔ na átaanu mmɔ anumi ewi kalɔ.
19Ndubukpeli-ɔ libo ƒula kabla kablakɔ,
na lɛƒɔ ƒula kenyekɔ lɛlɛku-ɔ enu kemmo.
20“Na limeyi lɛmmɔ ni, ndubɔlɔ mina kabla ɔblane Eliakim ɔni ndi Hilkia ubidi ka ubenye ƒula kenyekɔ. 21Ndubuti ƒula awu gyɔlɔɔ lɛkya-nwu, na liti ƒula kadii lɛbala-nwu kavobi, na liti ƒula lɛlɔ bɔdi ɔyikun ugyii lɛkya-nwu lɛkɔkɔ. Na anwu ndubunwini Yerusalem kadi bekyuli ku Yuda ɔtɔ kemmo bekyuli ƒui ɔti. 22Na ndubuti ɔtɔ lɛlɛmila ɔyikun likposela lɛsia-nwu lɛmangba, na ɔdubuti-ni ɔlɛmi Dawid lɛga kadikɔ kammɔ ɔtɔ biala. Na si ɔ́lɛmi ni, ukyuli biala ulakana bɔkalɛ. Na si ɔ́kalɛ lɛnɔ ni, ukyuli biala ulakana bɔlɛmi. 23Na ndubo-nwu bubo bɔlɛ kalɔ kpakplaa aani liwele. Na use aani lɛgaboku lɛni mbo lɛnyi ku ɔbu ute ɔti kaduli. 24Na anwu ndubɔya na nwuna ɔtɔ kemmo bekyuli ƒui bekeye ɔ́si bebi útédu bawɔ aani kalɛ na baaklibi kanwakɔ ala ƒui teese sɛɛn, ɔ́si ani na baaƒuƒwɛ útédu ani náƒɔ kuye lɛlɔ.
25“Ɔƒɛni si limeyi lɛni na lɛ́su líse mmɔ lídu ni, liwele lɛni na líbo lɛ́lɛ kalɔ mmɔ lɛdubo bɔkpa na ala ani nda-nwu lɛlɔ ku kɔbuli mmɔ adubukulo alɛ-nwu lɛlɔ. Unwoti násu.”

Title: YESAIA 23
Content:
Yesaia Ɔ́su Lɛla Lɛni Na Ɔ́nu Na Tiro Lɛlɔ
1Unwoti údie lɛla lɛdi ɔ́tina na Tiro lɛlɔ.
Amii Tarsis beyedine bani mɔɔsia ntu anumi ku lɛkɔlɔ
na bɛɛdi kuye teesie Tiro, biteewulo kɔnyana, ɔsika bákyula Tiro,
na ɔtɔ iye kabɛkɔ iye lɛkɔlɔ kalɛlɛkɔ kadi
kasɔ keeebo.
Beyedine bammɔ bénu kenye kamɛni
uwi ɔni na báyu bébedu ntuntɛ kalɔ kani baalɔ Kipro.
2Bɛbla kpoo ku kɔnyana, amii bani nli ɛpu kalɔ ƒiaa lɛlɔ,
ku amii Sidon beyedine lɛnɔ ƒui, na lɛla lɛni nébo ɔsu.
Bina batalane bávia ɛpu anumi ekpo ekpo
3na bakɛ ntukpa lidu lidu lɛlɔ.
Bésie bétédu Sihor ku Nil ntukpa bonwu lɛlɔ,
na beeyé edula lidu lidu ebi teeboku-mii.
Na Tiro mmɔ kénwini kuye kadikɔ bonwu
kéte bayawine ƒui.
4Kɔƒa kukpo-mii, amii Sidon beyedine
bani náƒɔ ɛpu ɔmmɔ ƒui anumi bilie-nwu lɛlɔ kpi,
nsu kɔsia kɔdi kútalɛ-nwu kemmo,
ɔsika ɛpu ɔmmɔ ɔlati mɔɔsu taatina ɔnini,
“Nse aani ukyuli ɔni na kawɔƒɔ kátadu-nwu kudii iye útawɔ kudii.
Na ńtada bakloƒu iye begblebi lɛnɔ dii.”
5Na si kenye kamɛni kétédu Egyipte
ka lɛni nébo Tiro lɛlɔ ni, kɔnyana kɔdubo-ma buƒie.
6Bikeli beteesie Tarsis,
na amii ntuntɛ kalɔ bekyuli beteewulo!
7Lɛlɔyɔ ku emeyi bɔdi ɔma ɔkukudi ɔmmɔ na ɔdi mɛni?
Ɔma ɔni bekyuli návi bésie ɔgyu geen náyii udu lɛni?
8Ɔyikune ɔmani kakwɛ ku kasusu náya
na ɔmɛni úbo Tiro lɛlɔ?
Ɔma ɔni kemmo na nka adubɔkɛ lɛla lɛla
na ukyuli ɔɔwia náta únwini lɛni?
Ɔma ɔni beyedine na bekyuli baabu
aani bekyuli batɔnkune ku lɛlɔ badine na ɔdi mɛni?
9Unwoti Katɔti Ɔyikune Ƒui nábla lɛla lɛmɛni udu,
kalɛ na ala ani lɛlɔ lɛmɛne bekyuli baakun
ka eekeye ayii udu.
Na bani na báƒɔ lɛnyi na kalɔ lɛnɔ mɛni uboku-ma kalɔ.
10Amii Tarsis kadi bekyuli bɛtuma bina kalɔ
kalɛ biala na bɛdubɔkana ina Nil bune,
ɔsika ásɔ eeebo beyedine lɛkɔlɔ kalɛlɛkɔ.
11Katɔti údie kɔnu na ɔ́tina nwuna ɔyikun
ɔni mɔɔdi ɛpu lɛlɔ, na ɔɔkunku kayawi lɛga kɔdikɔ ƒui.
Úbo ɔda ɔnii bekisine babwɛ Tiro
ɔma kɔgyumanakɔ kpakplaa ƒui.
12Na ɔ́sɔ ɔ́su ɔnini, “Ƒula lɛlɔyɔ ku emeyi bɔdi kenye kékulo.
Awɔ Sidon ɔma ɔbuni ɔni nse aani adagyaa,
ɔƒɛni amu áyii udu!
“Bɛta na bɛvia bisie Kipro,
nsu mmɔ muedi bɛɛɛdubo bɔkɛ bɔnwuna bɔdi.”
13Amii binwini bɛnu Babel.
Mmɔ kasɔ kaaadi keliekɔ buni kadi
Asiriaƒuɔ békpo-ma,
na mmɔ kénwini bakumbweyi keliekɔ.
Bátu kunyekɔ bámana awodu ammɔ
na bénye báƒɛ bana kɔgyumanakɔ kɔmmɔ ku awodu ammɔ ƒui,
na báyila lɛla biala udu na mmɔ.
14Na amii Tarsis lɛkɔlɔ beyedine biteewulo keku ku kɔnyana,
ɔsika bábwɛ bina kɔgyumanakɔ kpakplaa kɔmmɔ
na kɔ́yii udu!
15Na uwi ɔni kemmo na ala amɛni adubɔlɛ lɛni ni, bekyuli badubɔyiƒala Tiro akwa liti ku aavlanyɔ uwi ɔni na ɔga ɔkana na ulie ngba ɔdi lɛga. Nsu na akwa liti ku aavlanyɔ amɛni kama ni, bekyuli badubudie ɔnu bɔsia Tiro aani ɔyalɛ kalɛ.
16Na batu kɔgya banini,
“Ɔyalɛ ɔni nákɔ ligblebi dii,
sɔ ti ƒula ɔbentaa
na asɔ atu ƒula lɛnu mini mini lɛmmɔ avi ɔma,
na bekyuli kayi kasɔ kenwini kasia-a lɛlɔ
aani kalɛ na úse kuuku.”
17Na akwa liti ku aavlanyɔ ammɔ kama ni, Katɔti ɔdubɔbla ku Tiro lɛla lɛni na ɔɔyɔ́ na ɔya na basɔ benwini besie bana kabla kuuku kudɔ, na badi ku kayawi bekyuli ƒui kuye. 18Nsu na kawɔlɔkɔ ni, kɔsia kɔni na Tiro kadi bekyuli bamɛni bákɛ na bana kuye bɔdi kemmo ni, belému-nya belése lɛlɔ kani. Mmomu badubudie-ku bese sɛsɛɛ bete Unwoti na beti babla kabla na beye adala ku adila abuni bete bekyuli bani mɔɔbla Katɔti kabla.

Title: YESAIA 24
Content:
Unwoti Úbile Kalɔ Kammɔ
1Bɛnu, Katɔti ɔdubo kalɔ kammɔ ƒui bubile
na kana anumi kasɔ kaladia lɛla lɛla.
Na ɔdubɔbɔku bekyuli bammɔ ƒui ɔkya
kalɔ kammɔ ekpo ekpo.
2Na lɛla udu unwi ndubɔlɛku Katɔti bakpane
ku bekyuli bani na baatɔnku ƒui,
batɔlati ku bani mɔɔbla-ma kabla,
belekubi kabla bablane ku bana baduni,
ukyuli ɔni nti lɛla lɛdi uuyé ku ukyuli ɔni néye-ni,
ukyuli ɔni muuvó lɛla teete ukyuli
ku anwu ɔni névo-ni,
ukyuli ɔni bada kayu ku awɔ ɔni nda kayu kammɔ ƒui
lɛla linwi kani ndubo bana ƒui bɔlɛku.
3Kayawi kemodi kammɔ kadubo bubie ƒui kede kede
na lɛla lɛla lɛsɔ lilésie siin.
Lɛni na Unwoti Katɔti ɔ́su.
4Kalɔ kammɔ kadubɔkwii na lɛla biala lɛyɛyɛ,
na kɔnyana kuƒie lɛla biala na lɛyii udu.
5Bekyuli bébile kayawi kammɔ na keesé lɛlɔ.
Bátadi ɔda bubo bɔmmɔ lɛlɔ,
na báta bénye litemi lɛmmɔ lɛlɔ,
na bébile Katɔti bunyimi bɔni nnye nte uwi ƒui mmɔ.
6Ɔkɛnku ɔmmɔ ɔsu ni,
ewida ádi bekyuli ku kayawi ƒui lɛla biala lɛlɔ
na ɔdi biala ɔlɛka ubo abi na nwuna likpidi lili
na bekyuli bayawine
bákywi ƒui
na bana ɛlɛɛ kani nébu.
7Kɔbuli kɔni ebi muudie ntɛ kɔ́yɛyɛ
na bekyuli basɔ bebo ntɛ.
Ɔmmɔ ɔsu na bani na lɛlɔ
lɛɛyɔ́ ƒui
béduo kɔnyana na beedumo.
8Agyala kɔku kúkulo
na lɛlɔyɔ kudu kɔ́ba diin.
9Ntɛ kalɔ lɛnu lɛsɔ liiibo na beedie,
ɔsika butudi bɔni na banine baakya lɛlɔ ogya
bubo ɔdu butulo lɛla biala.
10Na bábwɛ ɔma ɔni kemmo
na ala bɔbla basa basa bɔ́ƒɔ-nwu mmɔ ƒui,
na bákalɛ kaduli biala kayakun
na bábala-ka bényene.
11Na kɔnyana keku ku kɔvanu kani nda
na ɔma kemmo lilu lɛlɔ ƒui
ka ntɛ bɔni na basɔ bani bataakɛ lɛlɔyɔ bɔsɔ buuubo ɔsu.
Na kayawi ebiti biala áyii ákya kede kede.
12Na lɛla biala líbie lɛ́yii udu
na ɔma umodi ɔmmɔ kemmo
na bétu kɔyakun kɔmmɔ ƒui
bégyingya na bébile
ala ƒui.
13Lɛni udu ndubɔƒɔ kayawi kemodi ku kadi ƒui bekyuli akɔ
aani kalɛ na edula udewi ɔɔví
na baƒiɛmi adingyii ammɔ ligyii kalɛ na ebi ani nábɛ
akya kɔgba akɔ lɛnɔ anu ewi kalɔ na bala.
14Na nkyuli ɛlɛɛ bani nébu mmɔ
báva momoomo ku lɛlɔyɔ básiku ɔƒɛ kanukɔ
na bédie Unwoti Katɔti lɛgadi ɔyikun keyi.
15Anwuɔsu bɛkɔliku Unwoti
lɛnyi katɔ,
na bimwi-nwu bɛsiku ɔƒɛ katukɔ
ku ɛpu ntuntɛ kɔlɔ ƒui.
Bibo Israel Unwoti Katɔti kudu.
16Binu bumwi lɛnu lɛni nda
ɔ́siku kayawi kawɔlɔkɔ ekpo ekpo ƒui,
úte Unwoti ɔni muukeye na use siin.
Nsu bɔbuɛ muute lɛlɔ,
ɔsika lɛlɔ kemmo kaanwá-mi ku kɔnyana,
na bani na bátaƒɔ bátadi bana taƒɔ tadi
ku ulikplu ala bɔbla ɔsu.
17Liƒu ala adubo-mii lɛlɔ bɔda bɔlɛ,
na bɛnu biduo libu kemmo
na kɔkpagyuɛ lɛnɔ kudie amii kalɔ lɛlɔ bekyuli ƒui.
18Na ukyuli ɔni menu liƒu lɛla lɛdi kɔku
na ɔnii uukeli ɔdubɔnu uduo ubu kemmo.
Na si ɔnii ɔɔkɔ́ ɔlɛ ubu ɔmmɔ kemmo lɛnɔ
kakpagyuɛ kadubo-nwu budie.
Kayaa kálɛmi kɔnakunwi
ku ntu yoo
aani kalɛ na baalɛmi ntu kayakun
na kalɔ kammɔ ɔka ɔni nkya-nwu kalɔ ɔ́kunku.
19Kayawi kammɔ kábwɛ na kéle ntɛ eku eku
na kégyingya kéwi kalɔ
na ɔni na bákunku-ka kpakplaa geen ɔsu.
20Kayawi kemodi kammɔ ƒui kágbanta késela
aani ntɛ ukpine.
Na use aani kabwa kani na ɔƒɛƒɛɛ ɔdanku ɔɔvínku,
na nwuna atuɔkplu ku litemi lɛlɔ tadi
únwini etila asia-nwu lɛlɔ, na ánya-nwu ámana
na ɔsɔ ɔɔɔdubo bɔkana bɔta.
21Na limeyi lɛmmɔ lɛlɔ ni,
Unwoti ɔdubɔni kayaa bayikune kɔtu
na katɔ mmɔ,
na ɔni kalɔ lɛlɔ baga lɛnɔ kɔtu na kalɔ lɛlɔ mɛni.
22Na badubuƒie batuɔkplune bammɔ ƒui
na bakya-ma ɔtɔ na bebo-ma lɛkpu bese na ubu kemmo
utédu ka bátɛku-ma litemi
na bani-ma kɔtu na emeyi pii adi kama.
23Na kadi ƒui Unwoti ɔdubɔdi lɛga
na Sion Kɔbi lɛlɔ ku Yerusalem ku bana benengu ƒui anumi
na udie nwuna lɛgadi
bukeye keyi.
Na nwuna bukeye bɔya na kɔbuli ku ɔƒɛ bukeye
bɔbla suu aani kalɛ na kɔƒa kuukpó ukyuli.

Title: YESAIA 25
Content:
Bemwi Unwoti
1O Unwoti, awɔ ndi mina Katɔti,
ndubumwi-ɔ na lɛkɔliku ƒula lɛnyi katɔ,
ɔsika ádi ƒula etemila lɛlɔ
na ábla ala ebendi geen ani ndi ulu
ɔni na áta ése ɔ́si kukuuku.
2Na awɔ nábwɛ ɔma unengudi
ɔni na bátu awodu
bámana mmɔ
na ásala-nwu lisu álɛ
aani kebu.
Ɔma ɔni na kemmo na báƒɔ béyi-nwu mmɔ ni,
awɔ nábwɛ-nwu
na ɔsɔ ɔɔɔdi ɔma
na ɔdi ɔnu ɔti ka ɔ́kya dii.
Na basɔ balakana-nwu bɔsɔku bɔtu lɛnɔ kudii.
3Ɔmmɔ ɔsu kadi kani bekyuli mbo ɔyikun
badubuti ɔbu bete-ɔ.
Na bani lɛnɔ mɔɔdi bekyuli lɛlɔ
na baanya-ma taakya badubo-ɔ lili kalɔ butaakya
na ƒula ɔyikun bonwu ɔsu.
4Katamikukɔ kpakplaa na adi ete bawabane
ku bani mɔɔyaki ala na baanya-ma taakya.
Na adi kabɛkɔ ku ɔyuli ete-ma si kadi kaabi
éte bani na ala eekpóku-ma geen.
Ɔsika balalane bammɔ kɔnyi kuse
aani kalɛ na ɔƒɛƒɛɛ kpakplaa uuƒwimi ala
taatáƒiɛni kowodu lɛlɔ.
5Na úlie ku kɔnwinimi kalɔ kakwiidi lɛlɔ liwulu.
Na baƒɔ bani ndi Israelƒuɔ bekisine mmɔ ni,
aabala-ma bɔkwanyi ku lɛsɛ lɛni na baakya
aani kalɛ na liƒlukutu ɔyuli ɔɔyala liwulu biala kenye
na babla kpoo.
6Na Sion Kɔbi kɔmɛni lɛlɔ ni,
Unwoti Ɔyikune Ƒui ɔdubɔlɔ bekyuli ƒui limeyi buni kadikɔ.
Na use adila abuni geen ute-ma
ku lɛna ku ntɛ bɔbuni ƒui geen.
7Na kɔbi kɔmɛni lɛlɔ ni,
na ala ani béti bákwa bekyuli ƒui lɛlɔ
aani ukpine kɔvadi bébo báda-ma lɛlɔ ni,
Unwoti ɔdubo-nya bɔmami budie
ku aduni ani nda-ma lɛlɔ ƒui.
8Ɔdubɔyila kukpi aani kalɛ na beebweli lɛla lɛdi
na kɔsɔ kulakya lɛnɔ kudii.
Unwoti Katɔti ɔdubuni imii udie ukyuli biala anumi
na kɔƒa kɔni muukpó nwuna bekyuli
kɔdubukeli ƒui kede kede
na kayawi kemodi kammɔ kemmo,
ɔsika Unwoti ɔlati násu
ɔmɛni úse.
9Na limeyi lɛmmɔ lɛlɔ na bekyuli ƒui badubɔsu banini,
“Sɔsɔ geen ni, bula Unwoti Katɔti ɔmmɔ na ɔdi mɛni.
Anwu na bunye bɔɔnu ulu teete ka ubaƒɔ-bu.
Bɛɛnu Unwoti ɔmmɔ, bɛya na lɛlɔ litaayɔ-bu
na bɔkɛ ebiti geen na kalɛ na úbo ubaƒɔ ɔsu.”
10Unwoti ɔlati kɔnu kɔdubɔgyumana kɔbi kɔmɛni.
Nsu badubɔnya Moab kadi bekyuli ama bakya
aani kalɛ na bebuo baanya keti taakya libi akɔ.
11Na beteebo enu ka balɛ mmɔ
aani kalɛ na ukyuli ɔni muubumo ketu uubó enu.
Nsu ina bi na bana enu aata
ala lɛlɔ
na bebo kɔkwɛ muedi ni,
Unwoti ɔdubo-ma bɔyila na bana lɛlɔtina
ku ulikplu ala bɔbla ɔsu.
12Na ɔdubɔƒɔ bana awodu
ani na bátu bámana bana kalɔ
na atɛ kalɔ na utu-nya
ɔ́bwɛ kpɛtɛ kpɛtɛ
unwini ɔtumu.

Title: YESAIA 26
Content:
Bátu Bumwi Ɔnu
11Na limeyi lɛmmɔ lɛlɔ ni, badubɔtu kɔgya kɔmɛni na Yuda badubɔtu ɔnu bedie banini,
“Ɔƒɛni amu bɔ́kɛ kagyumanakɔ ɔma unengudi kpakplaa.
Na Katɔti ɔ́ya na awodu ku awodu akpa
ani náka ámana-nwu adi ngba bɔƒɔ.
2Bɛlɛmi ɔban kɔyakun kɔmmɔ,
na kadi bani bekyuli nse siin beduo.
Ama bani náƒɔ bádi na bada bɔƒɔtaadi bɔmmɔ.
3Ukyuli ɔni na nwuna anu
ku kasusu kasia-a lɛlɔ kpakplaa ni,
adubɔda-nwu kɔkɔɔkɔ na uulie na atu bɔyɔ kemmo,
ɔsika ƒula lɛlɔ na úkpo kama.
4Ti ƒula anu ƒui sia Unwoti lɛlɔ uwi ƒui,
ɔsika anwu ndi kama kekpokɔ lɛtakpɛ
lɛni nnye uwi ƒui.
5Na bekyuli bani mɔɔkɔliku lɛlɔ katɔ ni,
uuboku-ma kalɔ.
Na lɛma linengudi lɛni bekyuli
mɔɔnu lɛlɔ katɔ katɔ ni,
uutú-ni teegyingya
na lɛɛbla kpɛtɛ kpɛtɛ
teenwini ɔtumu.
6Lɛgba na badubɔnya mmɔ bavi
na bawabane ku bekyuli
bani mmomu na baanya taakya
ndubɔkɔ-ma lɛlɔ bavi.”
7O Ati ɔni nse kedee,
bekyuli bani ablala nse siin ni,
bana kasiakɔ biala kaatɛ
kalɔ ƒiaa.
Na bana kɔvinkɔ ni,
aayá na kɔɔbla suɛlɛ suɛlɛ.
8Unwoti, ka aatɛ litemi siin
ɔsu ni,
bunye bɔɔnu-ɔ ulu,
ɔsika bɔɔwia ka buteemwi-ɔ lɛnyi kedee
na butaabla-a lɛyɔla
uwi ndi uwi.
9Mɔɔwia-a kpakplaa usien umodi,
na ɔtanta ni, ƒula kɔka kɔɔda mina kɔyu.
Ɔsika si átɛku bayawine
litemi ni,
kayawi bekyuli baatɛya kalɛ na babla ƒula lɛyɔla.
10Si ina bi lɛƒɔndia na ábla belikplune ni,
baaadubo bɔti kalɛ na baabla ala siin.
Kesii kani na siin bɔbla bɔkya muedi ni,
ama likpidi bɔbla lilu lɛlɔ kani na baasia uwi ndi uwi
na balánu kalɛ na Unwoti úbomo
na uukeye lɛnɔ taati.
11O Unwoti, áakɔliku ƒula
kɔnu ése ka
ebo-ma na ani-ma kɔtu,
nsu balánu taati.
Unwoti, ya na bekyuli bamɛni banu bati
kalɛ na anumi égyie-ɔ
ka agyumana ƒula kadi bekyuli
na kɔƒa kukpo-ma.
Na aya na ogya ɔni na áklibi ése
ka ɔkyula ƒula bekisine ubakyula-ma.
12O Unwoti ya na bulie
na atu bɔyɔ kemmo,
ɔsika ɔkɛnku ƒula ɔyikun kemmo
na bɔ́kana na bɔ́bla ala ani na bɔ́bla.
13O Unwoti bula Katɔti,
benwoti bamba báadi-bu lɛlɔ na ƒula kama
nsu awɔ ƒula lɛnyi kani na buudie kenye teemwi.
14Na bekyuli bani kabla na bɔ́bla ƒui béekpi báyii udu
na basɔ baaadubo bɔta
bubo mɛni!
Awɔ nékpo-ma na áyila-ma
udu ƒui
na bekyuli báyiƒala-ma.
15Nsu abu ni, Unwoti,
áya na búmomo búbu na ƒula lɛnyi líkeye.
Bula kalɔ lɛmii lísie kama líbu
na bula kalɔ kábɛbɛ kébu.
16Unwoti, uwi ɔni na lɛbibo lɛ́siaku-bu
na bɔ́ɔnɔ na bula lɛtuni kemmo ni,
bɔ́wia-a kama ulu.
17Búse aani uleku ɔni na ɔtɛ kɔwɔ
na uubó adi ka kawɔƒɔ kaadu-nwu.
Na lɛni na bɔ́da bɔ́lɛ awɔ Unwoti anumi.
18Bɔ́kali bɔnii bula lɛbibo lɛdubɔlɛ-bu kɔsia
aani kalɛ na ɔƒɔndane ɔni na ɔtɛ kɔwɔ
ɔɔwɔ ubi, nsu únwini lɛƒua.
Bútakana na bukpo bɔƒɔ kalɔ na bekisine kudɔ.
Na bútakana kayawi kadi bekyuli bammɔ lɛnɔ lɛlɔ bɔdi.
19Nsu bani na badi awɔ badi ina ka békpi ni,
badubɔsɔ bata ku bana ɔlɔna na belie ngba.
O amii bani nkya kaƒiɔtɔ kemmo,
bɛta na bidie lɛnu ku lɛlɔyɔ!
Ɔsika ɔtanta amii na adi muuwi-mii lɛlɔ.
Na kalɔ kammɔ kadubo
kana bekpine bammɔ bɔwɔ bɔlɛku mmɔ.
20Mina bekyuli, bɛgyu lɛgba
na bitákalɛ lɛlɔ bɛkya lɛtɔ
wetédu ka Unwoti kɔnyi kɔni ala
na ɔdubo bina bekisine
bɔbla kɔ́vi.
21Ɔsika Unwoti ɔ́si ɔdubo
na ubani kayawi bekyuli
ƒui kɔtu
na bana ekpidi ɔsu.
Na kalɔ kammɔ kadubɔsu
ubugya ɔni na bekyuli bádu béwi-ka lɛlɔ.
Na ɔsɔ ulakana ɔdi bɔbɛla lɛnɔ.

Title: YESAIA 27
Content:
Katɔti Údie Israel Kadi Bekyuli
1Na kɔnyi limeyi lɛmmɔ lɛlɔ ni,
Unwoti ɔdubo ku nwuna kewii bonwu
kani mbo ɔkplu na kebo ɔbi yayaaya,
na ɔni bayikune bani ntulo ƒui mmɔ kɔtu.
Ada bonwu ɔni muukeli,
na ɔɔkono lɛlɔ taatu teetéwi,
ku liƒu kebweyi bonwu kani na ɛpu kemmo,
na badi bayikune mmɔ na ɔdubo bɔdu ƒui.
2Na limeyi lɛmmɔ lɛlɔ ni,
Unwoti ɔdubɔsu ɔnini,
“Bidie ɔnu na egyiibi kemo
kani mɔɔnwu kaduɛ mɛni lɛlɔ.
3Bɛsu ka ami Unwoti mɔɔnu kemo kammɔ lɛlɔ.
Na muuwi-ka ntu uwi ndi uwi
na mɔɔgyumana-ka lɛnɔ usien ku ɔƒɛ
kalɛ na ukyuli ɔdi ulésie uletébile-ka.
4Ńtakɛ kɔnyi na kemo kammɔ lɛlɔ.
Ɔsika si bekisine badi-mi
aani liyu ku alakpigya ni,
nka ndubuduo-ma lɛlɔ mmɔ na lɛkyula-ma ƒui.
5Na si use lɛni na békeli bébekpi-mi kɔtɔ
na báwia ka buwi kenye ntu
na bɔbla unwi ni, ɔdia-ma utulo.”
6Uwi ɔdubo ɔni mina kadi bekyuli
badubo ligyiitu budie na Israel kadi bamɛni
badubo bɔta na bedie evete
na banwu ebi pii beyile kayawi.
7Bɔni na Unwoti ɔ́ni Israelƒuɔ kɔtu
kalɛ na ɔ́ni bana bekisine kɔtu?
Munuu ɔ́du-ma kalɛ na ɔ́du bekyuli
bani nádu Israelƒuɔ?
8Kekpo ku bana bɔbɔku taatákya kɔlɔ bamba kemmo
ndi lɛla lɛni na éti ékpoku-ma
aani ɔƒɛƒɛɛ kpakplaa ɔni muukpó taasi ɔƒɛ katukɔ
na uubó ala taatɔlɔku.
9Na ɔkɛnku ɔmɛni lɛlɔ
na ndubudie kɔtu bɔni
bana lɛlɔ
na bana ekpidi ammɔ alɛ-ma lɛlɔ ƒui.
Na lɛnɔ ni, ntu bábwɛ akpabi
ani na bátu ku atabi mmɔ kpɛtɛ kpɛtɛ.
Na babwɛ Asera baƒiɔ na bagyu-ma
ku lɛƒiɔgyii lɛmmɔ na abi lɛlɔ
kesii kani na baakyula oloƒui teete-ma mmɔ ƒui
na basɔ balanu ka ɔdi unye.
10Na Israel lɛma linengudi
lɛni na bátu bámana mmɔ ƒui
asɔ elénu kɔku kɔdi nina kemmo,
ɔsika badubɔda lɛma ku kɔduli kɔmmɔ bewi
na kɔkwɛ livo ɔbla aani kalɔ kakwiidi
kesii kani na bebuo baaví
na beekpeli egyii evete taakun taatɛ mmɔ
na evete asa kɔgba kɔmmɔ lɛlɔ.
11Na si egyii ammɔ kɔgba
kɔ́kwii ni,
kɔɔƒɛ na beleku babayɔ-ku basala ogya.
Ɔsika lɛni na Israel kadi bekyuli bamɛni bese
na belenu na balanu ala taati.
Anwuɔsu na bana udiene lɛnɔ
ɔɔɔdubo-ma kɔnyana bɔnu.
12Nsu ni, uwi ɔdi ɔdubo ɔni na Unwoti ɔdubo-mii bubo kedenkɛ lɛlɔ na ɔla-mii unwi unwi ɔsiku Euƒrate Ketu kɔtu na ɔƒɛ katukɔ útédu Egyipte utukwalɛ kalɔ na ɔƒɛ kanukɔ aani kalɛ na beebó kamu na kedenkɛ lɛlɔ teewiile-ka ebi. 13Na badubɔvwi lise bete bani na báyii bakya Asiria kalɔ lɛlɔ ku bani na bábɔku bálɛku Egyipte kalɔ lɛlɔ na limeyi lɛmmɔ lɛlɔ na bebo bebemwi Unwoti na kɔbi kedee kɔmmɔ lɛlɔ na Yerusalem.

Title: YESAIA 28
Content:
Eƒraim Lɛbibo
1Bɔbuɛ beete Eƒraim ntɛ banine
bani nti lɛlɔtina lɛka aani kagabwa,
na lɛkɛ ku ala abuni
ani na baanu ka Israel
ubo ɔsu.
Baasíku ala amɛni na ɔkwalɛ ɔni nélie lɛmwi
na kesii kani na baabla-nya mmɔ,
na baaní ntɛ bɔmmɔ teekpi.
Nsu ala ammɔ aayii udu,
aani kalɛ na egyii anwula aayɛyɛ kalɛ.
2Bɛnu, Unwoti ɔdanku ukyuli ɔni na úbomo,
na ubo ɔyikun ku ɔlɔkplu,
aani etubankɛ ku ɔnantu ku ɔƒɛƒɛɛ kpakplaa
ɔni muubile ala, na ɔdubo ubetiku-ma ku kɔnyi.
3Na lɛlɔtina lɛka kagabwa kani na beti ni,
bekyuli badubɔkɔ banya-ka lɛlɔ bavi.
4Na nwuna bɔdia bɔni muukeye
nsu uuubo bɔyɛyɛ
na ɔkwalɛ ɔni nélie lɛmwi
mmɔ ni,
útavumana ku kɔnwingyie ebi ani mɔɔka bugyie.
Na si ukyuli ɔdi ɔ́nu-nya
na ɔɔkpɔɔlɔ-nya ɔdi udie kɔnakunwi.
5Si uwi ɔni na ala amɛni álɛ lɛni áwɔlɔ ni,
Unwoti ɔni ndi kadi ƒui Unwoti
ɔdubunwini kagabwa kani muukeye
ku lɛka lɛni bédi na lɛɛdia bɔnu
na nwuna nkyuli ɛlɛɛ bani mebu lili.
6Na ɔdubunwini kɔyu kɔni mɔɔtɛ litemi siin
ute bani mɔɔtɛ bekyuli etemila.
Na anwu ɔmmɔ ndubɔbla ɔlɔkplu ku ɔyikun
ute bani nnye ɔban kenye ka babɔku kekpo biala.
7Na Katɔti bakpane ku Katɔti kenye bediene ƒui
benye baabla ntɛ ekpila na ntɛ kpakplaa bɔni ɔsu.
Na baagbánta si baanu kɔyu kemmo ala
iye baadi kasusu kpakplaa kadi na lɛla lɛdi lɛlɔ.
Na ntɛ bɔ́ya na béƒu bakɛ.
8Bana ala kasiakɔ ƒui kɔdala sɔɔn náƒɔ-ku
na kesii kadi kétebu
na kɔbɔ ala
ani muusé lɛlɔ átaƒɔ mmɔ.
9“Na ɔma bene na ɔdubo ala bɔtina?
Na ɔma bene na uudie ala kalɔ taatina?
Bani mɔɔnyimi lɛnyii
munuu bani na basia lɛgba?
10Unye ɔɔká ɔda bubo bɔmmɔ taasia kama
egyu egyu kɔlɛ kɔlɛ.”
11Na ka banii belénu litemi ɔsu ni,
kadi bamba bekyuli na Unwoti ɔdubɔya
na babatɛmi bete-ma.
12Ɔsika anwu ɔlati ɔ́su-ma ka bekyuli bani ƒui
na lɛla lɛdi liikpóku ni, bebo-nwu kudɔ
na badubɔkɛ bɔnwuna, nsu béni na belenu.
13Ɔmmɔ ɔsu béti Unwoti ɔda bubo
aani litemi keeke ku ala bɔka taasia kama
egyu egyu banii bla lɛmɛni ku lɛni ngyie kani.
14Anwuɔsu binu, amii bani mɔɔdi bekyuli lɛlɔ,
na bɛda Katɔti litemi bɛɛƒianku na Yerusalem.
15Bɛɛkun lɛmɛnɛ taasu bɛnini,
“Abu ku kukpi bínyimi ka kɔsɔ kuládu-bu,
na bɔsɔ buleduo kaƒiɔtɔ kemmo
